hero.sub: Omufuzi w'okuzuula & okukakasa ku mutimbagano gwa Vortex peer-to-peer. Okuggula. Ensirifu. Tekiziyizibwa.

network.label: NETWORK .
network.body: Buli munne alina endagamuntu eriko omukono. Bakasitoma bakakasa nga tebannayunga, nodes zikakasa obwannannyini ku kwewandiisa. Tewali kitongole kya wakati kiyinza kujingirira ebyo cryptography bye yakakasa edda.
network.dual_body: Ewandiisiddwa ne controller AND essiddwa ku lujegere ng’eyita mu Solana. Abajulizi babiri abetongodde bakakasa code hash ne pubkey. Safe for sensitive sessions.
network.ctrl_body: Omukono gukakasa nti node erina ekisumuluzo kyayo eky'ekyama, naye obulungi bwa koodi tebunywezeddwa ku lujegere. Fine ku session ezisinga obungi; akabi = okwesiga omukozi afuga.
network.unverif_body: Emanyiddwa okuva ku config oba olugambo. Tewali bukakafu bwa cryptographic n'okutuusa kati. Kozesa kwokka bootstrap olukalala lwa banno — never nga handoff target for live sessions.

security.label: SECURITY .
security.body: Ebisumuluzo bina ebyetongodde Ed25519, nga buli kimu kirina omulimu gumu omufunda. Okukkaanya ekisumuluzo kyonna ekimu tekimenya birala.
security.controller_verified: Bakasitoma — okuva ku SNS oba okuzimba pin
security.step1_d: Soma vortexx.sol ku lujegere. Ebiwandiiko ebissiddwako emikono Wallet ya Solana — tekisoboka DNS-hijack.
security.step2_d: Kasitoma akubira essimu /v1/integrity. Egaana okuddamu kwonna okuggyako status: verified okuva ku kisumuluzo ky'okufulumya ekissiddwako ppini.
security.step3_d: Buli API essimu ekomawo {payload, sig, signed_by}. Kasitoma akakasa omukono gwa Ed25519 nga tannaba kwesiga.
security.step4_d: Ennyiriri ezisiddwako akabonero: kasitoma asoma code_hash okuva mu registry ya Solana. Divergence okuva ku controller = enkalakkalira ku lukalala oluddugavu.
security.check_auth: Obutuufu bw'okuddamu — tekisoboka kujingirira /v1/nodes awatali kisumuluzo kya kyama kya mufuzi.
security.check_integrity: Code integrity — fayiro z’omufuzi ziteekebwako hashed era ne zikeberebwa ku buli ntandikwa. Okukyusakyusa kuzzaayo 503 nga tebannaba kuweereza kalippagano konna.
security.check_identity: Node identity — nodes zirina okussa omukono ku kwewandiisa n'ekisumuluzo kyazo. Omulumbaganyi tayinza kwewandiisa ku lwa pubkey ya node endala.
security.check_dns: DNS okukuuma okuwamba — .sol records butereevu ku Solana. Omulabe yeetaaga okukosa waleti, so si muwandiisi wa DNS yekka.
security.check_handoff: Obukuumi bw'okukozesa emikono — okukyusa sessions kutwala tokens eziriko omukono gwa Ed25519 nga zirina anti-replay, ezikola eddakiika 5 zokka. Target egaanyi ensonda ezitamanyiddwa.
security.check_transport: Eby’ekyama mu by’entambula — omukutu URL ogulabika eri ISP / Cloudflare yo. Kozesa endabirwamu ya Tor singa metadata eba nsonga.
security.check_content: Ebiri mu bubaka — NOT ebikwatibwako omufuzi. End-to-end encrypted wakati w'abakozesa. Controller tasobola kusoma kintu kyonna ne bwe kiba nga kikoseddwa mu bujjuvu.
security.check_host: Host OS / kernel — singa VPS eba efunye emirandira, ebisumuluzo bisobola okubbibwa. Kozesa okussa omukono okuyambibwako hardware ku kuteeka mu nkola paranoid.

access.label: ACCESS .
access.body: Ebifo ebingi ebiyingira bitegeeza nti tewali kitongole kimu kiyinza kuziyiza kuyingira kwo. Emikutu gy’endabirwamu giweereza ebirimu bye bimu ebiteekeddwako emikono okuva mu bikozesebwa ebyetongodde.
access.tunnel_body: Endagiriro ya *.trycloudflare.com ey'obwereere. Tekyetaagisa akawunti. URL ekyuka nga tunnel eddamu okutandika — kitwale nga ephemeral.
access.tor_body: .endagiriro y’obutungulu, etuukirirwa ng’oyita mu Tor yokka. Censor-proof ne metadata-private, naye nga zigenda mpola. Yeetaaga kasitoma wa Tor.
access.ipfs_body: Kopi eriko endagiriro y'ebirimu eya static frontend. Omulyango gwonna ogwa IPFS gusobola okuguweereza — tewali seva emu okuzibira.
access.direct_body: Domain eya bulijjo + TLS. Ekyokulonda ekisinga amangu. Blockable ku DNS/IP level — okugwa okudda ku balala singa censored.
access.mirrors_body: Host endala eziweereza ebirimu ebiteekeddwako omukono bye bimu ddala n'omufuzi ono. Buli ndabirwamu enoonyezebwa buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera — akabonero aka kiragala kitegeeza nti esobola okutuusibwako mu ddakiika 5 ezisembayo. Endabirwamu za Tor .onion teziyinza kukeberebwa bulamu nga tezirina Tor proxy ya wano.

start.label: GET STARTED .
start.step1: Teeka Vortex ku kyuma kyo — ku ssimu oba ku kompyuta.
start.step2: Londa Global mode y'omukutu mu mugezi w'okuteekawo.
start.step3: Teeka controller URL (auto-resolved via SNS) oba entry yonna URL okuva ku lupapula lw'Ebiyingizibwa.
start.step4: Kakasa nti pubkey mu app yo ekwatagana n'engalo ya controller wansi. Obutakwatagana kitegeeza kukyusakyusa.
start.step5: Olina akakwate. Olukalala lwa node, emikono, n'okuyisa ekkubo bikwatibwa automatically.
start.fingerprint_note: Pin ekisumuluzo kino mu kasitoma wo nga tonnaba kwesiga kuddamu kwonna.

treasury.label: TREASURY & REWARDS .
treasury.transparency_body: Ebisale byonna ebya protocol — ebisale bya node register n’okusalako ebitundu 20% ku premium subscriptions — bikulukuta mu waleti y’eggwanika ku Solana. Buli nkolagana ekakasibwa mu lujjudde omuntu yenna.
treasury.rewards_body: Ebitundu 70% ku buli premium sub bigenda mu rewards pool, egabibwa pro-rata eri active node operators. Ebitundu 20% biwa ssente enkulaakulana enkulu. 10% eyokya oba etuula nga yinsuwa.

gravitixDocs.title: Gravitix Ekiwandiiko ky’Olulimi
gravitixDocs.subtitle: Olulimi lw'okuwandiika olukola obulungi olw'okuzimba bots. 96 ebifaananyi. Rust backend.
gravitixDocs.introDesc: Gravitix lulimi olukwata ku domain (DSL) olukoleddwa okuva wansi okuwandiika Vortex bots. Ennimi endala we zeetaaga amaterekero g’ebitabo, okuddamu okuyita, ne boilerplate, Gravitix ekuwa abakwata emikolo egy’omutindo ogusooka, okutambula kw’emboozi, n’embeera ezimbiddwamu — byonna mu nsengeka ennyonjo, esomebwa nga eluŋŋamizibwa Rust.
gravitixDocs.goalReadable: Readable — code esoma nga intent, so si byuma
gravitixDocs.goalSafe: Safe — ebika ebitali bikyuka bikwata ensobi nga tebannaba kukola
gravitixDocs.goalExpressive: Okwolesebwa — okukulukuta, abakuumi, n’okukwatagana kw’emisono bizimbibwamu
gravitixDocs.goalMinimal: Minimal — tewali bibiina, tewali busika, tewali nkola za kuyiga
gravitixDocs.whoDesc: Gravitix ya muntu yenna ayagala okuzimba Vortex bot mu bwangu — oba towandiikangako code, oba oli seasoned developer akooye Python boilerplate. Ekiwandiiko kino kisomesa Gravitix okuva ku misingi egisooka: tekyetaagisa bumanyirivu nga bukyali.
gravitixDocs.howToReadDesc: Buli kitundu kizimba ku ebyo ebyasooka. Bw’oba ​​mupya mu kukola pulogulaamu, soma okuva waggulu okutuuka wansi. Bw’oba ​​omanyi dda olulimi olulala, kozesa ebirimu okubuuka butereevu ku ekyo ekikunyumira.
gravitixDocs.quickStartDesc: Ekkubo erisinga okusimbula okuva ku ziro okutuuka ku bot edduka.
gravitixDocs.whatHappenedDesc: ku /start { ... } — etegeeza omukwasi akola ng'omukozesa asindika /start. emit "..." — esindika obubaka okudda eri omukozesa. {ctx.first_name} — eyingiza erinnya ly'omukozesa erisooka mu lunyiriri.
gravitixDocs.runningDesc: Mu Gravitix IDE, nyweza ku bbaatuuni ya Run mu bbaala eya waggulu. Yingiza Vortex Bot Token yo nga osabiddwa. Bot etandika mangu — tewali mutendera gwa kuzimba gwetaagibwa.
gravitixDocs.syntaxDesc: Buli pulogulaamu ya Gravitix ezimbiddwa okuva mu bizimbe bisatu ebikulu: handlers, emit statements, ne logic.
gravitixDocs.typesDesc: Buli muwendo mu Gravitix gulina ekika. Enkola y'ekika tekyukakyuka: ebika bikeberebwa mu kiseera ky'okukung'aanya, nga bot yo tennatambula.
gravitixDocs.operatorsDesc: Abaddukanya emirimu bagatta emiwendo okufulumya emiwendo emipya.
gravitixDocs.stringsDesc: Ennyiriri mu Gravitix biwandiiko ebiriko enkodi ya UTF-8. Ziwagira okuyingiza obugagga n’ekibinja ky’emirimu egyazimbibwamu.
gravitixDocs.stringOperations: Emirimu gy'emiguwa nga giyita mu bizimbibwa
gravitixDocs.matchDesc: Pattern-match omuwendo ku patterns eziwera. Kilowoozeeko nga sitatimenti ya switch ey’amaanyi.
gravitixDocs.functionsDesc: Emirimu giba bulooka za koodi eziddamu okukozesebwa. Zikuyamba okwewala okuddiŋŋana n’okukwanguyira okutegeera koodi.
gravitixDocs.eventHandlersDesc: Abakwate gwe mutima gwa Gravitix bot. Buli mukwasi awuliriza ekika ky'ekintu ekigere era adduka ng'ekintu ekyo kibaddewo.
gravitixDocs.guardDesc: Abakuumi bakuleka okwongerako akakwakkulizo ku mukwasi. Omukwasi adduka singa omukuumi yeekenneenya ku kituufu.
gravitixDocs.contextDesc: Ekintu kya ctx kibeerawo munda mu buli mukwasi. Kirimu ebikwata ku bubaka obuliwo kati n’omukozesa eyabuweereza.
gravitixDocs.stateDesc: State ereka bot yo okujjukira ebintu wakati w'obubaka. Awatali state, buli bubaka bwetongodde era bot terina memory.
gravitixDocs.flowsDesc: Flows zikusobozesa okuwandiika emboozi ez’emitendera mingi mu ngeri ya linear, esomebwa. Flow esobola okuyimirirako katono n'erinda obubaka bw'omukozesa obuddako.
gravitixDocs.emitDesc: Okusindika obubaka kye kisinga okufuluma mu bot.
gravitixDocs.schedulingDesc: Dukanya code automatically ku schedule — tewali mirimu gya cron, tewali mpeereza za bweru zeetaagibwa.
gravitixDocs.atSpecificTime: ku — okudduka mu kiseera ekigere eky’olunaku
gravitixDocs.pipeDesc: Omukozi wa payipu |> ayisa omuwendo nga ensonga esooka eri omulimu oguddako. Kifuula emirimu gy’okusiba enjegere okusomebwa, okuva ku kkono okudda ku ddyo.
gravitixDocs.errorDesc: Gravitix egaba okukwata ensobi okutegekeddwa nga try / catch / finally blocks.
gravitixDocs.structsDesc: Structs ekusobozesa okugatta data ekwatagana wansi w'ekika ekituumiddwa erinnya. Enums zitegeeza ekibinja ekiggaddwa eky’enjawulo.
gravitixDocs.mathDesc: Gravitix esindika etterekero ly'okubala eririmu emirimu ~180.
gravitixDocs.complexDesc: Gravitix erina ekika ekizibu enzaaliranwa — pair ya 64-bit floats ezikiikirira ebitundu ebituufu n’eby’okulowooza.
gravitixDocs.calculusDesc: Gravitix erimu calculus y’omuwendo: ebivaamu n’ebisengekeddwa ebibalirirwa ku mirimu egy’okwesalirawo.
gravitixDocs.linearAlgebraDesc: Linear algebra ye kubala kwa vekita ne matriksi.
gravitixDocs.numberTheoryDesc: Endowooza y’ennamba esoma eby’obugagga bya namba enzijuvu. Omusingi gw’okuwandiika ebikusike eby’omulembe.
gravitixDocs.statisticsDesc: Ebibalo biwa ebikozesebwa okunnyonnyola, okwekenneenya, n’okusalawo okuva mu biwandiiko.
gravitixDocs.specialDesc: Emirimu egy’enjawulo bye bigonjoola ensengekera za ddiferensi ezikulu.
gravitixDocs.gammaRelated: Gamma & emirimu egyekuusa ku nsonga eno
gravitixDocs.fftDesc: Enkyukakyuka ya Fourier evunda siginiini mu firikwensi zaayo ezigikola.
gravitixDocs.bp3: Kozesa abakuumi mu kifo kya if-chains okufuna olukusa
gravitixDocs.bp5: Kozesa okudda nga bukyali okukendeeza ku kuzimba ebisu
gravitixDocs.bp6: Ebintu biwe amannya mu ngeri etegeerekeka obulungi
gravitixDocs.keepLearningDesc: Engeri esinga okuyiga Gravitix kwe kuzimba. Tandika ne echo bot ennyangu, olwo osseeko state, olwo osseeko flows. Buli ndowooza empya gy’oyiga eggulawo ebintu ebirala ebisoboka.

error.p1: Zingira code yonna eyinza okulemererwa mu try block. Singa ensobi eba thrown — oba nga Gravitix runtime oba mu bulambulukufu ku code yo — okutuukiriza kubuuka ku catch block. Omuwendo ogukwatiddwa gusibiddwa ku nkyukakyuka gy’otuuma erinnya lya catch.
error.p2: finally eddukira awatali bukwakkulizo — oba try yatuuka ku buwanguzi oba catch yakwata ensobi. Kikozese okufulumya eby'obugagga, okuwandiika, oba okuweereza obubaka obw'okumaliriza.
error.p3: Kozesa okukwata ensobi ku mirimu egyesigama ku kuyingiza okw'ebweru: okusengejja ebiwandiiko by'omukozesa, okuyita APIs, okusoma enkyukakyuka z'embeera, oba okukola okubala okuzibu nga ensobi za domain (sqrt of negative, log of zero) zisoboka. Ku nsobi za logic ez’omunda, singa kwagala guard clauses ne returns ezisooka.

intro.p1: Gravitix lulimi olukwata ku domain (DSL) olukoleddwa okuva wansi okuwandiika Vortex bots. Ennimi endala we zeetaaga amaterekero g’ebitabo, okuddamu okuyita, ne boilerplate, Gravitix ekuwa abakwata emikolo egy’omutindo ogusooka, emboozi flows, n’ebizimbibwamu state — byonna mu nsengeka ennyonjo, esomebwa nga eluŋŋamizibwa Rust.
intro.p2: Gravitix ya muntu yenna ayagala okuzimba Vortex bot mu bwangu — oba towandiikangako code, oba oli seasoned developer akooye Python boilerplate. Ekiwandiiko kino kiyigiriza Gravitix okuva ku misingi egisooka: tekyetaagisa bumanyirivu nga bukyali.
intro.p3: Buli kitundu kizimba ku ebyo ebyasooka. Bw’oba ​​mupya mu kukola pulogulaamu, soma okuva waggulu okutuuka wansi. Bw’oba ​​omanyi dda olulimi olulala, kozesa ebirimu okubuuka butereevu ku ekyo ekikunyumira.
intro.p4: Mu kujuliza kuno kwonna, → kitegeeza "okwekenneenya okutuuka" oba "okufulumya", ate // ... kitegeeza ebigambo ebibuusibwa amaaso omukung'aanya.

math_special.h1: Gamma & emirimu egyekuusa ku nsonga eno
math_special.p1: Omulimu gwa Gamma Γ(n) gwe kugatta okutambula obutasalako okwa factorial: Γ(n) = (n−1)! ku namba enzijuvu ennungi. Kigaziya factorial okutuuka ku namba entuufu n’enzibu.
math_special.p2: Omulimu gw’ensobi erf(x) = (2/√π)∫₀ˣ e^(−t2)dt ye integral ya Gaussian. Kikwatagana butereevu ne CDF eya bulijjo era kirabika mu nsengekera z’ebbugumu n’endowooza y’obusobozi.
math_special.p3: ζ(s) = Σ 1/nˢ ku n=1,2,3,... (nga Re(s)>1). Eyungibwa ku kugabanya kwa prime okuyita mu kiva mu Euler. Endowooza ya Riemann (etegonjoddwa!) ekwata ku ziro za ζ mu nnyonyi enzibu.
math_special.p4: Emirimu gya Bessel Jₙ(x) ne Y3(x) bye bigonjoola ensengekera ya Bessel eya ddiferensi: x2y'' + xy' + (x2−n2)y = 0. Zirabika mu kusaasaana kw’amayengo, okutambuza ebbugumu mu ssilindala, ne makanika wa kwantumu.
math_special.p5: Ai(x) ne Bi(x) bye bigonjoola ku y'' = xy. Zilabika mu quantum tunneling (WKB approximation) ne optics (diffraction).
math_special.p6: Famire zino eza polinomi zisituka nga eigenfunctions za operators enkulu era zikozesebwa mu nkola za spectral, quadrature, ne quantum mechanics.
math_special.p7: K(k) ne E(k) zibeera integral za elliptic ezijjuvu ez’ekika ekisooka n’ekyokubiri. Zibala ekiseera kya pendulum etali ya linnya n’enkulungo ya ellipse.
math_special.td1: Γ(x) = ∫^∞ tˣ⁻1e⁻dt. Okugerageranya kwa Lanczos. Γ(n+1)=n!
math_special.td2: ln|Γ(x)|. Avoids overflow ku x ennene.
math_special.td5: Pₙ(x): ekwatagana ku [−1,1]. Ekitundu eky’enkoona eky’emirimu gy’amayengo ga haidrojeni.
math_special.td6: H3(x): eky’enjuyi ezikwatagana w.r.t. e^(−x2) nga bwe kiri. Ekiwujjo kya harmonic ekya quantum.
math_special.td7: T3(x) = cos(n·acos(x)): okugerageranya kwa polinomi okusinga obulungi.
math_special.td8: L3(x): ekwatagana ku [0,∞) w.r.t. e^(−x) nga bwe kiri. Enkola z’amayengo ga haidrojeni (hadrogen radial wavefunctions).

types.p1: Namba enzijuvu eriko akabonero ka bit 64. Awagira emiwendo okuva ku nga −9.2 × 10¹⁸ okutuuka ku +9.2 × 10¹⁸.
types.p10: Empisa ezimu ziyinza obutabaawo. Ennimiro ez’okwesalirawo mu ctx (nga ctx.username) ziyinza okuba null. Bulijjo kebera nga tonnaba kukozesa:
types.p11: Okwongerako ? oluvannyuma lw’ekika kigiteekako akabonero nga optional — omuwendo guyinza okuba null. Eno y'engeri parameters z'emirimu n'ennimiro za state gye ziraga "kino kiyinza oba tekiyinza kubaawo":
types.p12: Singa omuwendo guyinza obutabaawo bulijjo, guteekeko T? era bulijjo kebera != null nga tonnagukozesa. Okuyingira mu nnimiro ya null tekikuba bot — returns null mu kasirise.
types.p2: Ennamba ya 64-bit ey’obutuufu obw’emirundi ebiri floating-point.
types.p3: 10 / 3 nga erina emiwendo gya int ebiri egaba 3 (esaliddwako). Kozesa 10.0 / 3.0 ku bivudde mu decimal.
types.p5: Omuguwa gw'ebiwandiiko ogwa Unicode. Ennyiriri miwendo egitakyuka.
types.p6: Omutendera gw’emiwendo ogutegekeddwa, gwonna gwa kika kye kimu T.
types.p7: Okutuuka ku index okuva mu bbanga (e.g., nums[99] nga olukalala lulina ebintu 5) returns null okusinga okugwa bot yo.
types.p8: Okukunganya ebibiri ebisumuluzo-omuwendo. Ebisumuluzo byonna birina okuba ekika kye kimu, emiwendo gyonna girina okuba ekika kye kimu.
types.p9: Ekika kya return emirimu egita return muwendo. Totera kuwandiika void mu bulambulukufu — kye kisookerwako nga tewali kika kya return kiragiddwa.

architexDocs.title: Architex Ekiwandiiko ky’Olulimi
architexDocs.subtitle: Olulimi olulangirira UI olwa Vortex Mini Apps. Embeera y’okuddamu, ensengeka ezisobola okukolebwa, omutendera gw’okuzimba zero.
architexDocs.introDesc: Architex ye declarative entono DSL eyakolebwa okusindika UI munda mu Vortex omubaka. Onnyonnyola screen bwerina okufaanana; ekiseera ky'okudduka kikuuma pixels mu sync ne state automatically. Tewali virtual DOM, tewali bundler, tewali JSX — fayiro ya `.arx` ye app.
architexDocs.goalDeclarative: Declarative — owandiika UI gyoyagala, so si mitendera gya kugizimba
architexDocs.goalReactive: Reactive — `~count += 1` era buli label egisoma etereeza mu kifo
architexDocs.goalPortable: Portable — `.arx` y'emu ekola ku web, iOS, ne Android runtimes awatali kulongoosa
architexDocs.goalTiny: Tiny — parser + renderer emmeeri mu wansi wa 30 KB, kale Mini Apps eggulawo amangu ago
architexDocs.goalReadable: Okusomebwa — okuyingiza (indentation) kwe nsengeka; abakyusa basibwa enjegere ne `::`; tewali musolo ku bubonero
architexDocs.whoDesc: Omuntu yenna ayagala okusindika screen ekwatagana mu Vortex — foomu za bakasitoma, dashboards, empapula z’okulonda, Telegram-style Mini Apps. Bw’oba ​​wali owandiise HTML+CSS+JS, Architex ejja kuwulira ng’omanyidde naye nga yangu okuwandiika. Bw’oba ​​tolina, Architex nayo nnyanjula ya mpola ku pulogulaamu ezikola (reactive programming) kubanga olulimi lukuuma ekigere nga kitono.
architexDocs.howToReadDesc: Buli kitundu kizimba ku ekyo ekyasooka. Tandika ku Quick Start, olwo osome Syntax, State, Layout, Modifiers, Actions, n’ekitundu eky’omulembe ekisembayo. Buuka okwetoloola ng’oyita mu kipande ky’ebirimu bw’oba ​​omanyi dda React oba Svelte — ensonga maapu nnyonjo.
architexDocs.quickStartDesc: Ekkubo erisinga obumpi okuva ku fayiro etaliiko kintu kyonna okutuuka ku Mini App edduka.
architexDocs.firstScreenExample:
@screen Mwasuze mutya

  ~erinnya = "ensi".

  col :: pad(24) ekituli(12) wakati

    omutwe "Mbalamusizza, {~erinnya}!" :: sayizi enzirugavu(28)

    okuyingiza ~ erinnya :: pad (8) radius (6) ensalo (# ccc)

    text "Wandiika erinnya waggulu — ekiwandiiko kino kitereezebwa nga bw'owandiika."
      :: sayizi(12) langi(#888)
architexDocs.whatHappenedDesc: `@screen Hello` erangirira ekikolo. `~name = "ensi"` ekola enkyukakyuka ekola. `col`, `omutwe`, `okuyingiza`, `ekiwandiiko` bitundu ebizimbibwamu. `::` egattako ebikyusa (padding, langi, sayizi). Omukozesa bw'awandiika mu kuyingiza, buli `{~name}` interpolation updates — tewali wiring, tewali subscriptions, tewali renders n'omukono.
architexDocs.runningItDesc: Ggulawo Architex tab mu Vortex bot studio, teeka code, nyweza Run. Obudde bw'okudduka bulaga mu kipande ky'okusooka era buddamu okutikka ku kutereka. Bw’ofulumya, abakozesa bo baggulawo app okuva mu mboozi yonna — tewali kussaako.
architexDocs.syntaxDesc: Buli pulogulaamu ya Architex ekolebwa ebintu bina: ebirangiriro ebitandikira ku `@`, enkyukakyuka ezikola ezisookerwako ne `~`, ebitundu ebiwandiikiddwa nga bare identifiers, n'ebikyusa ebiyungiddwa oluvannyuma lwa `::`.
architexDocs.anatomyDeclDesc: `@screen Name`, `@theme`, `@import "./lib.arx"`, ne `@for item in ~list` byonna bitandikira mu column 0. Buli kintu ekiyingiziddwa wansi waabwe kya block eyo.
architexDocs.anatomyCompDesc: Ebitundu bituula ku layini yaabwe: `ekiwandiiko`, `bbaatuuni`, `ekifaananyi`, `omutwe`, `akabonero`, `badge`, `omugabanya`, `col`, `olunyiriri`. Ensonga yaabwe ey'ekifo ejja amangu ddala oluvannyuma lw'erinnya: `text ~message`, `button "Save"`, `image "/logo.png"`.
architexDocs.anatomyModifierDesc: Oluvannyuma lwa `::` osobola okusiba enjegere abakyusakyusa bangi nga bw'oyagala. Buli emu etwala ziro oba okusingawo ensonga mu bbalansi: `:: pad(24) gap(16) wakati bold size(20) color(#4f8ef7)`. Abakyusa biba bya kifo, so si kigambo kikulu — ensengeka si nsonga okuggyako ezo ezisembayo-omuwandiisi-awangula nga `langi`.
architexDocs.anatomyActionDesc: `=>` ku bbaatuuni (oba ekitundu kyonna ekikwatagana) kiddukanya okuyitibwa kw'okugaba oba omulimu okugoberera. Enjegere eziwera `=>` oludda ku ludda: `button "Submit" => ~busy = kituufu => sindika (ekikolwa: "okutereka", data: ~ ffoomu)`.
architexDocs.reactiveVarsDesc: Erinnya lyonna erisookerwako ne `~` ye katoffaali akakola. Wandiika `~count = 0` okulangirira, `~count = 5` okuddamu okugaba, `~count += 1` okulongoosa. Buli UI node esoma cell — butereevu oba okuyita mu interpolation — eddamu okukola nga cell ekyuse.
architexDocs.computedVarsDesc: Kozesa `:=` mu kifo kya `=` okulangirira ekigambo ekibaliriddwa: `~total := ~count * ~step`. Oludda olwa ddyo luddamu okwekenneenya buli lwe kikyuka okwesigamizibwa kwonna. Tewali kuwandiika mu ngalo era tewali kizibu kya muwendo mukadde — bw'osoma `~a` awalala mu kigambo, otomatiki okisinziirako.
architexDocs.typeAnnotationsDesc: Ennyonyola za kwesalirawo naye ziyamba ku bubaka obw'okwemalira n'ensobi: `~bala: ennamba = 0`, `~erinnya: string = ""`, `~ok: boolean = false`, `~ebintu: array = []`, `~omukozesa: ekintu = {}`. Bw’oba ​​ozibuuka ekika kiteberezebwa okuva ku initialiser.
architexDocs.supportedTypesList: `ennamba`, `omuguwa`, `boolean`, `ensengekera`, `ekintu`, `null`. Ennaku ne blobs ziyisibwa nga ennyiriri n’ebintu. Ekiseera ky'okudduka kikozesa amateeka ga JavaScript ag'okukaka wansi wa hood, kale `~count + 1` ekola ne bwe kiba nti `~count` yatandika obulamu nga string.
architexDocs.stringInterpolationDesc: Omuguwa gwonna gusobola okuyingiza ebigambo ne `{...}`: `"Mbalamusizza, {~erinnya.omukozesa}!"`, `"Omugatte: {~bala * ~omuwendo}"`. Interpolation bulijjo eba ya reactive.
architexDocs.layoutDesc: Architex erina ebibya bibiri ebisobola okukolebwa n’ebitundu by’amakoola kkumi. Zisibe ebisu nga zirina indentation — tewali tags eziggalawo.
architexDocs.containersDesc: `col` etuuma abaana mu vertikal, `row` mu horizontal. Bombi bakkiriza `gap(n)`, `pad(n)`, `center`, `grow`, n'ekikyusa obugazi/obugulumivu. Indent abaana level emu mu buziba okutuuka ku kisu.
architexDocs.containerExample:
olunyiriri :: ekituli(8) pad(16) wakati
  ekifaananyi "/avatar.png" :: w (40) h (40) radius (20)
  col :: okukula ekituli(2)
    ekiwandiiko ~erinnya :: enzirugavu
    ekiwandiiko ~ bio :: sayizi (12) langi (# 888)
architexDocs.leafComponentsList: `text` — kkopi yonna ey'omubiri. `omutwe` — mu makulu omutwe. `label` — ekiwandiiko ekitono ekiwandiikiddwa. `button` — okufuga okusobola okukwata. `input` — ennimiro y'ebiwandiiko esibiddwa ku var ekola. `ekifaananyi` — ekifaananyi okuva mu URL. `badge` — tag eringa empeke. `omugabanya` — layini ennyimpi eyawula. `toast` — ebbaala y'emmere ey'akaseera obuseera. `tabs` / `tab` — omukyusa tabu.
architexDocs.componentTextDesc: `text "Hello"` eraga olunyiriri olutakyukakyuka. `text ~message` ekola ekintu ekiddamu. Gatta n'okuyingiza: `ekiwandiiko "Omugatte: {~count}"`.
architexDocs.componentHeaderDesc: Ekiwandiiko eky’omutwe. Esookera ddala ku kinene, ekinene okusinga `ekiwandiiko`. Ensonga y'emu ey'ekifo: `omutwe "Ensengeka"`. Minzaani za sayizi ne screen — kyusa ne `size(n)`.
architexDocs.componentButtonDesc: Ekintu ekisobola okukwata. Omuguwa gw’ekifo gwe guwandiikibwako; ekikolwa kya `=>` kiddukira ku taapu. `button "Teeka" => ~ebbago = null`. Omuliro `=>` omungi mu nsengeka.
architexDocs.componentInputDesc: Ennimiro y'ebiwandiiko eriko amakubo abiri. Enkyukakyuka ekola oluvannyuma lw'erinnya ekwata omuwendo oguliwo kati: `input ~email`. Ebikyusa: `ekifo ("...")`, `debounce (300)` ku bipya ebiziyiziddwa.
architexDocs.componentImageDesc: Emigugu okuva mu kkubo lya HTTPS URL oba `/uploads/...`. Abakyusa `w (px)`, `h (px)`, `radius (px)` basala ku kibokisi. Agwa emabega ku silhouette y’ekifo singa URL 404s.
architexDocs.componentDividerDesc: Hairline separator, 1px, essa ekitiibwa mu langi y’omulamwa eriwo kati. Tewali nsonga.
architexDocs.componentBadgeDesc: Empeke enywegera ebirimu: `badge ~count`, `badge "empya"`. Kozesa ku counters ezitasomeddwa ne tag chips.
architexDocs.componentLabelDesc: Ebiwandiiko ebiwandiikiddwa/omuyambi — ebikkakkamu mu kulaba. Good ku mannya g'ennimiro ya ffoomu.
architexDocs.componentToastDesc: Okumanyisibwa okutali kuziyiza. `toast ~erabika "Eterekeddwa!" :: duration(2000)` eraga okumala s 2 buli lwe kiba nti `~visible` kituufu, olwo auto-dismisses. Tewali modal stacking, tewali ntalo za z-index.
architexDocs.componentTabsDesc: Ekintu kya tab ekisibiddwa ku lunyiriri olukola: `tabs ~activeTab`. Munda mu yo, buli `tab "Label" "key"` erangirira tab emu; omubiri oguyingiziddwa wansi gulagibwa ng’ekisumuluzo kikwatagana.
architexDocs.modifiersDesc: Abakyusakyusa y’engeri yokka ey’okukola sitayiro y’ekitundu. Zisibe enjegere oluvannyuma lwa `::`. Zijja mu maka ataano: ebanga, obunene, langi, ensengeka, n’enneeyisa.
architexDocs.modSpacingDesc: `pad(n)` — okusiba ku njuyi zonna. `pad(x, y)` — okwesimbye + okwesimbye. `pad(waggulu, ku ddyo, wansi, kkono)` — CSS-order. `gap(n)` — ekifo wakati w'abaana ba `col` / `row`. `margin(n)` — ebanga ery'ebweru okuva ku baganda.
architexDocs.modSizingDesc: `w(px)` — obugazi obutakyukakyuka. `h(px)` — obuwanvu obutakyukakyuka. `grow` — jjuza ekifo ekisigadde mu lunyiriri/col. `wakati` — wakati okuyita ku kisenge ky’omusalaba; mu `col` ebeera wakati mu bbanga, mu `row` ebeera wakati mu vertikal.
architexDocs.modColourDesc: `langi (#rrggbb)` — mu maaso. `bg (# rrggbb)` — eby'emabega. Bombi bakkiriza obubonero bw'omulamwa: `color(~primary)` esoma okuva mu `@theme` block eriwo kati. Opacity eyita mu hex ya digito 8: `#00000080` ye 50 %% muddugavu.
architexDocs.modTypographyDesc: `size(px)` — obunene bw'empandiika. `bold` / `italic` — obuzito n'omusono. `align(ku kkono|wakati|ku ddyo)` — okulaganya ebiwandiiko.
architexDocs.modVisibilityDesc: `hidden(~flag)` — esumulula node nga bendera ntuufu. `ekirabika (~ bendera)` — ekikyuusa. Nodes ezitassiddwa ziyiwa DOM zazo, kale conditional UI ya buseere.
architexDocs.modBehaviourDesc: `debounce (ms)` ku `okuyingiza` throttles ebipya. `placeholder("...")` eraga olunyiriri lw'akabonero. `format(kind, arg)` ku `text` ekola ennamba: `format ("ssente", "USD")`, `format ("ebitundu ku kikumi")`, `format ("compact")`.
architexDocs.modRadiusDesc: `radius(px)` yeetooloola enkoona. `ensalo (#rrggbb)` ekuba ekifaananyi kya 1 px. `border(px, #rrggbb)` eteekawo obuwanvu nabwo.
architexDocs.actionsDesc: Ebikolwa bikyusa embeera oba okwogera n’ensi ey’ebweru. Zidduka mu kiseera kye kimu mu tap/keypress handler.
architexDocs.actionAssignDesc: `=> ~bala = 0`, `=> ~bbize = kituufu`, `=> ~olukalala = []`. Enkyukakyuka yonna ekola (reactive variable) ewandiikibwa.
architexDocs.actionIncDecDesc: `+= n`, `-= n`, `*= n`, `/= n`. `=> ~count += 1` ye nfumo eri ababala.
architexDocs.actionMultipleDesc: `=>` eziwera ku layini emu zikuba omuliro okuva waggulu okutuuka wansi mu tick emu, kale UI etereeza omulundi gumu ku nkomerero: `button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false`. Ku mulimu gwa async, singa kwagala `@reaction` ebaliriddwa.
architexDocs.actionSendDesc: `send(action: "name", ...args)` ye bridge okudda ku bot. Host (Vortex runtime) efuna nga JSON RPC obubaka era esobola okuyita code ya bot yo. Kikozese okuyingira, API okuleeta, okusasula — ekintu kyonna DSL yennyini ky’etasobola kwogera.
architexDocs.actionNavigateDesc: `goto ("ScreenName", arg: omuwendo, ...)` esika endala `@screen` ku stack; `emabega ()` efuluma. Ekiseera ky'okudduka kikola obulamu nga bwekiba.
architexDocs.actionHostBuiltinsDesc: `copy(~text)`, `share(~text)`, `haptic("light" | "medium" | "heavy")`, `vibrate(ms)`, `alert("...")`, `confirm("...") => ~ok = it` — ennukuta enfupi ya `it` gwe muwendo ogudda ogw’ekigambo ekisoose.
architexDocs.themeDesc: Langirira palette omulundi gumu, ddamu okozese buli wamu. Tokens zifuuka regular reactive variables kale app yo esobola okusindika dark-mode toggle mu layini ssatu.
architexDocs.importsDesc: `@import "./shared/ui.arx"` esika buli `@component` ne `@screen` okuva mu fayiro eyo mu kifo ekiriwo kati. Amakubo gakwatagana ne fayiro eyingiza; ebiyingizibwa mu nkulungo bizuulibwa era ne biweebwa lipoota mu kiseera ky’okusengejja.
architexDocs.componentsDesc: Nnyonnyola omulundi gumu, kozesa emirundi mingi: `@component Avatar url size\n image url :: w(size) h(size) radius(size / 2)`. Munda mu mubiri gw'ekitundu parameters ezituumiddwa amannya ziri mu scope nga plain identifiers (nga tezirina `~`).
architexDocs.forLoopsDesc: `@for item mu ~list` ekola olunyiriri lumu buli elementi. `@for item, idx mu ~list` nayo esiba index eyesigamiziddwa ku ziro. Ekiseera ky’okudduka kirondoola endagamuntu nga kiyita mu elementi yennyini, kale okugattako ebintu waggulu ku lukalala lw’ennyiriri 10 000 kigula O(1) DOM omulimu.
architexDocs.forExample:
@ku kintu, idx mu ~ebintu
  olunyiriri :: ekituli(8) paadi(4) .
    badge ~idx
    ekiwandiiko ~ekintu :: okukula
architexDocs.ternaryDesc: `cond ? a : b` ekola wonna ekigambo we kikkirizibwa. Ekisu kya enums: `~embeera >= 10 ? "waggulu" : ~embeera >= 5 ? "mid" : "wansi"`.
architexDocs.slotsDesc: Munda mu kulangirira ekitundu, `slot` eraga omubiri gw'oyo akubira we guyingira.Kilowoozeeko nga React children / Vue default slot.
architexDocs.reactivityDesc: Buli `~var` kabonero. Bw'ogisoma munda mu computed, modifier argument, oba interpolation, runtime etegeera okusoma mu graph y'okwesigamira eriwo kati. Bw’owandiika, buli node egisoma efuna okuddamu okwekenneenya — omulundi gumu, ku nkomerero ya microtask eriwo kati.
architexDocs.reactivityBatchingDesc: Ebiwandiiko ebingi mu handler emu biba batched. `=> ~a = 1 => ~b = 2` etandika okuyisa okumu ddala.
architexDocs.reactivityEqualityDesc: Nga bwekiba ekiseera ky'okudduka kikozesa obwenkanya obukakafu (`===`). Okuwandiika omuwendo gwe gumu tekuddamu kuddukanya kintu kyonna. Yisa ekintu/ensengekera empya okukaka okulongoosa; obutakyukakyuka kukubirizibwa naye tekyetaagisa.
architexDocs.examplesDesc: Apps nnya eza canonical, buli emu yeetongodde ate nga eri wansi wa layini 40. Koppa ekimu ku byo mu Architex tab n’onyiga Run.
architexDocs.exampleCounter: Counter — embeera ekola, ebaliriddwa, abakwata button, okusiba ebiwandiiko.
architexDocs.exampleTodo: Todo — okulaga olukalala, okwongera / okuggyawo, okulongoosa mu layini.
architexDocs.exampleProfile: Profile — ekifaananyi, badge, okulabika okw’obukwakkulizo, okutambulira.
architexDocs.exampleKiller: Ebintu ebitta — emiramwa, okuyingiza, tabs, toasts, ennamba eziteekeddwateekeddwa, ternaries, typed vars.
architexDocs.errUnknownName: `erinnya eritamanyiddwa ~foo` — wakozesa enkyukakyuka ekola nga tonnagirangirira. Yongera `~foo = ...` waggulu ku `@screen` eggaddwa.
architexDocs.errIndent: `unexpected indent` — abaana balina okuba nga bali mu buziba bwa level emu okusinga omuzadde waabwe. Architex ekozesa ebifo bibiri ddala buli ddaala; tabs zigaanibwa okwewala obuzibu obutalabika-whitespace.
architexDocs.errModifier: `unknown modifier` — wawandiika `:: shadow` naye ekiseera ky'okudduka tekikiwagira. Kebera olukalala lw'abakyusa waggulu; Architex ekakanyavu ku mannya agatamanyiddwa okukuuma okukwatagana mu maaso.
architexDocs.errType: `obutakwatagana mu kika` — e.g. oyise mu lunyiriri awali ennamba esuubirwa. Annotate the reactive variable (`~count: number`) era omusengejja ajja kukubuulira omuwendo omubi we gusibuka.
architexDocs.errDebug: Okulongoosa mu kiseera ky'okudduka, zingira ekigambo ekiteeberezebwa mu `debug(...)` — ekiseera ky'okudduka kiwandiika buli kwekenneenya ku console awatali kukosa muwendo.
architexDocs.compatWeb: Web — ekola mu vanilla DOM n'enkyukakyuka CSS ku bubonero bw'omulamwa. Tewali kwesigama ku React / Vue / Svelte.
architexDocs.compatIOS: iOS — `.arx` y'emu esengekebwa era n'efulumizibwa mu kulaba kwa SwiftUI okuyita mu Vortex iOS host. Buli mukyusa akola maapu ku sitayiro ya SwiftUI.
architexDocs.compatAndroid: Android — omutegesi akola mu Jetpack Compose. Ebikyusa obubonero (`:: onTap`, `:: onLongPress`) bivvuunula mu Compose equivalents.
architexDocs.compatVersions: Enkola y'enkyusa — Architex ekakasa okukwatagana okudda emabega ku fayiro za `.arx` mu nkyusa entono. Fayiro ya `.arx` ewandiikiddwa ku 0.1 ekyakola ku 0.9.
architexDocs.nextStepsDesc: Soma ekitabo ky’okufumba ku bifaananyi (enkalala ezitaliiko kkomo, foomu, okusasula), ekitabo ekikwata ku bikozesebwa ku CLI ne VS Code plugin, n’ekitabo ekikwata ku kuwaayo bw’oba ​​oyagala okwongerako ekitundu ekizimbibwamu. Ensonda mu bujjuvu eri ku github.com/vortex/Architex.

meta.title: Vortex Ekiwandiiko ekijuliziddwa
meta.subtitle: Buli subsystem ya Vortex mu kifo kimu.
meta.intro: Ekiwandiiko kino kijjuvu okusinziira ku ngeri gye kyakolebwamu. Tandika wonna — buli ssuula yeetongodde. Buli sitatimenti ekwatagana okudda ku makubo g'ensibuko bwe kiba nga kikwatagana. Buli kikyukakyuka kiyitibwa mu bulambulukufu.
meta.howToUse: Ebirimu ebiri ku kkono biraga essuula eziri wano. Nywa ku ssuula okubuuka ku yo; buli ssuula erina emitwe emitonotono n’enkalala z’osobola okusika mu sikonda 30 nga tonnabbira mu mazzi.
meta.updatedBy: Ekoleddwa okuva mu `scripts/build_vortex_docs_v2.py`. Ddamu okuzimba ne `ebiwandiiko bya python3/okuzimba_vortex_docs_v2.py`.

architecture.title: Okulambika kw’ebizimbe
architecture.subtitle: Enkola ssatu — kasitoma, node, controller — ne protocol emu ezizisiba.
architecture.intro: Vortex ye mubaka atali mu bitundu. Mu kifo ky’okubeera back-end emu eya kkampuni emu, egatta akatimba akaggule aka **nodes** abetongodde, akazuuliddwa era ne kakakasibwa **controller** entono efulumya manifest eriko omukono eya code gye yakakasizza. **Bakasitoma** bakwata ebisumuluzo byonna eby'ekyama ne bakola UI. Essuula eno esigadde etambulira ku nkola essatu, ensalo zazo, ne data ekulukuta wakati wazo.
architecture.h1p1: Ababaka abateekeddwa wakati ensonga emu ey’okukaka. Ekiragiro kya kkooti, ​​okuvaako kw'omugabi w'ekire, oba okugula ebintu mu ngeri ey'obulabe byonna bivvuunulwa nti "abakozesa bafiirwa okuyingira". Vortex sidesteps ekyo nga aleka omuntu yenna okuddukanya node n'aleka clients okutambula wakati wa nodes nga tebazzeemu kwewandiisa.
architecture.h1p2: Okugabanya obuyinza kulina okukuuma ebyama n’obugolokofu. Ekibiina kya seeva eziteesigika kikola singa seeva tezisobola kusoma biwandiiko bya bulijjo era nga tezisobola kujingirira bubaka. Vortex essa mu nkola byombi ng’eyita mu kusiba okuva ku nkomerero okutuuka ku nkomerero n’okukakasa kwa Ed25519 ku buli bubaka obusalasala.
architecture.h1p3: Controller ye one centralised-ish piece, naye nga ntono. Efulumya `INTEGRITY.sig.json` yokka n'olukalala lw'ebifo ebyesigika ebiyingira. Omuntu yenna asobola okwekyaza endabirwamu, kale n'omufuzi si nsonga emu ey'okulemererwa — ensibuko emu yokka ey'amazima ku "which pubkey signs official releases".
architecture.h1l1: Tewali kusiba mutunzi: bakasitoma basobola okukyusa endagamuntu yaabwe wakati wa nodes essaawa yonna nga baddamu okussa omukono ku X25519 pubkey ne JWT empya.
architecture.h1l2: No outage correlation: node emu bwegenda wansi, abakozesa ku node endala tebakiraba.
architecture.h1l3: Tewali buyinza bumu: abaddukanya emirimu balondawo amaka gaabwe ag’amateeka, ate abakozesa balondawo omuddukanya waabwe.
architecture.h1l4: Tewali UI emu: iOS, Android, web bannaabwe ba ddaala erisooka — tewali musingi guzingira mugonvu ku ndala.
architecture.h2p1: Kasitoma atambulira ku kyuma ky'omukozesa. Ekyo kye kifo kyokka obubaka obuwandiikiddwa mu ngeri ennyangu, ebisumuluzo eby’ekyama, ne fayiro-mu-ki-mu-ku-ntegeerevu live. Node tebalabako.
architecture.h2p2: Buli mutendera oguwagirwa gussa mu nkola enkola za waya ze zimu (HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC). SOLID-split feature modules (`api/` protocols, `impl/` code, `ui/` views) zikuuma endagaano nga nnywevu ate nga code eyenjawulo ku platform eri mu kitundu.
architecture.h2p3: Okutereka ku kyuma: Keychain / EncryptedSharedPreferences / Kuki ya HttpOnly ku bubonero; SQLite (GRDB ku iOS, Ekisenge ku Android, IndexedDB wrapper ku web) ku kiwandiiko ekikuumiddwa + omuwendo gwa FTS.
architecture.h2l1: iOS — Swift Package nga erimu modulo z’ebintu 30+. Min okuteekebwa mu nkola kigendererwa iOS 17.
architecture.h2l2: Android — Kotlin + Okuyiiya + Okukwata. minSdk 26, ekiruubirirwaSdk 34.
architecture.h2l3: Web — vanilla JS PWA, omukozi w’obuweereza, tewali ddaala lya kuzimba kusukka ES module bundling.
architecture.h2l4: Desktop — Tauri wrapper okwetoloola kasitoma wa web; bundle y'emu, enzaalwa ya Chrome renderer.
architecture.h3p1: Node ye nkola ya Python (`python -m app.main`, oba ekibinja `run.py`) ewuliriza ku 9000 nga bwekiba. Enywerera ku ciphertext, ewagira WebSocket emikolo, ekwata TURN credentials, ne brokers federation ne nodes endala.
architecture.h3p2: Layer ya node egonvu mu bugenderevu. Kibikkula amakubo nga 120 okuyita mu muti gwa `/api/*` nga kwogasse `/ws` okusobola okufuluma mu kiseera ekituufu. Okusitula okuzitowa (crypto, okubeerawo, okuteekawo enteekateeka) kusengekebwa mu `app/obukuumi/`, `app/entambula/`, `app/peer/`.
architecture.h3p3: Node emu mu mbeera ya SQLite esookerwako ekwata ~50 abakozesa mu kiseera kye kimu mu ngeri eyeeyagaza ku M1. Nga Postgres ne Redis zisobozeseddwa, code y’emu egerageranya mu bbanga — buli node efuuka stateless okuyita ku DB ne fan-out.
architecture.h3l1: Ebifo ebiyingira: `/api/*` HTTPS, `/ws` WebSocket, `/v1/obugolokofu` ne `/obulamu` olw'obulamu.
architecture.h3l2: Ebisinziirwako: FastAPI, SQLAlchemy 2.x, uvicorn, cryptography (OpenSSL), pqcrypto (liboqs), python-ebitundu ebingi, Pillow, Rust okugaziya `vortex_chat` ku crypto ey'ekkubo ery'ebbugumu.
architecture.h3l3: Okwesalirawo: Redis (okubeerawo fan-out okuyita mu nodes eziwera), Postgres (okufulumya DB), coturn (TURN relay), fluent-bit (log okusindika).
architecture.h3l4: Sayizi ya binary: ~60 MB Python deps + ~10 MB Rust okugaziya. Ekifaananyi kya Docker nga 400 MB nga squash tennabaawo.
architecture.h4p1: Omufuzi nkola ya njawulo Python (`vortex_controller`) n'ekigendererwa ekifunda: okufulumya n'okukakasa `INTEGRITY.sig.json`, okubikkula URL z'okuyingira, n'okulondoola obulamu bwa bannaabwe abagatta.
architecture.h4p2: Ku kutandika omufuzi atambula omuti gw'ensibuko, akola hashes buli fayiro, era n'ageraageranya ku manifesito. Singa hash yonna etakwatagana controller agaana okutandika. Kino kitegeeza nti fayiro eri ku disiki ekyusiddwa tesobola kuweereza `status:"verified"`.
architecture.h4p3: Bakasitoma bakuba `/v1/integrity` nga tebannaba kwesiga node. Bwe balaba `status != "verified"` bagaana okukwasa ebiwandiiko ebikakasa, period. Oyo ye anchor y'obwesige.
architecture.h4l1: Essiddwako omukono ne `ebisumuluzo/release.key` (Ed25519). Ekitundu kya lukale kifumbiddwa mu bifulumiziddwa bakasitoma.
architecture.h4l2: Ebiyingizibwa mu manifest: `{path, sha256, size}` ku buli fayiro etali gitignored.
architecture.h4l3: Ddamu okuzimba: `python -m vortex_controller.obutuukirivu.ekintu_eky'akabonero`. Ebifulumya `INTEGRITY.sig.json` mu kikolo kya repo.
architecture.h4l4: Okuzimbulukuka: abaddukanya forking Vortex bakyusa `release.key`. Bakasitoma abategekeddwa ne pubkey yaabwe olwo ne beesiga fork eyo.
architecture.h5p1: Tambula mu bibaawo nga Alice asindikidde Bob "hi":
architecture.h5p2: 1. Kasitoma atunuulira ekisumuluzo ky’ekikolo ky’ekisenge mu dduuka lye ery’omu kitundu. Bwe kiba nga tekibaawo, kiggya envulopu empya okuva mu `/api/rooms/{id}/keys` olw'ekisumuluzo kyayo eky'okunywa. Aba DM omulundi ogusooka badduka Diffie-Hellman ya lawundi emu ku prekeys.
architecture.h5p4: 3. Node etereka olunyiriri era n'ewagira ebweru `{type:"m", ekisenge:..., msg:{id, ct, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at}}` eri buli WebSocket ayungiddwa ku kisenge.
architecture.h5p5: 4. Kasitoma wa Bob afuna fuleemu, aggyamu ensirifu n’ekisumuluzo ky’ekikolo kye kimu, akakasa nti sender pseudo akwatagana n’obwammemba obusuubirwa, era n’alaga bubble.
architecture.h5p6: 5. Kasitoma wa Bob awandiika `POST /api/rooms/{id}/read` nga alina id y'obubaka obusembayo okusoma. Ekyo kivaako okuweereza kwa `{type:"r"}` kale ekibumba kya Alice kiraga akabonero.
architecture.h6p1: CBOR (RFC 8949) nkakali, ya binary, era ya mangu okukooda. Bw’ogeraageranya ne JSON esala ku sayizi ya payload ne ~30 % ku ciphertext eya bulijjo ey’emboozi era emalawo obutategeeragana mu kifo ekizungu.
architecture.h6p2: Bw’ogeraageranya ne Protobuf tekyetaagisa schema generator era tekyetaagisa ku freeze namba za field. Ekyo kikulu kubanga Vortex ekulakulana — twayongeddeko `thread_id`, `reply_to`, `reactions_count`, `kind` ku bifulumizibwa awatali kumenya bakasitoma abakadde.
architecture.h6p3: CBOR era kye bakozesa Signal, Matrix, ne NIP-29 olw’ensonga ezifaanagana ennyo. Okukwatagana n’okulonda kwabwe kitegeeza nti protocol yaffe nnyangu okubalirira abanoonyereza ku by’okwerinda abamanyi edda encoding.
architecture.h7p1: Buli fuleemu etambuza `v:<int>`. Enkyusa eriwo kati eri 1. Fuleemu erimu enkyusa etamanyiddwa esuulibwa; bakasitoma bawandiika okulabula ne bagenda mu maaso ne fuleemu eddako.
architecture.h7p2: Okukwatagana okudda emabega kukakasiddwa ku fuleemu yonna ekyatwala `v:1`. Okukwatagana mu maaso kwe kufuba okusinga: ennimiro empya zongerwako ku nkomerero ya dict, bakasitoma abakadde bazisimbira ekkuuli.
architecture.h7p3: Okumenya okukaluba kuterekeddwa enkyukakyuka ezikulu mu by’okwerinda (e.g. okukyusakyusa HKDF context strings). Mu mbeera ezo enkyusa ekuba ku 2 era eddirisa ly'okusenguka ne lifulumizibwa.
architecture.h1_a: Omukutu gwa Vortex gweyawulamu enkola ssatu. Buli emu eddukira ku bwayo, eyogera n’endala ng’eyita mu nkola za waya ezitegeerekese obulungi, era esobola okukyusibwa nga yeetongodde. Tewali monolith — buli feature plugs mu emu ku mirimu esatu.
architecture.h1_b: Kasitoma akwata ebisumuluzo era akola UI. Node enywerera ku ciphertext, ewagira ebibaddewo ku WebSocket, ne brokers WebRTC signalling. Omufuzi afulumya URL za manifesito n'okuyingira eziteekeddwako omukono. Ziwuliziganya ku HTTPS + WebSocket nga zikozesa emigugu egya CBOR-encoded munda mu AES-GCM envulopu.
architecture.h1_c: Enjawukana yaleetebwa mu v0.0.3 oluvannyuma lw'enkyusa ya monolith eyasooka okuddukira mu bizibu bibiri: okukakasa okufulumya kwasibirwa ku node edduka (kale node eyali efuuse obuzibu yali esobola okulimba ku code yaayo), era federation yali tesoboka kubanga node state ne trust state zaali zibeera mu tables ze zimu. Okugabanya attestation mu nkola yaayo kyawa buli operator pubkey emu oku pin era tuleke scale federation ku arbitrary N.
architecture.h1_f:
kasitoma --HTTPS/WSS--> ekitundu
  ^ |
  |                        v
  +------/v1/obulungi-- omufuzi (manifesito eriko omukono)
architecture.h2_a: Enjawukana ya node/controller eyawula ekintu ekisinga okukwata ku by’okwerinda (manifest eriko omukono) okuva ku ngulu w’okulumba okusinga obunene (seva ya API).
architecture.h2_b: Controller etereka akatono aka SQLite DB: pubkeys ezesigika, URL z'endabirwamu, n'obubonero bw'ebyobulamu. Kigaana okutandika singa INTEGRITY.sig.json tekwatagana na muti gwa disiki — fayiro ekyusibwakyusibwa teyinza nate kuweereza `status:"verified"`. Node ekola ku Postgres/SQLite yaayo era tekwatangako kisumuluzo kya kufulumya.
architecture.h2_c: Omusono guva mu Chrome eya root-store split (certs zibeera ku browser's release track, so si web origin) ne Debian's Release.gpg (manifest signed, packages unsigned). Yatwalibwa kubanga dizayini zombi zaawona amakumi g’emyaka egy’okuddamu okwetegereza.
architecture.h3_a: TLS 1.3 ku buli hop, end-to-end encrypted payloads munda. TLS akola ku ntambula; AES-GCM ekwata ebirimu.
architecture.h3_b: Wakati wa kasitoma ne node: HTTPS (`/api/*`) ne WSS (`/ws`). Wakati wa nodes: HTTPS (`/federation/*`). Wakati wa node ne controller: HTTPS (`/v1/*`). Bonna bakozesa TLS 1.3 nga balina engalo za Chrome 120 okuziyiza DPI.
architecture.h3_c: Vortex eyasooka yakozesanga TCP embisi n’okukwatagana mu ngalo okwa custom noise-protocol. Yakyusa okudda ku TLS 1.3 mu v0.0.4 oluvannyuma lw'okukimanya nti enkola ez'ennono ziraga "ezisanyusa" eri abatunuulizi abatakola. TLS 1.3 eboola, eri buli wamu, era ECH-ready — ebintu bisatu bye twagala.
architecture.h3_f:
oluwuzi lw’entambula: TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446) + eky’okwesalirawo ECH (RFC 9460)
layeri y'ebirimu: AES-256-GCM essiddwako akabonero munda CBOR
architecture.h4_a: Obubaka bumu obufuluma buyita mu mitendera ena: frame → encrypt → post → fan out.
architecture.h4_b: Kasitoma abala ekisumuluzo ky'ekisenge (X25519 + HKDF), akola fuleemu y'obubaka nga CBOR, assaako akabonero ne AES-256-GCM ng'akozesa random 96-bit nonce, POSTs ku `/api/rooms/{id}/messages`. Node etereka olunyiriri lw'ebiwandiiko ebikusike n'ewanirira ku buli WebSocket eyungiddwa ku kisenge. Kasitoma w'oyo afuna akola decrypts n'ekisumuluzo kye kimu. Okusirika okudda n’okudda wansi wa 50 ms ku local LAN, ~120 ms typical WAN.
architecture.h4_c: Payipu eno ey’emitendera ena y’emu ku Signal gye yakozesa mu 2014; twakyusa entambula yokka (WebSocket mu kifo kya Signal's TCP) n'enkodi (CBOR mu kifo kya protobuf). Okukwataganya dizayini ekakakasiddwa kisinga okuyiiya empya.
architecture.h5_a: Twalonda CBOR ku JSON ne Protobuf oluvannyuma lw’okugeraageranya sayizi y’omugugu, okukyukakyuka, n’okulongoosa ergonomics ku mirimu gy’emboozi egy’amazima.
architecture.h5_b: CBOR efulumya ~30% payloads entono okusinga JSON ku bubaka obuzitowa unicode, terina whitespace ambiguity, era ewagira field addition awatali schema generators. Proto yandibadde yeetaaga fayiro ya .proto buli kufulumizibwa era yandisibye ennamba z'ennimiro.
architecture.h5_c: Signal yakyuka okuva ku protobuf okudda ku CBOR-like framing mu 2017 olw’ensonga ze zimu. Matrix ekozesa CBOR mu layeri yaayo ey’okusalawo kw’embeera. CBOR mutindo gwa IETF (RFC 8949) era buli lulimi lwe tutunuulira lulina etterekero ly’ebitabo erikuze.
architecture.h5_f:
CBOR sayizi: ~0.7 × JSON ku utf-8 ezitabuddwa
          ~1.05 × protobuf ku schema y'emu
Okwongera ennimiro = okugattako ku nkomerero. Bakasitoma abakadde tebafaayo.
architecture.h6_a: Lwaki CBOR — ekitundu ky’essuula y’ebizimbe. Eno y’emu ku nkola enkulu ezijuliziddwa mu kujuliza kwonna okwa Vortex. Soma essuula eyeetooloddewo omanye ensonga egazi; ekitundu kino kigaziya ku nneeyisa entongole.
architecture.h6_b: Okulaba okussa mu nkola kwa "Lwaki CBOR". Enkola eno eteekebwa mu nkola mu modulo ekwatagana wansi wa `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, oba `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README eyita amakubo ga fayiro amatuufu.
architecture.h6_c: Enkola ya "Lwaki CBOR" yakulaakulana mu bifulumizibwa Vortex. Dizayini eno edda mu kunoonyereza okufulumiziddwa n’enkola z’okufulumya ez’ababaka abaaliwo emabega. Ebyafaayo by’enkyusa mu `CHANGELOG.md` biwandiika buli kitundu lwe kyatuuka ku ttaka n’ekyo ekyakikubiriza.
architecture.h7_a: Protocol versioning — ekitundu ky'essuula y'okuzimba. Eno y’emu ku nkola enkulu ezijuliziddwa mu kujuliza kwonna okwa Vortex. Soma essuula eyeetooloddewo omanye ensonga egazi; ekitundu kino kigaziya ku nneeyisa entongole.
architecture.h7_b: Okulaba okussa mu nkola kwa "Protocol versioning". Enkola eno eteekebwa mu nkola mu modulo ekwatagana wansi wa `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, oba `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README eyita amakubo ga fayiro amatuufu.
architecture.h7_c: Enkola ya "Protocol versioning" yakulaakulana mu Vortex ebifulumizibwa. Dizayini eno edda mu kunoonyereza okufulumiziddwa n’enkola z’okufulumya ez’ababaka abaaliwo emabega. Ebyafaayo by’enkyusa mu `CHANGELOG.md` biwandiika buli kitundu lwe kyatuuka ku ttaka n’ekyo ekyakikubiriza.

crypto.title: Ebintu ebisookerwako eby’okuwandiika (cryptographic primitives).
crypto.subtitle: Buli algorithm mu stack, ekigendererwa kyayo, parameters zaayo, RFC yaayo.
crypto.intro: Vortex ekozesa ebisookerwako byokka ebikebereddwa bannaabwe. Tewali custom block ciphers, tewali KDFs ezikuliddwa awaka, tewali novel signature schemes. Essuula eno ewandiika buli primitive gye tukozesa, parameters entuufu, n’ensonga enkulu emabega wa buli kulonda.
crypto.h1p1: Curve25519 (RFC 7748) mu ngeri yaayo eya Montgomery, ekozesebwa ku Elliptic-curve Diffie-Hellman. Ebisumuluzo eby’obwannannyini ebya byte 32, ebisumuluzo eby’olukale ebya byte 32, ebifulumizibwa eby’ekyama ebigabanyizibwa bya byte 32.
crypto.h1p2: Ekozesebwa ku: endagamuntu y’ekyuma ekitali kikyukakyuka, ebisumuluzo by’olutuula eby’akaseera obuseera, envulopu ezisibiddwa, okuzinga ebisumuluzo by’ekisenge, envulopu za federo.
crypto.h1p3: okussa mu nkola iOS: `Curve25519.KeyAgreement.PrivateKey` okuva mu CryptoKit. Android: `x25519-dalek` ng'oyita ku JNI. Node: `ensengeka y'ebintu ebikusike.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric.x25519` ku OpenSSL.
crypto.h1p4: Bonsatule bakolagana bit-for-bit. Okudda n’okudda kugezesebwa ku RFC 7748 Alice/Bob test vectors ku buli kuzimba.
crypto.h1p5: Enkola: ~100 μs buli Diffie-Hellman ku iPhone ya 2020, ~30 μs ku Mac ya 2020. Laawundi y’okuzinga ekisumuluzo ky’ekisenge eri ekibinja ky’abantu 200 etwala nga 10 ms wall-clock.
crypto.h1p6: Ekiseera-ekitali kikyuka: yee, byombi mu kubala kwa curve ne mu kkubo ly’okuggya kkoodi lya raw-byte.
crypto.h1p7: Enyimirira y’omukutu ku mabbali: Amadaala ga Montgomery tegaziyiza kiraasi ya bulumbaganyi bwa budde obukuba Weierstrass curves; OpenSSL ne Swift CryptoKit zombi zigikozesa.
crypto.h1p8: Okusengeka ebisumuluzo: 32-byte little-endian. Ebisumuluzo by'olukale binywezebwa ku kuyingiza kale ebiyingizibwa ebitali bikoleddwa bulungi tebireeta kukulukuta kwa low-order-point.
crypto.h1l1: Lwaki X25519 so si P-256: eyangu, entono, tewali NIST-curve concerns.
crypto.h1l2: Lwaki 32-byte output so si 64: ekwatagana bulungi n'obuwanvu bw'okuyingiza HKDF-SHA256.
crypto.h1l3: Lwaki Montgomery so si Edwards: twetaaga DH zokka, so si mikono, ku kintu kino ekikulu. Edwards yandibadde yeetaaga omutendera gw’okukyusa buli mulundi.
crypto.h2p1: EdDSA (RFC 8032) ku edwards25519. Ekisumuluzo ky’olukale ekya byte 32, omukono gwa byte 64.
crypto.h2p2: Ekozesebwa ku: okukakasa node ku bubaka bwa federation, emikono gy'okufulumya-ekisumuluzo ku integrity manifest, bot deploy signing, device long-term identity for Double Ratchet.
crypto.h2p3: Determinism: enkyukakyuka ya RFC 8032 gye tukozesa efulumya omukono gwe gumu emirundi ebiri ku bubaka + ekisumuluzo kye kimu. Apple's CryptoKit ku iOS 17+ ekozesa RFC 8032bis randomized variant — byombi bituufu era byombi bikakasa n'omukakasa yenna akwatagana.
crypto.h2p4: Ebisale by'okukakasa: ~200 μs ku CPU ey'omulembe. Batch okukakasa (`batch_verify ([msg, sig, pk] * N)`) ye ~ 10× mangu buli mukono.
crypto.h2p5: Enkola y'omukono: `R || S`, bytes 32 buli emu, entono-endian.
crypto.h2l1: Okukiikirira ekisumuluzo eky’olukale: Ensonga enyigiriziddwa eya 32-byte. Bulijjo kituufu — tewali "point at infinity" case.
crypto.h2l2: Okukiikirira ekisumuluzo eky’obwannannyini: Ensigo ya byte 32. Skalara egaziyiziddwa efunibwa ku nnyonyi ng’eyita mu SHA-512.
crypto.h2l3: Lwaki si ECDSA: ECDSA yeetaaga RNG ey’omutindo ogwa waggulu ku buli mukono; a biased RNG ekulukuta ekisumuluzo eky’ekyama. Ed25519 ya deterministic, tewali RNG yeetaagibwa mu kiseera ky'akabonero.
crypto.h3p1: AES mu mbeera ya Galois/Counter (NIST SP 800-38D). Ebisumuluzo bya bit 256, nonces ebya bit 96, obubonero obukakasa obwa bit 128.
crypto.h3p2: Ekozesebwa ku: envulopu y'obubaka obusirikitu, envulopu z'ebitundu bya fayiro, emigugu egy'okutereka egy'ensirifu, emigugu egy'okusika egyassiddwako akabonero.
crypto.h3p3: Okuzimba Nonce: buli bubaka bukola nonce empya eya 96-bit random. Node erondoola nonces 10 ^ 6 ezisembayo buli kisenge era n’esuula ebikoppi mu ngeri ey’okwekuuma — kasitoma talina kukola bikoppi mu kifo ekisooka, naye kitwale-tewali kintu kya buseere.
crypto.h3p4: Lwaki 96-bit nonces so si 128-bit: 96 bits ye GCM-standard "deterministic" nonce length, era etuwa 2^32 random nonces nga okutomeragana kw'amazaalibwa tekunnafuuka kweraliikirira. Ekisumuluzo ky’ekisenge kimu kikyusibwakyusibwa edda nga ekyo tekinnatuuka, kale tekirina bulabe.
crypto.h3p5: Sayizi ya tag: ebijjuvu 128 bits. Tetusalako — okutereka okutereka tekulina mugaso era okusalako kwongera ku mikisa gy’okujingirira.
crypto.h3l1: Okusannyalala kwa Hardware: AES-NI (x86), ARMv8-A crypto extensions, crypto blocks eziweereddwayo ku Apple Silicon. Okuyita mu kusiba ~3 GB/s.
crypto.h3l2: Ku byuma eby'edda ARM ebitaliiko bigambo bya crypto: ~300 MB/s nga tuyita mu software. Akyali mangu okusinga disiki IO.
crypto.h3l3: Data ekwatagana: omutwe gwa fuleemu (`{v, room_id, sender_pseudo}`) guyisibwa nga AAD kale omutwe ogujingirire tegujja kukakasa.
crypto.h4p1: HKDF (RFC 5869) ne SHA-256. Efuna ebisumuluzo ebitonotono ebya byte 32 ebingi okuva mu kuyingiza okumu okwa byte 32.
crypto.h4p2: Ekozesebwa ku: okugabanyaamu X25519 ekifulumizibwa mu kisumuluzo eky'okusiba + MAC ekisumuluzo + ekisumuluzo ky'omutwe; okuggya ekisumuluzo kya root ratchet okuva mu round ya Diffie-Hellman; okuzimba ebisumuluzo bya fayiro buli kitundu okuva ku kikolo kya fayiro.
crypto.h4p3: Ennyiriri z'amawulire bulijjo zibeera za kusalawo ASCII: `"v1:okusiba"`, `"v1:mac"`, `"v1:omutwe"`, `"v1:okutereka"`. Enkyusa etusobozesa okukyusakyusa ensengeka y'ebisumuluzo yonna nga tuyita mu nkyukakyuka ya info-string.
crypto.h4p4: Omunnyo guba gwa kwesalirawo. Mu Vortex tukozesa room id nga omunnyo for room-key derivation kale ebisenge eby'enjawulo tebisobola kuddamu kukozesa derived keys mu butanwa ne bwe kiba nti X25519 output y'emu erabika.
crypto.h4l1: Lwaki SHA-256 so si SHA-512: platform zonna zirina hardware SHA-256 acceleration; SHA-512 esingako katono ku CPU za 64-bit naye si ku masimu.
crypto.h4l2: Lwaki si KMAC-based KDF: KMAC ye niche. HKDF eri mu buli crypto library gyetukozesa.
crypto.h5p1: Argon2id (RFC 9106) nga bwe kiri. Ebipimo: m = 64 MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32.
crypto.h5p2: Ekozesebwa ku: hash y'ekigambo ky'okuyingira ku ludda lwa seva (`users.password_hash`), ekisumuluzo ky'okuzinga eky'okutereka mu kitundu, okuyingiza ensigo-ekigambo.
crypto.h5p3: Lwaki parameters zino: OWASP 2023 ebiteeso. 64 MiB + 3 iterations etwala ~0.5 s ku iPhone X — ekyuma kyaffe ekisinga okuwagirwa. Omulumbaganyi ASIC alina 100× memory bandwidth y'essimu akyetaaga ~5 ms buli kugezaako. Ebigambo ebiwanvu (entropy > 40 bits) bifuuka ebitasoboka mu kubala okukutula ku minzaani.
crypto.h5p4: Enkola y'okutereka: `argon2:<encoded>` nga encoded ye RFC-format string omuli omunnyo, memory, iterations, ne hash.
crypto.h5l1: Lwaki Argon2id so si Argon2i oba Argon2d: 2id ye hybrid — okuyita okusooka kuziyiza side-channels (i-mode), okuyita okuddirira kuziyiza GPU/ASIC (d-mode). Signal ekozesa ekintu kye kimu.
crypto.h5l2: Dummy-hash comparison: ne bwe kiba nti omukozesa taliiwo, tukyaddukanya ekicupuli Argon2 verify nga tulina hash etakyukakyuka. Kino kyenkana obudde bw'okuyingira kale abalumbaganyi tebasobola kubala mannya ga bakozesa okusinziira ku budde bw'okuddamu.
crypto.h5l3: Rehash ku kuyingira: singa server admin bumps memory cost, hashes enkadde ziddamu hashed ku login okuddako okuwangula. Entangaavu eri omukozesa.
crypto.h6p1: FIPS 203 (NIST, 2024). ML-KEM-768. Ekisumuluzo kya lukale ekya byte 1184, ekiwandiiko ekikusike ekya byte 1088, ekyama ekigabanyizibwa ekya byte 32.
crypto.h6p2: Ekozesebwa ku: ebisumuluzo by’olutuula lw’oluvannyuma lwa quantum eby’omugatte. Banne bombi bwe balanga obuwagizi bwa Kyber ekisumuluzo ky'olutuula kiba `HKDF(x25519_output || kyber_output)`.
crypto.h6p3: Lwaki hybrid: ne bwe kiba nti Kyber oluvannyuma emenyekedde (eba ntono bw’ogigeraageranya), ekitundu kya X25519 kikyatukuuma. Okugatta kiwa best-of-both.
crypto.h6p4: Lwaki Kyber so si balala NIST abesimbyewo: ye yali eyalondebwa okussa omutindo. Okubeerawo kwa koodi kugazi (liboqs, pqcrypto).
crypto.h6l1: Enkola: omulembe omukulu ~100 μs, encapsulation ~30 μs, decapsulation ~50 μs. Negligible bw’ogeraageranya n’okusirika okudda n’okudda.
crypto.h6l2: Bandwidth cost: 1088 bytes buli session ciphertext, 1184 bytes ku kisumuluzo eky'olukale. Olutuula lusasulwa ku kusooka okukwatagana; oluvannyuma lw’ekyo kiba ziro.
crypto.h6l3: Oludda lwa seva: `pqcrypto` Python ekipapula nga kiriko `kem.ml_kem_768`. Oludda lwa kasitoma: liboqs nga ziyita mu kusiba ku pulatifomu.
crypto.h7p1: Signal's Double Ratchet (nga bwe kirambikiddwa mu 2016 public spec). Egatta Diffie-Hellman ratchet n’olujegere lw’ekisumuluzo olukwatagana.
crypto.h7p2: Ekozesebwa ku: obubaka obutereevu wakati w’ebyuma bibiri. Ebisenge by'ekibinja bikozesa enkola ennyangu eya "ekisumuluzo ky'omusindika" ekisumuluddwa okuva ku kikolo ky'ekisenge.
crypto.h7p3: Ebintu: eby’ekyama mu maaso (okukosa ekyuma kibikkula obubaka bwokka bwe kyafuna edda, so si obw’omu maaso), obukuumi oluvannyuma lw’okukkaanya (okuddamu okukola ratcheting kuwona oluvannyuma lw’okukkaanya ekisumuluzo), okutuusa ebweru w’enkola (obubaka obutuuka ku 1000 obw’okubuuka).
crypto.h7p4: Okussa mu nkola kwaffe kuli mu `app/security/double_ratchet.py` ne `ios/Modules/Sources/Chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.swift` / `android/app/src/main/.../chat/impl/DoubleRatchet.kt`.
crypto.h7l1: Enkoofiira y’obuwanvu bw’olujegere: Obubaka 1000 buli lujegere nga tonnawalirizibwa kuddamu kukola ratchet. Ekoma ku kwonooneka okuva mu kisumuluzo ky’olujegere enzibe.
crypto.h7l2: Skipped-key cache: ebisumuluzo ebiwera 1000 ebitali mu nkola ebikuumibwa mu jjukira buli lujegere. Okusukka awo obubaka bugaanibwa ng’obukadde.
crypto.h7l3: Ensirifu y'omutwe: ku nga bwekiba. Omutwe gutwala metadata ya ratchet era nga gukuumibwa n’ekisumuluzo ky’omutwe ekyetongodde ekiggiddwa mu kikolo nga kiyita mu HKDF.
crypto.h8p1: Endagamuntu ya fayiro etali ya cryptographic n'obulungi bwayo ekozesa BLAKE3 kubanga esinga SHA-256 ku blobs ennene 10×.
crypto.h8p2: Ekozesebwa ku: fayiro `sha256` ennyiriri mu DB (erinnya ly'ebyafaayo; mu butuufu BLAKE3 wansi wa hood okuva v0.1.2), attachment dedup, file-upload integrity check.
crypto.h8p3: Enyimirira y’obukuumi: BLAKE3 ya maanyi mu ngeri ya cryptographic (256-bit); tuyita ennyiriri `sha256` olw'okukwatagana kw'okusenguka kwokka.
crypto.h9p1: Nonces zonna, prekeys, emiwendo gy'okusoomoozebwa gikolebwa nga giyita mu OS RNG: `SecRandom` ku iOS, `java.security.SecureRandom` ku Android, `secrets.token_bytes` ku Python (okuzinga `/dev/urandom` oba ekyenkanankana).
crypto.h9p2: Tobangako `random.random ()`, tewabangako `Math.random ()`, temubangako `rand ()`. Amateeka ga Lint gawera okuzikozesa mu modulo za crypto.
crypto.h10p1: HMAC okugeraageranya, okukakasa omukono, okukakasa password hash — byonna bikozesa constant-time primitives okuziyiza timing side-channels.
crypto.h10p2: Python: `hmac.geraageranya_okugaaya`. Swift: Omuyambi wa `OkugeraageranyaEkiseera Ekitali Kikyuka`. Kotlin: `ObubakaDigest.kyenkanankana`.
crypto.h1_a: X25519 ye Diffie-Hellman eya elliptic-curve ku Curve25519 mu ngeri yaayo eya Montgomery. Ebisumuluzo bya byte 32, ekyama ekigabanyizibwamu bya byte 32. Buli kisumuluzo eky'ekyama / ekisumuluzo ky'ekyuma ekitali kikyukakyuka / ekisumuluzo ky'olutuula mu Vortex kikikozesa.
crypto.h1_b: Alice ne Bob buli omu alina ebisumuluzo eby’obwannannyini a, b n’ebisumuluzo eby’olukale A = a·G, B = b·G nga G ye nsonga y’omusingi gw’enkulungo. Babala s = a·B = b·A. Ekyama kino ekya byte 32 ekigabanyizibwa kigenda mu HKDF-SHA256 okuggya ebisumuluzo bya symmetric AES-GCM. Okubala kwa curve kukolebwa mu kiseera ekitali kikyukakyuka nga tukozesa amadaala ga Montgomery; tewali matabi ku data ey’ekyama.
crypto.h1_c: Curve25519 yafulumizibwa Daniel J. Bernstein mu 2005 era yalondebwa IETF mu RFC 7748 (2016). Yatwalibwa kkampuni ya Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard. Vortex egikozesa kubanga ya mangu okusinga P-256, erina sayizi y’ekisumuluzo ya byte 32 enywevu, yeewala okweraliikirira kwa NIST curve, era buli platform esindika enkola ekalubye.
crypto.h1_f:
Ekisumuluzo eky’ekyama: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bytes little-endian) .
Ekisumuluzo eky’olukale: A = a · G (ekifo ekinyigirizibwa ekya byte 32) .
Ekyama ekigabanyizibwa: s = a · B = b · A (bayiti 32, →HKDF okuyingiza)
crypto.h2_a: Ed25519 ye muganda wa X25519 ow’omukono, ng’akozesa enkokola y’emu mu ngeri yaayo eya twisted-Edwards. Ebisumuluzo by’olukale ebya byte 32, emikono gya byte 64, ebisalibwawo nga bwe biba.
crypto.h2_b: Okussa omukono ku bubaka m n’ekisumuluzo eky’ekyama d: okubala r = SHA-512(d, m), R = r·G, c = SHA-512(R, A, m), S = r + c·a. Omukono gwe (R, S). Okukakasa: kebera R + c·A = S·G. Okussa emikono okusalawo kwewala akabi k’obutaddamu kukozesa ddala — emikono ebiri egy’obubaka bwe bumu n’ekisumuluzo kye kimu gifaanagana bit.
crypto.h2_c: Ed25519 (RFC 8032) yava mu lupapula lwa Bernstein olwa 2011 ne Duif, Lange, Schwabe, ne Yang. Yatwalibwa nnyo oluvannyuma lwa 2013. CryptoKit ya Apple, Tink ya Google, libsodium, OpenSSH byonna bigikozesa. Vortex assa omukono ku buli nvulopu ya federo ne buli node attestation ne Ed25519.
crypto.h2_f:
Akabonero (d, m): r = SHA-512 (d∥m);  R = r·G
              c = SHA-512 (R∥A∥m);  S = r + c·a
              okudda (R, S) .

Kakasa: c = SHA-512 (R∥A∥m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
crypto.h3_a: AES mu Galois/Mode ya Counter. Ebisumuluzo bya 256-bit, 96-bit random nonces, 128-bit okukakasa tags. Buli blob ensirifu mu Vortex ekozesa GCM.
crypto.h3_b: GCM ekola AES mu mbeera ya CTR era ebala GHASH ku ciphertext + AAD ng’ekozesa ekisumuluzo eky’enjawulo ekiggiddwa mu kisumuluzo ky’okusiba. Tag = GHASH(AAD, ekiwandiiko ekikusike) ⊕ AES-CTR(0). Okuggya ensirifu kuddamu okubala GHASH n’okugeraageranya — bit-flip yonna emu eremererwa okukakasa. Hardware-eyanguwa ku buli mulembe CPU okuyita mu AES-NI oba ARMv8-A crypto extensions.
crypto.h3_c: AES yawangula empaka za NIST AES mu 2001. GCM yateekebwa ku mutindo mu NIST SP 800-38D mu 2007 era ye default AEAD mu TLS 1.3. Vortex alonda ebisumuluzo bya 256-bit newankubadde nga 128-bit yandibadde emala ku balabe aba classical — okubuuka ku 256-bit kituwa roughly 128 bits ez’obukuumi obw’oluvannyuma lwa quantum wansi w’enkola ya Grover.
crypto.h3_f:
Encrypt (k, n, aad, pt): ct = AES-CTR (k, n, pt) .
                          tag = GHASH_h (aad∥ct∥lens) ⊕ AES (k, n∥1) .
                          zzaayo ct∥tag
Nonce reuse ⇒ ebyama + obutuufu bumenyeddwa.
crypto.h4_a: HKDF (HMAC-based KDF, RFC 5869) efuula ekisumuluzo kimu mu bingi. Etwala okuyingiza kwa entropy eya waggulu n’akabonero k’embeera; efulumya bytes 32 buli label.
crypto.h4_b: Emitendera ebiri: Ggyayo n’okugaziya. Okuggyamu = HMAC-SHA256(omunnyo, IKM) → PRK. Gaziya = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, info∥counter) eyungiddwa ku bytes za len. Kino tukikozesa okugabanyaamu ekifulumizibwa X25519 mu kisumuluzo ky'okusiba, ekisumuluzo kya MAC, n'ekisumuluzo ky'omutwe nga kiriko ennyiriri z'amawulire "v1:encryption", "v1:mac", "v1:header".
crypto.h4_c: HKDF yafulumizibwa Hugo Krawczyk mu EUROCRYPT 2010 era n’eteekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 5869 mu 2010. Yakozesebwa TLS 1.3 ku nteekateeka yaayo, eya Signal for Double Ratchet, eya WireGuard ku bisumuluzo by’olutuula. Enkyusa mu miguwa gya info etusobozesa okukyusakyusa ensengeka y'ebisumuluzo yonna nga tukuba "v1" → "v2".
crypto.h4_f:
PRK = HMAC-SHA256(omunnyo, IKM) .
T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ amawulire ∥ i) .
OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... esaliddwako okutuuka ku bytes za len
crypto.h5_a: Argon2id ye memory-hard password hash eyakolebwa okuziyiza abalumbaganyi GPU ne ASIC. Ebipimo m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32.
crypto.h5_b: Argon2id etabula Argon2i (eziyiza side-channels nga tezitabikira ku data evudde mu password) ne Argon2d (ejjuza memory mu ngeri etategeerekeka kale parallel hardware tesobola kusala corners). Ekitundu ekisooka eky’okuyita tekikwata ku data (i-mode); ekisigadde kyesigamye ku data (d-mode). 0.5 seconds of compute ku iPhone X ku parameters zaffe, roughly 5 ms ku ASIC — ~100× speedup ntono bw’ogeraageranya ne SHA-256-based hashes nga ASICs ziwangula ne 1 000 000×.
crypto.h5_c: Argon2 yawangula empaka za Password Hashing Competition eza 2015 ezaategekebwa Dmitry Khovratovich ne Alex Biryukov. Yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 9106 mu 2021. Ekozesebwa 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Vortex's parameters ziva mu OWASP 2023 recommendations, tuned down okukola okuyingira ku kyuma kyaffe ekisinga okuwagirwa (iPhone X) wansi wa 1 second.
crypto.h5_f:
omuwendo (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4) ≈ 0.5 s ku iPhone X
omulumbaganyi omuwendo: m × t × (p / okulumba_parallelism)
Ku 1010 okuteebereza/s nga olina 40-bit password entropy:
  Sikonda 1012 = emyaka 32 000
crypto.h6_a: Kyber-768 (ML-KEM-768) ye nkola ya NIST-standardized post-quantum key encapsulation enkola. Ewa ebisumuluzo by’olutuula ebitaliiko bulabe bwa quantum nga bigattiddwa wamu ne X25519.
crypto.h6_b: Alice azaala (pk, sk). Bob ayita Encapsulate (pk) → (c, ss); asindika c eri Alice. Alice ayita Decapsulate(sk, c) → ss. Enjuyi zombi kati zigabana ss, ekyama kya byte 32. Obukuumi bukendeera okutuuka ku kizibu kya Module-LWE, ekiteeberezebwa nti kya quantum-hard. Tukigatta ne X25519: session_key = HKDF(x25519_okufuluma ∥ kyber_okufuluma). Singa ekitundu ekimu kiwona, olutuula luwona.
crypto.h6_c: Kyber yalondebwa NIST mu July 2022 oluvannyuma lw'okuvuganya okumala emyaka 6. Standardized nga FIPS 203 mu August 2024. Vortex esindika Kyber nga optional kubanga eyongera ~2 KB buli session handshake; esobozeseddwa mu butonde ku mitendera egyasasulwa, okulonda okuyingira awalala. Enkola ya hybrid yasemba Signal mu 2023 ate Chrome n’etwalibwa mu 2024.
crypto.h6_f:
KeyGen (): (pk ∈ Zq ^ k, sk ∈ Zq ^ k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps (pk): (ct ∈ Zq ^ k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B. Okuzimba omubiri (t ∈ Zq ^ k, ss ∈ {0,1}26) ct = 1088 B
Ebisengejja (sk, ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256
olutuula lw'omugatte = HKDF (x25519_okufuluma ∥ kyber_okufuluma, info="olutuula-v1")
crypto.h7_a: Signal's Double Ratchet egaba ebyama mu maaso n'obukuumi oluvannyuma lw'okukkaanya ku mboozi za 1:1.
crypto.h7_b: Enjegere bbiri: olujegere olusindika n’olujegere olufuna. Buli bubaka bugenda mu maaso n’olujegere lwabwo nga buyita mu HKDF. Buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera ekiwujjo kya Diffie-Hellman kigenda mu maaso n’ekikolo, ne kiddamu okusumulula enjegere zombi. Okukkaanya ekisumuluzo ky'olujegere kubikkula obubaka bwokka bwe kyasiba butereevu. Oluvannyuma lw’okukuba DH ratchet, obubaka obw’omu maaso tebulina bulabe ne bwe kiba nti omulumbaganyi yabba ekisumuluzo ky’olujegere.
crypto.h7_c: Yakolebwa Trevor Perrin ne Moxie Marlinspike mu 2013, yassibwa mu Signal 2014, eyatwalibwa WhatsApp (2016), Facebook Messenger Secret Conversations, Skype Private Conversations. Public spec mu 2016. Okussa mu nkola kwa Vortex mwalo gwa butereevu; interop ne bakasitoma abalala ba Signal-protocol eri ku v0.4 roadmap.
crypto.h7_f:
sindika: CK = HKDF (CK, "omutendera");  MK = HKDF(CK, "obubaka")
okufuna: CK' = HKDF (CK', "omutendera"); MK' = HKDF(CK', "obubaka")
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(eph_yaffe, eph_yabwe), RK_eyasooka)
crypto.h8_a: BLAKE3 hashing for files — ekitundu ku ssuula ya crypto. Eno y’emu ku nkola enkulu ezijuliziddwa mu kujuliza kwonna okwa Vortex. Soma essuula eyeetooloddewo omanye ensonga egazi; ekitundu kino kigaziya ku nneeyisa entongole.
crypto.h8_b: Okulaba okussa mu nkola "BLAKE3 hashing for files". Enkola eno eteekebwa mu nkola mu modulo ekwatagana wansi wa `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, oba `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README eyita amakubo ga fayiro amatuufu.
crypto.h8_c: Enkola ya "BLAKE3 hashing for files" yakulaakulana mu Vortex ebifulumizibwa. Dizayini eno edda mu kunoonyereza okufulumiziddwa n’enkola z’okufulumya ez’ababaka abaaliwo emabega. Ebyafaayo by’enkyusa mu `CHANGELOG.md` biwandiika buli kitundu lwe kyatuuka ku ttaka n’ekyo ekyakikubiriza.
crypto.h9_a: Okuzaala ennamba mu ngeri ey’ekifuulannenge — ekitundu ky’essuula ya crypto. Eno y’emu ku nkola enkulu ezijuliziddwa mu kujuliza kwonna okwa Vortex. Soma essuula eyeetooloddewo omanye ensonga egazi; ekitundu kino kigaziya ku nneeyisa entongole.
crypto.h9_b: Okulaba okussa mu nkola kwa "Okuzaala ennamba mu ngeri ey'ekifuulannenge". Enkola eno eteekebwa mu nkola mu modulo ekwatagana wansi wa `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, oba `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README eyita amakubo ga fayiro amatuufu.
