cryptoWire.title: Enkola za waya za crypto
cryptoWire.subtitle: Ensengeka za byte entuufu ku buli blob encrypted.
cryptoWire.intro: Essuula eno eraga bytes eziri ku waya. Omuntu yenna assa mu nkola kasitoma omulala oba ekintu eky’okunoonyereza ku misango asobola okusoma awamu.
cryptoWire.h1p1: Enzimba: `{v:1, nonce:<12-byte hex>, ciphertext:<hex ekyukakyuka>, omusindika_pseudo:<32-hex>, yasindikibwa_ku:<unix_ms>}`. Eweerezeddwa ku HTTPS (POST) ne WebSocket (ekika kya fuleemu `m`).
cryptoWire.h1p2: `ciphertext` ebirimu oluvannyuma lwa AES-GCM okuggya ensirifu: CBOR `{v:1, ekiwandiiko?:<omuguwa>, ebigattibwako?:[<file_id>, ...], okuddamu_ku?:<msg_id>, okulongoosa?:[<ekiwandiiko_eky'emabega>, ...], kyogera?:[<user_id>, ...]}`.
cryptoWire.h1p3: Tag egoberera: `ciphertext` byte string ye (omugugu ogukuumibwa || tag ya byte 16). Kasitoma eyawukana ku buwanvu.
cryptoWire.h1p4: AAD: ennukuta entono hex room id eyisibwa nga data ekwatagana. Okusiba room id kiremesa cross-room replay.
cryptoWire.h2p1: Ekisumuluzo ky'ekikolo kya fayiro kiri random 32 bytes. Ekisumuluzo kya buli kitundu: `HKDF(ekikolo, info: "fayiro:ekitundu:" + <offset>, len: 32)`.
cryptoWire.h2p2: Ekiwandiiko ekikusike eky'ekitundu: AES-GCM nga kiriko ekisumuluzo kya buli kitundu, nonce eya random 96-bit, AAD: `<file_id> || <okuggyako>`. Ekipimo ekisinga obunene 512 KiB.
cryptoWire.h2p3: Obutuufu bwa fayiro yonna: kasitoma abala BLAKE3 ku biwandiiko ebya bulijjo era n'asindika nga `plain_blake3` eri oyo afuna ng'ayita mu bubaka bw'ekisenge. Omuntu afuna addamu okubala oluvannyuma lw’okuwanula n’akakasa.
cryptoWire.h3p2: Okusika bwe kubaawo, node ekola ekisumuluzo kya X25519 eky’akaseera obuseera, ekola DH ne `p256dh_pub`, efuna ekisumuluzo kya AES-GCM ng’eyita mu HKDF.
cryptoWire.h3p3: Blob essiddwako akabonero: `{enkomerero, p256dh: ebbaala ya kasitoma, okukakasa: bytes 16, data: ciphertext||tag}`. APNs/FCM laba `data` yokka.
cryptoWire.h3p4: Kasitoma aggyamu ensirifu ku kufuna ng'akozesa ekisumuluzo kye eky'ekyama ne `p256dh` (nga mu butuufu ye node's ephemeral pub mu envulopu).
cryptoWire.h4p1: Password efuna ekisumuluzo eky'okutereka ng'eyita mu Argon2id (m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, omunnyo = <random 16B>, hashLen = 32).
cryptoWire.h4p2: Blob: `{omunnyo, nonce, ekiwandiiko ekikusike}`. Ekiwandiiko ekikusike kiri CBOR ekya `{v:1, ebisenge:[{id,key,ct_refs}...], profile:{...}, abakwatagana:[...]}`.
cryptoWire.h4p3: Eterekebwa oba mu kitundu (iCloud / Google Drive) oba ku node mu kisenge ky'omukozesa eky'ekyama.
cryptoWire.h5p1: Obubaka bwa cross-node: `{source_node: <pubkey>, target_user: <id>, munda: {... kye kimu ne envulopu y'ekisenge ...}, sig: <64-byte Ed25519>}`.
cryptoWire.h5p2: `sig` ekwata ku CBOR-esengekeddwa mu lunyiriri `{source_node, target_user, inner}`. Target ekakasa ku `source_node` pubkey okuva mu `trusted_nodes`.
cryptoWire.h1_a: Obubaka bw’ekisenge kimu ku waya buba CBOR dict nga buliko payload ensirifu, nonce, erinnya ery’obulimba eriweereza, ne timestamp. Envulopu y’emu oba evuga HTTPS (POST) oba WebSocket (ekika kya fuleemu `m`).
cryptoWire.h1_b: Kasitoma asengeka omubiri gw'obubaka `{v:1, ekiwandiiko, okuddamu_ku, okusindikibwa_ku}` nga CBOR → `pt`. Ekola nonce ya byte 12 eya random. Abala `aad = hex (ekisenge_id)`. Ayita `ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt (ekisenge_ekisumuluzo, nonce, pt, aad)`. Ezinga mu `{v:1, ekiwandiiko ekikusike: hex (ct), nonce: hex (nonce), sender_pseudo: hex (pseudo), sent_at: unix_ms}` era esindika. Receiver akakasa GCM tag mu kiseera kya decrypt, olwo CBOR-parses ebiwandiiko ebitegeerekeka.
cryptoWire.h1_c: Enkula ya waya eriko nkyusa-tagged okuva v0.0.4 oluvannyuma lw'okufulumya v0.0.3 okuggwaamu embuto okwali tekulina nnimiro ya `v` — twalina okukuba ensengeka yonna bwe twagattako `thread_id` kubanga bakasitoma abakadde baagwa ku kisumuluzo ekitamanyiddwa. Ekyokuyiga: buli kifaananyi kya waya eky’omu maaso kitwala `v:N` mu nnimiro yaakyo esooka kale okukwatagana mu maaso kweyoleka bulungi.
cryptoWire.h2_a: Fayiro zaawulwamu ebitundu bya sayizi ezitakyukakyuka, buli emu n’ekisumuluzo kyayo ekiggiddwa mu kikolo kya fayiro n’ekitundu ekikyusiddwa. Ensirifu ya buli kitundu kireka omusindika okuyimirira/okuddamu ku nsalosalo yonna eya chunk.
cryptoWire.h2_b: Ekisumuluzo ky'ekikolo kya fayiro kiri random 32 bytes. Ekisumuluzo kya buli kitundu kiri `HKDF (ekikolo, info = "fayiro:ekitundu:" + str (offset), len = 32)`. Buli kitundu kikuumibwa AES-GCM n'ekisumuluzo kyakyo, random 96-bit nonce, ne `aad = file_id ∥ offset`. Chunks zisookera ku 512 KiB; 4 Enkoofiira ya MiB. Fayiro enzijuvu BLAKE3 esindikibwa nga `plain_blake3` mu bubaka bw'ekisenge obujuliza fayiro abafuna basobole okukakasa oluvannyuma lw'okuggyamu.
cryptoWire.h2_c: Chunked E2E encryption with per-chunk keys yatandikibwawo Mega.nz mu 2013 era n’erongoosebwa Signal’s large-file support mu 2019. Vortex’s 512 KiB default ye sayizi TCP flow control gy’ekuuma payipu ng’ejjudde awatali mikira miwanvu ku mobile 4G. Twagezesa 256/512/1024/4096 KiB era 512 ye yali ewooma mu bipimo byaffe.
cryptoWire.h3_a: Envulopu essiddwako akabonero ekweka omugugu gw'okumanyisa okuva ku Apple / Google / Mozilla nga esiba n'ekisumuluzo kya X25519 ekikwata ku kyuma.
cryptoWire.h3_b: Kasitoma awandiika `p256dh_pub` ne `auth` ku node. Nga okusika kulina okubaawo, node edduka ephemeral-ECDH ne p256dh_pub, efuna ekisumuluzo + nonce okuyita mu HKDF nga ekyama kya auth nga omunnyo. Encrypts `{omutwe, omubiri, ekisenge_id, obubaka_id}` ne AES-GCM. Sindika likodi nga ennimiro ya `data` etali ya bulambulukufu eri omugabi w'okusika. Ekyongerwako ky'ekyuma kiddamu okuggya, okuggyamu, kulaga.
cryptoWire.h3_c: Okusika okussiddwako akabonero ye Web Push Message Encryption spec (RFC 8291, 2017). Apple yakitwala mu iOS 16's Notification Service Extensions. Nga sealed push tennafuuka ewagirwa nnyo, Signal ne WhatsApp zaasindika ping ezisirise "ekintu kyatuuse" nga tezirina birimu era nga app ereeta obubaka ku wake-up — nga kino kyali kigenda mpola. Sealed push etuwa eby’ekyama okuva ku nkomerero okutuuka ku nkomerero nga kwogasse n’okulaga amangu.
cryptoWire.h4_a: Encrypted backup blob ereka omukozesa okuzzaawo ebisumuluzo by'ekisenge + profile + okumala ennaku 90 ku kyuma ekipya okuva ku password yokka.
cryptoWire.h4_b: Ekisumuluzo kya backup kiva mu password nga kiyita mu Argon2id nga kiriko omunnyo gwa random 16-byte. Omugugu guli CBOR: `{v:1, ebisenge: [{id, ekisumuluzo, msg_ref_ids}], profile, contacts}`. Encrypted ne AES-GCM wansi w'ekisumuluzo ekiggiddwamu. Eterekebwa oba mu kitundu (iCloud / Google Drive) oba nga fayiro mu kisenge ky'ekire eky'ekyama eky'omukozesa. Okuzzaawo: ssaamu password → Argon2id → decrypt → ddamu okuyingiza ebisumuluzo n'ebijuliziddwa.
cryptoWire.h4_c: Enkola eno ekoleddwa ku OPVault eya 1Password (2013) ne Bitwarden’s encrypted export (2017). Bombi bakozesa KDF-olwo-AEAD ne metadata erimu omunnyo. Vortex yayongeddeko okusala kw’ennaku 90 kubanga backups z’ebyafaayo ebijjuvu zaali 100 MB+ mu kugezesa; ekitundu ekisinga obunene eky'okuzzaawo kyetaaga obubaka obusembyeyo bwokka, era ebirimu eby'edda bikyatuukirirwa okuyita mu ciphertext ya seva ng'omukozesa alina omukutu.
cryptoWire.h5_a: Obubaka bwa cross-node federation buzinga envulopu ey'omunda eyasibirwa edda mu envulopu ey'ebweru eriko omukono ng'ekakasa envulopu y'ensibuko.
cryptoWire.h5_b: Node A esengeka `{source_node, target_user, inner_ct, munda_nonce, sent_ku}` nga CBOR. Ebipande n'ekisumuluzo kyayo eky'obwannannyini ekya Ed25519 → `sig`. POSTs `{envulopu, sig}` ku node B's `/federation/okutuusa`. B akakasa `sig` ku pubkey ku `source_node` mu `federations`, akebera timestamp mu ddirisa lya skew ery'eddakiika 5, olwo n'awandiika ciphertext ey'omunda ku mmeeza yaayo eya `messages` eri omukozesa agenderera.
cryptoWire.h5_c: Envulopu ez’ebweru eziriko emikono zeewolwa okuva mu Matrix’s federation spec (2015) ne ActivityPub’s HTTP Signatures (2018). Eddirisa lino ery’eddakiika 5 likwatagana n’okuteesa kwa SMTP RFC 5321 era liziyiza obulumbaganyi obw’okuddamu okuzannya ng’omulumbaganyi akwata federo emu POST n’addamu okugizannya oluvannyuma lw’essaawa. Vortex yalonze Ed25519 okusinga RSA-PSS kubanga emikono gya Ed25519 giri 64 bytes vs RSA-PSS-2048's 256 bytes — kikulu nga federation eri mu mboozi.
cryptoWire.h1_f:
pt = CBOR{v:1, ekiwandiiko, okuddamu_ku?, thread_id?, okwogera?, okusindikibwa_ku}
ct = AES-GCM-256-Encrypt (ekisenge_ekisumuluzo, nonce, pt, aad = hex (ekisenge_id))
waya = CBOR{ .
  v: 1, 10.
  ciphertext: hex (ct), // obuwanvu obukyukakyuka
  nonce: hekisi(12 B), .
  omusindika_obulimba: hex (16 B), .
  esindikiddwa_ku: unix_ms
}
cryptoWire.h2_f:
fayiro_ekikolo = rand (32) .
chunk_key (o) = HKDF (fayiro_ekikolo, "fayiro:chunk:" + o, 32)
chunk_ct (o) = AES-GCM (chunk_key (o), rand (12), ebiwandiiko ebitegeerekeka, aad = fayiro_id ∥ o)
full_hash = BLAKE3 (ebiwandiiko_ebya_bytes_bya_fayiro_enzijuvu) // esindikiddwa nga plain_blake3
cryptoWire.h3_f:
eky’akaseera obuseera = (priv, pub);  ikm = ECDH (eby’akaseera obuseera.priv, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(omuwandiisi, ikm)
ekisumuluzo = HKDF-Expand (prk, "Ebirimu-Okuwandiika: aes128gcm \ 0", 16)
nonce = HKDF-Expand (prk, "Ebirimu-Okuwandiika: nonce \ 0", 12)
ct = AES-GCM(ekisumuluzo, nonce, CBOR{omutwe, omubiri, ekisenge_id, obubaka_id})
waya = omunnyo (16) ∥ rs (4) ∥ obutakola (1) ∥ ephemeral.pub (32) ∥ ct
cryptoWire.h4_f:
omunnyo = rand(16) .
ekisumuluzo = Argon2id (ekigambo ky'okuyita, omunnyo, m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, len = 32)
nonce = randi (12) .
ct = AES-GCM(ekisumuluzo, nonce, CBOR{ebisenge, profile, abantu abakwatagana}, aad="vortex-backup-v1")
fayiro = {v:1, omunnyo, nonce, ct}

auth.title: Okukakasa
auth.subtitle: Wewandiise, yingira, zza obuggya, okusazaamu. JWT + X25519 + ekisumuluzo ky'okuyita eky'okwesalirawo / ensigo / 2FA.
auth.intro: Vortex efulumya JWTs eziwangaala (15 min access, 30 days refresh) nga ekisumuluzo ky'olukale X25519 ky'omukozesa kisibiddwa mu Buli nkomerero enzibu ekebera JWT + ekakasa nti ekisumuluzo tekisaziddwamu. Essuula eno ekwata ku buli kutambula okuva ku nkomerero okutuuka ku nkomerero.
auth.h1p1: Kasitoma atandika n’okukola ekisumuluzo eky’ekyama ekipya ekya byte 32 X25519 nga kiriko OS RNG. Kiggya ekisumuluzo eky'olukale, enkodi nga 64 hex chars.
auth.h1p2: Kasitoma awandiika `POST /api/authentication/register` ne `{erinnya ly'omukozesa, ekigambo ky'okuyita, x25519_ekisumuluzo_eky'olukale, erinnya_olw'okulaga, essimu, email, avatar_emoji, kyber_public_key?}`.
auth.h1p3: Node ekakasa: erinnya ly'omukozesa likwatagana ne `^[a-z0-9_]{3,30}$` (ennukuta entono okwewala okusiba homograph); password eyita zxcvbn-style amaanyi (min obubonero 2); essimu ekwatagana E.164 singa eweebwa; email ekwatagana RFC 5322 basic regex singa eweebwa.
auth.h1p4: Node ekebera `x25519_public_key` uniqueness — buli pubkey esobola okuwandiisa akawunti emu ddala. Kino kiyimiriza obulumbaganyi bw'okuwandiisa mu bungi obuddamu okukozesa pubkey y'emu.
auth.h1p5: Node ekola Argon2id ku password (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) era etereka `argon2:$...$` mu `users.password_hash`.
auth.h1p6: Node mints JWTs bbiri: okuyingira (eddakiika 15, `jti:<device_id>`) n'okuzza obuggya (30 d). Ebigamba: `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: okuyingira|okuzza obuggya, exp: ...}`. Essiddwako omukono HS256 ku kyama kya seva ekya byte 64 ekitikkiddwa okuva mu `.env`.
auth.h1p7: Node ekola olunyiriri lwa `ebyuma_omukozesa`: `{id_omukozesa, id_ekyuma, agent_omukozesa, yatondebwa_ku}`. Buli kuzza obuggya kusibiddwa ku device_id yaayo; okusazaamu ekyuma kitta omugga ogwo gwokka.
auth.h1p8: Okuddamu: `{ok, user_id, erinnya_omukozesa, access_token, refresh_token, x25519_ekisumuluzo_eky'olukale, kyber_public_key, okulaga_erinnya, avatar_url, essimu, email}`.
auth.h1p9: Kasitoma atereka obubonero mu Keychain (iOS) / EncryptedSharedPreferences (Android) / HttpOnly SameSite=Kukisi enkakali (omukutu).
auth.h1l1: Ekkomo ku miwendo: Okwewandiisa 5 buli sikonda 60 buli IP. TESTING=kituufu kilemesa kino.
auth.h1l2: Omutindo gw'okuyita: singa `REGISTRATION_MODE=invite`, omubiri gulina okubeeramu `invite_code` entuufu. Codes zikolebwa nga ziyita mu admin API.
auth.h1l3: Omutindo oguggaddwa: `REGISTRATION_MODE=ggaddwa`. Admin w'ensigo yekka y'asobola okwewandiisa. Abakozesa abaddako batuuka nga bayita mu nkolagana z’okuyita mu bisenge ebitongole.
auth.h2p1: Kasitoma awandiika `POST /api/okukakasa/okuyingira` ne `{erinnya ly'omukozesa, ekigambo ky'okuyingira}`.
auth.h2p2: Node ebuuza `abakozesa` nga ekozesa erinnya ly'omukozesa eririko ennukuta entono. Bwe kiba tekizuuliddwa, ekyaddukanya dummy Argon2 verify okusinziira ku hash etakyukakyuka okwenkanankana obudde (~0.5 s either way).
auth.h2p3: Singa Argon2 verify etuuka ku buwanguzi era nga akawunti telemesebwa, node ezzaayo envulopu y'emu nga register. Olunyiriri olupya `user_devices` lutondeddwawo; ennyiriri eziriwo zirekebwa zokka omukozesa asobole okuyingira ku byuma ebingi.
auth.h2p4: Singa okukakasa kulemererwa, node ezzaayo 401 ne `{error:"invalid credentials"}`. Tewali njawulo wakati wa "erinnya ly'omukozesa erikyamu" ne "ekigambo ky'okuyita ekikyamu" mu kuddamu.
auth.h2l1: Ekkomo ku muwendo: Okugezaako 10 okulemererwa buli sikonda 60 buli IP. Okusukka kuzzaayo 429 n'omutwe `Retry-After`.
auth.h2l2: Account lockout: 20 okugezaako okulemererwa mu 24 h flag account for admin review. Abakozesa Legit bamala kuzzaawo password-reset ekkubo lyabwe okuyingira.
auth.h2l3: Okulondoola entuula: `/api/authentication/devices` kuwandiika entuula zonna ezikola; omukozesa asobola okusazaamu yonna.
auth.h3p1: Nga akabonero k'okuyingira kali kumpi okuggwaako (kasitoma alondoola `exp` mu kitundu) oba okusaba bwe kuzza 401 nga `akabonero kaggwaako`, kasitoma awandiika `POST /api/authentication/refresh` ne `{refresh_token}`.
auth.h3p2: Node eggyamu okuzza obuggya, ekebera nti `jti` ekyaliwo mu `user_devices` (teyasazibwamu), ekebera `exp`, era ekuba akabonero k'okuyingira akapya.
auth.h3p3: Okukyusakyusa okuzza obuggya kuzikiddwa mu butonde. Ssobozesa ne `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` okufulumya okuzza obuggya okupya nakyo.
auth.h3p4: Singa okuzza obuggya kuggwaako, kusaziddwamu, oba okujingirira, node ezzaayo 401. Kasitoma afuluma mu kitundu era n'asaba okuddamu okuyingira.
auth.h4p1: Bakasitoma ba Web basobola okuwandiisa ekikakasa omukutu (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric). Seva etereka `{credential_id, ekisumuluzo_eky'olukale, counter}`.
auth.h4p2: Okuyingira: `POST /api/okukakasa/passkey/begin` → seva ezzaayo okusoomoozebwa; obubonero bwa kasitoma n’ekisumuluzo ky’okuyita eky’obwannannyini (ekikuumibwa mu Secure Enclave / TPM); `POST /api/okukakasa/passkey/finish` → seva ekakasa era n'efulumya JWT.
auth.h4p3: Okukebera monotonicity ya counter: buli kukakasa kulina okwongera ku counter. Bwe kitaba bwe kityo, passkey etwalibwa nga cloned era egaanibwa.
auth.h5p1: Nga ekkubo ly’okuddamu okukola mu katyabaga, omukozesa asobola okufulumya ensigo ey’ebigambo 24 BIP-39. Okugiyingiza ku kyuma kyonna kiddamu okuzimba endagamuntu ya X25519 (ensigo → HKDF → ekisumuluzo ekitakyuka) era kikakasa okubeera nga kiyita mu kusoomoozebwa okuteekeddwako omukono.
auth.h5p2: Ensigo teva ku kyuma ekyo. Node elaba ekisumuluzo ky'olukale X25519 ekiggiddwamu kyokka n'omukono ku kusoomoozebwa kwa seva.
auth.h5p3: Entropy: Ebitundu 256 (bayiti 32). BIP-39 checksum ya mutindo, kale ensobi z'okuwandiika zikwatibwa nga tezinnaba kutuuka ku seva.
auth.h6p1: TOTP (RFC 6238) nga erina emitendera gya s 30 ne koodi za digito 6. Okwesalirawo buli mukozesa.
auth.h6p2: Okwewandiisa: `POST /api/okukakasa/2fa/setup` ezzaayo ekyama + otpauth URI + QR. Omukozesa asika ne Google Omukakasa / Authy / 1Password. Omukozesa azzaayo sampuli ya koodi ya digito 6 okukakasa nti app ekola.
auth.h6p3: Yingira ne 2FA: oluvannyuma lw'ekigambo ky'okuyita okuyita, node ezzaayo `{needs_2fa: true}`. Kasitoma asaba koodi era n'awandiika ku `/api/authentication/login/2fa`.
auth.h6p4: Ekkomo ku muwendo: 5 TOTP okugezaako buli ddakiika 5 buli mukozesa. Okusukka kuleeta cooldown ya sekondi 60 n’okulabula ku email.
auth.h6p5: Koodi z’okutereka: Koodi za digito 12 × 10 eziragibwa omulundi gumu nga weewandiisa. Buli koodi esobola okukozesebwa omulundi gumu gwennyini.
auth.h7p1: Essimu eyingidde esobola okulinnya tabuleti empya ng’erina koodi ya QR. Ekyuma A kiwandiika `POST /api/authentication/qr/begin` → seva ezzaayo nonce ne TTL.
auth.h7p2: Ekyuma A kiraga QR erimu `nonce + user_id + server_url`. Ekyuma B kisika ne kiteeka `POST /api/authentication/qr/verify` ne nonce.
auth.h7p3: Server ekakasa nonce ekyali mulamu (TTL 60 s, one-shot), esiba ekintu B ekipya X25519 pubkey ku akawunti y'omukozesa A (olunyiriri olupya `user_devices`), era n'edda JWT ku kyuma B.
auth.h7p4: Ekyuma A kifuna okumanyisibwa kwa WebSocket `{type:"n", event:"new_device"}` omukozesa asobole okukakasa / okusazaamu mu kiseera ekituufu.
auth.h8p1: Tuzzaayo mu bugenderevu ensobi y'emu ku "erinnya ly'omukozesa eritamanyiddwa" ne "ekigambo ky'okuyita ekikyamu". Ekkomo ku muwendo gw'okuwandiisa likweka amannya g'abakozesa agaliwo.
auth.h8p2: Enkomerero za profile (`/api/users/{erinnya ly'omukozesa}`) zeetaaga auth. Attacker tasobola kubala mannya ga bakozesa nga talina kabonero katuufu.
auth.h8p3: Ekkomo ku muwendo ku `/api/authentication/login` likuuma brute force ku crawl.
auth.h1_a: Okwewandiisa kutondawo endagamuntu empya: X25519 keypair ku kyuma, Argon2id password hash ku server, JWT pair efulumiziddwa ku buwanguzi.
auth.h1_b: Omutendera 1: kasitoma addukanya `crypto.randomBytes(32)` ku kisumuluzo eky'ekyama X25519, aggya ekisumuluzo eky'olukale (~100 μs ku ssimu). Omutendera 2: POST /api/okukakasa/okwewandiisa ne `{erinnya ly'omukozesa, ekigambo ky'okuyita, x25519_ekisumuluzo_eky'olukale, erinnya_ly'okulaga, essimu, email, avatar_emoji}`. Omutendera 3: node ekakasa okuyita mu Pydantic (erinnya ly’omukozesa regex, password ≥ 8 chars, essimu E.164, email RFC-5322-lite). Omutendera 4: node eddukanya Argon2id (password) → `argon2:...`, etereka mu `users.password_hash`. Omutendera 5: node efulumya okuyingira JWT (eddakiika 15) + okuzza obuggya JWT (ennaku 30), enywerera ku lunyiriri lwa `user_devices`.
auth.h1_c: Okukulukuta kwe nkulaakulana ey'omulembe ey'omulembe gwa PHP ogwa mysql_real_escape_string. Buli auth stack ey’omulembe — Auth0, Firebase, Supabase — ekola roughly ekifaananyi kino. The specific twist mu Vortex kwe kusindika X25519 pubkey mu register call: kitegeeza account esibiddwa ku long-term E2E identity okuva ku frame emu, so si kwongerwako oluvannyuma. Yaluŋŋamizibwa enkola ya Signal eya 2013 protocol design.
auth.h2_a: Okuyingira kukakasa ekigambo ky'okuyingira ku hash ya Argon2 eterekeddwa era n'efulumya JWT pair empya singa ekwatagana.
auth.h2_b: POST /api/okukakasa/okuyingira ne `{erinnya ly'omukozesa, ekigambo ky'okuyingira}`. Node ebuuza `abakozesa` nga ekozesa erinnya ly'omukozesa eririko ennukuta entono. Bwe kizuulibwa, ekakasa Argon2id mu kiseera ekitali kikyukakyuka ku `users.password_hash`. Bwe kiba tekizuuliddwa, ekyadduka dummy Argon2 verify ku lunyiriri olutakyukakyuka okwenkanya obudde. Obuwanguzi → empya JWT pair + empya `user_devices` olunyiriri (emu buli kyuma ekiyingidde). Okulemererwa → 401 n'obukakafu obw'enjawulo "ebiwandiiko ebitali bituufu" — tewali njawulo wakati w'erinnya ly'omukozesa ebbi n'ekigambo ky'okuyita ekibi, okuziyiza okubala.
auth.h2_c: Okukakasa obudde obutasalako n’okukozesa hashing ey’obulimba eri abakozesa abataliiwo ye nkola Signal gye yakwata mu 2014 oluvannyuma lw’abanoonyereza okulaga okubala obudde ku nkomerero yaabwe ey’okuyingira. Okuva olwo kyatwalibwa nnyo — django-axes, authelia, Keycloak byonna bikikozesa. Enkola eyongera ~0.5 s ku buli kugezaako okuyingira okulemererwa, ekintu ekirungi; tugerageranya-ekkomo okuyingira ku 10/min/IP anyway.
auth.h2_f:
dummy_hash = Argon2id ("__ekiseera_ekyenkanya__", omunnyo = gutereezeddwa, ...)

okuyingira (u, p): .
  olunyiriri = abakozesa.zudde (erinnya ly'omukozesa = u.wansi ())
  singa olunyiriri luba Tewali:
      Argon2Verify (dummy_hash, p) // okwenkanya obudde
      okusitula 401
  bwe kiba nga si Argon2Verify (olunyiriri.ekigambo ky'okuyita_hash, p):
      okusitula 401
  okuddamu ensonga_jwt (olunyiriri)
auth.h3_a: Obubonero bw’okuyingira buggwaako oluvannyuma lw’eddakiika 15. Refresh ewanyisiganya akabonero k'okuzza obuggya akawangaala n'akabonero akapya ak'okuyingira nga tezzeemu kusaba mukozesa kigambo kye eky'okuyingira.
auth.h3_b: Kasitoma alondoola `exp` mu kitundu. Bwe `kati + 30s > exp`, oba nga okusaba kuzza 401 ne `token_expired`, kasitoma POST akabonero k'okuzza obuggya ku `/api/authentication/refresh`. Node eggyamu kkoodi, ekebera `jti` eri mu `user_devices` so si `revoked_at`, ekebera `exp`, era ekuba akabonero akapya ak'okuyingira ak'eddakiika 15. Okukyusakyusa okuzza obuggya is opt-in via `ROTATE_REFRESH=true` — off by default kubanga okukyusakyusa obubonero bw'okuzza obuggya ku buli kuzza obuggya okuyingira kuleeta emisinde nga bakasitoma babiri bazza obuggya omulundi gumu.
auth.h3_c: OAuth 2.0 (RFC 6749, 2012) yaleeta okwawula okuyingira + okuzza obuggya. Obulamu bw’okutuuka obw’eddakiika 15 bwe bu wakati mu mulimu gwonna — Google ekozesa essaawa 1, Auth0 esookera ku ssaawa 24, Okta ku ssaawa 1. Twalonda 15 min okukendeeza ku ddirisa nga mu kiseera kino akabonero k’okuyingira akabbibwa ka mugaso. Okuzza obuggya ennaku 30 kukwatagana n’ekyo apps ezisinga ku ssimu ze zeetaaga okukuuma abakozesa nga bayingira mu mwezi gumu nga tebakola.
auth.h4_a: WebAuthn / okuyingira mu kisumuluzo ky’okuyita kukozesa ekikakasa omukutu (Touch ID, Face ID, Windows Hello, Android biometric) mu kifo ky’ekigambo ky’okuyingira.
auth.h4_b: Okwewandiisa: server eteeka okusoomoozebwa; omukakasa wa kasitoma akola ekisumuluzo ekipya munda mu enclave yaayo obukuumi era n'azzaayo ekisumuluzo eky'olukale + okukakasa. Seva etereka `{credential_id, ekisumuluzo_eky'olukale, counter}`. Okuyingira: `POST /api/okukakasa/passkey/begin` → seva ezzaayo okusoomoozebwa; kasitoma assa emikono n’ekisumuluzo eky’ekyama eky’omukakasa (ekikuumibwa mu Secure Enclave, tekiva ku chip); `POST /api/authentication/passkey/finish` → seva ekakasa omukono ku kisumuluzo eky'olukale ekiterekeddwa. Omubala wa monotonic azuula ebikakasa ebikoleddwa mu ngeri ya cloned.
auth.h4_c: FIDO2 / WebAuthn yassibwa ku mutindo W3C mu 2019 oluvannyuma lw’okukola emyaka mingi FIDO Alliance. Apple yayongeddeko obuyambi bwa platform-authenticator mu iOS 16 (2022); Google, Microsoft, 1Ekigambo ky'okuyita kyagobereddwa. Vortex yakwatibwa WebAuthn mu v0.0.8. Kiba kya kwesalirawo naye kirungi nnyo — abakozesa ebisumuluzo by’okuyita tebalaba kutwala akawunti eyesigamiziddwa ku phishing kubanga ekisumuluzo eky’ekyama tekisalako nsalo ya kyuma.
auth.h5_a: Okuzzaawo ensigo-ebigambo kuddamu okuzimba endagamuntu ya X25519 ku kyuma ekipya okuva mu kujjukira okw’ebigambo 24 BIP-39. Tekyetaagisangako seva kukwata kintu kyonna ekiggyamu ensirifu.
auth.h5_b: Omukozesa awandiika wansi mnemonic ku kusooka okutongoza (optional, one-time prompt). Okuddamu: ku kyuma ekipya, omukozesa ayingira mu mnemonic; kasitoma adduka PBKDF2-HMAC-SHA512(okujjukira, "okujjukira", lawundi 2048) → bytes 64 ez'ensigo. Bytes 32 ezisooka ez’ensigo zifuuka ekisumuluzo eky’ekyama X25519; ekisumuluzo eky’olukale kiggibwa. Server etegeezebwa ekisumuluzo eky'olukale ekipya kyokka; ekakasa okubeera n'okusoomoozebwa-okuddamu kwa Ed25519 (okussa omukono nonce), olwo n'efulumya JWTs.
auth.h5_c: BIP-39 (Bitcoin Improvement Proposal 39, 2013) y’engeri ey’ennono ey’okuwandiika ebyama eby’ekyama ng’enkalala z’ebigambo ezijjukirwanga. Enkuluze y’Olungereza ey’ebigambo 2048 ng’eriko checksum ya byte 4 ku nkomerero. Vortex ekozesa ebigambo 24 kubanga omutindo gw’amakolero ku waleti ez’obukuumi obw’amaanyi (Trezor, Ledger) guli 24. Ebigambo 12 byandibadde bimala obukuumi bwa 128-bit naye tebirabika nga bya maanyi kimala eri abakozesa abasinga obungi.
auth.h5_f:
ebigambo = BIP39_Encode (entropy=256_bits + 8_bit_okukebera_okukebera)
ensigo = PBKDF2-SHA512(ebigambo, "okujjukira", enzirugavu=2048, len=64)
sk = ensigo [0:32] // X25519 eky'ekyama
pk = sk · G // X25519 mu lujjudde
auth.h6_a: Okukakasa okw’ensonga bbiri kwongera ku mutendera gw’ekigambo ky’okuyita ogw’omulundi gumu (TOTP) ogwesigamiziddwa ku budde oluvannyuma lw’okukakasa ekigambo ky’okuyingira.
auth.h6_b: Okwewandiisa: `POST /api/authentication/2fa/setup` → seva ekola ekyama ekitali kigenderere ekya bit 160, ekizzaayo nga base32 string + an otpauth:// URI for QR scanning. Omukozesa asika ne Google Omukakasa / Authy / 1Password; posts back a sample 6-digit code okukakasa nti setup yakola. Okuyingira: oluvannyuma lw'ekigambo ky'okuyita okuyita, seva ezzaayo `{needs_2fa: true}` mu kifo kya JWTs. Kasitoma asaba koodi ya digito 6 ne POSTs `/api/authentication/login/2fa`. Seva ekakasa HOTP(ekyama, T=kati_unix / 30) ku koodi.
auth.h6_c: TOTP yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 6238 mu 2011 nga Mark Pei. Nga ekyo tekinnatuuka, RSA SecurID yakozesanga enkola ey’obwannannyini; oluvannyuma, buli app ya 2FA yasenga ku TOTP. Omutendera gwa Vortex ogwa sikonda 30 n’obuwanvu bwa digito 6 bye bisookerwako RFC. Backup codes (12 × 10-digit, eragiddwa omulundi gumu) zeewolwa okuva mu dizayini ya GitHub okuva mu 2012.
auth.h6_f:
ekyama = rand (bytes 20) // Ebitundu 160 buli RFC 6238
TOTP(ekyama, t) = HOTP(ekyama, ⌊t / 30⌋) .
HOTP(k, c) = okusalako( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106

eddirisa: ±1 omutendera gugumiikiriza ku ssaawa skew
auth.h7_a: QR login egatta ekyuma ekipya ku akawunti eriwo nga tozzeemu kuwandiika password. Essimu eyayingidde edda essa omukono ku nonce ekyuma ekipya kye kikozesa okukakasa.
auth.h7_b: Ekyuma A kiwandiika `/api/okukakasa/qr/begin`. Server ekola nonce ya 128-bit nga erina TTL 60s, n'agisiba ku user_id ya A, n'agizzaayo. A eraga nonce ewandiikiddwa nga QR (mulimu `nonce + user_id + server_url`). Ekyuma B kisika, kiteeka `/api/authentication/qr/verify` ne nonce. Server: nonce valid ate nga ya ssasi limu? Associate B's fresh X25519 pubkey with user_id (new `user_devices` row), mint JWTs for B. Ekyuma A kifuna okumanyisibwa kwa WebSocket omukozesa asobole okulaba n'okwesalirawo okusazaamu.
auth.h7_c: QR-based pairing yasooka kumanyibwa WhatsApp Web mu 2015. Telegram yagoberera; Signal yakikoppa olw'obuyambi bwabwe obw'ebyuma ebingi mu 2021. Vortex's twist: buli kiseera ky'okugatta kifuluma ku kyuma ekyasooka nga kiriko bbaatuuni "okukakasa", kale omulumbaganyi akwata QR okuva ku screenshot tasobola kumala kugatta nga takolagana na bakozesa ku kyuma A.
auth.h8_a: Okuziyiza okubala akawunti — ekitundu ky’essuula ya auth. Eno y’emu ku nkola enkulu ezijuliziddwa mu kujuliza kwonna okwa Vortex. Soma essuula eyeetooloddewo omanye ensonga egazi; ekitundu kino kigaziya ku nneeyisa entongole.
auth.h8_b: Okulaba okussa mu nkola kwa "Okuziyiza okubala akawunti". Enkola eno eteekebwa mu nkola mu modulo ekwatagana wansi wa `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, oba `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README eyita amakubo ga fayiro amatuufu.
auth.h8_c: Enkola ya "Account enumeration resistance" yakulaakulana mu Vortex ebifulumizibwa. Dizayini eno edda mu kunoonyereza okufulumiziddwa n’enkola z’okufulumya ez’ababaka abaaliwo emabega. Ebyafaayo by’enkyusa mu `CHANGELOG.md` biwandiika buli kitundu lwe kyatuuka ku ttaka n’ekyo ekyakikubiriza.

rooms.title: Ebisenge n’obubaka
rooms.subtitle: Ebika by’ebisenge ebina, obwammemba, okukyusakyusa ebisumuluzo, obubaka.
rooms.intro: Ebika by'ebisenge byonna ebina — DM, ekibiina eky'obwannannyini, ekibiina eky'olukale, omukutu — bagabana emmeeza emu eyali wansi `ebisenge`. Enneeyisa eggalwa bbendera za boolean.
rooms.h1p1: **DM**: ddala bammemba babiri, `is_dm=true`, `is_private=true`. Erinnya auto-set ku mukono gwa mmemba omulala.
rooms.h1p2: **Ekibinja eky'ekyama**: okuyita-kwokka, `kye_ekyama=kituufu`, `kye_omukutu=bulimba`. Max 5000 members nga bwekiba.
rooms.h1p3: **Ekibiina ky'olukale**: `is_private=false`. Omuntu yenna alina invite link asobola okwegatta; ewandiikiddwa mu dayirekita y'olukale singa nnannyini yo asalawo okuyingira.
rooms.h1p4: **Omukutu**: okuweereza ku mpewo kwokka, `is_channel=true`. Bannannyini/admin bokka be basobola okuteeka; bammemba aba bulijjo basoma.
rooms.h2p1: Emirimu: `nnannyini`, `admin`, `mmemba`. Nnyinimu omu yekka buli kisenge (assignable).
rooms.h2p2: Admins basobola okuyita, okusamba, okusirisa, n'okulongoosa ensengeka z'ekisenge. Bammemba basobola okuweereza obubaka, okukola, okulongoosa obwabwe, okusazaamu obwabwe.
rooms.h2p3: Permissions cascade: bannannyini balina buli maanyi ga admin. Admins tebasobola kussa wansi nannyini.
rooms.h2p4: Enkyukakyuka mu mirimu zikola obubaka bw'enkola (`kind: "role_changed"`) obulabika eri buli mmemba.
rooms.h3p1: Buli kisenge kirina **ekisumuluzo ky'ekikolo** ekya byte 32 ekikolebwa ku kutonda nga kiyita mu `secrets.token_bytes(32)` ku kyuma ky'omutonzi.
rooms.h3p2: Buli mmemba afuna envulopu `{member_id, envulopu: X25519_encrypt(member_pubkey, root_key)}` eterekeddwa mu `room_keys`.
rooms.h3p3: Memba bw’ayingira, envulopu empya ebakolebwa kasitoma wa mmemba yenna aliwo. Envulopu minting eri O(1) buli join.
rooms.h3p4: Memba bw'avaawo, ekisenge kikyuka: omutonzi (oba admin asooka akola) afuna ekikolo ekipya, addamu envulopu ku bammemba abasigadde, awandiika `{type:"k", ekisenge:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` okuyita mu WebSocket. Ciphertext enkadde esigala nga esomebwa n'ekisumuluzo ekikadde bakasitoma kye bakyatereka.
rooms.h3l1: Variant-B key publish: ku bisenge by'olukale ku > bammemba 1000, envulopu zikomya okusika. Mu kifo ky'ekyo, nnannyini assa omukono era n'afulumya ekisumuluzo ky'ekikolo ekiriwo mu kipande kya `room_public_keys`. Bakasitoma bakakasa omukono ku kisumuluzo kya nnannyini kisenge. Okukyusakyusa ku luwummula lwa bammemba n’olwekyo no-op eri ebisenge bya Variant-B.
rooms.h3l2: Per-room pseudo: buli kisenge nakyo kirina `room_pseudo_salt`. Amannya ag'obulimba aga bammemba mu bubaka gali `HMAC-SHA256(omunnyo, user_id)` nga gasaliddwako okutuuka ku 16 hex chars. Node tesobola kumanya mukozesa ki eyasindika bubaka ki nga tewali maapu ya ludda lwa kasitoma.
rooms.h4p1: Obubaka bulina ID za monotonic buli kisenge (64-bit auto-increment, `bigserial` mu Postgres, `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY` mu SQLite).
rooms.h4p2: Okulagira kuweebwa seva. Bakasitoma tebalwana ku timestamps; zikola mu nsengeka ya ID era ziraga obudde bw’essaawa y’oku bbugwe bw’omusindika nga UI metadata yokka.
rooms.h4p3: Edits: ciphertext empya edda mu kifo ky'edda mu kifo, `edited_at` updates. Bakasitoma balaga akabonero ka `(edited)`.
rooms.h4p4: Esazaamu: teeka `deleted_at`, null out ekiwandiiko ekikusike. `{type:"m", esaziddwamu:true}` okuweereza ku mpewo.
rooms.h4p5: Replies: `reply_to` = obubaka obujuliziddwa id. Bakasitoma balaga omutwe omutono ogw'okujuliza.
rooms.h5p1: Reactions ze nnyiriri mu `reactions (obubaka_id, user_id, emoji, created_at)`. Kasitoma POSTs `/api/obubaka/{id}/ebikolwa/{emoji}`. DELETE ku bitakola.
rooms.h5p2: Node fans out `{type:"m", reactions:[...]}` eri buli muwandiisi. Bakasitoma bagatta.
rooms.h5p3: Tewali kuziyiza ku emoji — Unicode yonna. Bakasitoma ba de-dupe ne bakola okubala.
rooms.h6p1: Obuwuzi kisenge kya bulimba ekisimbye emirandira ku bubaka. `POST /api/obubaka/{id}/thread` ekola `{id: <id_ekisenge_ekipya>, id_obubaka_omuzadde: <msg_id>, id_ekisenge_omuzadde: <original>}`.
rooms.h6p2: Ebisenge by’obuwuzi bisikira obwammemba okuva ku muzadde. Memba yenna ow'ekisenge ky'omuzadde asobola okuteeka mu thread yonna.
rooms.h6p3: Ekisumuluzo derivation: ekisumuluzo ky'ekikolo ky'obuwuzi = `HKDF (omuzadde_ekikolo, info: "oluwuzi:" + <omuzadde_obubaka_id>, len: 32)`. Okukkaanya ku kisumuluzo kya thread tekulukuta muzadde.
rooms.h7p1: Admins basobola okupinira obubaka obuwera 10 buli kisenge. `POST /api/ebisenge/{id}/pin` ne `{obubaka_id}`.
rooms.h7p2: Pinned set etikkibwa ku kisenge ekiggule; bakasitoma bakola omutwe ogussiddwako ppini waggulu.
rooms.h8p1: Ebiwandiiko ebikwata ku buli kisenge bisigala ku nsonga: `PUT /api/rooms/{id}/draft` ne `{text}`. `GET` ezzaayo akaseera kano. `DELETE` egogola.
rooms.h8p2: Bakasitoma bakwataganya ebbago mu byuma byonna kale okuwandiika ku ssimu kuggwa ku desktop. Drafts teziri encrypted okuva ku nkomerero okutuuka ku nkomerero — zibeera plaintext ezirabika ku server. Ekyo kusuubula mu bugenderevu ku cross-device UX. Abakozesa abawakanya basobola okulemesa sync buli kisenge.
rooms.h9p1: `POST /api/scheduled` ne `{ekisenge_id, ekiwandiiko ekikusike, sindika_ku}`. Node etereka mu `bubaka_obutegekeddwa`; omukozi wa cron yeeyama mu budde.
rooms.h9p2: Editable era esazibwamu okutuusa nga send_at tick ekuba omuliro. Oluvannyuma lw'okusindika, obubaka bufuuka olunyiriri olwa bulijjo mu `obubaka`.
rooms.h1_a: Ebika by'ebisenge byonna ebina (DM, ekibiina eky'obwannannyini, ekibiina eky'olukale, omukutu) bigabana emmeeza emu eya `ebisenge`. Enjawulo eri mu bendera ssatu eza boolean.
rooms.h1_b: Bendera: `ye_dm`, `ye_ya bwannannyini`, `ye_omukutu`. DM: is_dm=kituufu, is_private=kituufu, ddala bammemba 2. Ekibiina eky'obwannannyini: is_private=true, is_channel=false, okutuuka ku bammemba 5000. Ekibinja eky'olukale: is_private=false, kiwandiikiddwa mu dayirekita singa nnannyini alonda mu Channel: is_channel=true, bannannyini/abaddukanya bokka be bawandiika. Bonna bagabana enzirukanya y’ebisumuluzo, fan-out, reactions, threads.
rooms.h1_c: Enkyukakyuka y’emmeeza emu ye nkola okuva mu kitabo kya Martin Fowler ekya *Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture* (2002). Telegram ekozesa ebika by’ebisenge bisatu eby’enjawulo munda; Slack ekozesa emikutu + DMs + DMs ez’ebibiina ebingi ng’ebika bina; Discord ekozesa "channels" ku buli kimu. Twalonze emmeeza emu oluvannyuma lw’okukola profiling okulaga nti omuwendo omukulu gwe gwa fan-out (nga gukwatagana mu bika byonna) era oluvannyuma lwa v0.0.3 refactor okugatta emmeeza ssatu ezifaanagana mu emu.
rooms.h1_f:
CREATE TABLE ebisenge (
  id BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY, .
  ekika VARCHAR(16), -- eky'omusika, ekitali kya mugaso nga kiriko bendera
  erinnya VARCHAR(256), .
  ye_ya bwannannyini BOOLEAN, .
  ye_omukutu BOOLEAN, .
  ye_dm BOOLEAN, .
  okubala_bammemba INT, .
  avatar_url VARCHAR (512), .
  yatondebwa_ku TIMESTAMP,
  yatondebwa_ba BIGINT REFERENCES abakozesa(id)
);
rooms.h2_a: Emirimu gya mitendera esatu: nnannyini, admin, mmemba. Ddala nnannyini muntu omu buli kisenge, waakiri admin omu, arbitrarily members bangi.
rooms.h2_b: `room_members (ekisenge_id, user_id, omulimu, okwegatta_ku, okusirise_okutuusa)`. Roles cascade: bannannyini balina buli maanyi ga admin. Admins basobola okuyita, okusamba, okusirisa, n'okulongoosa ensengeka z'ekisenge naye nga tebasobola kussa wansi nnannyini kyo. Bammemba basobola okuweereza obubaka, okukola, okulongoosa obwabwe, okusazaamu obwabwe. Okukyusa nnannyini nga oyita mu `PATCH /api/rooms/{id}` ne `new_owner_id` — nnannyini mukadde agwa ku admin.
rooms.h2_c: Nnannyini/admin/member ye nkola ya IRC op/voice/user model ey’enjuyi essatu okuva mu 1988, oluvannyuma eyatwalibwa Slack, Discord, Telegram. Okulonda okwetongodde okubeera ne nnannyini omu ddala (si mungi) kuva mu kulowooza mu mateeka: mu bitundu ebirina amateeka agakwata ku buvunaanyizibwa bw’ekibinja, okubeera ne nnannyini omu omutegeerekeka kyanguyiza DMCA n’okusaba okufaananako bwe kutyo.
rooms.h2_f:
CREATE TABLE aba_ekisenge (
  ekisenge_id BIGINT, .
  ekiwandiiko ky'omukozesa BIGINT, .
  omulimu VARCHAR(16) CHECK(omulimu IN ('nnannyini','omuddukanya','mmemba')),
  yeegasse_ku ssaawa TIMESTAMP,
  okusirise_okutuusa TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (ekisenge_id,_omukozesa)
);
rooms.h3_a: Buli kisenge kirina ekisumuluzo ky’ekikolo ekya 32-byte symmetric. Bammemba bakutte kkopi nga zizingiddwa wansi w’ekisumuluzo kyabwe ekya X25519.
rooms.h3_b: Ku kutondebwa, kasitoma akola `root_key = secrets.token_bytes (32)`. Ku buli mmemba, kasitoma asiba `root_key` wansi wa `X25519(member_pubkey)` → envulopu. Envulopu zibeera mu `room_keys(room_id, user_id, envulopu)`. Omukozesa bwe yeegatta, kasitoma wa mmemba yenna aliwo abakuba envulopu empya. Omukozesa bw'avaawo, nnannyini oba admin asooka akola akyuka — akola root_key empya, addamu envulopu za bammemba abasigadde, aweereza `{type:"k", room:..., new_envelopes:[...]}` ku WebSocket.
rooms.h3_c: Okuzinga buli mmemba ye nkola Signal gye yatandikawo mu 2014 ku bibinja byayo-v2. Matrix's Megolm ekozesa enkola efaananako bwetyo eya "sender keys". Vortex yagenda ne envulopu za buli mmemba kubanga kyangu okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku: tewali forward secrecy drift wakati w'abasindika. Okusuubulagana kwe kukola envulopu ya O(N) ku nkyukakyuka y’obwammemba, nga kino kirungi okutuuka ku bammemba ~5000; public-channel Variant-B evudde ku kkomo.
rooms.h3_f:
ku kutondawo:
  ekisumuluzo_ekikolo = rand (32) .
  ku m mu bammemba:
    envulopu [m] = X25519_Encrypt (m.ekisumuluzo kya pub, ekisumuluzo_ekikolo)

mu luwummula:
  ekikolo_ekipya = rand (32) .
  rebroadcast(envulopu empya eri bammemba abasigadde)
rooms.h4_a: Variant-B key publish ekyusa envulopu za buli mmemba n’ekisumuluzo kimu ekiriko omukono, ekissiddwa ku mmeeza esomebwa abantu bonna. Minzaani okutuuka ku bammemba 100k+.
rooms.h4_b: Mu kifo ky'okukuba envulopu O(N), nnannyini kyo assa omukono ku kisumuluzo_ekikolo n'awandiika ku `room_public_keys(room_id, ekisumuluzo, signed_by, signed_at)`. Bakasitoma baleeta, bakakasa okusinziira ku pubkey ya nnannyini yo Ed25519, ne bakozesa. Rotation is a no-op for membership changes — omuntu yenna eyalina ekisumuluzo akyalina ne bwe kiba nga bamukubye. Ekyo kikkirizibwa ku public announce-channels nga "deep history" si ya threat model naye reach and scale biri.
rooms.h4_c: Variant-B ekozesebwa ku Matrix's "world readable" history visibility nga egattibwa wamu n'okukyusakyusa ekisumuluzo ekissiddwako omukono. Yayongerwa ku Vortex mu v0.0.8 oluvannyuma lwa beta okuba n’omukutu gw’olukale ogwa bammemba 50k nga buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera okuddamu envulopu okubutuka kwajjuza node. Enkola essiddwako omukono n’efulumiziddwa egerageranya mu layini n’okukyusakyusa ebisumuluzo (ezitatera kubaawo) okusinga n’enkyukakyuka z’obwammemba (ezitakyukakyuka).
rooms.h4_f:
Enkyukakyuka-B:
  obubonero bwa nnannyini: sig = Ed25519Sign (nnannyini_priv, id_ekisenge ∥ ekisumuluzo_ekikolo ∥ enkyusa)
  okufulumya: ebisumuluzo_eby'olukale_ekisenge += {id_ekisenge, ekisumuluzo_ekikolo, enkyusa, sig}
  kasitoma: GET /api/ebisenge/{id}/ekisumuluzo ky'olukale → kakasa sig ku owner_pubkey
rooms.h5_a: Koodi z’okuyita ziri 32 hex chars. Okwesalirawo max_uses, expires_at, okugaba omulimu, okusazibwamu.
rooms.h5_b: `POST /api/rooms/{id}/invite` (admin-only) ekola olunyiriri mu `invites (code, room_id, created_by, max_uses, used_count, expires_at, assign_role, revoked_at)`. `POST /api/rooms/join` ne koodi ekebera obutuufu (teyasazibwamu, teggwaako, used_count < max_uses), eyongera `used_count`, ekola olunyiriri lwa `room_members`, ezzaayo metadata y'ekisenge. Sazaamu ng'oyita mu `DELETE /api/invites/{code}` — oluvannyuma okwegatta kulemererwa.
rooms.h5_c: Koodi eziyita nga primitive nkadde nga IRC's `+i` mode (1988). Telegram's public invite links with expiry and use limits were introduced in 2017. Vortex's variant adds `assign_role` kale bannannyini basobola okugaba admin-granting codes mu ngeri ey'obukuumi mu nkola ya one-shot — ya mugaso ku onboarding a new moderator nga tekyetaagisa kumanya user id yaabwe entuufu upfront.
rooms.h5_f:
ayita olunyiriri:
  koodi : VARCHAR(64) -- ennukuta za hekisi 32
  ekisenge_id : BIGINT
  max_uses : INT -- NULL = tewali kkomo
  okubala_okukozesebwa : INT .
  eggwaako_ku : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = tewali
  okugaba omulimu : VARCHAR(16) -- NULL = mmemba
  revoked_at : TIMESTAMP -- NULL = mulamu
rooms.h6_a: Olunyiriri lw'obubaka lutereka ciphertext + metadata; omusindika taterekebwako mu biwandiiko ebitegeerekeka.
rooms.h6_b: `obubaka (id, ekisenge_id, omusindika_id, ciphertext, nonce, omusindika_pseudo, yasindikibwa_ku, edited_at?, okusazibwamu_ku?, okuddamu_ku?, thread_id?, ekika)`. `sender_id` eriwo okufuga okuyingira era eriko index. `sender_pseudo` ye buli kisenge deterministic hash ya sender_id kale fan-out tekyetaagisa kukwata ku mmeeza y'abakozesa. `kind` kye kimu ku: ekiwandiiko, ekifaananyi, fayiro, eddoboozi, okuyita, enkola. `ciphertext` is opaque AES-GCM ekifulumizibwa; bammemba b’ekisenge bokka abalina ekisumuluzo be basobola okuggya ensirifu.
rooms.h6_c: Ekirowoozo kya sender_pseudo kiva mu Signal sealed-sender (2018). Signal egikozesa okuziba amaaso ku seva ku ndagamuntu y'omusindika; tugikozesa ku kigendererwa ekifaananako naye tukuuma `sender_id` cleartext for ACL n'ekkomo ku muwendo. Enjawukana etusobozesa okussa mu nkola "bammemba bokka be basobola okuteeka" nga server teyize ani yayogera ki ku full DB dump.
rooms.h7_a: Edits ziwandiika ku `ciphertext` mu kifo ne zikuba `edited_at`. Esazaamu null out ciphertext era n'eteeka `deleted_at`.
rooms.h7_b: Edit: `PATCH /api/obubaka/{id}` n'ekipya `{ciphertext, nonce}`. Omuweereza yekka y’asobola okulongoosa obubaka bwe. Row's ciphertext/nonce ekyusiddwa, `edited_at = kati`, `ekika` tekikyusiddwa. Fan-out `{ekika:"m", id, ct, nonce, ekirongooseddwa_ku}`. Ssaawo: `DELETE /api/obubaka/{id}`. Sender oba admin asobola okusazaamu. `saziddwamu_ku = kati`, `ekiwandiiko ekikusike = NULL`. Row asigala kale replies zikyalina amakulu. Fan-out `{ekika:"m", esaziddwamu:kituufu, id}`.
rooms.h7_c: Edit-in-place ye nkola ya Telegram/Slack; Discord yakuuma ebyafaayo by’okulongoosa mu bujjuvu mu kusooka n’oluvannyuma n’abisuula olw’ekyama. Vortex ekuuma ebisembyeyo byokka — ebyafaayo by'okulongoosa nsibuko ya PR ebibaddewo nga okulongoosa-okusaziddwamu kuddamu. Soft-delete with null ciphertext eva mu Telegram playbook y’emu era ekuuma enjegere z’okuddamu awatali kusigaza birimu.
rooms.h7_f:
okulongoosa: UPDATE obubaka SET ekiwandiiko ekikusike = $1, nonce = $2, edited_at = NOW() WHERE id = $3
okusazaamu: UPDATE obubaka SET busaziddwamu_ku = NOW(), ekiwandiiko ekikusike = NULL WHERE id = $1
rooms.h8_a: Drafts — ekitundu ku bisenge essuula. Eno y’emu ku nkola enkulu ezijuliziddwa mu kujuliza kwonna okwa Vortex. Soma essuula eyeetooloddewo omanye ensonga egazi; ekitundu kino kigaziya ku nneeyisa entongole.
rooms.h8_b: Okulaba okussa mu nkola kwa "Drafts". Enkola eno eteekebwa mu nkola mu modulo ekwatagana wansi wa `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, oba `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README eyita amakubo ga fayiro amatuufu.
rooms.h8_c: Enkola ya "Drafts" yakulaakulana mu Vortex ebifulumizibwa. Dizayini eno edda mu kunoonyereza okufulumiziddwa n’enkola z’okufulumya ez’ababaka abaaliwo emabega. Ebyafaayo by’enkyusa mu `CHANGELOG.md` biwandiika buli kitundu lwe kyatuuka ku ttaka n’ekyo ekyakikubiriza.
rooms.h9_a: Obubaka obutegekeddwa — ekitundu ku ssuula y’ebisenge. Eno y’emu ku nkola enkulu ezijuliziddwa mu kujuliza kwonna okwa Vortex. Soma essuula eyeetooloddewo omanye ensonga egazi; ekitundu kino kigaziya ku nneeyisa entongole.
rooms.h9_b: Okulaba okussa mu nkola "Obubaka obutegekeddwa". Enkola eno eteekebwa mu nkola mu modulo ekwatagana wansi wa `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, oba `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README eyita amakubo ga fayiro amatuufu.
rooms.h9_c: Enkola ya "Scheduled messages" yakulaakulana mu Vortex ebifulumizibwa. Dizayini eno edda mu kunoonyereza okufulumiziddwa n’enkola z’okufulumya ez’ababaka abaaliwo emabega. Ebyafaayo by’enkyusa mu `CHANGELOG.md` biwandiika buli kitundu lwe kyatuuka ku ttaka n’ekyo ekyakikubiriza.

files.title: Fayiro n’ebigattibwako
files.subtitle: Single-shot ku bitono, resumable ku binene, ensirifu ku ludda lwa kasitoma ku byombi.
files.intro: Buli fayiro eteekebwa ku mukutu eyita mu payipu y'emu ey'okusiba. Enjawulo wakati w’amakubo ekwata ku kugumira omukutu gwokka: resumable egumiikiriza enkolagana ezifuukuuse.
files.h1: Ekkubo ly'okuteeka ku mukutu ogw'okukuba omulundi gumu
files.h1p1: Enkoofiira: 5 MB. Ekozesebwa ku bifaananyi, ebiwandiiko by’amaloboozi, ebitundu ebimpi.
files.h1p2: Kasitoma asiba fayiro yonna ne AES-GCM, random 96-bit nonce, ekisumuluzo = `fayiro_root = secrets.token_bytes(32)`.
files.h1p3: POSTs `ebitundu ebingi / ffoomu-data` okutuuka ku ` / api / fayiro` n'ennimiro `fayiro` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (obugolokofu okwewozaako), `mime_type` (hint; seva eddamu okukebera ne `python-magic`).
files.h1p4: Node etereka wansi wa `uploads/<category>/<sha256>.bin` era n'ezzaayo `{file_id, url}`.
files.h1p5: Kasitoma olwo n'ateeka obubaka bw'ekisenge obujuliza file_id era ne butambuza file_root mu ciphertext yaayo bammemba b'ekisenge basobole okuggya ensirifu.
files.h2: Ekkubo ly'okuteeka ku mukutu eriddamu okukozesebwa
files.h2p2: Omutendera 1: `POST /api/fayiro/resumable/init` ne `{erinnya lya fayiro, obunene, chunk_size_hint}`. Node egaba id y'okuteeka, elonda sayizi ya chunk (default 512 KiB, capped ku 4 MiB), ezzaayo `{upload_id, chunk_size}`.
files.h2p3: Omutendera 2: ku buli kitundu, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` n'omubiri gw'ebiwandiiko ebikusike ebibisi. Offsets zirina okukwatagana ne `chunk_size`.
files.h2p4: Omutendera 3: `POST /api/fayiro/eziddamu/{upload_id}/finalise` ne `{plain_blake3}`. Node eddamu okukuŋŋaanya, ekakasa obunene, etereka, ezzaayo `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2p5: Enkwata y'okulemererwa: okuteekebwako okutaataaganyizibwa kuyinza okuddamu nga kuddamu okuteeka offsets zokka ezibula. Node erondoola offsets ki ezaatuuka mu Redis (oba mu-memory ku mode ya SQLite).
files.h2p6: TTL: uploads ezitannaggwa zirongoosebwa oluvannyuma lwa 24 h.
files.h3p1: Ebifaananyi ebiteekebwa ku mukutu (MIME `ekifaananyi/*`) bitandikawo jenereta y'ebifaananyi ebitono eyesigamiziddwa ku Pillow ku 256×256 JPEG q=80. Eterekeddwa wansi wa `uploads/thumbs/<hash>.jpg`.
files.h3p2: Ebifaananyi ebitonotono nabyo bikuumibwa ku ludda lwa kasitoma — omuweereza yeetaaga file_root okulaga. Etereka bandwidth okusobola okulaba olukalala.
files.h3p3: Okuteeka vidiyo (MIME `video/*`) kuleeta okuggyamu ekipande okusinziira ku ffmpeg ku 10 % ku bbanga lya clip, okuterekebwa mu ngeri y’emu.
files.h4p1: `mime_type` eyaweebwayo kasitoma ye kabonero. Server ekola `python-magic` ku 1 KB esooka era egaana singa ekika ekiwunyiriza kiba mu lukalala lw'okugaana: `application/x-dosexec`, `application/x-sharedlib`, `application/x-mach-binary`.
files.h4p2: Kino kiyimiriza abakozesa abasirusiru okusaasaanya malware mu butanwa nga bayita mu messenger. Abalumbaganyi abakubirizibwa bakyayinza okuyita ku konteyina eziwandiikiddwa obulungi — okwekuuma kwe kugaana okusumulula ku ludda lwa kasitoma, so si kuwunyiriza ku ludda lwa seva.
files.h5p1: Ekisookerwako: enkola ya fayiro ey'omu kitundu. Good ku kuteeka mu nkola kwa node emu.
files.h5p2: S3: teeka `OKUTEREKA_BACKEND=s3` + `S3_BUCKET=...`. Fayiro zitambuzibwa butereevu ku S3 awatali kukwata ku disiki ya node. URL eziteekeddwako emikono edda zikozesebwa okuwanula.
files.h5p3: IPFS: okugezesa. Uploads zilangirira CIDs nga ziyita mu DHT; downloads zireeta node yonna eya pinning.
files.h1_a: Single-shot upload lye kkubo ery’amangu eri ekintu kyonna ekiri wansi w’emyaka 5 MB — ebifaananyi, ebiwandiiko by’eddoboozi, ebitundu ebimpi. HTTPS POST emu, blob emu ensirifu, olunyiriri lumu mu `fayiro`.
files.h1_b: Kasitoma asiba bytes za fayiro okuva ku nkomerero okutuuka ku nkomerero ne AES-GCM wansi wa random 32-byte `file_root`. POSTs `ebitundu ebingi / ffoomu-data` okutuuka ku ` / api / fayiro` n'ennimiro `fayiro` (ciphertext), `plain_blake3` (obugolokofu okwewozaako), `mime_ekika` (hint). Node ekaka 5 MB cap ku receive buffer level, ekola `python-magic` okuzuula ekika, egaana singa MIME eri ku lukalala lw'okugaana, etereka wansi wa `uploads/<category>/<hash>.bin`, ezzaayo `{file_id, url, mime_type, size}`. Kasitoma olwo ateeka obubaka bw'ekisenge nga bujuliza `file_id` era ng'atwala `file_root` mu ciphertext yaayo.
files.h1_c: Enkoofiira ya 5 MB ye nnamba y'emu Slack ne Telegram gye bakozesa ku kkubo lyabwe ery'okuteeka "inline". Fayiro ennene zigenda mu kkubo eriddamu okukozesebwa. Vortex eyasooka yalina enkoofiira ya 100 MB ey’okukuba essasi limu; twakka ku 5 MB oluvannyuma lw’okukola profiling okulaga nti okuteekebwako okukuba omulundi gumu okusukka 5 MB kwalina okugwa kwa 40 % ku mikutu gy’essimu. Ekkubo eriddamu okukozesebwa lisingako nnyo ku fayiro ennene wadde nga lisinga kugenda n'okudda ku makubo ag'essanyu.
files.h2_a: Resumable upload lye kkubo lya fayiro ennene. Kasitoma ateeka ebitundu bya sayizi ezitakyukakyuka, asobola okuyimirira, asobola okuddamu ku nsalo ya chunk yonna, asobola okuddamu okuva mu blips z’omukutu.
files.h2_b: Protocol ey’emitendera esatu. Init: `POST /api/files/resumable/init` ne `{erinnya lya fayiro, obunene, chunk_size_hint}` → node egaba `upload_id` + ekakasa obunene bw'ekitundu. Ebitundu: ku buli offset, `PUT /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/chunk/{offset}` n'omubiri gw'ebiwandiiko ebikusike ebibisi. Offsets zirina okuba nga zikubisaamu chunk_size. Finalise: `POST /api/files/resumable/{upload_id}/finalise` ne `{plain_blake3}` — node eddamu okukuŋŋaanya, ekakasa sayizi + tag, etereka, ezzaayo `{file_id, url}`.
files.h2_c: Enkola ey’emitendera esatu eri mu ngeri y’emu ne tus.io (Resumable Uploads, 2013), AWS S3 okuteeka ku mukutu ogw’ebitundu ebingi, ne Google Drive okuteekebwa ku mukutu okuddamu okuteekebwako. Vortex yakwata ekifaananyi kya tus.io kubanga kye kyali omupiira ogusinga okuba ogwangu ku FastAPI + streaming. The 24 h TTL ku uploads ezitannaggwa ekwatagana ne S3's default era balances okuddamu okukyukakyuka okusinziira ku nkozesa ya server disk.
files.h3_a: Ebifaananyi ebitonotono bikolebwa ku ludda lwa seva mu kiseera ky'okuteeka naye bisigala nga bikuumibwa wansi w'ekikolo kya fayiro kye kimu, kale bammemba b'ekisenge bokka be basobola okubikola.
files.h3_b: Ku `ekifaananyi/*` MIME, Pillow ekola 256×256 JPEG q=80 okuva mu kusooka okusumululwa. Linda — nedda, seva tebangako na biwandiiko bya bulijjo. Okutambula okutuufu: kasitoma akola engalo ensajja mu kitundu, asiba ne file_root y'emu + nonce empya, assa nga blob ya muganda, era ajuliza `thumb_id` mu bubaka bw'ekisenge. Server etereka ekiwandiiko ekikusike. Ku `video/*`, kasitoma akola kye kimu ne ffmpeg-derived keyframe.
files.h3_c: Vortex eyasooka yalina okukola ebifaananyi ebitonotono ku ludda lwa seva okuva mu biwandiiko ebya bulijjo — twaggyako obusobozi obwo mu v0.0.4 oluvannyuma lw’okwekenneenya eby’okwerinda okulaga nti kyamenya omusingo gwa E2E. Engalo ensajja ku ludda lwa kasitoma ye nkola Signal gy’ekozesezza okuva mu 2018 ne WhatsApp okuva mu 2020. Bandwidth cost is negligible — a 256×256 JPEG is under 20 KB.
files.h4_a: Seva ekaka olukalala lw'okugaana MIME ku layeri y'okuwunyiriza okuyimiriza ebikolebwa ebisaasaanyiziddwa mu butanwa.
files.h4_b: Oluvannyuma lw'okuteeka mu bujjuvu (single-shot) oba okumaliriza (okuddamu), seva ekola `python-magic` ku 1 KB ezisooka eza ciphertext's host container okuzuula ekika ekituufu. Singa sniff etegeeza `application/x-dosexec` (Windows PE), `application/x-sharedlib` (Linux ELF), oba `application/x-mach-binary` (macOS Mach-O), okuteeka ku mukutu kugaanibwa ne 415 Ekika ky'Emikutu Ekitawagirwa. Eno nkola ya seva, so si nsalo ya bukuumi — bammemba b’ekisenge kya kasitoma bakyayinza okuteeka ensengeka y’okuzinga eyitako okuwunyiriza.
files.h4_c: MIME okuwunyiriza nga enkola y'okwegaana ye IETF draft-mime-sniffing-0X okuva mu 2012. Discord / Slack / Telegram bonna bakikola. Ekikoma (zipped/containerised executables bypass sniff) kimanyiddwa okuva mu 2016 — okwekuuma kwaffe kuli layered: nga kwogasse n’okulabula ku ludda lw’omukozesa ku fayiro yonna erimu ekyongereza ekiyinza okukolebwa.
files.h5_a: Storage backends — ekitundu ku ssuula ya fayiro. Eno y’emu ku nkola enkulu ezijuliziddwa mu kujuliza kwonna okwa Vortex. Soma essuula eyeetooloddewo omanye ensonga egazi; ekitundu kino kigaziya ku nneeyisa entongole.
files.h5_b: Okulaba okussa mu nkola ku "Storage backends". Enkola eno eteekebwa mu nkola mu modulo ekwatagana wansi wa `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, oba `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README eyita amakubo ga fayiro amatuufu.
files.h5_c: Enkola ya "Storage backends" yakulaakulana mu Vortex ebifulumizibwa. Dizayini eno edda mu kunoonyereza okufulumiziddwa n’enkola z’okufulumya ez’ababaka abaaliwo emabega. Ebyafaayo by’enkyusa mu `CHANGELOG.md` biwandiika buli kitundu lwe kyatuuka ku ttaka n’ekyo ekyakikubiriza.
files.h1_f:
POST /api/fayiro
  Ebirimu-Ekika: ebitundu bingi/foomu-data
  fayiro: <bytes z'ebiwandiiko ebikusike ≤ 5_242_880>
  plain_blake3: <ennukuta za hex 64>
  mime_type: "ekifaananyi/jpeg" (hint; node eddamu okukebera)

→ 201 { file_id, url: "/eteeka/...", ekika_eky'okukoppa, obunene }
files.h3_f:
kasitoma akola thumb_plain = okukyusa obunene (ekijjuvu, 256, 256, JPEG, q = 80)
thumb_ct = AES-GCM (fayiro_ekikolo, ekipya_nonce, engalo_engalo_engalo ensajja, aad = engalo_id_id)
upload thumb_ct, juliza thumb_id mu bubaka bw'ekisenge ku mabbali ga file_id

presence.title: Obubonero bw’okubeerawo n’okutuusa
presence.subtitle: Ebiraga okuwandiika, lisiiti z’okusoma, ezisembyeyo okulabibwa — byonna bya kaseera buseera.
presence.intro: Siginini zino zikola amaloboozi. Vortex zizikuuma nga tezinyweredde ku butonde: okuwandiika kubeera mu Redis (oba mu-memory), lisiiti ezisomeddwa ze siginiini yokka ewona okuddamu okutandika.
presence.h1p1: Kasitoma asindika `{type:"t", room:..., state:"start"|"stop"}` ku kunyiga ebisumuluzo. Debounced to at most omukolo gumu buli s 3.
presence.h1p2: Node eweereza `{ekika:"t", ekisenge:..., omukozesa:..., embeera:...}` eri bonna abawandiise WebSockets.
presence.h1p3: Auto-expire: `start` awatali `stop` times out eddako oluvannyuma lwa s 10 ku ludda lwa kasitoma.
presence.h2p2: Node esigala mu `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` era eweereza ku mpewo `{ekika:"r", ekisenge:..., omukozesa:..., message_id:...}`.
presence.h2p3: Bakasitoma balaga "kulabibwa N" wansi w'obubaka obufuluma.
presence.h2p4: Eby'ekyama: omukozesa asobola okulemesa "seen" yonna; awo node tegumiikiriza lisiiti ku lwabwe. Trade-off: era tebalaba lisiiti za bantu balala (symmetry).
presence.h3p1: Node erondoola `presence.last_seen_at` (unix ms) buli mukozesa. Etereezeddwa ku buli WebSocket frame.
presence.h3p2: Granularity tiers (user-choosable): entuufu, eyeetooloovu okutuuka ku ddakiika 5 ezisinga okumpi, eyeetooloovu okutuuka ku ssaawa esinga okumpi, "recently", oba off.
presence.h3p3: Yabuuziddwa okuyita mu `GET /api/abakozesa/{id}/okubeerawo`. Yawandiise ng'ayita mu `{type:"sub_presence", omukozesa:...}`.
presence.h4p1: Omukozesa abeera "ku mutimbagano" singa aba alina waakiri WebSocket emu ekola ku kyuma kye kyonna.
presence.h4p2: Kirabika eri abakwatagana bokka — abatali bakwatagana balaba ebisembyeyo okulabibwa naye si kabonero kalamu.
presence.h1_a: Ekiraga okuwandiika kisindikibwa nga kiyita mu WebSocket frame `{type:"t", ekisenge, state: "start"|"stop"}` era ne kiweebwa ku mpewo node eri buli subscriber mu kisenge.
presence.h1_b: Kasitoma akola debounces ku s 3 — okukuba ekisumuluzo okusooka kusindika `okutandika`, okuddirira mu s 3 tekukola kintu kyonna. 10 s oluvannyuma lw'okukuba ekisumuluzo ekisembayo, kasitoma asindika `stop`. Node eweereza fuleemu mu kigambo, nga etandikiddwaako `user_id`. Tewali kugumiikiriza — embeera y'okuwandiika ebeera mu dicts eziri mu jjukira buli kisenge (oba Redis pub/sub for multi-node). Auto-expire 10 s ku ludda lwa receiver: singa tewali update etuuka, clients bakitwala nti yayimiridde.
presence.h1_c: Ebiraga okuwandiika bidda mu AIM / ICQ (1997). Modern debounced designs trace to Skype 2006 and iMessage 2011. Ennamba za 3 s / 10 s ziva mu nneeyisa ya iMessage eyeetegerezeddwa — ffe A/B twagezesa 2/5, 3/10, 5/15 ne 3/10 twalina endowooza esinga obulungi ey'omutwe "ekwatagana n'ennyimba z'omuntu".
presence.h2_a: Okusoma lisiiti esigalawo: kasitoma POSTs last-read message id; node etereka mu `read_receipts` n'okuweereza ku mpewo.
presence.h2_b: `POST /api/ebisenge/{id}/okusoma` ne `{da_obubaka_busoma_okusembayo}`. Node ezza obuggya `read_receipts(room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` n'amakulu ga UPSERT. Eweereza ku mpewo `{ekika:"r", ekisenge, omukozesa, message_id, read_at}`. Bakasitoma balaga "kulabibwa N" wansi w'obubaka obufuluma. Eby’ekyama: omukozesa asobola okulemesa lisiiti zonna; awo node tegunywerera ku lwabwe AND tebalaba lisiiti za balala (symmetric).
presence.h2_c: Lisiiti z’okusoma zaafuuka buli wamu oluvannyuma lwa iMessage 2011 ne WhatsApp 2014. Etteeka lya symmetry (bw’okweka eyiyo, tolaba ya balala) ya Telegram 2014 era y’engeri yokka ey’okwewala omukutu gw’okulondoola ogw’engeri emu. Vortex essa mu nkola symmetry ku server — so si client yokka — kale clients ezilimba ku flag nakati tebafuna visibility.
presence.h3_a: Last-seen ye timestamp emu eya buli mukozesa, etereezebwa ku buli WebSocket frame era ekaddiwa nga tewali frames etuuse.
presence.h3_b: Node erondoola `presence.last_seen_at` nga unix ms. Etereezeddwa ku buli fuleemu ya WebSocket ekakasiddwa okuva ku mukozesa oyo. Soma ng'oyita mu `GET /api/abakozesa/{id}/okubeerawo`. Wewandiise ng'oyita mu `{type:"sub_presence", user}` okufuna live push ku nkyukakyuka. Granularity is user-configurable: timestamp entuufu, rounded okutuuka ku 5 min, rounded okutuuka ku 1 h, "recently", oba off.
presence.h3_c: Granularity tiers trace to WhatsApp's 2012 privacy update oluvannyuma lw'okwemulugunya ku stalking eyasembyeyo okulabibwa. Telegram mu 2013 yayongerako ebibbo bya "gye buvuddeko / mu wiiki emu / mu mwezi gumu". Vortex's 5 min / 1 h / "gye buvuddeko" eddamu Telegram. Enkola ya "off" ekweka mu ngeri ya symmetrically omukozesa obutalaba balala abasembyeyo okulabibwa olw'ensonga y'emu ne lisiiti ezisomeddwa.
presence.h4_a: Ekiraga ku mutimbagano: omukozesa abeera "ku mutimbagano" singa aba alina waakiri live WebSocket emu ku kyuma kye kyonna.
presence.h4_b: Node ekuuma `active_ws_count (user_id)` mu jjukira. Okwongera ku WS upgrade, okukendeera ku close. `ku mutimbagano = active_ws_count (omukozesa_id) > 0`. Kirabika eri abakwatagana bokka — abatali bakwatagana balaba last-seen (subject to granularity) naye never the live green dot. Kyusa ebibaddewo omuliro nga okubala kusala ziro mu buli ludda.
presence.h4_c: Okulaba okukwatagana kwokka gwe muze buli mubaka ow’amaanyi gw’asenzeemu oluvannyuma lw’okugoberera ebiseera ebingi (WhatsApp 2014, Telegram 2015). Vortex eyasooka yakolebwa ku yintaneeti okulabika eri buli muntu; twakyusa default oluvannyuma lw’omukugu mu kwekenneenya beta okulaga nti ebisenge by’olukale byandivuddemu okubeerawo kw’enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu be tutamanyi eri enkumi n’enkumi z’abantu abalala be tutamanyi.
presence.h3_f:
obutundutundu: .
  exact → zzaayo ekisembayo_okulabibwa_ku
  5_min → okudda ⌊semba_okulabibwa_ku / 300000⌋ · 300000
  essaawa_1 → okuddayo ⌊semba_okulabibwa_ku / 3600000⌋ · 3600000
  gye buvuddeko → zzaayo 'gye buvuddeko' singa (kati - last_seen_at) < 7d else 'edde'.
  off → zzaayo null; omukozesa ono naye tasobola kulaba balala
presence.h4_f:
ku mutimbagano (u) = (|{ws ∈ open_ws : ws.id_omukozesa == u}| > 0)
okulabika: contacts-only (abatali bakwatagana laba abasembyeyo okulabibwa bokka)
okukyusa event fires iff online(u) enkyukakyuka 0 ↔ 1

calls.title: WebRTC essimu
calls.subtitle: Eddoboozi + vidiyo, 1:1 n’ekibinja, ebiweebwa obubonero ku WebSocket, ebiweebwayo nga biyita mu coturn.
calls.intro: Vortex ekozesa omutambi gwa sitokisi WebRTC. Node eri ku bubonero bwokka. Banne bwe bamala okuyunga abesimbyewo baabwe ICE, emikutu gy’amawulire gikulukuta butereevu (peer-to-peer) oba okuyita mu TURN relay ku bad NAT.
calls.h1p1: Omukubi w'essimu: `POST /api/calls/{room_id}/tandika` ne `{akatambi: bool, amaloboozi: bool}`. Node egaba call_id, eweereza `{type:"c", kind:"invite", call_id, vidiyo, amaloboozi}` mu kisenge.
calls.h1p3: Okuwaanyisiganya okuwaayo/okuddamu: `{ekika:"okuwaayo", sdp:...}` → `{ekika:"okuddamu", sdp:...}` → `{ekika:"omuntu eyeesimbyewo", ice:...}` × N okutuusa nga kiyungiddwa.
calls.h1p4: Okuyita kuggwa: `POST /api/okuyita/{call_id}/end`. Buli ludda lusobola okusiba essimu. Node records `call_records(call_id, ebbanga_s, vidiyo, amaloboozi, ebibiina)`.
calls.h2p1: Okuteekawo Omukago gwa Server Interactive. Banne bawanyisiganya abesimbyewo (host, srflx, prflx, relay).
calls.h2p2: STUN: nga kikubiddwa ne coturn. Stun-only mode ekozesebwa okuzuula symmetric-NAT.
calls.h2p3: TURN: coturn ne HMAC-omukono ebiwandiiko ebiwangaala. Buli call efuna fresh creds ezikola okumala 24 h.
calls.h2p4: Ebiwandiiko: `{erinnya ly'omukozesa: <timestamp>:<user_id>, password: base64(HMAC-SHA1(ekyama, erinnya ly'omukozesa))}`. Ensengeka ya mutindo RFC 5389.
calls.h3p1: Amaloboozi: Opus 48 kHz enkyukakyuka ya bitrate (6-128 kbps). DTX ku olw'okunyigiriza okusirika.
calls.h3p2: Akatambi: VP9 (asinga kwagala) / H.264 / AV1 (okulonda). Simulcast for group calls: omuyita awandiika enkodi ssatu mu kiseera kye kimu.
calls.h3p3: FEC: bulijjo ku maloboozi; ku vidiyo singa bitrate headroom ekkiriza.
calls.h4p1: Ku > 2 abeetabye, Vortex ezaala SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) ku node. Buli eyetaba mu mpaka zino ateeka omulundi gumu, SFU fans out.
calls.h4p2: Mu kiseera kino amaloboozi gokka agawera 100 abeetabye mu mpaka zino; ebibinja bya vidiyo byakoma ku 8 mu v0.1 (vidiyo SFU okukaluba mu v0.3 roadmap).
calls.h4p3: SFU ekozesa coturn relay y’emu okutambula; tekyetaagisa mpeereza ndala.
calls.h5p1: Nga oyita mu `getDisplayMedia`. Kasitoma ayongera oluyimba olupya ku PeerConnection eriwo; addamu okuteesa ku kuwaayo/okuddamu.
calls.h5p2: Abaweebwa bakola screen egabanyizibwa ng’oluyimba lwa vidiyo olw’enjawulo. Ku ssimu, okugabana ku screen kyetaagisa olukusa olwa OS-level — iOS egamba, Android eraga enkola dialog.
calls.h6p1: WebRTC's built-in NetEQ ekwata ku kufiirwa n'okuwuguka. Ku kukendeera okw’amaanyi kasitoma asuula resolution oba okulemesa vidiyo yonna ng’akuuma amaloboozi nga galamu.
calls.h6p2: Okuziyira kwa 500 ms kuleeta okugezaako okuddamu okuyunga (ICE okuddamu okutandika). Abakozesa balaba "Okuddamu okuyunga..." overlay.
calls.h1_a: Call signaling evuga WebSocket y’emu ekozesebwa mu kunyumya. Node is signalling-only — ekola broker SDP ne ICE wakati wa bannaabwe naye tekwata ku mikutu gya mawulire.
calls.h1_b: Omukubi w'essimu POSTs `/api/calls/{room_id}/start` ne `{vidiyo, amaloboozi}`. Node egaba `call_id`, eweereza `{type:"c", kind:"invite", call_id, vidiyo, amaloboozi}` mu kisenge. Omuyiti awandiika `/api/calls/{call_id}/akiriza` → `{ekika:"c", ekika:"ekkiriziddwa"}`. SDP okuwanyisiganya okuwaayo/okuddamu: `{ekika:"okuwaayo", sdp}` → `{ekika:"okuddamu", sdp}`. ICE abesimbyewo: `{kind:"candidate", ice}` × N okutuusa nga PeerConnection etegeezezza nti `eyungiddwa`.
calls.h1_c: SDP + ICE signaling ye nkola ya standard WebRTC enyonyoddwa mu RFC 8839 ne 8841. Vortex tayiiya kintu kyonna wano; ye flow y'emu Chrome, Firefox, ne buli WebRTC tterekero implement. Okulonda kwa node-as-signalling-only kuva mu kukimanya nti okuweereza emikutu mu ngeri ya SFU kusiba bandwidth era kyetaagisa hardware gye tutayagala kusindika mu base install.
calls.h2_a: ICE efuna ekkubo okuyita mu NATs nga ekozesa host + server-reflexive + relay candidates. emikono gya coturn STUN ne TURN ku ludda lwa Vortex.
calls.h2_b: Buli munne abala abesimbyewo: host (IPs ez’omu kitundu), srflx (server-reflexive okuyita mu STUN), relay (TURN-allocated). Banne bawanyisiganya abesimbyewo bonna; buli pair ekola "pair", okukebera okuyungibwa kusindika okusaba okusiba STUN ku UDP. Pair esooka ewangudde efuuka ekkubo erirondeddwa. Emabega wa symmetric NAT, relay pairs zokka ze zikola — awo we TURN relay mu butuufu relay media.
calls.h2_c: ICE yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 5245 mu 2010 ate n’ezza obuggya nga RFC 8445 mu 2018. Emabega wa carrier-grade-NAT, STUN eremererwa ebitundu nga 15 % ate TURN tekyewalika. coturn ye seva y'ensibuko enzigule TURN ey'okujuliza; tugisindika kubanga eky’okuddako (Twilio/Vonage TURN eky’obusuubuzi) kigula buli ddakiika y’amaloboozi agaweebwayo.
calls.h3_a: TURN credentials ziwangaala HMAC-signed username/password pairs ezifulumizibwa buli ssimu, so si byama ebiwangaala.
calls.h3_b: Ku kutandika okuyita, node ekola `erinnya ly'omukozesa = "<expiry_unix>:<user_id>"` ne `password = base64(HMAC-SHA1(server_secret, username))`. Bombi balina TTL 24 h. Kasitoma azikozesa mu nsengeka ye eya RTCPeerConnection. coturn ekakasa HMAC ku nteekateeka y'olutuula. Creds eziggwaako zilemererwa okukebera HMAC — zilekera awo okukola automatically awatali database ya revocation.
calls.h3_c: Creds eziwangaala akaseera katono HMAC ziva mu RFC 5389 (STUN) era ze nkola buli production WebRTC deployment gy’ekozesa. Twilio, Google, Xirsys bonna bakikola. Eky’okuddako — static TURN creds — kivuba singa kasitoma yenna aba mu kabi. Creds eziwangaala akaseera katono zikoma ku ddirisa ly’okwonooneka ku 24 h.
calls.h4_a: Amaloboozi ga Opus ku 48 kHz nga DTX; vidiyo ye VP9 primary / H.264 fallback / AV1 okulonda okuyingira.
calls.h4_b: Amaloboozi: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR. DTX (Discontinuous Transmission) ekoma okusindika mu kiseera ky'okusirika, edda ku ddoboozi. FEC ku bulijjo. Akatambi: VP9 ku ntandikwa; H.264 yalangibwa ku byuma ebitaliiko hardware VP9 decode (iOS nga A10 Bionic tennabaawo); AV1 ewereddwa nga opt-in for premium ku hardware ey'omulembe. Simulcast for group calls: caller encodes three resolutions concurrently, SFU abawagizi okuva ekituufu eri buli mulabi.
calls.h4_c: Opus ye codec y'amaloboozi eya IETF etali ya bwakabaka (RFC 6716, 2012). VP9 ye Google's open H.265-enkanankana. H.264 ye fallback kubanga Apple yanywerera ku buwagizi bwa VP9 okutuusa mu 2021. AV1 yafuuka ekola ku masimu oluvannyuma lwa iPhone 15 Pro (2023) ne Pixel 8 (2023) okugattako hardware decode. Vortex's codec mix y'emu Google Meet gy'ekozesa.
calls.h5_a: Okuyita mu bibinja kukozesa SFU (Selective Forwarding Unit) ku node. Buli eyeetabye mu mpaka zino assaako omulundi gumu; SFU mu maaso eri buli muntu.
calls.h5_b: Ku > 2 peers omuyita ateeka `/api/calls/{room_id}/group/start`. Node ewuuta waggulu ekifaananyi kya SFU ekisibiddwa ku kuyita. Buli eyetabamu aggulawo PeerConnection eri SFU mu kifo ky’okuggulawo eri buli munne omulala. Uplink: buli emu esindika omugga 1. Downlink: SFU egenda mu maaso emigga gya N-1. Simulcast layers kitegeeza SFU elonda resolution esaanira buli mulabi bandwidth eriwo.
calls.h5_c: SFU ebizimbe byava mu Videobridge ya Jitsi (2013). Nga SFU tennabaawo, okuyita kw’ekibinja kwa WebRTC kwali kwa full-mesh — buli peer encoded N-1 streams, ezigerageranya quadratically. Zoom, Google Sisinkana, Jitsi, Okuyita ekibinja kya siginiini byonna bikozesa SFU. Vortex amasimu g'ekibiina agawulikika gokka agasindikibwa mu v0.0.8; okuyita mu bibinja bya vidiyo kuli ku v0.3 roadmap.
calls.h6_a: Okugabana ku screen ye track empya ey’emikutu ku PeerConnection eriwo, eddaamu okuteesebwako nga bayita mu offer/answer.
calls.h6_b: Omukozesa akuba ku Share Screen → browser / iOS / Android eyita `getDisplayMedia()`. MediaStream ekomezeddwawo eyongerwako Track-ed ku PeerConnection. Omuliro gw’okuddamu okuteesa: okuwaayo/okuddamu okupya n’oluyimba olwongezeddwaako. Abaweebwa bakola screen egabanyizibwa nga ekintu kya vidiyo eky’enjawulo. Ku iOS, okugabana ku screen kwetaaga Broadcast Upload Extension; ku Android, empeereza ey'omu maaso + olukusa lwa MediaProjection.
calls.h6_c: getDisplayMedia yatuuka ku mutindo mu 2017 era eri mu buli browser okuva mu 2019. iOS’s Broadcast Upload Extension yajja mu iOS 11 (2017). Android MediaProjection ebadde nnywevu okuva ku Lollipop (2015). Vortex okugabana ku screen kusindikiddwa mu v0.0.8.

abesimbyewo:
  omutegesi : rtp:addr (omu kitundu IP)
  srflx : STUN yazudde okwogera mu lujjudde
  relay : TURN-endagiriro ya relay ewereddwa

okukebera babiri: STUN okusaba okusiba ku UDP .
selected pair: okusooka okutuuka ku buwanguzi
calls.h3_f:
username = "{okuggwaako_unix}:{id_omukozesa}".
password = base64 (HMAC-SHA1 (ekyama_eky'omuweereza, erinnya ly'omukozesa))
TTL = essaawa 24
coturn: ekakasa HMAC ku AUTH okusaba; agaana oluvannyuma lw’okuggwaako
calls.h4_f:
amaloboozi: Opus 48 kHz, 6-128 kbps VBR, DTX ku, FEC ku
vidiyo: VP9 (ekisookerwako)
         ↓ okugwa emabega
        H.264 omusingi (okuziyizibwa) .
         ↓ okulonda okuyingira

full mesh (N peers): buli emu esindika emikutu gya N-1 → O(N2) uplink
SFU (N peers): buli emu esindika 1 stream → O(N) uplink buli munne

getDisplayMedia ({akatambi: {akabonero: "bulijjo"}, amaloboozi: bulimba})
