federation.title: Ekibiina kya Federo
federation.subtitle: Pubkeys abesigika, olugambo oluteekeddwako emikono, cross-node DMs.
federation.intro: Federation eleka abakozesa ku node A obubaka abakozesa ku node B. It's opt-in per operator. Node pubkeys zeesigika mu bulambulukufu; tewali automatic "node yonna esobola okugatta n'eyange" mode.
federation.h1p1: Buli node ekuuma `federations (pubkey, endpoint, ebyobulamu_score, added_at, added_by)`.
federation.h1p2: Okwongerako peer kyetaagisa operator-signed admin action. Admin UI alaga engalo ya remote olwo abaddukanya basobole okukakasa out-of-band.
federation.h1p3: Banne abaggyiddwawo basigala mu DB nga bawandiikiddwako `revoked_at` okubala. Okusaba kwa federo okupya okuva ku pubkey y'emu kugaanibwa okutuusa nga admin un-revokes.
federation.h2p1: Okufuluma okuva ku A okutuuka ku user@B: node A ezinga envulopu y'obubaka mu blob eriko omukono era n'ewandiika `/federation/deliver` ku node B.
federation.h2p2: Envulopu: `{source_node, target_user, munda_ciphertext, munda_nonce, sent_at, sig}`. Sig abikka buli kimu okuggyako sig yennyini.
federation.h2p3: Node B ekakasa omukono ku `source_node` pubkey okuva ku mmeeza yaayo eya `federations`. Invalid sign → 401 + ekintu ekibaawo mu kubala ebitabo.
federation.h3p1: Singa B tatuukirirwa, A asimba ennyiriri mu `federation_outbox (target_node, payload, okugezaako, next_retry_at)`.
federation.h3p2: Okudda emabega mu ngeri ey’ekigero: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, okukoppa ku 6h. Okulemererwa okw’olubeerera oluvannyuma lw’ennaku 14.
federation.h3p3: Operator alert ekuma omuliro nga outbox depth > 1000 messages — eraga nti federation link ekwatiddwa.
federation.h4p1: Buli s 60 buli node ekuba ping `GET /v1/health` ku buli munne. Obudde bw'okuddamu + embeera erondooleddwa.
federation.h4p2: Obukodyo bw’ebyobulamu: obusookerwako 100. Buli kiseera ekiggwaako kiggyako 1; buli buwanguzi byongerako 1 (cap 100). Score 0 → federation yayimirira ku lwa munne oyo.
federation.h4p3: Efulumiziddwa okuyita mu `GET /v1/peers` ku daasiboodi z'abaddukanya.
federation.h1_a: Federo mu Vortex nkolagana ya kwesigagana wakati w’abakozi ba node babiri. Buli node efulumya ekisumuluzo ky'olukale ekya Ed25519 ekya byte 32; node endala bagigattako ku mmeeza ya `trusted_nodes` ku mabbali g'enkomerero yaayo n'obubonero bw'ebyobulamu.
federation.h1_b: Okwongerako pubkey eyesigika kyetaagisa omukozi okussa omukono ku kusaba kwa admin n'ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya ekya node yennyini. UI eraga engalo ya remote mu ffoomu ya 64-hex-char ba admins basobole okukakasa out of band. Oluvannyuma lw’okugattako, buli nvulopu ya federo eyingizibwa ekakasibbwa okusinziira ku mukono gwa pubkey ogwo ogwa Ed25519 — ebicupuli bizuulibwa mangu ne biwandiikibwa. Okusazaamu kugonvu: olunyiriri lusigala nga luwandiikiddwako `revoked_at` okusobola okubala, naye omukono gw'envulopu kati gulemererwa.
federation.h1_c: Omusono guggibwa mu federo ya Matrix (nga buli seva elanga ekisumuluzo ky’okussa omukono era buli mukolo ne guteekebwako omukono nakyo) ne ku email’s DKIM (nga DNS afulumya ekisumuluzo ky’okussa omukono). Matrix yakakasa nti model ekola ku scale — network yaabwe erina over 100k federated servers. Enkyukakyuka ya Vortex eyawukana nga yeetaaga okulonda okwa nnamaddala okwa buli omu mu kifo ky'etteeka lya Matrix erya "seva yonna esobola okugatta mu butonde"; twasuubula convenience for a stronger defense against rogue federation.
federation.h1_f:
trusted_nodes olunyiriri:
  ekisumuluzo ky'okunywa : 32 bytes Ed25519
  enkomerero : https://...
  obubonero_obw'ebyobulamu : int [0, 100].
  added_at : unix_ms
  added_by : admin_omukozesa_id
  okusazibwamu_ku : unix_ms | NULL .
federation.h2_a: Obubaka obusalasala buvuga envulopu y’emu eya E2E n’ey’omu kitundu, nga buzingiddwa mu nvulopu ey’ebweru eriko omukono ekakasa envulopu esindika eri envulopu efuna.
federation.h2_b: Node A eyagala okutuusa ku user@B. Omutendera 1: A serialises `{ensibuko_node, target_omukozesa, munda_ciphertext, munda_nonce, sent_ku}`. Omutendera 2: A assa omukono ku bytes ezisengekeddwa n'ekisumuluzo kyayo eky'ekyama ekya Ed25519 → `sig`. Omutendera 3: A POSTs tuple ku `POST /federation/deliver` ku node B. Omutendera 4: B atunuulira `source_node` mu `trusted_nodes` yaayo, akakasa `sig`, akebera `sent_at` ku replay-window, era n'anyweza envulopu ey'omunda mu mmeeza yaayo eya `messages` ey'omu kitundu. Kasitoma afuna akiraba ddala ng’obubaka obw’omu kitundu — layeri ya federo telabika eri abakozesa enkomerero.
federation.h2_c: Envulopu eriko omukono ogw'ebweru yeewolwa okuva mu mikolo gya Matrix egya federo eya `m.room.message`. Eddirisa ly’okuddamu okuzannya (eddakiika 5) n’obwetaavu nti sitampu z’ebiseera eziteekeddwako omukono gw’ensibuko zikwatagana n’essaawa y’oku bbugwe byewolwa okuva ku DKIM. Vortex (v0.0.2) eyasooka yagezaako federo etalina mukono nga erina TLS client certs; twakyusa ne tudda ku payload signatures mu v0.0.5 oluvannyuma lw'okukimanya nti client certs teziwona load balancers ne zikweka okukakasa kwennyini okuva mu application layer.
federation.h2_f:
envulopu = {
  ensibuko_ennyingo : hex32, .
  ekigendererwa_omukozesa : int64, .
  ekiwandiiko_eky'omunda: bytes, .
  munda_nonce : bytes, .
  esindikiddwa_ku : unix_ms, .
}
sig = Ed25519Sign (ensibuko_priv, CBOR (envulopu))
POST /federation/okutuusa { envulopu, sig } .
federation.h3_a: Node ey'ewala bweba nga tetuukiddwako, node esindika esimba ennyiriri envulopu mu `federation_outbox` yaayo era eddamu okugezaako n'okudda emabega okw'ekitalo.
federation.h3_b: Enteekateeka y’okudda emabega: 1s, 5s, 30s, 2min, 10min, 1h, capped ku ssaawa 6h. Ku buli kugezaako okulemererwa ennyiriri z'olunyiriri `attempts` zeeyongera era `next_retry_at` eteekebwa ku kati + current-step. Omukozi w'emabega (`app/federation/outbox_worker.py`) azuukuka buli s 5 n'alonda ennyiriri awali `next_retry_at <= kati()`. Obuwanguzi busazaamu olunyiriri; Ennaku 14 ez'okulemererwa zigiteekako akabonero ak'olubeerera era oweereze admin alert.
federation.h3_c: Exponential backoff nga eriko ceiling ye pattern y’emu Kafka gy’akozesa ku producer retries ate SMTP gy’akozesa ku bounced mail. Enkoofiira eno ey’ennaku 14 ekwatagana n’okuteesa kwa SMTP RFC 5321. Enkyusa ezaasooka zaakozesanga fixed 60-second retries ekyavaako thundering-herd spikes nga munnaabwe akomyewo ku mutimbagano oluvannyuma lw’okuvaako; exponential spread yatereeza ekyo mu v0.0.7.
federation.h3_f:
okulwawo (n) = min (6h, 1s · 2−) ku n = 0, 1, 2, ...

enteekateeka y’okuddamu okugezaako: 1s, 2s, 4s, 8s, 16s, 32s, 64s, 128s, 256s, ..., 6h
okulabula: outbox_depth > 1000 okumala > eddakiika 5
federation.h4_a: Buli sikonda 60 buli node ekuba ping buli munne `/v1/health` endpoint. Obukodyo bugenda waggulu ku buwanguzi, wansi ku kulemererwa, nga bukoma mu [0, 100].
federation.h4_b: Obukodyo butandikira ku 100 ku add. Buli buwanguzi byongera +1 (capped ku 100), buli timeout eggyako -1 (floored ku 0). Score 0 pauses federation to that peer — obubaka obupya busimba ennyiriri mu outbox, tewali outbound delivery empya egezaako okutuusa nga score erinnya okudda waggulu wa 20. Obukodyo bubikkulwa nga buyita mu `GET /v1/peers` ku dashboards z'omukozi n'okuyita mu `/metrics` ku Prometheus. Okugwa kw'obubonero okw'amangu mu bannaabwe abawera mu ddirisa erimpi kuleeta okulabula "okuteebereza okugabanya omukutu".
federation.h4_c: Obukodyo buno obw’omulembe gwa AIMD busibuka ku ddirisa lya TCP ery’omugotteko n’ekyuma kya Akamai eky’okukebera obulamu. Omutendera gwa ±1 ogutali gwa kigero (mu kifo ky’okukendeeza ku kitundu kya TCP) gufuula okuddamu okubeera empola okusinga okulemererwa, ekisosola enkola eri okwegendereza — twandibadde twagala okuyimiriza federation nga tetukakasa okusinga okuweereza obubaka obuddiŋŋana nga tuyita mu link efuumuuka. Yayongerwako mu v0.0.6 oluvannyuma lwa munne eyeeyisa obubi okubooga munne babiri abalungi n'okuddamu okugezaako.
federation.h4_f:
ku buwanguzi: obubonero = min(100, obubonero + 1)
ku budde obuwedde: obubonero = max (0, obubonero - 1)
singa obubonero == 0: pause_federation (munnaabwe) .
singa obubonero >= 20: okuddamu_federation (munnaabwe) // hysteresis

gossip.title: Gossip n'okuzuula bannaabwe
gossip.subtitle: Engeri nodes gye zisangamu nga tezirina registry ya wakati.
gossip.intro: Okusukka olukalala lw’omufuzi olukakasibwa, Vortex nodes zinyumya bannaabwe wakati waabwe. Kino kizuula nodes empya nga operators ziziwuuta, ne bwe kiba nti controller tannazikakasa.
gossip.h1p1: Buli s 60, node elonda peer random era n’esindika 256-bit Bloom filter ya peers ezimanyiddwa. Peer eddamu ne peers NOT mu filter, nga kwogasse n'omusengejja gwayo. Bandwidth eri `O(new peers × 32 bytes)`, mu bujjuvu wansi wa 1 KiB buli round.
gossip.h1p2: Buli munne alangibwa ateekebwako omukono gw’ekitundu ky’okulanga. Bakasitoma bakakasa emikono ku kusooka okukwatagana — omulumbaganyi tasobola kujingirira munne mu lugambo.
gossip.h1p3: Laawundi eno eriko ekkomo ku muwendo: okuwanyisiganya okumu buli munne buli s 30 (eddirisa erisereba).
gossip.h2p1: Nodes empya zitandika ne hardcoded bootstrap controllers 8. First gossip round ezudde bannaabwe amakumi; omukutu gukwatagana mu ddakiika ~1.
gossip.h2p2: Olukalala lwa bootstrap lukyusibwa nga luyita mu `.env` `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=ekisumuluzo1@enkomerero1,ekisumuluzo2@enkomerero2,...`.
gossip.h3p1: Buli munne alangibwa alina okuteekebwako omukono n'ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya Ed25519 eky'omukozi. Okujingirira ekirangiriro kya banno kyetaagisa okubba ekisumuluzo ekituufu.
gossip.h3p2: Obukakafu bw'omulimu (obutereezebwa, obusookerwako 2 ^ 18 ziro ezikulembera) ku kuwandiisa kwa bannaabwe okupya bukuuma amayengo ga Sybil-bot amangi nga tegakola.
gossip.h3p3: Enkola y’erinnya: bannaabwe abeeyisa obubi (emikono emibi, ebirango ebijingirire, okuggwaako obudde enfunda eziwera) erinnya lyabwe ligenda livunda. Zero reputation → olukalala oluddugavu.
gossip.h1_a: Buli s 60 buli node elonda peer random era n’eweereza 256-bit Bloom filter efunza peers ezimanyiddwa. Peer eddamu ne peers empya + filter yaayo. Bandwidth ye `O (banne_new_peers × 32 bytes)`.
gossip.h1_b: Bloom omusengejja k=5 hashes, m=256 bits. Node A eyingiza peer_ids zaayo zonna ezimanyiddwa. Sindika eri munne B. B abuuza omusengejja ne buli omu ku banne; ekintu kyonna ekisubwa, B asindika eri A (nga kwogasse n’omusengejja gwayo). A akola okukebera kwe kumu mu reverse. Oluvannyuma lw’okuwanyisiganya ennyiriri zombi zigabana okumanya kumpi kwe kumu. Okuwanyisiganya okwa bulijjo: 200-800 bytes. Ebipya bikwatagana mu mutimbagano gwonna mu ~5 rounds (eddakiika 5) olw'ebintu by'olugambo.
gossip.h1_c: Olugambo lwa Bloom-filter lwava ku lupapula lwa Cornell olwa bimodal multicast mu 1998. Apache Cassandra agikozesa ku bwammemba; Bitcoin ey’okutambuza emirimu; IPFS ku DHT okuddaabiriza. Eky’obugagga ky’okukwatagana ekya O(log N) kye kigifuula etuukira obulungi ku nkozesa yaffe — tetwetaaga ndowooza za nsi yonna, just eventually-consistent peer knowledge. Sayizi ya ffilta (256 bits) etereezeddwa kale omuwendo gwa false-positive guli < 1 % ku banne 100.
gossip.h2_a: Nodes empya zitandika ne hardcoded bootstrap controllers 8. First gossip round ezudde ebisingawo; ekwatagana mu ddakiika ~1.
gossip.h2_b: `.env` esindikibwa ne `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=ekisumuluzo1@enkomerero1,ekisumuluzo2@enkomerero2,...`. Ku kutandika, node egezaako buli emu mu nsengeka. Okusooka okuddamu kiwa olukalala lwa bannaabwe olusooka (ng'oyita mu `GET /v1/trusted_nodes`). Node eyingiza ezo mu mmeeza yaayo eya local peers, n’eziteekako akabonero nga bootstrapped, era n’etandika 60 s gossip loop. Laawundi eziddako zizuula bannaabwe.
gossip.h2_c: Bootstraps eziriko hardcoded ze nkola y’emu Bitcoin, Ethereum, IPFS gye bakozesa. Eky’okuddako — okuzuula okwesigamiziddwa ku DHT — kyetaagisa okuyingira okusooka mu ngeri yonna. Vortex's 8 bootstrap count was picked kubanga okubeera ne > 4 kiwa resilience ku 2-3 simultaneous downtime events, era < 16 ekuuma fayiro ya `.env` nga esomebwa. Teekateeka buli-kuteekebwa mu nkola nga olongoosa `BOOTSTRAP_PEERS`.
gossip.h3_a: Buli munne alangibwa alina okuteekebwako omukono n'ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya Ed25519 eky'omukozi we ensibuko. Omulumbaganyi tasobola kuyiiya banne mu mutimbagano.
gossip.h3_b: Node A bwelanga peer P mu lugambo eri node B, A erimu `P.pubkey`, `P.endpoint`, ne timestamp, byonna nga biteekeddwako omukono n'ekisumuluzo kya P yennyini eky'okufulumya. B akakasa omukono nga tannaba kwesiga P. Singa B oluvannyuma akwatagana ne P ne P's TLS cert + first heartbeat tezikwatagana na pubkey eyalangibwa, akalango kawandiikibwako obutwa era ne kasaasaanyizibwa wansi.
gossip.h3_c: Ebirango bya bannaabwe ebissiddwako emikono biba bya mutindo gwa anti-Sybil primitive okuva mu Chord (2001) ne Kademlia (2002). Obubaka bwa adr bwa Bitcoin bukozesa model enafu (tewali mikono, yeesigamye ku ssente z’okuyungibwa nga Sybil deterrent); Ebipande bya Ethereum ebya discv5. Vortex yakwata ebirango ebiriko emikono mu v0.0.6 oluvannyuma lw’omulumbaganyi wa testnet okulanga banne ab’ebicupuli 1000 ng’ayita mu node emu entuufu.
gossip.h1_f:
omusengejja: k=5, m=256 ebitundu
insert (x) = ku lwa i mu 0..k: okusengejja [hash_i (x) mod m] = 1
okubuuza (x) = ku lwa nze mu 0..k: kebera omusengejja [hash_i (x) mod m].
false-positive ku bannaabwe 100, bits 256, k=5: ~0.4 % .
gossip.h2_f:
.env:
  BOOTSTRAP_PEERS=abcd...@https://a.ekyokulabirako,efgh...@https://b.ekyokulabirako

okutandikawo:
  ku lwa munne mu BOOTSTRAP_PEERS:
    gezaako: banne ← peer.get ('/v1/nodes_ezesigika'); okuwummulamu
    okuggyako: okugenda mu maaso
  tandika olugambo loop

stealth.title: Omukutu gw'okukweka
stealth.subtitle: Layer ttaano, enkola 28. Buli kimu okuva ku TLS padding okutuuka ku Tor onion services.
stealth.intro: Vortex atwala omulabe ow’omutindo gw’eggwanga. Stealth stack eriko layers kale ne bweba layers ez’ebweru ziyisibwa, ez’omunda zikyawa degraded-but-working service.
stealth.h1p1: Layer 1 — okuzza engalo mu mbeera eya bulijjo. Ayimiriza ebisengejja ebitaliiko kye bikola (passive classifiers).
stealth.h1p2: Layer 2 — okukyusakyusa enkula / obunene. Ayimiriza ensengeka z’ebidduka-okwekenneenya ebidduka.
stealth.h1p3: Layer 3 — okukweka mu nkola. Akoma okukola DPI.
stealth.h1p4: Layer 4 — entambula ezisibirwa. Akola mu networks eziziyiza primary yaffe.
stealth.h1p5: Layer 5 — eky’okudda emabega eky’okusembayo. Obutungulu, BMP, relay ya hop eziwera. Akola nga tewali kirala kikola.
stealth.h2p1: TLS 1.3 ClientHello ekwatagana ne Chrome ku Windows 11 byte-ku-byte. JA3/JA4 hash ekwatagana ne Chrome 120 — tewali Vortex-specific fingerprint.
stealth.h2p2: Record-layer padding: ebiwandiiko byonna TLS bipadd okutuuka ku 16 KB. Sayizi za packet zikwatagana n'entambula ya browser mu bungi.
stealth.h2p3: Constant-rate send: ennyiriri efulumya fuleemu emu buli N ms awatali kulowooza ku mirimu gy'okukozesa. Ebiseera ebitaliiko kye bikola bifulumya fuleemu ez’obulimba eziteekeddwako akabonero mu nvulopu ey’omunda kale abazifuna ne bazisuula.
stealth.h2p4: Timing jitter: 0-50 ms random delay ku egress okuwangula latency-based DPI.
stealth.h3p1: YouTube-720p morfer: okusaasaanya obunene bwa packet, burst cadence, n'ebituli mu kusirika bikwatagana ne YouTube live stream. Abagabanya abanoonya emitima gy’ababaka balemererwa okukwatagana.
stealth.h3p2: Multipath: okukulukuta kwe kumu okwawukana ku Wi-Fi, cellular, ne VPN yonna ekola omulundi gumu. Ddamu okukuŋŋaanya ku receiver. Awangula okubumba okw’ekkubo erimu.
stealth.h3p3: WebRTC omukutu gwa data: TLS bw’ezibiddwa naye nga WebRTC ekola, Vortex eyita mu mukutu gwa DTLS-SRTP okutuuka ku munne amanyiddwa.
stealth.h3p4: Enkolagana ya Decoy: Entuula 3 eziwangaala ennyo nga tezikola TLS okutuuka ku Google, YouTube, ne Cloudflare. Observer alaba enneeyisa ya browser eya bulijjo.
stealth.h4: Omutendera 3 — Okukweka mu nkola ya protocol
stealth.h4p1: DoH (RFC 8484): byonna DNS bigonjoolwa nga biyita mu DoH okutuuka ku Cloudflare / Google / Quad9. ISP elaba HTTPS yokka eri abagonjoola abo, so si lukalala lwa domain lwennyini.
stealth.h4p2: ECH (Encrypted Client Hello): SNI encrypted n'ekisumuluzo ekifulumiziddwa mu likoda ya DNS HTTPS. Abatunuulizi abataliiko kye bakola tebasobola kulaba linnya ly'omukozi w'ekifo we bagenda.
stealth.h4p3: Okuzuula okunoonyereza: node erondoola okusaba nga tewali auth session. Probes ssatu eziremye okuva ku IP mu 5 min zitandika "decoy site" mode — nti IP kati alaba plain HTML landing page nga 200 OK.
stealth.h4p4: DGA (Domain Generation Algorithm): ensengekera y’ekitundu etegeerekeka (deterministic domain generator) esigiddwa n’olunaku lwa leero. Singa enkomerero enkulu ezibiddwa, bakasitoma babala omuntu addako ne bagezaako.
stealth.h5p1: vmess / vless / trojan / shadowtls: entambula ez'omulembe eza V2Ray nga zirina ensengeka ya JSON eyinza okusiigibwa.
stealth.h5p2: Entuufu: TLS-munda-TLS omukutu. Okukwatagana mu ngalo okw’ebweru kugenderera www.microsoft.com; okukwatagana mu ngalo okw’omunda kuli Vortex. Probes against the outer get forwarded to Microsoft kale okukebera okukola tekulaga kintu kyonna.
stealth.h5p3: Snowflake: browsers ez’obwannakyewa zitambuza Vortex traffic ku WebRTC. Abakozesa abateeka eky'okugaziya Snowflake bawa ekibikka.
stealth.h5p4: NaiveProxy: ekyusa HTTPS probes okutabula n'enneeyisa ya Chromium yennyini okutuuka ku microsecond.
stealth.h6p1: Empeereza z'obutungulu: buli node nayo yeeyanjula nga `.obutungulu`. Bakasitoma abalina obuyambi bwa Tor bagwa mu kino nga ebirala byonna biremye.
stealth.h6p2: Blind Mailbox Protocol (BMP): okutereka-n'okuweereza obubaka obutamanyiddwa. Laba essuula BMP.
stealth.h6p3: Multi-hop relay: obubaka busobola okubuuka okuyita mu nodes eziwera 5 ez’omu makkati, nga buli emu eyongerako layeri ya envulopu. Nga Tor naye mu mesh yaffe.
stealth.h6p4: OHTTP (RFC 9458): obutafaayo HTTP okuyita mu relay. Tewali kibiina kimu kiraba kusaba na kuddamu.
stealth.h1_a: Stealth etegekeddwa nga layers ttaano ezeetongodde. Buli layeri ewangula kiraasi y’omulabe ey’enjawulo. Okulemererwa kwa layeri emu kukendeera okutuuka ku ndala — tekuyitamu.
stealth.h1_b: Layer 1 normalises TLS fingerprint yaffe kale passive DPI tesobola kugabanya. Layer 2 ekyusa enkula y’ebidduka okulabika nga streaming. Layer 3 ekweka protocol ng’eyita mu ECH / DoH / obukodyo bw’okuddamu okunoonyereza. Layer 4 ekyuka okudda ku ntambula ezisobola okusibirwa (vmess, reality, Snowflake) nga primary ezibiddwa mu ngeri ekola. Layer 5 ye yasembayo: Tor obutungulu, BMP, multi-hop relay.
stealth.h1_c: Omuze gwa layeri guva mu nsengeka ya Tor eya pluggable-transports architecture (2013). Vortex yayongerako layers ttaano mu kifo ky’essatu eza Tor kubanga mu mwaka gwa 2025 ekifo eky’okuvuganya kyalimu DPI eyategeera entambula za Tor zennyini (Great Firewall 2020, Iran 2022). Buli layeri ya Vortex yayingizibwa oluvannyuma lw’ekintu ekyaliwo mu nnimiro: L1 oluvannyuma lwa Kazakhstan okuzibira (ekyenkanankana ne 2019), L2 oluvannyuma lwa Iran okufufuggaza mu 2022, L3 oluvannyuma lwa China okuzuula DoH mu 2020, L4 oluvannyuma lwa Turkey okuzibira 2023, L5 mu kwetegeka.
stealth.h1_f:
Ekibiina ky'omulabe | Yawanguddwa...
------------------- | -----------
ekitakola DPI | L1 (engalo) .
okwekenneenya ebidduka | L2 (enkula) .
active DPI | L3 (okukweka) .
okuziyiza nga IP | L4 (ebyentambula) .
ebirala byonna | L5 (obutungulu / BMP) .
stealth.h2_a: Layer 1 efuula Vortex traffic obutayawukana ku Chrome ku Windows 11 ku TLS layer.
stealth.h2_b: ClientHello ordering, olukalala lw'okugaziya, olukalala lwa cipher suite, ALPN values ​​— byonna bituukiddwa okukwatagana ne Chrome 120's exact bytes. JA3/JA4 hash ekwatagana ne Chrome efulumiziddwa mu kiseera kino. TLS record padding okutuuka ku 16 KB. Constant-rate sender efulumya frame emu buli N ms ne dummy fillers mu kiseera ky'obutakola. Timing jitter 0-50 ms okumegga okwekenneenya latency. Ebiyungo bya Decoy ku Google, YouTube, Cloudflare bidduka mu mugongo mu bbanga lya s 45.
stealth.h2_c: JA3/JA4 fingerprinting yafulumizibwa bayinginiya ba Salesforce mu 2017. We bwatuukira mu 2019 yali ya mutindo mu bitongole DPI. Vortex's fingerprint normalization is modeled on uTLS, etterekero lya Go Snowflake ly'ekozesa ku kigendererwa kye kimu. Abasindika omuwendo ogutaggwaawo gwe mwalo ogw'obutereevu ogw'ekiteeso kya WireGuard ekya "cover traffic".
stealth.h3_a: Layer 2 ekyusa traffic okulabika nga bulk streaming media okusinga interactive chat.
stealth.h3_b: YouTube-720p morfer: okusaasaanya obunene bwa packet kukwatagana ne 720p YouTube live stream (empirical table), emipiira gya burst cadence, silence gaps match. Multipath: omugga gwe gumu ogw’ensonga ogwawuddwamu ku Wi-Fi, cellular, ne VPN yonna ekola mu kiseera kye kimu; receiver eddamu okukuŋŋaanya mu nsengeka y’ennamba z’omutendera. WebRTC data channel fallback: TLS bwezibiddwa naye WebRTC n’ayita, tunnel Vortex okuyita mu DTLS-SRTP data channel eri munno amanyiddwa.
stealth.h3_c: Okunoonyereza ku nkyukakyuka y’ebidduka kudda mu Wright et al. 2009. Obfs4 yakiteeka mu nkola nga "morph" sub-mode yaayo mu 2014. Meek+domain-fronting yatuyigiriza nti ekifaananyi kikulu nnyo nga encryption. YouTube-specifically yalondebwa kubanga gwe mukutu gumu ogusinga obunene ogutali gwazibikira mu mikutu egisinga egy'okuziyiza — okwekweka munda mu ntambula eringa YouTube "kwekweka mu bantu".
stealth.h3_f:
obunene_obupakiti [nze] ~ P (obunene | YT-720p)
okusindika_okulwawo [nze] ~ P (okulwawo | YT-720p)
dummy_frames eziyingizibwa mu kiseera ky'obutakola okukuuma enkula y'envulopu
stealth.h4_a: Layer 3 ekweka endagamuntu ya protocol yennyini — SNI, DNS, koodi z’okuddamu.
stealth.h4_b: DoH (RFC 8484): byonna DNS biyita mu DNS-ku-HTTPS okutuuka ku Cloudflare/Google/Quad9. ISP alaba HTTPS yokka eri abo abagonjoola. ECH (RFC 9460): SNI ekuumibwa n'ekisumuluzo ekifulumiziddwa mu likoda ya DNS HTTPS. Abatunuulizi abataliiko kye bakola balaba eky’omu maaso kyokka IP. Okuzuula okunoonyereza: nodes zilondoola IPs ezitakkirizibwa nga zikuba `/api/*`; okulemererwa okusatu mu ddakiika 5 kyusa IP okudda ku "decoy mode" — nti IP kati alaba static HTML landing page ne 200 OK. DGA: deterministic domain generator seeded n'olunaku lwa leero kale bakasitoma bafuna fallback nga primary ezibiddwa.
stealth.h4_c: DoH yatongozebwa mu Firefox 2018 era n’efuuka default ku Chrome mu 2019. ECH yayita mu drafts ttaano nga tannateekebwa ku mutindo mu 2024 — Vortex yasindika obuwagizi mu kiseera kya draft-13 era kati ewagira spec esembayo. Probe-response decoys zeewolwa okuva mu dizayini ya meek eya 2014 ne zirongoosebwa mu 2023 oluvannyuma lw’aba Iran abakola probers okuzuula meek okusinziira ku budde bwayo obw’okuddamu.
stealth.h5_a: Layer 4 ekozesa entambula ezisibirwa — emikutu egy’ekika eky’okusatu ezifaanana ekintu ekirala kyonna.
stealth.h5_b: vmess/vless/trojan: entambula ezifuluma mu ngeri ya V2Ray eza bulijjo; okutegeka JSON. Entuufu: TLS-munda-TLS tunnel nga okukwatagana mu ngalo okw’ebweru kugenderera www.microsoft.com; okukwatagana mu ngalo okw’omunda kuli Vortex. Active probes eri ebweru ziweerezeddwa ku Microsoft, kale probing tekulaga kintu kyonna. Snowflake: browsers ez’obwannakyewa zitambuza Vortex ku WebRTC; tewali infra ku ludda lwaffe. NaiveProxy: ekyusa HTTPS probes okutabula n'enneeyisa ya Chromium entuufu.
stealth.h5_c: V2Ray’s VMess yatongozebwa mu 2015 aba China abalwanyisa okusengejja. Trojan yatongozebwa mu 2019. Entuufu eva mu 2022 — okuddamu ku Great Firewall’s TLS fingerprint detection. Snowflake ye Tor Project eyadda mu bigere bya obfs4 mu 2020; Vortex yayongedde obuwagizi mu v0.0.9 oluvannyuma lwa Iran okuzibira mu 2023 mu bujjuvu ebifo eby’okuyingira Tor.
stealth.h5_f:
reality inbound ekyokulabirako:
  Erinnya ly’omuweereza: www.microsoft.com
  ekifo: www.microsoft.com:443
  shortIds: ["<ekitali kya bulijjo>"]
kasitoma ayunga ku IP yaffe, SNI=www.microsoft.com, tukiikirira okuddamu okwa nnamaddala Microsoft
singa ekkubo likwatagana ne shortId+auth ⇒ ekkubo erigenda ku Vortex .
stealth.h6_a: Layer 5 ye nsawo esembayo ey’obukodyo: obuweereza bw’obutungulu, BMP store-and-forward, multi-hop relay, OHTTP.
stealth.h6_b: Buli node efulumya endagiriro ya `.onion`. Bakasitoma abalina host esobola Tor bagwa nga TLS + L1-L4 bonna balemererwa. BMP (Blind Mailbox Protocol): omusindika asuula blob ensirifu ku node yonna eriko ekisumuluzo `HKDF(recipient_pubkey, "bmp-v1")`; olugambo lusaasaana; omuweebwa asikayo okuva ku node yaabwe ey’awaka. Multi-hop: obubaka bubuuka okuyita mu nodes ezituuka ku 5 ez’omu makkati, buli emu n’eyongerako layeri ya envulopu — nga Tor naye munda mu mesh yaffe. OHTTP (RFC 9458): oblivious HTTP okuyita mu relay kale tewali ludda lumu lulaba byombi okusaba n’okuddamu.
stealth.h6_c: Okuweereza obutungulu kwatandika mu 2004 mu Tor. BMP kye kiyiiya kyaffe, nga kikoppa olugambo lwa Tor olwa hidden service descriptor. Endabirwamu za relay ezikola multi-hop Signal’s sealed-sender nga kwogasse n’okuyisa obutungulu. OHTTP ya 2024, yayiiya Cloudflare ne Apple olw’okukuuma eby’ekyama ku telemetry; twakitwala mu v0.0.9 nga fallback esembayo.
stealth.h6_f:
BMP mailbox_id = HKDF (omuweereza_pk, "bmp-v1", 32)
Okutereka: POST /bmp/okutereka { mailbox_id, blob }
Okulonda: GET /bmp/obubaka (obukakafu)
TTL: 7200 s |  Max blob: 1 MB |  Max buli node: 500 MB

bmp.title: Enkola ya Mailbox eya Muzibe
bmp.subtitle: Anonymous store-and-forward okufuna obubaka okuyita mu katimba k'olugambo.
bmp.intro: BMP ereka omuweereza okuteeka obubaka ku node yonna nga talaze ndagamuntu. Obubaka buyomba okutuusa lwe butuuka ku node y’awaka y’oyo abufuna, gye busumulula nga bulijjo.
bmp.h1p1: Omusindika aggya `mailbox_id = HKDF (omuweereza_ekisumuluzo, info: "bmp-v1", len: 32)`. Omusindika yekka (amanyi recipient_pubkey) y'asobola okugibalirira; omuweebwa naye amanyi.
bmp.h1p2: Omusindika awandiika `POST /bmp/deposit` ne `{mailbox_id, blob}` ku node yonna enyumya.
bmp.h1p3: Node etereka pair okutuuka ku 7200 s. Node era erimu mailbox_id mu next gossip round's Bloom filter.
bmp.h1p4: Nodes endala zisika blobs ku mailbox_ids ze bafaako mu kitundu (abafuna ku node yaabwe).
bmp.h1p5: Kasitoma w'oyo afuna okulonda `GET /bmp/messages` era n'aggyamu blobs zonna empya n'ebintu bye ebikulu ebya bulijjo.
bmp.h2p1: Tewali node esobola kuyunga blob ku musindika — omukutu gw’omusindika TLS gulaga ensibuko IP, naye olujegere lw’obutungulu obubuuka wakati w’omusindika n’ennyiriri esooka BMP nakyo kiggyawo.
bmp.h2p2: Recipient-hiding: blob ekuumibwa n'ekisumuluzo ky'omuweereza. Nodes za wakati zilaba olunyiriri lwa byte olutali lutangaavu lwokka ne mailbox_id eya random.
bmp.h2p3: Tewali kukakasa kutuusa eri oyo eyasindika. At-most-omulundi gumu amakulu.
bmp.h3p1: Obunene bwa blob obusinga obunene: 1 MB. Emigugu eminene girina okusengekebwa okuyita mu nkola ya fayiro eya bulijjo.
bmp.h3p2: Max okutereka buli node: 500 MB ez’ebitereke byonna awamu. LRU okusengulwa ku cap. Abaddukanya emirimu basobola okutuunya.
bmp.h3p3: Spam: buli-IP omuwendo gw’okutereka gukoma ku 10 / min. Mailbox IDs ezitunuuliddwa emirundi egisukka mu 3 / essaawa ku node emu zirina rate-limited nga ziteeberezebwa nti amataba.
bmp.h4p1: Abafuna okusengejja okw'amaanyi: omusindika teyeetaaga kumanya node y'awaka y'omuweereza.
bmp.h4p2: Okuyungibwa okutambula obutasalako: blobs zirinda okutuusa ng’oyo afuna azzeemu okuyungibwa n’okulonda.
bmp.h4p3: Okufuuwa enduulu nga tomanyiddwa mannya: obutungulu ku ludda lw’omuweereza + BMP = tewali metadata ku ani yateeka kiki.
bmp.h1_a: BMP ye layeri ya store-and-forward etamanyiddwa mannya. Sender asuula blob ku node yonna esobozesa olugambo; blob erinda mu mailbox eriko ekisumuluzo kyokka ku kisumuluzo ky'olukale eky'oyo afuna.
bmp.h1_b: Omusindika abalirira `mailbox_id = HKDF(omuweereza_ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya, "bmp-v1", 32)`. Omuntu yekka amanyi `recipient_pubkey` y'asobola okugibalirira — oyo agifuna amanyi, oyo asindika amanyi, omuntu ow'okusatu tamanyi. Omusindika POSTs `{mailbox_id, blob}` ku node yonna egambo. Node etereka pair okutuuka ku 7200 s (2 h), era n'elangirira mailbox_id mu gossip exchange Bloom filter eddako. Nodes endala okulaba mailbox_id mu kitundu ng'ekwatagana ne mailbox y'omukozesa eterekeddwa zisika blob ne zigenda mu maaso eri kasitoma w'omukozesa oyo.
bmp.h1_c: BMP yategekebwa okuva ku ntandikwa nga ttiimu ya Vortex. Twagizimba kubanga tewali mubaka mukulu yali mwetegefu kusaasaanya by’obugagga ebyetaagisa okukweka metadata okuva ku nkomerero okutuuka ku nkomerero — buli kintu eky’amaanyi kyasindikanga okusiba ebirimu naye ne kireka layeri y’okutuusa nga nzigule, kale seva yali ekyamanyi ani ayogera na ani era ddi. Munda mu ttiimu twasigala tugamba nti "omubaka ow'obukuumi avuga social graph abeera kitundu kya bukuumi kyokka." BMP kye ky’okuddamu kyaffe: omusindika, oyo afuna, n’ebirimu byonna bifuuka ebitali bitangaavu; tewali node emu mu mesh ekwata ebitundu ebimala okuddamu okuzimba emboozi. Eddukira ku lugoye lwa Vortex lwennyini olw’olugambo okusinga ebikozesebwa ebiteekeddwako obuuma, kye kyafuula omuwendo gw’ebyobusuubuzi okuba ogw’ensaamusaamu ate nga ne dizayini ebalirirwa mu nnyumba.
bmp.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF (omuweereza_ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya, info = "bmp-v1", len = 32)

Okutereka: POST /bmp/okutereka {mailbox_id: 32B, blob: ≤1 MB}
Langirira: olugambo Bloom filter += mailbox_id
Okulonda: GET /bmp/obubaka (auth'd) → blobs ku mailbox_ids z'omukozesa
TTL: 7200 s |  buli-node okutereka cap: 500 MB |  omuwendo gw'okutereka: 10/eddakiika/IP
bmp.h2_a: BMP egaba ebintu bisatu eby’ekyama ebyetongodde: okukweka omusindika, okukweka omuweereza, okukweka ebirimu.
bmp.h2_b: Sender-hiding: TLS okuyungibwa ku node etereka kulaga ensibuko IP; okugattako Tor hop oba olujegere oluyisibwa obutungulu ku BMP node esooka kiggyawo ekyo. Recipient-hiding: mailbox_id ye hash ya kkubo erimu eya recipient_pubkey eriko omunnyo n'omuguwa gw'enkyusa ya BMP — node eya wakati elaba ekimanyisa kya byte 32 ekitali kitangaavu. Okukweka ebirimu: blob yasibirwa dda E2E eri oyo afuna ng’akozesa ebisumuluzo ebya bulijjo Vortex room / DM, kale node eya wakati elaba ciphertext yokka.
bmp.h2_c: Ensengeka y’ebintu bisatu y’engeri Pond gye yannyonnyolamu ebigendererwa byayo mu 2014. Vortex yagirongoosa ng’efuula mailbox_id collision-resistant (256-bit hash) kale abakozesa babiri abatalina kakwate tebasobola kugabana mailbox mu butanwa. TTL ya sikonda 7200 eva mu kwetegereza nti 95 % ku bafuna mu beta yaffe basika mu ssaawa 2; okutereka okuwanvuwa TTL okufuuwa buli node awatali magoba ga kutuusa galabika.
bmp.h2_f:
Omulabe alaba embeera ya node:
  - amanyi mailbox_id eriwo mu kiseera T
  - NOT amanyi omusindika (yali TLS/Tor hop away)
  - amanyi NOT oyo afuna (mailbox_id ye hash ya ngeri emu)
  - NOT amanyi ebirimu (blob eri E2E-encrypted)
bmp.h3_a: Ekkomo enkakali ku sayizi ya blob, okutereka buli node, n’omuwendo gw’okutereka bikuuma BMP obutafuuka dead-drop for arbitrary data.
bmp.h3_b: Obunene bwa blob obusinga obunene: 1 MB. Emigugu eminene girina okukutuka okuyita mu nkola ya fayiro eya bulijjo, erimu ekkubo lyayo ery’okutereka. Max buli node okutereka: 500 MB omugatte gwa BMP ebitereke. Bwe kituuka ku cap, okugobwa okusinga obukadde-okusooka kusuula blobs nga tebannaba TTL — abaddukanya basobola okutereeza nga bayita mu `BMP_MAX_BYTES` env var. Omuwendo gw’okutereka buli IP: 10 buli ddakiika, okuziyiza amataba okuva ku mulumbaganyi omu. ID za mailbox ezitunuuliddwa emirundi egisukka mu 3/essaawa mu mutimbagano gwonna zirina emiwendo egy'ekkomo nga "kiteeberezebwa nti ekigendererwa ky'amataba".
bmp.h3_c: 1 MB blob cap ekwatagana ne IRC DCC-send conventions ne Signal's sealed-sender cap — ennene ekimala obubaka obumpi n'ebifaananyi ebitonotono, entono ekimala nti omulumbaganyi tasobola kukozesa BMP ku kukyaza fayiro. 500 MB buli-node kiri OSS-ekisookerwako ekitegeerekeka; abaddukanya emirimu eminene bagisitula ne `BMP_MAX_BYTES`. Ekkomo ku miwendo lyajja oluvannyuma lwa v0.0.8 beta nga script y’okugezesa eya tester ejjuza nodes 50 n’ebitereke mu ddakiika 20.
bmp.h3_f:
ekkomo:
  BMP_BLOB_MAX_BYTES = 1_000_000 # 1 MB .
  BMP_NODE_MAX_BYTES = 500_000_000 # 500 MB .
  BMP_DEPOSIT_RATE = 10 # buli ddakiika buli IP
  BMP_FLOOD_THRESHOLD = 3 # mailbox_id y'emu buli ssaawa
bmp.h4_a: BMP eyaka mu mbeera ssatu: abafuna okusengejja okw’amaanyi, okuyungibwa okutambula obutasalako, okukuba enduulu nga tebamanyiddwa mannya.
bmp.h4_b: High-censorship: sender tamanyi recipient's home node (era mpozzi tasobola kugituukako anyway). Drop ku munno yenna, leka olugambo route. Okuyungibwa okutambula obutasalako: oyo afuna obuyambi aba tali ku mutimbagano okumala essaawa; blob alinze, tekyetaagisa kuddamu kugezaako. Okufuuwa enduulu nga tomanyiddwa mannya: obutungulu ku ludda lw’omuweereza + BMP = tewali metadata ku ani yateeka kiki. Bw’ogattako ekisumuluzo ky’ekisenge ekimanyiddwa abantu beesigika bokka, ebirimu nabyo tebitangaala eri omukwasi yenna.
bmp.h4_c: Ensonga essatu ez’okukozesa zirondoola ebyafaayo ebikubiriza okutonnya okufu mu kuketta okw’omubiri (omulembe gwa Soviet), ku `alt.anonymous.messages` ku Usenet (1990s), ne ku SecureDrop (2013 okudda waggulu). BMP kwe kugezaako kwaffe okuleeta ebyafaayo ebyo mu mubaka ow'omulembe nga tetwetaaga kikozesebwa kya njawulo.

push.title: Okumanyisibwa okusindiikiriza
push.subtitle: APNs, FCM, Web Push — byonna nga biriko envulopu ezissiddwaako akabonero kale abagaba baleme kusoma.
push.intro: Empeereza za standard push (APNs, FCM, Web Push) laba buli payload. Vortex ezinga buli notification mu E2E layer eyawukana kale omuwa alaba opaque blob yokka nga tewali room id, sender, oba text.
push.h1p1: Kasitoma afuna akabonero ka platform (APNs device token, FCM registration id, oba Web Push subscription JWT).
push.h1p2: Kasitoma akola ekisumuluzo ekipya ekya byte 32 X25519 `p256dh_pub` n'ekyama kya byte 16 ekya `auth`. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` ne `{enkomerero, p256dh, okukakasa, omukutu}`.
push.h1p3: Node esigala `push_subscriptions (omukozesa_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, omukutu, yatondebwa_ku)`.
push.h2p1: Okumanyisibwa bwe kubaawo (obubaka obupya mu kisenge ekisirise ekiteekeddwa okutegeeza, okwogera, okuyita okuyita), node encrypts payload ne AES-GCM nga ekozesa ekisumuluzo ekiggiddwa mu `ECDH(p256dh_pub, ephemeral_priv)` okuyita mu HKDF.
push.h2p2: Node packages `{endpoint, TTL, obwangu, omulamwa: <collapse_key>, data: <ciphertext>}` era esindika ku APNs / FCM / Web Push server.
push.h2p3: Omuwa alaba `data` yokka (ciphertext) + `omulamwa`. Tewali kuvuba kwa biwandiiko bya lwatu.
push.h3p1: Ekisumuluzo ky'omulamwa buli kisenge: `ekisenge:<id>`. Obubaka obuwera mu kisenge kimu bugwa ne bufuuka okumanyisibwa okumu ku ddaala lya OS.
push.h3p2: Omulamwa gwa buli kuyita: `okuyita:<id>`. Okuddamu oba okugaana kusika bendera; new call invites mu kisenge kye kimu zzaawo enkadde.
push.h4p1: iOS: Notification Service Extension eggyamu ensirifu mu nkola ya NSE (yawukana ku app enkulu). Ekozesa CryptoKit primitives ze zimu.
push.h4p2: Android: FirebaseMessagingService esumulula mu mpeereza ey'emabega. JobScheduler etegeka UI update entuufu nga app eri mu maaso.
push.h4p3: Web: Service Worker aggyamu ensirifu mu mbeera ya SW, ateeka okumanyisibwa okw’omu kitundu ng’ayita mu Web Notifications API.
push.h5p1: APNs: yeetaaga akabonero k'omugabi okuzza obuggya buli ddakiika 60. Okuzza obuggya obubonero kukolebwa mu ngeri ya otomatiki nga kuyita mu fayiro ya Apple eya `auth-team-id` + `auth-key-id` + p8 key file.
push.h5p2: FCM: enkomerero HTTP enkomerero ebadde tekozesebwa; tukozesa enkomerero ya HTTP v1 n'ebiwandiiko ebikakasa akawunti y'empeereza OAuth2. Okuzimbulukuka buli luvannyuma lwa ssaawa emu.
push.h5p3: Web Push: VAPID ebisumuluzo (ekisumuluzo kimu buli node). TTL capped ku nnaku 28 nga browser ezisinga obungi.
push.h1_a: Kasitoma awandiika akabonero k’ekyuma (APNs/FCM/Web Push) wamu n’ekisumuluzo eky’olukale ekipya X25519 n’ekyama ky’okukakasa ekya byte 16.
push.h1_b: Kasitoma akola `p256dh_priv = rand (32)` ne `auth = rand (16)`. Eggyamu `p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G`. POSTs `/api/push/subscribe` ne `{enkomerero, p256dh, okukakasa, omukutu, omukozesa_agent}`. Node esigala `push_subscriptions (omukozesa_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, platform, yatondebwa_ku, yasembayo_okuzza obuggya_ku)`. Okukyusakyusa: kasitoma addamu okwewandiisa ku buli kutongoza app, ekizza obuggya `last_refreshed_at`. Okwewandiisa okusukka ennaku 30 kulongoosebwa.
push.h1_c: Ennimiro za p256dh + auth ziva mu Web Push RFC 8291 (2017). Twaddamu okuzikozesa ku APNs ne FCM newankubadde nga empeereza ezo tezeetaaga nkola essiddwako akabonero — okukola ekyo kikuuma ekkubo lya koodi limu mu zonsatule. Nga v0.0.5 Vortex tennasindika payloads za plaintext okuyita mu mpeereza za push; oluvannyuma lwa Apple’s 2022 push privacy update n’akabenje ak’enjawulo nga pulojekiti ya FCM eyali etegekeddwa obubi n’efulumya okumanyisibwa, buli kimu twakitwala mu nvulopu ezissiddwaako ssimu.
push.h1_f:
p256dh_priv = ssente za ssente (32)
p256dh_pub = p256dh_priv · G // X25519 .
auth = randi (16) .

POST /api/sika/okuwandiika
  { enkomerero, p256dh: hex (p256dh_pub), okukakasa: hex (okukakasa), omukutu }
push.h2_a: Okumanyisibwa bwe kubaawo, node esiba payload kale ekyuma ky’oyo agifuna yokka esobola okugisoma. Empeereza y'okusika (Apple / Google / Mozilla) elaba blob etali ya bulambulukufu yokka.
push.h2_b: Node elonda ekisumuluzo eky’ekiseera ekitono X25519. Eggyamu `ikm = ECDH(eky'akaseera obuseera_priv, p256dh_pub)`. Edduka HKDF(omunnyo=auth, ikm, info="aesgcm", len=32) → ekisumuluzo. Encrypts `{omutwe, omubiri, room_id, message_id}` nga CBOR → AES-GCM n'ekisumuluzo ekiggiddwamu + random 96-bit nonce. Asindika `{endpoint, TTL, obwangu, omulamwa: collapse_key, data: ciphertext, aes128gcm: {omunnyo, pub_ephemeral}}` eri APNs/FCM/Web-Push. Ekyuma kifuna, omukozi w'okugaziya / service addukanya ekisumuluzo kye kimu derivation mu reverse, decrypts, alaga okumanyisibwa.
push.h2_c: Okusika okussiddwako akabonero ye butereevu Web Push Message Encryption spec okuva mu 2017 (RFC 8291 + RFC 8188). Apple's 2022 iOS 16 update yayongeddeko obuwagizi obw'omutindo ogusooka ku notification service extensions ezikola decryption; Android ebadde egiwagira ng’eyita mu bubaka bwa data FCM okumala emyaka. Vortex y’emu ku babaka abatono abassa mu nkola enkola y’okutambula okujjuvu nga balina koodi y’emu ku mikutu gyonna esatu — iOS ekozesa `NotificationServiceExtension`, Android ekozesa `FirebaseMessagingService`, Web ekozesa omukozi w’empeereza.
push.h2_f:
ephemeral_priv = rand (32) nga bwe kiri;  ephemeral_pub = eby'akaseera obuseera_priv · G
ikm = ECDH (priv_ey'akaseera obuseera, p256dh_pub)
prk = HMAC-SHA256(omuwandiisi, ikm)
ekisumuluzo = HKDF-Expand (prk, "Ebirimu-Okuwandiika: aes128gcm \ x00", 16)
nonce= HKDF-Expand (prk, "Okuwandiika-Ebirimu: nonce \ x00", 12)
ct = AES-GCM-Encrypt (ekisumuluzo, nonce, omugugu gw'okusasula)
send { endpoint, data: omunnyo∥record_size∥idlen∥ephemeral_pub∥ct }
push.h3_a: Ebisumuluzo by’okugwa biremesa okumanyisibwa okungi okuva mu mboozi y’emu okutuula nga banner ssekinnoomu — OS ezigatta mu kimu.
push.h3_b: Okugwa kwa buli kisenge: omulamwa = `ekisenge:<id>`. APNs's `apns-collapse-id` ne FCM's `collapse_key` zigamba OS okukyusa okumanyisibwa okwasooka n'omulamwa gwe gumu. Omukozesa alaba banner emu buli kisenge ne bwe butuuka obubaka bumeka. Okugwa kwa buli kuyita: omulamwa = `okuyita:<id>`; ebiyita okuyita ebipya mu kisenge kye kimu bikyusizza eby’edda. Per-mention: topic = `okwogera:<omukozesa>:<ekisenge>`; banner emu ey’okwogera ku buli babiri abakozesa-ekisenge.
push.h3_c: Ebisumuluzo by’okugwa byayongerwa ku APNs mu iOS 10 (2016) ne ku FCM mu 2014. Nga ekyo tekinnatuuka, okubutuka kw’obubaka obungi kwakola stacks za banner eziwera abakozesa ze bakyawa mu ngeri y’emu. Telegram ye yatandikawo okugwa kwa buli kisenge UX mu 2015; buli mubaka omukulu yagoberera. Vortex's split into room / call / mention collapse yava ku user feedback mu v0.0.6 beta nti "call invite replaces chat banner" yawulira nga kikyamu — emitwe egy'enjawulo gyakitereeza.
push.h3_f:
APNs: apns-collapse-id = room:42 → ekyusa banner ezaaliwo emabega
FCM: collapse_key = call:17 → ekyusa banner ezaaliwo emabega
Web: omulamwa = mention:u12:r5 → ekyusa banners ezaaliwo emabega
push.h4_a: Buli pulatifomu erina gotcha zaayo. iOS yeetaaga Okugaziya Empeereza y’Okumanyisa; Android yeetaaga obubaka bwa data FCM; Web yeetaaga omukozi w'empeereza + VAPID.
push.h4_b: iOS: ekibinja kya app kiweereza ekiruubirirwa kya `NotificationServiceExtension`. Enkola etuusa payload encrypted eri NSE; NSE erina s 30 eza CPU + 25 MB eza memory okuggya ensirifu n'okukyusa okumanyisibwa nga tekunnalagibwa. FCM: tuweereza obubaka bwa `data` (si `notification`) kale FirebaseMessagingService ya app ekola nga tutuuse — ekyo kituwa obuyinza ku oba okulaga banner. Web Push: omukozi w'empeereza akwata ebibaddewo `push`, aggyamu, alaga ng'ayita mu `self.registration.showNotification`.
push.h4_c: Enkola ya NSE yaleetebwa Apple mu iOS 10 (2016) naddala ku mbeera z’okukozesa obubaka-okuggya ensirifu. Nga ekyo tekinnatuuka, ababaka abakubiddwa ensirifu okuva ku nkomerero okutuuka ku nkomerero baalina okulonda wakati w’emigugu egy’okusika egy’ebiwandiiko ebya bulijjo (privacy-hostile) n’okusika kwa badge yokka (UX-hostile). WhatsApp, Signal, Telegram byonna byabuuka mu NSEs mu mwaka gumu. Vortex egoberera enkola y’emu.
push.h5_a: Quirks ezikwata ku muwa — ekitundu ky’essuula y’okusika. Eno y’emu ku nkola enkulu ezijuliziddwa mu kujuliza kwonna okwa Vortex. Soma essuula eyeetooloddewo omanye ensonga egazi; ekitundu kino kigaziya ku nneeyisa entongole.
push.h5_b: Okulaba okussa mu nkola "Ebizibu ebikwata ku muwa obuyambi". Enkola eno eteekebwa mu nkola mu modulo ekwatagana wansi wa `app/`, `ios/Modules/Sources/`, oba `android/app/src/main/java/sol/vortexx/android/`. Module README eyita amakubo ga fayiro amatuufu.
push.h5_c: Enkola ya "Provider-specific quirks" yakulaakulana mu Vortex ebifulumizibwa. Dizayini eno edda mu kunoonyereza okufulumiziddwa n’enkola z’okufulumya ez’ababaka abaaliwo emabega. Ebyafaayo by’enkyusa mu `CHANGELOG.md` biwandiika buli kitundu lwe kyatuuka ku ttaka n’ekyo ekyakikubiriza.

controller.title: Empeereza ya Controller
controller.subtitle: Okukakasa obulungi, okuzuula okuyingira, okulondoola ebyobulamu.
controller.intro: Omufuzi nkola ya Python eyawukana. Ensi yaayo ey’okulumba ntono (amakubo nga kkumi) era obwesige bwayo busibiddwa ku kisumuluzo kimu eky’olukale ekya Ed25519 ekifumbibwa mu bakasitoma.
controller.h1p1: `GET /v1/obulungi` — ekivudde mu kukakasa. Schema: `{embeera, signed_by, trusted_pubkey, version, built_at, ekwatagana, etakwatagana, ebula, ey'okwongerako, obubaka}`.
controller.h1p2: `GET /v1/obulamu` — obulamu. Schema: `{embeera: "ok", enkyusa, pubkey, stats:{ku mutimbagano, okukkirizibwa, omugatte}}`.
controller.h1p6: `GET /v1/okukuba kw'omutima/{pubkey}` — okunoonyereza ku bulamu bw'ennyingo. Ekozesebwa federated nodes okukuuma okwewandiisa kwazo nga kupya.
controller.h1p7: `POST /v1/register` — node empya ekola okwesiga. Yeetaaga okukkirizibwa kwa admin okuggyako nga `AUTO_APPROVE=true`.
controller.h2p1: Fayiro ya manifesito: `INTEGRITY.sig.json`. Mulimu buli fayiro BLAKE3 hash + Ed25519 omukono.
controller.h2p2: Omulembe: `python -m vortex_controller.obulungi.ekintu_eky'akabonero`. Asoma ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya okuva mu `keys/release.key`, atambula omuti, awandiika manifest.
controller.h2p3: Okukakasa: controller esoma manifest ku startup era egerageranya ne disk. Startup eremererwa nnyo ku mismatch.
controller.h3p1: Endabirwamu zikola code ya controller y'emu nga ekisumuluzo kye kimu eky'okufulumya kikoppoloddwa. Bakasitoma balaba `signed_by` ezifaanagana mu ndabirwamu — engeri emu ey'okuzuula endabirwamu ey'ekicupuli kwe kugeraageranya pubkeys.
controller.h3p2: DNSLink / SNS / IPFS okufulumya ebisonga ku emu ku ndabirwamu eziwerako. Bakasitoma bagezaako mu nsengeka y’okukulembeza nga balina ebiseera ebiwedde.
controller.h3p3: `vortex.sol-mirror/` dayirekita mu repo eno ndabirwamu ya trycloudflare eyeetegefu okugenda okukulaakulanya.
controller.h1_a: Controller's public API surface eri nga amakubo daziini. Byonna bitono, byonna nga essira liteekeddwa ku kukakasa n’okuyingira-URL okuzuula.
controller.h1_b: `/v1/integrity` — okukakasa okweyoleka okussiddwako omukono. `/v1/obulamu` — obulamu + pubkey + ebibalo. `/v1/entries` — URL z'okuyingiza ez'okuyunga. `/v1/mirrors` — abafuga endabirwamu. `/v1/trusted_nodes` — bannaabwe aba federo. `/v1/heartbeat/{pubkey}` — okunoonyereza ku bulamu bw'ennyingo. `/v1/register` — node empya ekola ku kwesiga (okukkirizibwa kw'omuddukanya okuggyako nga `AUTO_APPROVE=true`). Ekyo kye kiri — kifunda mu bugenderevu okukuuma engulu y’okulumba nga ntono.
controller.h1_c: Enteekateeka y’okungulu enfunda etegeezebwa okwetegereza nti enkola y’okukakasa efuuka ekigendererwa eky’omuwendo ogusinga obunene nga bakasitoma bamaze okugisibirako. Koodi entono = engulu entono. Geraageranya ku node erimu amakubo 120+; omufuzi alina 12. Omuze ogufaanagana: Debian's apt-get yeesiga enkola entono eya `Release.gpg` eyawukana ku nkola y'okukyaza package.
controller.h2_a: `python -m vortex_controller.integrity.sign_tool` etambula omuti gw'ensibuko, ekola hashes buli fayiro, essa emikono n'ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya, ewandiika `INTEGRITY.sig.json`.
controller.h2_b: Ekintu kisoma `ebisumuluzo/release.key` (32-byte Ed25519 ekisumuluzo eky'ekyama). Atambula `vortex_controller/` + `app/` (nga tobaliddeemu fayiro ezitunuulirwa). Ku buli fayiro: `blake3(ebirimu) → hash`. Builds manifest `{enkyusa, ezimbiddwa_ku, fayiro: [{ekkubo, sha256, sayizi}]}`. Ebala `canonical_bytes = CBOR (okulaga)`. Obubonero: `sig = Ed25519-Sign (okufulumya_ekisumuluzo, canonical_bytes)`. Awandiika `INTEGRITY.sig.json = {manifest, omukono_nga: pubkey, sig}`.
controller.h2_c: Manifesito eziteekeddwako omukono zidda ku Debian's Release.gpg (1997) ne PGP-signed Linux kernel tarballs. Sigstore (2021) yalongoosa enkola eno okusobola okukakasa enkola y’okugaba ebintu. Enkyusa ya Vortex esinga kuba nnyangu kubanga ekakasa okuteekebwa mu nkola omulundi gumu, so si lujegere lw’okufulumya olw’ebibiina bingi. Tuyinza okwettanira Sigstore mu v0.4 okufulumizibwa mu lujjudde.
controller.h3_a: Endabirwamu zikola code ya controller y’emu nga zirina ekisumuluzo kye kimu eky’okufulumya. Ebiyingizibwa ebingi DNS / SNS / IPFS bisonga ku emu ku ndabirwamu eziwerako.
controller.h3_b: Abaddukanya emirimu bateekawo endabirwamu N (mu ngeri entuufu 3-5). Buli emu ekola koodi y'emu eya `vortex_controller` nga erina `keys/release.key` y'emu. Bakasitoma balaba `signed_by` efaanagana okubuna endabirwamu — okukebera amagezi okulungi. DNS/SNS/IPFS awandiika olukalala lw’endabirwamu n’ebintu ebikulembeza. Bakasitoma bagezaako mu nsengeka y'okukulembeza, nga buli kugezaako kuggwaako kwa sikonda 7. Dayirekita ya `vortex.sol-mirror/` mu repo eno kyakulabirako kya ndabirwamu ya trycloudflare eyasooka okuteekebwako waya.
controller.h3_c: Endabirwamu eziwera nga zirina okutunula okukulembeza ye nkola y’emu SMTP gy’ekozesa ku MX likodi ate HTTPS gy’akozesa ku SRV likodi. Abakulu ba Tor's directory model ekwatagana — 9 hardcoded DAs + obululu. Vortex yalonda "londa endabirwamu ekola" okusinga "quorum vote" kubanga dizayini ezisinziira ku bululu zigumira embeera naye nga zigenda mpola nnyo bootstrap.
controller.h1_f:
/v1/obulungi : GET → ekivudde mu kukakasa
/v1/obulamu : GET → {embeera, enkyusa, pubkey, ebibalo}
/v1/ebiyingizibwa : GET → [{protocol, url}, ...]
/v1/endabirwamu : GET → [url_omufuzi, ...]
/v1/trusted_nodes : GET → [{ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya, enkomerero, obulamu}, ...]
/v1/heartbeat/{pk} : POST (okuva mu nodes eziwandiisiddwa zokka)
/v1/register : POST (ku nsonga empya) .
controller.h2_f:
ekintu = akabonero_ekintu
input = omuti gw'ensibuko, ebisumuluzo/okufulumya.ekisumuluzo
okweyoleka = { .
  enkyusa: "0.1.0",
  ezimbiddwa_ku: unix_ms, .
  fayiro: [{ekkubo, sha256, obunene}, ...]
}
sig = Ed25519-Sign (okufulumya_priv, CBOR (okulaga))
ekifulumizibwa = INTEGRITY.sig.json = {okulabika, okuteekebwako omukono: pub_hex, sig: sig_hex}
controller.h3_f:
DNSLink TXT _dnslink.vortexx.sol: akayungiro akatono=/ipfs/<CID>
SNS okuwandiika vortexx.sol: {"endabirwamu": [url1, url2, url3]}
IPFS CID: INTEGRITY.sig.json ekoppa
kasitoma alonda: okusooka okuddamu mu nsengeka y’okukulembeza, 7 s timeout

storage.title: Layer y’okutereka
storage.subtitle: SQLite ku dev, Postgres ku prod, Alembic ku kusenguka, GRDB/Room/IndexedDB ku bakasitoma.
storage.intro: Vortex's node okutereka eri SQL. Okukyusa wakati wa SQLite (dev) ne Postgres (prod) nkyukakyuka ya DATABASE_URL — tewali koodi forks.
storage.h1p1: `abakozesa (id, erinnya ly'omukozesa, password_hash, x25519_ekisumuluzo_eky'olukale, kyber_ekisumuluzo_eky'olukale?, erinnya_ly'okulaga, avatar_url, essimu, email, created_at, is_active)` — emmeeza y'endagamuntu enkulu.
storage.h1p2: `user_devices (id, user_id, device_id, user_agent, yasembyeyo_okulabibwa_ku, okusazibwamu_ku)` — buli-ennyiriri z'olutuula lw'ekyuma.
storage.h1p3: `ebisenge (id, ekika, erinnya, is_private, is_channel, is_dm, member_count, avatar_url, created_at, created_by, description)` — emmeeza y'ekisenge, olunyiriri lumu buli kisenge.
storage.h1p4: `room_members (ekisenge_id, user_id, omulimu, joined_at, okusirise_okutuusa)` — obwammemba + ACL.
storage.h1p5: `obubaka (id, room_id, sender_id, ciphertext, nonce, sender_pseudo, sent_at, edited_at?, esaziddwamu_ku?, okuddamu_ku?, thread_id?, ekika)` — buli bubaka, indexed ku `(room_id, id)`.
storage.h1p6: `reactions (obubaka_id, user_id, emoji, created_at)` — ekisumuluzo ekisookerwako ekigatta `(obubaka_id, user_id, emoji)`.
storage.h1p7: `fayiro (id, user_id, mime_type, sayizi, sha256 /* mu butuufu BLAKE3 */, ekkubo_okutereka, uploaded_at)` — fayiro metadata.
storage.h1p8: `read_receipts (room_id, user_id, message_id, read_at)` — omulaga ogusembyeyo okusoma buli mukozesa buli kisenge.
storage.h1p10: `federations (pubkey, endpoint, ebyobulamu_score, added_at, eyongezeddwa_by, revoked_at)` — olukalala lwa bannaabwe.
storage.h1p11: `federation_outbox (id, target_node, payload, okugezaako, ekiddako_okuddamu_ku)` — ennyiriri ezifuluma.
storage.h1p12: `scheduled_messages (id, ekisenge_id, ciphertext, nonce, sindika_ku, yatondebwa_nga, yatondebwa_ku, esaziddwamu_ku)`.
storage.h1p13: `contacts (omukozesa_id, contact_mukozesa_id, erinnya ly'ekika, added_at)` — ekitabo ky'endagiriro.
storage.h1p14: `saved_gifs (omukozesa_id, url, obugazi, obuwanvu, added_at)` — buli-mukozesa GIF okukung'aanya.
storage.h1p15: `folders(user_id, id, erinnya, room_ids, is_system, yatondebwa_ku)` — ebitabo by'emboozi.
storage.h1p16: `bot_installations(omukozesa_id, bot_id, installed_at)` — buli mukozesa bot eteekebwa.
storage.h1p17: `sessions (jti, user_id, device_id, expires_at)` — okuzza obuggya registry y'obubonero.
storage.h1p18: `push_subscriptions (omukozesa_id, endpoint, p256dh, auth, omukutu, yatondebwa_ku)` — okusindika okwewandiisa.
storage.h2p1: Alembic mu `alembic/enkyusa/`. Ebyafaayo bya linear, okuddamu okutunulwamu okumu buli kufulumizibwa (oluusi ebitonotono buli kufulumizibwa).
storage.h2p2: Dev mode: `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` okusobola okuddiŋŋana okw'amangu.
storage.h2p3: Prod mode: `omutwe gw'okulongoosa ogwa alembic` nga tonnatandika. Ekifaananyi kya Docker kigiddukanya mu kifo ekiyingira.
storage.h3p1: `messages(room_id, id DESC)` — omuko ogusookerwako ogw'okuleeta empapula.
storage.h3p2: `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — olw'okulagira okwesigamiziddwa ku budde ku kulongoosa.
storage.h3p6: FTS emmeeza ezirabika (FTS5 SQLite / tsvector Postgres) okunoonya ebiwandiiko ebijjuvu.
storage.h4p1: `make db-backup` efulumya archive eriko akabonero k'ekiseera. Encrypted nga ewummudde n'ekisumuluzo ky'omukozi.
storage.h4p2: Okusigala: buli lunaku okumala ennaku 14, buli wiiki okumala wiiki 4, buli mwezi okumala emyezi 12.
storage.h4p3: Okuzzaawo: `kola db-okuzzaawo FILE=<ekkubo>`. Adduka ku siteegi DB asooka; operator akakasa olwo akyusakyusa.
storage.h1_a: Okutereka kwa node kuli SQL. SQLite for dev n'obutono obw'okwekyaza; PostgreSQL okukola okufulumya okw'omukago oba okw'ennyiriri nnyingi. Koodi y'emu eya SQLAlchemy 2.x async evuga byombi.
storage.h1_b: Okusengeka ng'oyita mu `DATABASE_URL=sqlite+aiosqlite:///vortex.db` oba `postgresql+asyncpg://omukozesa:pw@host/db`. Single config, tewali fooro za koodi. SQLite ekola mu nkola; Postgres eddukira mu ngeri ya njawulo. Enkola: SQLite ekwata ~50 abakozesa mu kiseera kye kimu mu ngeri eyeeyagaza ku M1; Postgres minzaani okutuuka ku nkumi n’enkumi. Okusenguka Postgres → SQLite ya ngeri emu nga eyitira mu `pg_dump --data-only` + okuyingiza SQLite; obulagirizi obulala bwe bumu.
storage.h1_c: Enkola ya "one ORM, two backends" nkola ya SQLAlchemy ey'emyaka kkumi. Vortex ekozesa async 2.x API kale buli kubuuza kulindiridde. Twalonda SQLAlchemy Core okusinga Django ORM / Tortoise ORM / raw `asyncpg` olw'emboozi y'okusenguka esinga obugagga n'okukwatagana n'enjogera za FastAPI ezitakwatagana.
storage.h2_a: 18 core tables: abakozesa, user_devices, ebisenge, room_members, obubaka, reactions, fayiro, read_receipts, okubeerawo, federations, federation_outbox, scheduled_messages, contacts, saved_gifs, ebitabo, bot_installations, entuula, push_subscriptions.
storage.h2_b: Emmeeza y'abakozesa ye kikolo ky'endagamuntu. room_members ekwata (ekisenge, omukozesa, omulimu, joined_at, muted_until). obubaka butambuza ciphertext + metadata; indexed ku (room_id, id) okusobola okuleeta empapula. reactions ye mmeeza ya compound-primary-key. Ebirala byonna biba butereevu. Okutereka kukula mu layini n’omuwendo gw’obubaka — nga 1 KB buli bubaka ku disiki oluvannyuma lw’omuwendo gwa index.
storage.h2_c: Ensengeka yali nnywevu oluvannyuma lwa v0.0.4. Emabegako twalina emmeeza ez'enjawulo eza `dm_messages` ne `group_messages`; egattibwa mu v0.0.3 oluvannyuma lwa koodi ya fanout okukoppololwa mu byombi. Emmeeza 18 ze zisinga obutono ku mubaka alina ebifaananyi ebijjuvu; okuteekebwawo okunene kwongera ku mmeeza z'okwekenneenya naye ezo tezeetaagisa kukola.
storage.h3_a: Alembic y’addukanya okusenguka. Ebyafaayo by’okuddamu okusoma mu layini, okuddamu okuddamu okumu buli kufulumizibwa. Buli kuddamu kulongoosa kulina emirimu gyombi egya `upgrade()` ne `downgrade()`.
storage.h3_b: `alembic/versions/` ekwata okuddamu okutunula. Buli emu ye fayiro ya Python ng'erina okulongoosa/okukendeeza. CI ekola `omutwe gw'okulongoosa mu alembic` + `omutwe gw'okulongoosa ogwa alembic -1` + `omutwe gw'okulongoosa mu alembic` okukakasa okugenda n'okudda. Okufulumya: `make db-migrate` ekola mu Docker entrypoint nga app tennatandika. Dev mode ekozesa `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` kale iteration ya mangu nga tekyetaagisa migrations ku buli rebase.
storage.h3_c: Alembic (Michael Bayer, 2011) kye kimu ku bikozesebwa mu kusenguka ebya SQLAlchemy mu mateeka. Ebyafaayo bya linear (si branching) kwe kulonda — kwewala ekizibu kya "abakola babiri bakola ennamba y'okuddamu y'emu". Okusenguka kwa Django kukozesa enkola y’emu. Rails yava ku linear okudda ku timestamped mu 2014 kyokka n’eddamu okutwala linear-with-merge mu 2020.
storage.h4_a: Ebisumuluzo ebikulu bilondebwa n'obwegendereza kale okusoma okw'ebbugumu (obubaka, okuddamu, lisiiti ezisoma) kukuba disiki rarely.
storage.h4_b: `obubaka (room_id, id DESC)` — omuko gw'okukuba empapula ogusookerwako. `messages(room_id, sent_at DESC)` — okudda emabega okulagirwa obudde okusobola okukyusa. `reactions(message_id)` — okugatta ku kisenge ekiggule. `read_receipts (room_id, message_id)` — "kirabibwa N" kubala. `ebyuma_omukozesa (id_omukozesa)` — olukalala lw'ebyuma. FTS emmeeza ezirabika (virtual tables) okunoonya (FTS5 ku SQLite, tsvector ku Postgres).
storage.h4_c: Okulonda index kwava mu explain-plan-profiling mu kiseera ky’okugezesa omugugu gwa v0.0.4. Twatandika ne naive indexes ne twongera/okuggyawo okusinziira ku nkola z’okubuuza ezitunuuliddwa. The `messages(room_id, id DESC)` ye index emu esinga okubuguma — nga 80 % ku kusoma kugikuba. Okugikuuma nga nfunda (tewali mpagi ezirimu) kigireka okuyingira mu jjukira.
