bots.title: Enkola ya bot
bots.subtitle: Gravitix DSL + Python SDK + akatale + antispam.
bots.intro: Bots beetabye mu kisenge mu ddaala erisooka. Obubaka buteekebwako omukono n'ekisumuluzo kya bot ekya Ed25519 kale ebicupuli bizuulibwa.
bots.h1p1: Enkola bbiri: Python SDK oba Gravitix DSL. Python ya nkola z’emirimu enzibu; Gravitix ku chat bots ezivugibwa emikolo ezeetaaga okusindikibwa mu bwangu.
bots.h1p2: Python ekyokulabirako: `okuva ku vortex_bot okuyingiza Bot \ nbot = Bot (akabonero =...) \ n @ bot.ku_obubaka \ nasync def echo (obubaka): linda bot.sindika (obubaka.ekisenge_id, obubaka.ekiwandiiko) \ nbot.dduka ()`. SDK ekwata WebSocket, okuddamu okuyunga, okuwanyisiganya ebisumuluzo by'okusiba.
bots.h1p3: Gravitix ekyokulabirako: `ku /tandika { emit "Mbalamusizza, {ctx.erinnya_eryasooka}!" }`. Ekung’aanya okutuuka ku bytecode era etambulira mu muvvuunuzi ow’omusenyu.
bots.h1p4: Bot token efulumizibwa ku kutondebwawo kwa bot. Token yabula? `POST /api/bots/{id}/rotate-token` efulumya empya.
bots.h2p1: Enkola bbiri ez'okuteeka mu nkola: mu nkola (coroutine munda mu node) n'ebweru (bot polls `/api/bots/{id}/updates`).
bots.h2p2: Mu nkola: zero network hop, esinga okutambula amangu, naye omukozi alina okwesiga bot code. Good ku bots zokka.
bots.h2p3: Ebweru: webhook oba long-poll. Tekyetaagisa kwesiga ku ddaala lya node. Good ku bots ez'ekika eky'okusatu n'akatale.
bots.h2p4: Gravitix bots bulijjo zidduka mu nkola mu sandbox — tezirina filesystem oba network access okuggyako API etegeerekeka.
bots.h3p1: Bots za lukale zisobola okuwaayo mu katale. Abakebera bakakasa nti code tekola phish, tekola spam, tefulumya data ya bakozesa.
bots.h3p2: Categories: ebivaamu, emizannyo, amawulire, ebikozesebwa, ai, okuvvuunula.
bots.h3p3: Teeka: okunyiga omulundi gumu. Node ewandiika omukozesa ku linnya ly'omukozesa lya bot kale DMs route correctly.
bots.h3p4: Okukola ssente: ku bwereere, okugula omulundi gumu, okuwandiika. Ssente za pulatifomu 10 %% ku mugatte.
bots.h4p1: Buli kisenge kirondoolebwa ekintu ekiyitibwa antispam bot ekitalabika. Okukebera: density y'okuyunga > 3 buli ddakiika, omugerageranyo gw'ennukuta ennene > 70 %% ku 10+ chars, obubaka obuddiŋŋana, okubutuka okw'amangu okw'abagatta akawunti empya.
bots.h4p2: Ebikolwa: okulabula → ekiseera kiwedde (eddakiika 5) → okukuba → okuwera. Okujulira kugenda mu room admin.
bots.h4p3: Tuneable buli kisenge nga oyita mu bot config.
bots.h1_a: Bots beetabye mu kisenge mu ddaala erisooka. Buli emu erina ekisumuluzo kya Ed25519 n’akabonero; buli bubaka bwe baweereza buba buteekeddwako omukono, kale ebicupuli bizuulibwa.
bots.h1_b: Tonda: nnannyini POSTs `/api/bots` ne `{erinnya ly'omukozesa, erinnya_ly'okulaga, koodi}`. Node ekola olunyiriri lwa `users` ne `is_bot=true`, ekola ekisumuluzo kya Ed25519, ezzaayo akabonero ka bot aka private-key eri nnannyini (kalagibwa omulundi gumu). Run: bot oba ebeera mu nkola nga coroutine oba ebweru elonda `/api/bots/{id}/updates` n'akabonero kaayo. Obubaka okuva mu bots butambuza bendera ya `from_bot: true` era buteekebwako omukono n'ekisumuluzo eky'ekyama ekya bot.
bots.h1_c: Bot APIs zaatandikibwawo Slack (2014) era ne zirongoosebwa Telegram (2015). Vortex's twist: emikono gya bot gisiba obubaka ku ndagamuntu ya bot, kale node eyali ekoseddwa teyasobodde kuyiiya "@bot said X". Matrix's bot support yayongera ku property eno mu 2021 nga bayita mu federated signatures; Vortex alina okuva ku v0.0.5.
bots.h2_a: Gravitix lulimi olukwata ku domain olw'okuwandiika bots ezikulemberwa ebibaddewo. Obutono, obulaga, obukung’aanyiziddwa mu bytecode eriko sandboxed.
bots.h2_b: Ensengeka y'ebigambo: `on /start { emit "Mbalamusizza, {ctx.erinnya_eryasooka}!" }`. Abakwata bisiba ku biziyiza (ekiragiro, regex, ekintu ekibaawo). Omubiri gwe mutendera gwa `emit`, `let`, `if`, `schedule`, n'ebirala Omukung'aanya afulumya bytecode; runtime etaputa mu sandbox nga tewali filesystem, tewali network ya kimpowooze, Vortex's API zokka. Ekiwandiiko ekijjuvu mu ssuula ya Gravitix docs.
bots.h2_c: Gravitix yategekebwa mu kiseera kya v0.0.6 oluvannyuma lw’okwetegereza nti bot code ezisinga zaali 80 % boilerplate okusiba waya ku Vortex SDK, nga wakati waliwo kernel ya logic entuufu. A DSL ereka logic okwaka era eremesa okukuba Python mu ngeri ey’okwegomba mu mbeera ya bot-dev nga sandbox escapes ziyinza okubaawo.
bots.h3_a: Buli kisenge kirina antispam bot etalabika etunuulira amataba, link spam, obubaka obuddiŋŋana, n’okubutuka kw’okugatta akawunti empya.
bots.h3_b: Amateeka: density y’okuyunga > 3 buli ddakiika okuva ku mukozesa omu, omugerageranyo gwa ALL-CAPS > 70 % ku bubaka ≥ chars 10, okuddiŋŋana obubaka > emirundi 3 mu s 30, okubutuka kw’abagatta nga balina emyaka gya akawunti < 24 h > 20 mu s 60. Ebikolwa byeyongera: okulabula → eddakiika 5 eziggwaako → Okusamba essaawa emu → okuwera (okukkiriza kwa admin okuwera). Tuneable buli-ekisenge nga oyita mu `/antispam config`.
bots.h3_c: Antispam heuristics ziva mu kugatta amateeka ga bot ag’omulembe gwa IRC (Eggdrop, BitchX) n’enkola ez’omulembe nga Discord AutoMod. Ebipimo ebitongole mu Vortex byatunuulirwa okusinziira ku beta corpus ey’emyezi 6 ey’obubaka 200k; false-positive rate is ~0.3 % buli kigero ky’okuwera-okujulira ekitunuuliddwa.
bots.h4_a: Bots za lukale ziwaayo mu katale. Abakebera bakakasa nti tewali phishing / tewali spam / tewali data leaks. Abakozesa banoonya okusinziira ku biti ne bateeka nga banyiga omulundi gumu.
bots.h4_b: Okuweereza: nnannyini awandiika bot source + description. Omukebera addukanya koodi mu sandbox, agisoma ku anti-patterns ezimanyiddwa, akebera okuyita kwonna okw’omukutu okuyita mu API ezikkirizibwa, akakasa enkola y’ekyama. Olukalala: ekika, ebbeeyi, okugereka, okuteeka omuwendo. Okuteeka: `POST /api/bots/{id}/install` — node ekola okuwandiika kwa buli mukozesa. Okukola ssente: ku bwereere / omulundi gumu / okuwandiika; platform etwala 10 %.
bots.h4_c: Obutale bwa app budda ku App Store eya 2008. Slack App Directory (2015), Olukalala lwa Discord Bot (2017), Telegram Bot Store (2024). Vortex's 10 % cut eri wansi okusinga Apple's 30 % ate wansi katono ku Shopify's 20 %, yalondeddwa okusikiriza abakola okufulumya. Enkola y'okuddamu okwetegereza ekoleddwa ku GitLab "okuddamu okwetegereza nga bwe kibadde, okuggya olukalala ku kwemulugunya".
bots.h3_f:
ebivaako:
  link_density > 3/eddakiika → okulabula
  all_caps_ratio > 0.7 (≥10c) → okulabula
  repeat_count > 3 mu myaka 30 → labula
  new_joiner_burst > 20 mu myaka gya 60 → kkufulu y'ekisenge

okulinnya kw’embeera:
  2 okulabula → 5 min timeout
  Okulabula 3 → 1 h kick
  4 okulabula → ban (admin akkirizza)
bots.h4_f:
ebika: ebivaamu, emizannyo, amawulire, ebikozesebwa, ai, okuvvuunula
emiwendo: gya bwereere | omulundi gumu (USD omuwendo) | okuwandiika (USD/omwezi)
okusala: 90 % eri omukugu, 10 % eri Vortex
okwekenneenya: manual, ~3 ennaku z'omulimu ekiruubirirwa okukyusa

ops.title: Ebikwekweto by’emirimu
ops.subtitle: Teeka mu nkola, okulondoola, okuddamu.
ops.intro: Buli mulimu ogukola gulina ekigendererwa kya `make` oba ekiragiro CLI. Emiko gya Ops gibeera mu `deploy/`.
ops.h1p1: `docker compose up` ereeta node, omufuzi, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1p2: Volumes: `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/okuteeka`, `/data/logs`. Mount to host okusobola okugumiikiriza.
ops.h1p3: Obutonde: `.env` mu kikolo kya repo. Tokolangako kwewaayo. `.env.example` ye kipande.
ops.h1p4: Caddy auto-leeta Let's Encrypt certs. Let's Encrypt ekkomo ku miwendo likola — kozesa emitendera okugezesa.
ops.h2p1: `kola okuteeka` — okuteeka Python deps + ebikozesebwa dev.
ops.h2p2: `make dev` — uvicorn nga ezzeemu okutikka ku mwalo 9000.
ops.h2p4: `okukola lint` — ruff + mypy. CI azibira ku kulemererwa.
ops.h2p8: `make ci` — ddukanya payipu CI enzijuvu mu kitundu.
ops.h3p1: `Vortex Wizard.app` ye kibinja kya PyInstaller nga kiriko pywebview GUI.
ops.h3p2: Okutambula okusooka: londa erinnya ly’ennyingo → okukola ebisumuluzo by’okufulumya → okutegeka TLS (Let's Encrypt / okuleeta-byo / okweteeka omukono) → londa URL z’okuyingira → sobozesa okubba → ggulawo emikutu gya firewall.
ops.h3p3: Oluvannyuma lw'okuteekawo, omugezi asigala nga admin console: start/stop node, okulaba ebiwandiiko, okukyusa ebisumuluzo, okwongerako federated peers.
ops.h4p1: Buli kufulumizibwa nga kuliko tagged mu git. Tag nayo essiddwaako omukono n'ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya kale tag yennyini ekakasibbwa.
ops.h4p2: Rollback: `git checkout <tag> && kola docker-okuzimba && docker okuyiiya waggulu -d`. Nodes ezidduka zikulukuta ne ziddamu okutandika.
ops.h4p3: DB: Alembic `downgrade <rev>` ewagirwa ku nkyusa emu entono emabega. Okwongera emabega kyetaagisa okuyingira mu nsonga mu ngalo.
ops.h1_a: `docker compose up` ereeta omutambi omujjuvu ogwa Vortex: node, omufuzi, Postgres, Redis, coturn, Caddy.
ops.h1_b: `docker-compose.yml` ku kikolo kya repo. Volumes `/data/vortex.db`, ​​`/data/uploads`, `/data/logs` eziteekeddwa ku host kale data enywerera okubuna okuddamu okutandika. Healthchecks: node bulamu iff `/obulamu/mwetegefu` ezzaayo 200; controller iff `/v1/integrity` ezzaayo ekakasiddwa. Caddy auto-leeta Let's Encrypt certs. `.env` egaba ebyama (never commit). `.env.example` ye kipande.
ops.h1_c: Docker Compose ye nkola ya de-facto ey'empeereza ez'okwekyaza ezirina konteyina eziwera. Umami, Ghost, Plausible, Miniflux bonna bakikozesa. Fayiro ya Vortex eya compose yaddibwamu okuva ku v0.0.2 okudda waggulu; enkula eriwo kati yatebenkedde mu v0.0.5. Enkola endala (k8s, nomad) zirekebwa nga dduyiro eri abaddukanya emirimu eminene.
ops.h2_a: Makefile ye central entrypoint ya buli dev ne ops action. `kola obuyambi` ewandiika ebigendererwa.
ops.h2_b: `kola okuteeka` → `pip okuteeka -r ebyetaago.txt`. `kola dev` → uvicorn nga olina okuddamu okutikka. `kola okugezesa` → pytest + okubikka, ebifulumya `okubikka.xml`. `kola lint` → ruff + mypy. `kola docker-okuzimba` → `docker okuzimba -t vortex:$VERSION`. `kola db-senguka` → `omutwe gw'okulongoosa mu alembic`. `kola db-backup` / `kola db-okuzzaawo FILE=...`. `kola ci` → payipu CI ejjula mu kitundu.
ops.h2_c: A Makefile nga canonical entrypoint nkola ya Unix emaze emyaka mingi, eyettanirwa buli pulojekiti enkulu Python (pytest, django, flask, fastapi). Ebikozesebwa ebirala (Poetry, Hatch, uv) biba bya buwoomi bw’omwaka; Make eboola ate nga ya bonna.
ops.h3_a: Omugezi w'okuteekawo ye PyInstaller bundle (`Vortex Wizard.app`) nga erina pywebview GUI etambuza omukozi omulundi ogusooka okuyita mu kuteeka mu nkola.
ops.h3_b: Okutambula okusooka: londa erinnya lya node → okukola ebisumuluzo ebifulumya (Ed25519 keypair eterekeddwa ku `keys/release.key`) → okutegeka TLS (Let's Encrypt / okuleeta-yo / okweteeka omukono) → londa URL z'okuyingira (vortexx.sol / custom domain / .onion) → sobozesa omutindo gw'okukweka → ggulawo emikutu gya firewall (ebipande ebiyitibwa iptables/ufw/pf). Oluvannyuma lw'okusooka okudduka, wizard asigala nga admin console: start/stop node, okulaba ebiwandiiko, okukyusa ebisumuluzo, okwongerako federated peers.
ops.h3_c: Abagezi b’okuteekawo ye nkola y’ebikozesebwa eby’okwekyaza nga bigenderera abakozesa abatali ba sysadmin: Ghost’s onboarding (2015), Standard Notes’ server setup, Mastodon’s installation questions. PyInstaller etuleka okusindika binary emu enyigirwa emirundi ebiri; pywebview ekola omuko gwa HTML ogw'omu kitundu oguweebwa omuddukanya FastAPI omukuŋŋaanyiziddwa API ku 127.0.0.1 — browser UX awatali buzibu bwa kuzimba GUI enzaaliranwa.
ops.h4_a: Buli kifulumizibwa kiteekebwako akabonero mu git. Rollback ye `git checkout <tag> && kola docker-okuzimba && docker okuwandiika waggulu -d`. Okusenguka kulina emirimu gya `downgrade()`.
ops.h4_b: Tags ziteekebwako omukono n'ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya kale tag yennyini ekakasibwa. Enkola ya rollback: checkout old tag, okuddamu okuzimba ekifaananyi, okuddamu okukola containers — okudduka connections drain ku SIGTERM (default 15 s grace). DB: `alembic downgrade <rev>` ezzaawo okuddamu okumu. Okwewala okufiirwa data: tetusuulangako mpagi mu kufulumya okumu; amatondo gabaawo N+1 oluvannyuma lwa code okulekera awo okugasoma.
ops.h4_c: Enkola y'okusenguka "code-then-code" (expand-migrate-contract) ye mutindo gw'okuteeka mu nkola nga ziro-downtime. Ekitabo kya Stripe ekikwata ku kusenguka (2019) kye kisinga okukinnyonnyola. Vortex yakitwala oluvannyuma lw’ekintu ekyaliwo mu v0.0.3 nga okugwa kw’empagi kwawaliriza eddirisa ly’okuddaabiriza ery’eddakiika 30.
ops.h1_f:
empeereza:
  node: ekifaananyi: vortex:emyalo egisembyeyo: [9000:9000].
  omufuzi: ekifaananyi: vortex-controller emyalo: [8800:8800].
  postgres: ekifaananyi: postgres:16 voliyumu: [./data/pg:/var/lib/postgresql/data].
  redis: ekifaananyi: redis:7
  coturn: ekifaananyi: emyalo gya coturn/coturn: [3478:3478/udp, 49152-65535:49152-65535/udp].
  caddy: ekifaananyi: emyalo gya caddy: [80:80, 443:443].
ops.h2_f:
kola okuteeka pip okuteeka -r ebyetaago.txt
kola dev uvicorn --okuddamu okutikka
kola okugezesa pytest + okubikka
kola lint ruff + mypy
kola docker-okuzimba docker okuzimba -t vortex:$VERSION
kola db-migrate alembic okulongoosa omutwe
kola ci lint + okugezesa + okusenguka okukebera
ops.h3_f:
Vortex Omugezi.app
  → Ekibinja kya PyInstaller
  → atongozza eddirisa lya pywebview (ery'omu kitundu HTML)
  → ayogera ne bundled admin FastAPI ku 127.0.0.1:random-port
  → ekola ebisumuluzo, awandiika .env, addukanya okusenguka okusooka
ops.h4_f:
okutambula kw’okufulumya:
  1. okuteeka mu nkola koodi empya; enkadde n'empya byombi bisoma "v1".
  2. okusenguka: code empya ewandiika "v2"; omukadde akyasoma "v1".
  3. okujjuza emabega "v1" → "v2".
  4. ekiddako okufulumya: suula ekkubo lya koodi enkadde
  5. okusenguka: okusuula ennyiriri "v1".

mobile.title: Bakasitoma b’oku ssimu
mobile.subtitle: iOS ne Android — enzaaliranwa UI, enkola y’emu.
mobile.intro: Bakasitoma bombi ku ssimu ba full peers, so si ba thin web wrappers. Entunula enzaaliranwa, enkola enzaaliranwa, okugatta enzaaliranwa (CallKit, ConnectionService, Lock Screen widgets).
mobile.h1p1: Paka ya Swift mu `ios/Modules/`. 30+ modulo z'ebifaananyi, buli emu SOLID-yawuddwamu `api/` + `impl/` + `ui/`.
mobile.h1p2: Ekigendererwa kya app mu `ios/VortexApp/`. XcodeGen spec ku `ios/project.yml` ezzaawo xcodeproj.
mobile.h1p3: Ekiwandiiko: Ekitabo ekiyitibwa CryptoKit (X25519, Ed25519, AES-GCM, HKDF) + Argon2Swift (Argon2id).
mobile.h1p4: DB: GRDB + FTS5. Enkyukakyuka zonna ziyita mu `db.write`.
mobile.h1p6: Push: APNs nga ziyita mu `UNUserNotificationCenter` + Okugaziya Empeereza y'okumanyisa okusobola okuggya ensirifu.
mobile.h2p1: Pulojekiti ya Gradle mu `android/`. Module 22 ez'ebifaananyi nga zirina Hilt DI, `api / impl / di / ui` y'emu eyawuddwamu.
mobile.h2p6: Push: FCM + Okuggya ensirifu mu FirebaseMessagingService.
mobile.h3p1: Ekibinja kye kimu eky'ebitundu 146 n'amannya enzaaliranwa (`Русский ru`, `Olungereza en`, `中文 zh`, ...).
mobile.h3p2: Katalogu y’emu eya 1500-emoji ng’erina ebika 9 + langi-olususu + MRU + okunoonya.
mobile.h3p4: Ebitabo by’emboozi bye bimu (Byonna / Ebiterekeddwa / ebya bulijjo) nga biriko okuddamu okusengeka okusika n’okusuula.
mobile.h3p5: Olukalala lwe lumu olwa saved-GIFs (tewali Tenor — okukung'aanya okw'obuntu kwokka).
mobile.h3p6: Same scheduled-obubaka UI, contacts screen, omuko gw'embeera ya premium.
mobile.h1_a: iOS client ye Swift Package nga erina modules 30+ ez'ebintu. Enkola y’emu eya HTTPS + WebSocket + WebRTC nga buli kasitoma omulala.
mobile.h1_b: Modules ezitegekeddwa okusinziira ku ngeri: `Bootstrap`, `Auth`, `Chat`, `Files`, `Calls`, `Push`, `Emoji`, `Folders`, `Accounts`, `SavedGifs`, `Contacts`, `Scheduled`, `Premium`, `Ebikolwa`, .... Buli emu yayawulwamu `api/` (protocols), `impl/` (ebibinja ebikakafu), `ui/` (okulaba kwa SwiftUI). Crypto: Ekitabo ky'Ekitabo kya X25519 / Ed25519 / AES-GCM; Argon2Swift ku lwa Argon2id. DB: GRDB ne FTS5. WebRTC: stasel/WebRTC XCFomulimu gw’okukola. Push: APNs ezirina Notification Service Extension okusobola okuggya ensirifu mu kusindika okusibiddwa.
mobile.h1_c: Modular packages ye nkola ya Swift eya bulijjo okuva ku Swift Package Manager 5.0 (2019). Okwawukana kwaffe mu api/impl/ui kiri SOLID-ish: okukyusakyusa okwesigama (modules zisinziira ku api/ yokka), okwawula ebikweraliikiriza, testability (swap impl for tests). Okubala modulo 30+ kwe kulonda okuzimba parallelism — buli modulo ekuŋŋaanya mu kweyawula.
mobile.h2_a: Endabirwamu za kasitoma za Android iOS: Kotlin + Compose + Hilt DI. 22 modulo z'ebifaananyi, y'emu `api / impl / di` okwawulwa.
mobile.h2_b: minSdk 26 (Android 8), ekigendererwaSdk 34 (Android 14). Crypto: Obukuumi bwa AndroidX + Tink ku AES-GCM; argon2-jvm ku lwa Argon2id. DB: Ekisenge nga kiriko ebiziyiza FTS4. WebRTC: Okutambuza WebRTC Android. Push: FCM nga oyita mu FirebaseMessagingService + okuggya ensirifu mu nvulopu essiddwako akabonero. Gradle multi-module, Hilt egatta modulo z’ebifaananyi awatali kwesigama butereevu.
mobile.h2_c: Compose ye Google's declarative UI toolkit, stable okuva mu 2021. Hilt (2020) ye Google-endorsed DI framework waggulu wa Dagger 2. Wamu zikwatagana SwiftUI + property wrappers ku iOS for a near-identical architectural feel. Vortex yakwata Compose/Hilt okuva ku v0.0.4 okudda waggulu; emabegako Android yali yeesigamiziddwa ku View.
mobile.h3_a: Bombi iOS ne Android bagatta JSON y’emu ey’ebitundu 146 n’amannya enzaaliranwa ne katalogu ya emoji 1500 — omukozesa awandiika 🥹 ku iOS 17 akola 🥹 ku Android 9.
mobile.h3_b: `ios/Modules/Sources/I18N/Eby'obugagga/ebifo/*.json` endabirwamu `android/app/src/main/eby'obugagga/ebifo/*.json`. Apps zombi zitikka locale entuufu ku kusooka okutongozebwa (language picker screen) era zinywerera ku kulonda. Katalogu ya emoji ya biti 9 JSON esindikiddwa mu bundles zombi; kiva ku OS-level emoji-set divergence ekivaako `?` glyphs ezitannaba kulaga ku OS enkadde.
mobile.h3_c: Okusindika katalogu yo eya emoji ye pattern Telegram gy’akozesa (Twemoji fork yaabwe) ne WhatsApp gye bakozesa okutuusa mu 2022. The trade-off: ~300 KB extra per app bundle for emoji + ~1.2 MB for locales. Worth it for okukwatagana kwa cross-platform.
mobile.h1_f:
ios/Ebitundu/
  Package.swift
  Ensonda/
    Auth/api/, Okuwandiika/impl/, Okuwandiika/ui/
    Okwogera/api/, Okunyumya/impl/, Okunyumya/ui/
    Amasimu/api/, Amasimu/impl/, Amasimu/ui/
    ... Module 30+
    App/ (ekikolo ky'ebitontome) .
ios/VortexApp/ (ekigendererwa kya app, eyingiza modulo ya App)
mobile.h2_f:
android/
  app/
    okuzimba.gradle.kts
    src / omukulu / java / sol / vortexx / android / .
      okukakasa/api/, okukakasa/impl/, okukakasa/di/, okukakasa/ui/
      okunyumya/...
      okuyita/...
      ... Module 22 ezirimu ebifaananyi
      App.kt (Ekikolo kya Hilt) .
mobile.h3_f:
ebifo: fayiro 146 JSON, buli emu ~8 KB wakati (amannya enzaaliranwa + ennyiriri zonna UI)
emoji: 1 JSON nga erina ebisumuluzo 9 (ebika) × 1500 ebiyingiziddwa
omulonda: tabu empanvu buli mutendera, giridi ya glyphs 8 buli lunyiriri, MRU okunywerera

webclient.title: Web client
webclient.subtitle: PWA, vanilla JS, mode etali ku mukutu, omukozi w'obuweereza.
webclient.intro: Web client ye vanilla-JS PWA. Tewali React, tewali bundler okusukka ESM. ~400 KB gzipped omugatte, nga kuliko 146 locales.
webclient.h1p1: `static/js/main.js` kye kiyingizibwa. Feature modules lazy-load ku kusooka okukozesa.
webclient.h1p2: State: buli kisenge empeta buffers mu IndexedDB, mu-memory decrypted cache. Omukozi w’Empeereza atabaganya okuleeta.
webclient.h1p3: UI: Ebikolwa bya Glass y’amazzi nga biyita mu CSS backdrop-filter. Tewali nkola ya nkola; event delegation + idempotent okuwa abayambi.
webclient.h2p1: Okuwandiika kwonna okukoleddwa nga toli ku mutimbagano ku nnyiriri ku IndexedDB. SW efuumuuka nga okuyungibwa kukomyewo.
webclient.h2p2: Ekisumuluzo kya Idempotency ku buli POST kireka okuddamu okugezaako okuddiŋŋana okutuuka ku buwanguzi mu ngeri ey'obukuumi.
webclient.h2p3: Okusoma kukola mu bujjuvu okuva ku mutimbagano — ebiwandiiko byonna ebikusike ebikwatagana bibeera mu IndexedDB.
webclient.h3p1: 146 ebifo mu `static/locales/*.json`. Olubalaza lw'okwaniriza (`lang-picker.js`) luyita mu kubuulirira kw'erinnya enzaaliranwa.
webclient.h3p2: Okukyusa ekifo ky'ekiseera ky'okudduka: `document.documentElement.lang = code` + okuddamu okulaga labels nga oyita mu `data-i18n` attributes.
webclient.h1_a: Web client ye vanilla-JS PWA. Nedda React, tewali ddaala lya kuzimba okusukka ESM bundling. Omugatte gwa JS ogwasindikiddwa: ~400 KB gzipped.
webclient.h1_b: `templates/base.html` ye kisusunku ekikoleddwa Jinja2. `static/js/main.js` ye ES-module okuyingira. Feature modules mu `static/js/<feature>/` lazy-load ku kukozesa okusooka. CSS mu `static/css/` n'enkola ya fayiro 1 buli kitundu. Omukozi w'Empeereza akwata cache; omugugu ogusooka guva ku mutimbagano, oluvannyuma okuva mu cache; update checks ku navigation.
webclient.h1_c: Okusigala nga tolina nkola zaali kusalawo kwa v0.0.1 mu bugenderevu oluvannyuma lw’okugeraageranya React ne Vue PWAs ku ~1.5 MB gzipped n’ebintu ebifaanagana. Module za vanilla JS + ES zituwa ~400 KB. Okusuubulagana kusinga DOM-manipulation boilerplate, gye tukendeeza n'abayambi abatono mu `static/js/lib/dom.js`.
webclient.h2_a: Offline mode: outgoing ewandiika ennyiriri ku IndexedDB; Service Worker afuuwa nga connection ekomyewo.
webclient.h2_b: POST / PATCH yonna omukozesa gy'akola offline efuna ekisumuluzo kya idempotency era n'egwa mu `outbox` (IndexedDB). Service Worker awuliriza `online` event era addamu okuteeka n'ekisumuluzo kya idempotency nga omutwe. Server etegeera ebikoppi okuyita mu kisumuluzo kya idempotency era n'ezzaayo eky'okuddamu ekyasooka. Okusoma kukola mu bujjuvu nga tolina mutimbagano — ebiwandiiko byonna ebikusike ebikwatagana bibeera mu IndexedDB era biggyamu ensirifu mu kitundu n’ebisumuluzo ebiri mu jjukira.
webclient.h2_c: Ebisumuluzo bya Idempotency ku POST eziddamu okugezesebwa ye nkola ya Stripe eya 2017, eyatwalibwa API ezisinga ez'omulembe. IndexedDB nga outbox ye pattern Google Drive web gy'ekozesa okulongoosa okutali ku mutimbagano. Vortex okussa mu nkola kwa layini ~200 mu `static/js/lib/outbox.js`.
webclient.h3_a: 146-olulimi ekibinja ku `static/locales/*.json`. Enzirukanya y'olutimbe lw'okwaniriza okuyita mu kubuulirira kw'erinnya enzaaliranwa (`Выберите язык` / `Londa olulimi lwo` / `选择语言` / ...).
webclient.h3_b: Okutongoza okusooka: `lang-picker.js` kulaga akabonero akalaga obulamu bw'ekyuma ekiwandiika akakyukakyuka okuyita mu bitundu 97 ku 45 ms/char, okuyimirira s 1.8, okusazaamu ku 30 ms/char, okugenda mu maaso. Omukozesa alondawo olulimi; yasigala mu `localStorage.vortex_lang`. Buli kudduka okuddirira kusoma okulonda okutereddwa. Okukyusa obudde bw'okudduka: `setLang (code)` etikka JSON, eddamu okulaga ebintu bya `data-i18n`.
webclient.h3_c: Enkola ya typewriter-hint ye kitiibwa eri terminal splash screens enkadde era yatwalibwa olw’ebbugumu lya UX oluvannyuma lwa v0.0.6 beta okulaga abakozesa okusimbira ekkuuli static dropdown. Ebigambo ebikwata ku kuvuga obugaali biwa eddirisa lya sikonda emu buli mukozesa okulaba erinnya ly’olulimi lwe n’okulitegeera amangu ddala.
webclient.h1_f:
ekisusunku: templates/base.html (ekoleddwa mu seva Jinja2)
okuyingira: static / js / main.js (ES modulo) .
ebikozesebwa: static/js/{chat,ebisenge,auth,okuyita,fayiro,bots}/...
SW: static/omukozi-omuweereza.js
sayizi: ~400 KB gzipped omugatte
webclient.h2_f:
okutambula kw'okuwandiika okutali ku mutimbagano:
  1. okubala idempotency_ekisumuluzo = rand (16).hex
  2. db.outbox.put ({url, enkola, omubiri, idempotency_ekisumuluzo, ts})
  3. ku 'ku mutimbagano': flush outbox
     ku buli lunyiriri: fetch (url, {enkola, omubiri, emitwe: {"Idempotency-Key": ikey}})
       → 2xx: ggyawo olunyiriri
       → 4xx: olunyiriri lw’okusuula (okulemererwa okw’olubeerera) .
       → 5xx/offline: ddamu gezaako oluvannyuma
webclient.h3_f:
lang-omulonda.js:
  hints = ["Выберите язык", "Londa olulimi lwo", "Elige tu idioma", ...]
  wandiika hint ku 45 ms/char → pause 1.8 s → okusazaamu ku 30 ms/char → pause 0.2 s → ekiddako

okukyusa obudde bw'okudduka:
  localStorage.vortex_lang = koodi
  fetch ('ebifo/' + koodi + '.json') → kola ku bintu bya data-i18n

security.title: Enyimirira y’obukuumi
security.subtitle: Omuze gw’okutiisatiisa, okwekuuma-mu buziba, WAF, omutendera gw’okubala ebitabo, canary.
security.intro: Vortex ekozesa defence-in-depth: okumenya layer emu tekimala, omulumbaganyi omutuufu yeetaaga obuwanguzi obw’enjawulo obw’enjawulo.
security.h1p1: **Omutunuulizi w'omukutu ataliiko kye yeekolera**: alaba TLS packets; akola okwekenneenya obunene/obudde. Yawanguddwa mu bubbi bwa Level 1.
security.h1p2: **Active network attacker**: asobola okusuula/okulwawo/okukuba empiso. Yawanguddwa ku Level 2-4 okubba.
security.h1p3: **Omukozi wa node akoseddwa**: alaba ciphertext + metadata. Ebirimu mu bubaka bisigala nga bya kyama.
security.h1p4: **Ekyuma kya kasitoma ekibbiddwa**: ebiwandiiko ebya bulijjo eby'obubaka obwayita obubikkuddwa. Double Ratchet ekoma ku session eriwo kati; wipe-on-next-okusumulula eriwo.
security.h1p5: **Omulabe wa quantum nga alina traffic emabega eterekeddwa**: yawanguddwa ebisumuluzo bya hybrid Kyber-768 session nga banne bombi balanga PQ.
security.h2p1: Okusaba omukebera: Enkola za SQLi, okuyita mu kkubo, okukuba empiso ya template, LFI, NoSQLi. Etonnya nga app code tennabaawo.
security.h2p2: Ekkomo ku miwendo: ensi yonna 1000 req/s soft cap nga eriko okubutuka; buli kkubo (okuyingira 10/eddakiika, okwewandiisa 5/eddakiika); buli-mukozesa 100 req/s oluvannyuma lw'okukakasa.
security.h2p3: Okuziyiza ettaka kw'okwesalirawo nga oyita mu `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN`.
security.h3p1: Ebintu ebikwatagana n'ebyokwerinda (ekikolwa kya admin, okukyusa federo, okulongoosa okufulumya, okusiimuula panic) hash-chained okuyita mu `app/security/canary.py`.
security.h3p2: Okumenya enjegere ⇒ okukyusakyusa kuzuuliddwa. Okulabula omuliro.
security.h3p3: `/api/admin/audit` eraga ekiwandiiko (admin auth yokka). Okugattako kwokka.
security.h4p1: Fayiro ya Canary essiddwaako omukono buli lunaku n'ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya. Obutabeerawo ⇒ okukkaanya kuteeberezebwa.
security.h4p2: Okusazaamu mu bwangu: admin aweereza `{type:"n", event:"compromise", ...}` eri buli WebSocket. Bakasitoma basiimuula ebisumuluzo ebiterekeddwa.
security.h4p3: Okukyusakyusa: ekisumuluzo ekipya eky’okufulumya, okuddamu okussa omukono ku manifest, okuddamu okufulumya. Bakasitoma baddamu okukola bootstrap.
security.h1_a: Ebika bina eby’omulabe bivuga dizayini: omutunuulizi atakola, omulumbaganyi akola, omukozi alina obuzibu, ekyuma ekikoseddwa. Buli omu yawanguddwa layeri ey’enjawulo.
security.h1_b: Passive observer: alaba TLS-encrypted packets, akola okwekenneenya entambula. Yawanguddwa ku Level 1-2 okubba. Active attacker: asobola okusuula/okulwawo/okufuyira packets. Yawanguddwa ku Level 3-4 okubba. Omukozi alina obuzibu: alaba ciphertext + metadata. Ewanguddwa E2E okukendeeza ku crypto + metadata. Ekyuma ekikoseddwa: kilaba plaintext y'obubaka obwayita. Okwonooneka okukoma ku kyama mu maaso (Double Ratchet) n’okusiimuula okutya.
security.h1_c: Omuze guno ogw'ebika bina guva mu nsengeka ya Schneier eya 1999 "Applied Cryptography" threat model taxonomy, eyagaziyizibwa n'okwetegereza oluvannyuma lwa Snowden ku batunuulizi ab'omutendera gw'amasaza. Buli dizayini ey’omulembe eya secure-messenger ejuliza ekintu ekifaananako bwe kityo. Vortex's twist kwe kwongerako kiraasi ey'okutaano ku v0.4 roadmap: quantum-enabled adversary with stored past traffic, Kyber ky'ekwata.
security.h2_a: WAF yeetegereza buli kusaba nga tekunnatuuka ku koodi ya app, okugaana SQL-i, okuyita mu kkubo, okukuba template, NoSQLi.
security.h2_b: `app/security/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware` ekola ~50 regex okukebera ku URL, okubuuza, n'omubiri. Enkola ezimanyiddwa-ez’obulabe (`UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$where`) → 403. Ekkomo ku muwendo: ensi yonna 1000 req/s soft cap n’okugumiikiriza okubutuka; buli-kkubo `/okuyingira` 10/eddakiika, `/okwewandiisa` 5/eddakiika; buli-mukozesa 100 req/s oluvannyuma lw'okukakasa. Geo-blocking optional nga oyita mu `GEO_BLOCK=RU,CN,IR` okumatiza ebisaanyizo by'envumbo eri abaddukanya emirimu abagoberera amateeka.
security.h2_c: WAFs nga middleware nkola etandikiddwawo — mod_security (2002), Cloudflare's WAF, AWS WAF. Vortex's mu bugenderevu ntono kubanga WAF enzito etondawo ebirungi eby'obulimba ebibbira okutiisatiisa okwa nnamaddala. Olukalala lwa regex lwakunganyizibwa okuva mu mikono gya OWASP Top 10 era ne lulongoosebwa mu v0.0.5 oluvannyuma lw'etteeka lya beta WAF okuziyiza olunyiriri olutuufu "DROP TABLE" munda mu bubaka bw'okukubaganya ebirowoozo ku SQL.
security.h3_a: Ebintu ebikwatagana n’ebyokwerinda bituuka mu kiwandiiko ky’okubala ebitabo ekirimu enjegere za hash. Okumenya mu lujegere kiraga nti waliwo okukyusakyusa.
security.h3_b: Buli kikolwa kya admin, enkyukakyuka mu federo, okulongoosa okufulumya, oba okusiimuula okutya kiyingizibwa mu `audit_log (ts, event, actor_id, target_id, detail_cbor)`. Buli lunyiriri lutambuza `prev_hash = hash (olunyiriri_olusooka)`. Hash y'olunyiriri oluliwo kati ebalibwa ku `ts ∥ event ∥ prev_hash`. Singa olunyiriri lwonna lusazibwamu oba lukyusibwa, ennyiriri eziddako' `prev_hash` olujegere lukutuka — luzuulibwa okuddamu okuzannya olujegere.
security.h3_c: Ebiwandiiko by’okubala ebitabo ebiriko enjegere za hash biba bya kikadde (hash-linked timestamping, 1991). Linux auditd ezikozesa. Git's commit DAG mu bukulu nsengeka y'emu. Vortex yazigattako mu v0.0.6 oluvannyuma lw’omuwi w’amagezi okulaga nti node eriko obuzibu esobola okusangula ennyiriri z’ebiwandiiko mu kasirise.
security.h4_a: Okuddamu ku bibaddewo kutegekeddwa nga tekunnabaawo: canary akakasa nti ekisumuluzo ky’okufulumya tekirina kukwatibwako; okusazaamu mu bwangu kusiimuula ebisumuluzo ebiterekeddwa mu bakasitoma bonna.
security.h4_b: Buli lunaku `canary.txt` essiddwako omukono n'ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya, efulumizibwa ku mabbali g'omufuzi. Bakasitoma bakakasa ku kutandika — obutabaawo ⇒ okukkaanya kuteeberezebwa. Singa okukkaanya kukakasibwa: admin aweereza `{type:"n", event:"compromise", ensonga}` ku buli WebSocket. Bakasitoma basiimuula ebisumuluzo ebiterekeddwa, bakaka okuddamu okuyingira. Ekisumuluzo ekipya eky'okufulumya minted, manifest re-signed, bakasitoma baddamu bootstrap okuva ku endpoint y'obutuukirivu endabirwamu. Ebiwandiiko ebikadde ebikusike bifuuliddwa nga tebisoma olw’engeri gye byakolebwamu.
security.h4_c: Fayiro za Canary zigoberera okutuuka ku Apple eya 2013 warrant canary ne pulojekiti ya `canarywatch.org`. Signal ezikozesa. Vortex's is automated: a cron essa omukono ku `canary.txt` n'ekisumuluzo ekifulumya buli 24 h. Okuweereza ku mpewo okw’okusazaamu okw’amangu y’engeri y’emu Let's Encrypt gy’akozesa okusazaamu satifikeeti mu bungi.
security.h1_f:
kiraasi | okwekuuma
----------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
omutunuulizi w'omukutu ogutaliiko kye gukola | L1+L2 okubba (engalo+enkula) .
omulumbaganyi w'omukutu akola | L3+L4 okubba (ECH, okusibirwa)
omukozi atabuse | E2E crypto + omuweereza obulimba
ekyuma ekikoseddwa | okwekuuma mu maaso + okusiimuula okutya
quantum (ebiseera eby’omu maaso) | Olutuula lwa Kyber-768 olw’omugatte
security.h2_f:
akebera ku buli kusaba:
  SQL empiso : okuzuula UNION SELECT, DROP TABLE, ; -- n'ebirala.
  okuyita mu kkubo : okuzuula ../, ..%2f, URL-encoded enjawulo
  template empiso : okuzuula {{, {% .
  XSS : okuzuula <ekiwandiiko, javascript:
  NoSQLi : okuzuula $ ne, $wa, $ regex
ekkomo ku miwendo: 1000/s mu nsi yonna, 10/min okuyingira, 5/min register
security.h3_f:
olunyiriri: {ts, ekintu ekibaddewo, omuzannyi_id, target_id, detail_cbor, prev_hash, olunyiriri_hash}
row_hash = SHA-256 (ts ∥ ekintu ∥ omuzannyi_id ∥ ... ∥ prev_hash)
kakasa: tambula log, ddamu okubala buli row_hash, geraageranya ku muwendo oguterekeddwa
break ⇒ okukyusakyusa okuzuuliddwa ku lunyiriri olwo

privacy.title: Eby’ekyama n’okugoberera amateeka
privacy.subtitle: GDPR, eddembe ly’okusangula, okukendeeza ku metadata, okutambuza data.
privacy.intro: Vortex emmeeri GDPR ne CCPA tooling okuva mu bbokisi. Abaddukanya emirimu mu bitundu ebifugibwa balina enkomerero emu eya admin ku buli kusaba okuli mu mateeka.
privacy.h1p1: Tewali IP logs nga bwekiba. Reverse proxy strips `X-Real-IP` okuggyako nga omukozi alonze mu.
privacy.h1p2: `sender_pseudo` mu nnyiriri z'obubaka hashes ID z'omuweereza entuufu — DB dump eraga amannya ag'obulimba gokka aga buli kisenge.
privacy.h1p3: Okunoonya kukozesa encrypted-tokens. Kasitoma asiba ebigambo ebikulu n’ekisumuluzo ky’ekisenge; node etereka obubonero obutatangaavu; lookup is exact-match ku bubonero bwa ciphertext.
privacy.h1p4: Last-seen truncated ku granularity omukozesa gy'alonze.
privacy.h2p1: `POST /api/privacy/erase` efuula olunyiriri lw'omukozesa obutamanya mannya, esangula obubaka bwabwe obuweerezeddwa (metadata ekuumibwa ku quorum), esazaamu fayiro okuva ku disiki.
privacy.h2p2: Federo: olugambo oluteekeddwako emikono lutegeeza bannaabwe; zisangula ku ludda lwazo mu 72 h.
privacy.h2p3: Audit: erasure ewandiikibwa ne timestamp ne (hashed) user id kale omukozi asobole okukakasa okugoberera.
privacy.h3p1: `GET /api/privacy/export` ekulukuta zipu: profile JSON, ciphertext eyasindikiddwa/efunibwa, ebijuliziddwa ku fayiro n'ebisumuluzo by'ekikolo kya buli fayiro, olukalala lw'abakwatagana.
privacy.h3p2: Obudde bw’okutondeka: ~5 min ku bubaka 10 k, nga bukoma ku IO.
privacy.h3p3: Omuweereza alina okuggya ensirifu mu ciphertext mu kitundu; export tooling esindikibwa ku mabbali.
privacy.h4p1: Long-press logo 5 s → immediate local wipe: ebisumuluzo, obubaka obuterekeddwa, ebigattibwako.
privacy.h4p2: Coupled wipe: `/api/privacy/panic` era amayinja ag'entaana akawunti ku ludda lwa seva.
privacy.h1_a: Tewali IP logs nga bwekiba. Tewali metadata ezuula omukozesa ku layini z'obubaka. Okunoonya ebiwandiiko ebijjuvu ku bubonero obusibiddwa.
privacy.h1_b: Reverse proxy strips `X-Real-IP` nga node tennagiraba okuggyako nga omukozi alonze mu rate-limiting. Ennyiriri z'obubaka zitereka `sender_id` (ku ACL) ne `sender_pseudo` (ku fan-out); sender_pseudo ye HMAC(room_salt, sender_id) kale DB dump teraga ani yayogera ki across rooms. Noonya: kasitoma asiba ebigambo ebikulu n’ekisumuluzo ky’ekisenge; node etereka obubonero obutatangaavu; lookup is exact-match ku bubonero bwa ciphertext, tewali index ya biwandiiko bya bulijjo.
privacy.h1_c: Okukendeeza ku metadata kwe kukkiriziganya oluvannyuma lwa Snowden — Signal yakimanyisa mu 2014, WhatsApp n’egoberera ne sender-pseudo mu 2019. Okunoonya okusibiddwa ku bubonero bwa ciphertext ye nkola ya CryptDB (2011) ne ShadowCrypt (2014). Vortex okussa mu nkola nkyusa ya stripped-down esuubula okukyusakyusa okumu okw'okubuuza olw'obwangu.
privacy.h2_a: `POST /api/privacy/erase` etamanyisa lunyiriri lw'omukozesa, esangula ebiwandiiko byabwe ebikusike, esazaamu fayiro, era etegeeza bannaabwe abagatta.
privacy.h2_b: Server-side: `abakozesa` ennimiro enzibu ez'olunyiriri zeroed (`erinnya ly'omukozesa = "saziddwamu-<id>"`, `essimu = null`, `email = null`, `display_name = "[saziddwamu]"`); `messages.ciphertext` teeka NULL ku layini zonna nga `sender_id = u.id`; fayiro eziyungiddwa okuva mu bubaka obwo obusaziddwamu okuva ku disiki. Banne abagatta bafuna olugambo olussiddwako omukono `{event: "erasure", user_id, signed_by}`; zidduka purge y’emu ku ludda lwazo mu ssaawa 72 (SLA).
privacy.h2_c: Eddembe ly’okusangula kyetaagisa GDPR Ennyingo 17 okuva mu 2018. CCPA yagobererwa mu 2020; LGPD (Brazil) mu 2021. Vortex esindika primitive out-of-the-box kale abaddukanya mu bitundu ebifugibwa tebalina kugizimba. Federo ya 72 h SLA ekwatagana n’eddirisa lya GDPR ery’okuddamu ery’ennaku 30 n’ekifo ky’omutwe okusaasaanya.
privacy.h3_a: `GET /api/privacy/export` ekulukuta zipu: profile JSON, ciphertext eyasindikiddwa/efunibwa, ebijuliziddwa ku fayiro n'ebisumuluzo by'ekikolo kya buli fayiro, olukalala lw'abakwatagana.
privacy.h3_b: Generation is async kubanga account ennene zitwala eddakiika. Client POSTs okusaba → node enqueues omulimu → omulimu gutambula mu mugongo → client polls `/api/privacy/export/{job_id}` → 200 nga ziteekeddwako omukono URL nga mwetegefu. Ebirimu mu zipu: `profile.json`, `rooms.jsonl` (ekimu buli kisenge), `messages.jsonl.enc` (ciphertext + buli-fayiro ebisumuluzo by'ekikolo), `fayiro/` (downloaded-as-is blobs).
privacy.h3_c: Okutambuza data kye kyetaagisa eky’amawanga abiri nga okusangulwa mu GDPR. Apple, Google, Telegram, Signal byonna birina ebikozesebwa okutwala. Vortex's eyongerako ekintu ekikulu (file_root buli fayiro) abakozesa basobole okuggya ensirifu okufulumya mu kitundu — bwe kitaba ekyo okufulumya tekulina mugaso. Awatali detail eno Apple / Google takeouts effectively plaintext-only kubanga za decrypted dda.
privacy.h4_a: Panic wipe: long-press the Vortex logo for 5 seconds okusaanyaawo amangu ebisumuluzo byonna ne data eziterekeddwa ku kyuma. Tekikyuka.
privacy.h4_b: Client-side: ku 5-second long-press, laga okukakasa; ku kukakasa, yita `wipeKeychainItems ()` / `clearKeystore ()` / `okutereka okw'omu kitundu.okulongoosa () + indexedDB.databases ().forEach (okusazaamuDatabase)`. Cached ciphertext eweddewo, ebisumuluzo biweddewo, JWTs ziweddewo. Optional coupled wipe: `POST /api/privacy/panic` nayo ekuba amayinja g'entaana ku ludda lwa seva ya akawunti era n'egatta olugambo lw'okusangula.
privacy.h4_c: Panic buttons / dead-man switches zirina ebyafaayo bingi mu bubaka obukuumibwa: Wickr's 2014 "Shred", Cryptocat's 2013 "Forget", Signal's 2013 "Secure Deletion" proposal (2016, never shipped). Vortex's 5-second long-press is deliberately hard to trigger accidentally — twasoma haptic feedback ku iPhone 15 ne Pixel 8 ne tulonda s 5 nga ekifo ekiwooma wakati wa "fast enough in an emergency" ne "can't fire by pocket-button".
privacy.h1_f:
sender_pseudo = HMAC-SHA256 (omunnyo_ogw'ekisenge, id_omuweereza)[:16]
  ⇒ DB dump: {ekisenge, omusindika_obulimba, ekiwandiiko ekikusike}
  ⇒ omulumbaganyi tasobola kuyunga sender_pseudo okuyita mu bisenge (eminnyo egy'enjawulo)

akabonero k'okunoonya = HMAC-SHA256(ekisumuluzo_ky'ekisenge, ekigambo ekikulu)
  ⇒ okubuuza "hello" ⇒ okubala akabonero ⇒ okunoonya omuwendo ogukwatagana obulungi
  ⇒ node telabako kigambo kikulu kya plaintext
privacy.h2_f:
POST /api/ekyama/okusangula (okwekolera) .
  UPDATE abakozesa SET erinnya ly'omukozesa='saziddwamu-'||id, essimu=NULL, email=NULL, ... WHERE id=$u
  UPDATE obubaka SET ekiwandiiko ekikusike=NULL WHERE sender_id=$u
  DELETE FROM fayiro WHERE ziteekeddwa_by=$u
  olugambo {ekintu:"okusangula", user_id, sig:Ed25519 (okufulumya_priv, ekintu)}
privacy.h3_f:
ebweru w’eggwanga.zip
├── profile.json (ennimiro z'abakozesa)
├── ebisenge.jsonl (ekisenge kimu buli layini)
├── messages.jsonl.enc (ekiwandiiko ekikusike + buli-obubaka file_root)
├── decrypt.py (ekiwandiiko ky'omuyambi)
└── fayiro/
    ├── <file_id>.bin (blob ensirifu, ekisumuluzo ky'ekikolo mu messages.jsonl)
    └── ...
privacy.h4_f:
okunyiga okumala ≥ s 5 ku kabonero ka VORTEX:
  okukakasa emboozi
  ku kukakasa:
    Keychain.deleteAll (entandikwa = "ekiwujjo.")
    UserDefaults.removeObject (ku Kisumuluzo: "vortex. *")
    SQLite vortex.db DROP emmeeza zonna
    okugatta: POST /api/eby'ekyama/okutya (oludda lwa seva y'amayinja g'entaana)

debugging.title: Okulongoosa obuzibu n’okuzuula obulwadde
debugging.subtitle: Ebikozesebwa mu kulondoola ensonga mu dev, staging, ne prod.
debugging.intro: Buli nkola entono erina ensengeka y’okutema emiti n’okungulu kwa /metrics. Laba wano ekitabo ky'okuzannya eky'okuzuula obulwadde ekya bulijjo.
debugging.h1p2: Zingulula ku 100 MB; kuuma gens 14 nga zikutte.
debugging.h1p3: Omutendera buli modulo nga guyita mu `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG` (e.g. `LOG_LEVEL_TRANSPORT=DEBUG`).
debugging.h1p4: Correlation id: buli kusaba kufuna `X-Request-Id`; RPC eziri wansi w’omugga ziddamu okugikozesa.
debugging.h2p1: Enkola ya Prometheus ku `/metrics` (ekakasibwa admin mu prod).
debugging.h2p2: RED: omuwendo / ensobi / ebbanga buli kkubo.
debugging.h2p3: USE: okukozesa / okujjula / ensobi buli DB pool, WebSocket fan-out, TURN relay.
debugging.h2p4: Custom: ebisenge ebikola, obubaka/obubaka, histogram ey’omutendera gw’okukweka.
debugging.h3p1: `py-spy` olw'okutwala sampuli mu kiseera ky'okudduka. Teeka ku node edduka PID.
debugging.h3p2: `memray` olw'okulaga entuumu. Ekifaananyi eky’eddakiika 1 kiraga nti ebikulukuta mangu.
debugging.h3p3: Rust ekyongereza `vortex_chat` kifulumya bendera ya `--profile` ewandiika okulondoola okukwatagana ne flamegraph.
debugging.h4p1: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` ekola register/login/send/receive/logout ku node ey'omu kitundu. Efuluma nga si zero ku kulemererwa kwonna.
debugging.h4p2: CI edduka omukka ku buli PR nga kwotadde ne ku merges to main.
debugging.h4p3: Omukka gw’okufulumya: probe ey’ebweru ekuba akawunti ya canary omulundi gumu buli ddakiika.
debugging.h1_a: Ebiwandiiko bitegekeddwa JSON nga bwe biba. Buli layini ya log erimu ts, level, module, message, ne correlation id.
debugging.h1_b: `logger.info ("omukozesa_yatondebwa", extra={"omukozesa_id": u.id})` efulumya `{"ts":"2026-04-21T10:23:14.127Z", "lvl":"INFO", "mod":"auth", "obubaka":"omukozesa_yatondebwa", "omukozesa_id": 42, "req_id": "..."}`. Correlation id eva ku mutwe gwa `X-Request-Id`; buli wansi RPC addamu okugikozesa. Okuzimbulukuka ku 100 MB; kuuma emirembe 14 nga gifuuse gzipped. Omutendera buli-module nga oyita mu `LOG_LEVEL_<MODULE>=DEBUG`.
debugging.h1_c: Structured JSON logging ye consensus eriwo kati — eyatwalibwa Stripe, Datadog, buli mutunzi wa observability ow’omulembe. ID z’enkolagana zilondoola okutuuka ku X-Request-Id (RFC 4557) era ne zifuuka canonical mu microservices nga ziyita mu Jaeger / Zipkin (2015). Vortex ekozesa id ennyangu ey’okukwatagana esaasaanyizibwa ku mutwe okusinga okulondoola okusaasaanyizibwa kubanga ebikozesebwa mu kulondoola okusaasaanyizibwa kwongera ku buzibu bwe tutakyetaaga.
debugging.h2_a: Prometheus metrics ku `/metrics` (okukakasibwa admin mu kukola). Dashboards za Grafana zisindikibwa mu `deploy/grafana/`.
debugging.h2_b: RED metrics per-route: omuwendo gw'okusaba, omuwendo gw'ensobi, histogram y'obudde. USE ebipimo buli ky’obugagga: DB okukozesa pool, WebSocket okujjula okuva mu ffaani, TURN bandwidth ya relay. Custom: ebisenge ebikola, obubaka buli sikonda, stealth-level histogram. Admin dashboard ku `/admin/metrics` eraga ebipande eby'okungulu; Prometheus nga asikambula ebyafaayo ebijjuvu.
debugging.h2_c: RED (omuwendo / ensobi / ebbanga) ye nfupi ya Weaveworks eya 2016. USE (okukozesa / okujjula / ensobi) ye nkola ya Brendan Gregg eya 2013. Wamu zikwata ku bubonero obw’omutendera gw’obuweereza n’ogw’ebikozesebwa. Prometheus + Grafana ye nkola ya open-source okuva mu 2016.
debugging.h3_a: `py-spy` olw'okutwala sampuli mu kiseera ky'okudduka; `memray` ku bifaananyi eby'entuumu; `vortex_chat` Rust okugaziya kulina `--profile` ku bilondoola bya flamegraph.
debugging.h3_b: `py-spy record -o profile.svg --pid <node>` okumala s 60 efulumya ekifaananyi ky'ennimi z'omuliro SVG ekiraga emigogo Python egyokya. `memray run -o mem.bin <cmd>` erondoola engabanya; `memray ekifaananyi ky'ennimi z'omuliro mem.bin` kiraga. Rust okugaziya kufulumya ebweru profiles ez'omunda nga Chrome-tracing JSON nga eyitibwa ne `--profile`. Gatta ekimu ku bino n'okugezesa-omugugu okudduka okuyita mu `scripts/smoke/all.sh` okufuna ebifaananyi ebikwatagana.
debugging.h3_c: py-spy (2018) ye statistical profiler etali ya kuyingirira eyegattira ku nkola ya Python edduka awatali nkyukakyuka za koodi — Go ya Python profilers. memray (Bloomberg, 2022) ye Python heap profiler esinga obulungi leero. Rust’s own profiling ecosystem ekuze naye nga tekwatagana nnyo; extension yaffe efulumya Chrome-tracing specifically kubanga buli browser erina viewer ezimbiddwamu.
debugging.h4_a: `scripts/smoke/all.sh` exercises okuwandiisa/okuyingira/okusindika/okufuna/okufuluma ku node ey'omu kitundu. CI agiddusa ku buli PR.
debugging.h4_b: Omukka gudduka mu ~5 seconds. Akola akawunti bbiri empya, aggulawo DM, aweereza obubaka, akakasa okutuusa, afulumyayo zombi. Efuluma nga si zero ku kulemererwa kwonna. CI akiyita oluvannyuma lw'okuzimba. Prod-smoke canary eyawukana eddukira buli ddakiika okuva ku probe ey’ebweru okusinziira ku akawunti y’okugezesa eyetongodde ku node y’okufulumya.
debugging.h4_c: Okugezesa omukka lugero lwa kkolero lya Toyota (emyaka gya 1950) — dduka okukebera okw’amangu okukakasa nti enkola eno temenyeddwa bulungi. Mu pulogulaamu za kompyuta zaafuuka za mutindo oluvannyuma lw'ekitabo kya Michael Feathers ekya "Working Effectively with Legacy Code" (2004). Vortex's smoke script eri ~200 layini za bash + curl.

testing.title: Enkola y’okugezesa
testing.subtitle: 29 k layini z’okugezesebwa okubuna Python, Swift, Kotlin, JS.
testing.intro: Buli layeri erina test suite yaayo. CI byonna abidduka mu ddakiika ezitakka wansi wa 10.
testing.h1p1: `pytest app/tests` ekwata ku routers, obukuumi, entambula, bots.
testing.h1p2: Okugezesebwa okwesigamiziddwa ku by’obugagga by’endowooza ku crypto: `assert decrypt (encrypt (m, k), k) == m` ku 1000 random m.
testing.h1p3: AFL-style fuzz ku WAF: obukadde n'obukadde bw'ebiyingizibwa ebitali bikoleddwa — akakasa tewali 5xx leaks.
testing.h2p1: `okugezesebwa okw'amangu` mu `ios/Modules/` kuddukanya ebigezo bya yuniti ku RFC 7748 / 8032 / 5869 / 8446 vekita z'okugezesa.
testing.h2p2: XCUI ebigezo bivuga okulaba kwa SwiftUI mu simulator etaliiko mutwe; snapshot-okugeraageranya.
testing.h3p1: `./gradlew test` ekola ebigezo bya JVM byokka (ebyangu).
testing.h3p2: `./gradlew connectedCheck` ekola ebigezo ebikozesebwa ku emulator ekola.
testing.h4p1: Omuwandiisi w’emizannyo avuga kasitoma w’omukutu, Chrome etaliiko mutwe + Firefox etaliiko mutwe. Okuyita kukolebwa ne `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream`.
testing.h4p2: Embeera: wandiika akawunti bbiri → DM → sindika fayiro → okusazaamu → kakasa okukwatagana → okuggwa.
testing.h1_a: Python ebigezo bikozesa pytest + okubikka. Buli router, buli security primitive, buli transport module erina ebigezo. ~80 % okubikka.
testing.h1_b: `pytest app/tests` eddukanya suite enzijuvu mu ddakiika ezitasukka 2 ku core emu. Okugezesebwa okwesigamiziddwa ku by’obugagga by’endowooza ku crypto primitives: `assert decrypt(encrypt(m, k), k) == m` ku bubaka 1000 obutali bumu. AFL-style fuzz tests ku WAF: obukadde n’obukadde bw’ebiyingizibwa ebitali bikoleddwa bikakasiddwa okuvaamu okuddamu kwa 4xx (si 5xx). `pytest --cov=app` okusobola okubikka.
testing.h1_c: pytest (Holger Krekel, 2009) ye muddusi w’okugezesa mu butuufu Python. Hypothesis (2015) for property-based testing ported ekirowoozo kya QuickCheck okuva mu Haskell. AFL (Michał Zalewski, 2013) ku fuzz ye fuzzer elungamizibwa okubikka mu mateeka. Vortex's stack ya bulijjo; akawoowo kokka kwe kwagala kwaffe okwa pytest parametrisation okusinga test-class inheritance.
testing.h2_a: Ebigezo bya Swift mu `ios/Modules/` bikwata ku crypto primitives ku RFC test vectors nga kwogasse n'okugezesebwa kwa SwiftUI snapshot.
testing.h2_b: `swift test` okuva mu `ios/Modules/` ekola ebigezo bya yuniti mu s wansi wa 1. RFC 7748 (X25519) ebiwujjo. RFC 8032 (Ed25519) ensengekera z’ebirungo. RFC 5869 (HKDF) ebiwujjo. RFC 8446 (TLS 1.3) emipiira. SwiftUI preview snapshots okugeraageranya okuyita mu image diff okusinziira ku git-tracked baseline; regression ku pixel yonna eremererwa okuzimba.
testing.h2_c: Okugezesa crypto ku vectors entongole ez’okugezesa y’enkola esinga obutaziyiza masasi — singa code yo ekwatagana ne vectors za RFC, ekwatagana mu ntegeeza. Okugezesa ebifaananyi eby'amangu ku SwiftUI kiri ~2022 embeera y'omulembe, emanyiddwa ennyo pointfreeco/swift-snapshot-testing. Vortex ekozesa enkyusa entono ey’omunda okwewala okwesigama.
testing.h3_a: Ebigezo bya Kotlin: JVM-byokka nga biyita mu `./gradlew test`; instrumented via `./gradlew connectedCheck` ku emulator ekola.
testing.h3_b: `./gradlew test` ekola mu sikonda ntono — tewali nkola ya Android yeetaagibwa, JUnit + Hilt-android-testing yokka. Ebigendererwa by’okugezesa yuniti: crypto, abaweereza, okukulukuta okwesigamiziddwa ku coroutine. `./gradlew connectedCheck` ewuuta emulator, n'eteeka app, ekola UI okugezesebwa ng'eyita mu Espresso. E2E ekulukuta: okuyingira → weereza obubaka → laba mu mboozi.
testing.h3_c: Okwawula ebigezo bya JVM byokka okuva ku bigezo ebikozesebwa mu bikozesebwa ye nkola ya Android 2019+. JVM ebigezo biba bya mangu (sekondi); ebigezo ebikozesebwa mu bikozesebwa biba bigenda mpola (eddakiika). Robolectric (2014) yakozesanga okuziba ekituli kino naye okusinga ekyusiddwamu okwawukana kuno mu nkulaakulana ya Android ey’omulembe.
testing.h4_a: Omuwandiisi w’emizannyo avuga kasitoma w’omukutu mu Chrome ne Firefox ezitaliiko mutwe, ng’akola dduyiro wa register entuufu → DM → okuyita okutambula.
testing.h4_b: `playwright-tests/` ekwata embeera mu TypeScript. Node esuulibwa + Postgres ewunyiriza buli kiseera ky'okugezesa okuyita mu docker compose. Ebigezo bivuga omukutu UI: okuwandiisa akawunti bbiri, okuggulawo DM, okuweereza obubaka, okukakasa okutuusa, okukuba essimu ya vidiyo nga olina bendera za `--use-fake-ui-for-media-stream` + `--use-fake-device-for-media-stream` kale Chrome ekola amaloboozi/vidiyo ag'obutonde. Scenarios zitambula mu parallel nga ziyita mu bakozi ba Playwright.
testing.h4_c: Omuwandiisi w’emizannyo (Microsoft, 2020) yasikira Selenium mu kugezesa okusinga ku web E2E kubanga ya mangu, yeesigika, era erina okulongoosa okulungi. WebRTC okugezesa mu browser ezitaliiko mitwe kyali kiruma okutuusa Chrome 69 lwe yayongeddeko bendera z’ebyuma ebicupuli; okuva olwo kifuuse enkola ya standard.

apiSurface.title: API kungulu
apiSurface.subtitle: Buli HTTP enkomerero node gy’ebikkula, nga esengekeddwa mu bibinja okusinziira ku kitundu.
apiSurface.intro: Luno lwe lukalala olw’obuyinza olw’amakubo ag’olukale. Buli kaadi y'enkomerero egaziwa okulaga ekigendererwa, auth tier, okusaba / okuddamu schemas, emmeeza ensobi, n'ekyokulabirako curl. Amakubo g'okulabirira amaka ag'omunda wansi wa `/internal/*` galekebwawo mu nkola.

auth.title: Okukakasa
auth.subtitle: Wewandiise, yingira, zza obuggya, okusazaamu — n'amakubo g'okuzzaawo.
auth.intro: Amakubo gonna wansi wa `/api/authentication/*`. JWT eva mu kuyingira okuwangudde etwala `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: access|refresh}` essiddwako omukono HS256 ku kyama kya node. Okuyingira kumala eddakiika 15, okuzza obuggya ennaku 30.

register.title: POST /api/okukakasa/okuwandiisa
register.subtitle: Tonda omukozesa omupya nga alina X25519 identity + Argon2id password.
register.h1_a: Ekola akawunti y'omukozesa empya era n'efulumya JWT pair esooka. Esiba ekisumuluzo ky'olukale eky'omukozesa ekiwangaala ennyo X25519 ku akawunti okuva ku ssimu esooka ennyo.
register.h1_b: Node ekakasa ennimiro zonna ng'eyita mu Pydantic, ekebera erinnya ly'omukozesa n'enjawulo ya x25519_public_key, eddukanya Argon2id (m=64MiB, t=3, p=4) ku password, eyingiza mu `users`, `user_devices`, `push_subscriptions`, mints access + refresh JWTs.
register.h1_c: Yasindikibwa mu v0.0.1 nga enkomerero esooka. X25519 pubkey parameter yayongerwako mu v0.0.2 oluvannyuma lw’okukimanya nti endagamuntu ne akawunti byetaaga okutondebwawo mu ngeri ya atomu — bwe kitaba ekyo seva eyinza MITM omukozesa wakati wa register n’okuteeka ekisumuluzo ekisooka.
register.h2_a: Yeetaaga: **tewali**. Middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` eyingiza ekkubo lino era egaana ne `401 unauthenticated` singa ekiwandiiko ekyetaagisa kibula oba nga tekituufu.
register.h2_b:
- `tewali` — tekikakasibwa (nga tonnayingira).
- `jwt` — Omusitula JWT akabonero k'okuyingira mu mutwe `Olukusa`.
- `okuzza obuggya` — Omusitula JWT akabonero k'okuzza obuggya.
- `admin` — JWT nga bye yeewozaako birimu `is_admin: true`.
- `peer-signed` — omubiri gw'okusaba ogussiddwako omukono n'ekisumuluzo kya Ed25519 ekya munne eyesigika.
register.h2_c: Omutendera gw'okukakasa gulaga omusingi gw'enkizo entono: enkomerero nga tonnayingira zikoma nnyo ku kutondawo akawunti n'okuzzaawo; buli kimu emabega wa JWT kilaba omukozesa omutuufu; admin endpoints ziraga badge mu UI kale okukozesa obubi kweyolekera.
register.h3_a: JSON omubiri nga gulina erinnya ly'omukozesa + ekigambo ky'okuyingira + x25519_public_key; essimu ey’okwesalirawo (E.164), email (RFC 5322 lite), erinnya_ly’okulaga, avatar_emoji, koodi_okuyita, kyber_public_key.
register.h3_f:
{
  "erinnya ly'omukozesa": "alice", // [a-z0-9_] {3,30}
  "ekigambo ky'okuyita": "...", // ≥ 8 chars
  "x25519_ekisumuluzo_eky'olukale": "<64-hex>", // 32 bytes hex
  "erinnya_ly'okulaga": "Alice", // eky'okwesalirawo
  "essimu": "+15551234567", // eky'okwesalirawo, E.164
  "email": "a@ekyokulabirako.com", // eky'okwesalirawo
  "avatar_emoji": "🦊", // eky'okwesalirawo, 1 emoji
  "invite_code": "...", // eky'okwesalirawo singa INVITE mode
  "kyber_public_key": "<1184 hex>" // eky'okwesalirawo, ku PQ
}
register.h4_a: 201 Yatondebwa ne JWT pair ne canonical profile y'omukozesa omupya.

  "akabonero_okuzza obuggya": "eyJ...", // olunaku 30 TTL

}
register.h5_a: Okukakasa kwa mutindo + okugaana kubiri okukwata ku domain. `409 username_taken` nga erinnya liriwo; `409 pubkey_reused` nga X25519 ekisumuluzo eky'olukale kyawandiisibwa dda ku akawunti endala.

login.title: POST /api/okukakasa/okuyingira
login.subtitle: Kakasa erinnya ly'omukozesa + ekigambo ky'okuyingira, zzaayo JWT pair.
login.h1_a: Awanyisiganya ebiwandiiko ebikakasa ku JWT pair. Ekigambo ky'okuyita kikakasibwa okusinziira ku hash ya Argon2id mu `users.password_hash`. Timing is constant-time ne ku mannya g'abakozesa agatamanyiddwa okuziyiza okubala.
login.h1_b: Etunuulira omukozesa n'erinnya ly'omukozesa ery'ennukuta entono, ekola `argon2.PasswordHasher.verify(eterekeddwa, eweerezeddwa)`. Singa omukozesa taliiwo, akakasa okusinziira ku dummy hash eyabalirirwa nga tennabaawo okwenkanankana obudde. Obuwanguzi → okufulumya JWT + `ebyuma_omukozesa` olunyiriri.
login.h1_c: Eweerezeddwa ne register mu v0.0.1. Constant-time dummy hashing yayongedde mu v0.0.2 oluvannyuma lw’abanoonyereza okulaga okubala ebiseera ku dizayini eyasooka.
login.h2_a: Yeetaaga: **tewali**. Middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` eyingiza ekkubo lino era egaana ne `401 unauthenticated` singa ekiwandiiko ekyetaagisa kibula oba nga tekituufu.
login.h2_b:
- `tewali` — tekikakasibwa (nga tonnayingira).
- `jwt` — Omusitula JWT akabonero k'okuyingira mu mutwe `Olukusa`.
- `okuzza obuggya` — Omusitula JWT akabonero k'okuzza obuggya.
- `admin` — JWT nga bye yeewozaako birimu `is_admin: true`.
- `peer-signed` — omubiri gw'okusaba ogussiddwako omukono n'ekisumuluzo kya Ed25519 ekya munne eyesigika.
login.h2_c: Omutendera gw'okukakasa gulaga omusingi gw'enkizo entono: enkomerero nga tonnayingira zikoma nnyo ku kutondawo akawunti n'okuzzaawo; buli kimu emabega wa JWT kilaba omukozesa omutuufu; admin endpoints ziraga badge mu UI kale okukozesa obubi kweyolekera.
login.h5_a: Standard Vortex ensobi envulopu `{ensobi, embeera, ekkubo}`. `401` ku biwandiiko ebibi; `403` ku nkizo etamala; `422` ku kukakasa; `429` ku kkomo ku miwendo; `5xx` ku nsobi ey'omunda.
login.h5_f:
401 invalid_credentials erinnya ly'omukozesa oba ekigambo ky'okuyita ekibi
401 account_suspended akawunti eyimiriziddwa
401 totp_kyetaagisa okugabira totp era oddemu okugezaako
429 rate_limited >okugezaako 10/eddakiika/IP
login.h6_a: Okuyita okwa bulijjo okwa `POST` mu curl:

refresh.title: POST /api/okukakasa/okuzza obuggya
refresh.subtitle: Suubula ekipya JWT okufuna ekipya JWT.
refresh.intro: Okuzza obuggya akabonero k'okuyingira — auth: **okuzza obuggya**.
refresh.h1_a: Mints a fresh 15-minute access token nga tozzeemu kusaba mukozesa password. Ekozesebwa nga akabonero k'okuyingira akaliwo kali kumpi okuggwaako oba nga kaakazzaayo 401.
refresh.h1_b: Decodes era n'okukakasa akabonero k'okuzza obuggya (omukono, exp, not-revoked), mints okuyingira okupya JWT ne `jti` y'emu. Singa `ROTATE_REFRESH=true`, era efulumya okuzza obuggya okupya.
refresh.h1_c: Agoberera RFC 6749 OAuth 2.0. Okukyusakyusa okuzza obuggya kuzikiddwa mu butonde okwewala emisinde nga bakasitoma abawera bazza obuggya mu kiseera kye kimu.

start.h1_b: Omukwasi w'ekkubo lino abeera mu modulo ekwatagana wansi wa `app/`. Omusono gw'ekkubo `/api/calls/{room_id}/start` gulangirirwa ne `@router.post('/api/calls/{room_id}/start')`.
start.h1_c: Yasindikibwa mu kufulumizibwa kwa Vortex nga bukyali ng'ekitundu ku busobozi bwa `okutandika`.
start.h2_a: Kyetaaga: **jwt**. Middleware `app/security/middleware.py::auth_required` eyingiza ekkubo lino era egaana ne `401 unauthenticated` singa ekiwandiiko ekyetaagisa kibula oba nga tekituufu.
start.h2_b:
- `tewali` — tekikakasibwa (nga tonnayingira).
- `jwt` — Omusitula JWT akabonero k'okuyingira mu mutwe `Olukusa`.
- `okuzza obuggya` — Omusitula JWT akabonero k'okuzza obuggya.
- `admin` — JWT nga bye yeewozaako birimu `is_admin: true`.
- `peer-signed` — omubiri gw'okusaba ogussiddwako omukono n'ekisumuluzo kya Ed25519 ekya munne eyesigika.
start.h2_c: Omutendera gw'okukakasa gulaga omusingi gw'enkizo entono: enkomerero nga tonnayingira zikoma nnyo ku kutondawo akawunti n'okuzzaawo; buli kimu emabega wa JWT kilaba omukozesa omutuufu; admin endpoints ziraga badge mu UI kale okukozesa obubi kweyolekera.
start.h5_a: Standard Vortex ensobi envulopu `{ensobi, embeera, ekkubo}`. `401` ku biwandiiko ebibi; `403` ku nkizo etamala; `422` ku kukakasa; `429` ku kkomo ku miwendo; `5xx` ku nsobi ey'omunda.
start.h5_f:
401 akabonero akabula/akatali kakakafu akatakakasiddwa
403 ezigaaniddwa enkizo etamala
422 validation_error ekiziyiza ky'ennimiro kimenyeddwa
429 rate_limited okugezaako kungi nnyo
500 internal_error ensobi ya seva etasuubirwa

roadmap.title: Enteekateeka y’okukola
roadmap.subtitle: Kiki ekitegekeddwa ne ddi.
roadmap.intro: Okulaba okw’omutindo ogwa waggulu. Ennaku zibeera za kwegomba; ensonga z’ebyokwerinda zisookera ddala okukola kw’ebintu.
roadmap.h1p1: Kyber-768 PQ esobozeseddwa mu butonde ku kussaako okupya.
roadmap.h1p2: Ebibinja ebituuka ku bammemba 50 000 nga balina ekisumuluzo kya Variant-B bifulumya.
roadmap.h1p3: Okupakinga ku mmeeza (Tauri) ku macOS / Windows / Linux.
roadmap.h1p4: Akatale ka Bot kaggulwawo eri abantu bonna okuweereza.
roadmap.h2p1: Ekibiina eky’amaloboozi gokka kiyita abantu abawera 100 nga bayita mu SFU.
roadmap.h2p2: Opus DTX + okubunyisa omulundi gumu + omutindo gwa bitrate ogukyukakyuka.
roadmap.h2p3: Buli eyetabamu mute / kick mu kuyita UI.
roadmap.h3p1: Miro-style collaborative canvas ku CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) okuyita mu layeri y'obubaka.
roadmap.h3p2: Okubeerawo kwa cursor mu kiseera ekituufu.
roadmap.h3p3: Okufulumya ebweru okutuuka ku PNG / SVG / PDF.
roadmap.h4p1: Escrow ku lujegere okugula bot (Solana + EVM).
roadmap.h4p2: Omugabo gw’enyingiza y’abaddukanya emirimu, 10 %% ssente za platform.
roadmap.h4p3: Fiat on/off ramp nga oyita mu Stripe connect.
roadmap.h5p1: Waggulu stabilised, formal security audit, reproducible okuzimba, SemVer frozen.
roadmap.h5p3: Waakiri okwekenneenya okw’ebyokwerinda okwetongodde okumu nga kuwandiikiddwa mu lujjudde.
roadmap.h1_a: v0.2 — okufulumizibwa okw’okubiri mu lujjudde. Kyber PQ ku by default, ebisenge by'olukale ebinene nga biyita mu Variant-B, Tauri desktop packages, akatale ka bot akaggule.
roadmap.h1_b: Kyber-768 esookera ddala ku enabled okuteekebwawo okupya; bakasitoma abatalina buwagizi gracefully downgrade. Ebisenge okutuuka ku bammemba 50 000 nga bayita mu Variant-B key publish — tewali buli mmemba envulopu fanout ku kukyusakyusa. Desktop (Tauri 2 wrapper around the web client) efulumiziddwa ku macOS, Windows, Linux n'ekibinja kye kimu. Akatale ka Bot kaggulwawo eri abantu bonna okuweereza nga kalina okwekenneenya okw’ennaku 3 ez’obusuubuzi SLA.
roadmap.h1_c: v0.2 ekwata ku kulinnyisa ebisookerwako ebiriwo okusinga okuyiiya ebipya. Kyber bulijjo yali ku nteekateeka; okukyusa okudda ku default kisinziira ku kutebenkera wansi w'omugugu. Tauri yalondebwa okusinga Electron kubanga bundle eri ~5 MB vs ~150 MB. Bot marketplace public submissions zazibiddwa ku review infrastructure eyatuuka mu v0.1.
roadmap.h2_a: v0.3 — okuyita mu kibiina. Ebibinja by’amaloboozi ebisinziira ku SFU okutuuka ku 100; ebibinja bya vidiyo okutuuka ku 32; okukyusakyusa mu kiseera kye kimu.
roadmap.h2_b: SFU essiddwa mu nkola mu Rust olw’okukola. Opus DTX + FEC + okuweebwa mu kiseera kye kimu okusobola okuwulira. VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulcast for video nga SFU okulonda buli-mulabi layer okusinziira ku lipoota downlink. Buli eyeetabye mu kusirika n’okusamba okuva ku UI. Okukwata essimu (consent-gated, off by default) kuterekeddwa nga ensirifu wansi w’ekisumuluzo ky’ekikolo kya buli kuyita ekigabanyizibwa mu beetabye.
roadmap.h2_c: Okuyita mu bibinja kye kimu ku bisinga okusabibwa okuva mu v0.1 beta. SFU dizayini egoberera enkola ya Jitsi Videobridge + Janus. Rust okussa mu nkola mu kifo ky'okuddamu okukozesa mediasoup kubanga mediasoup's Node.js runtime eyongera latency gye tutayagala ku kkubo eryokya.
roadmap.h3_a: v0.4 — kanvaasi ey’okukolagana. Miro-style shared board over CRDT (Yjs-flavoured) okuyita mu layeri y'obubaka eriwo.
roadmap.h3_b: CRDT ebiwandiiko sync piggybacks ku bubaka bw'ekisenge obuliwo. Buli board edit ye ​​CRDT operation serialized nga CBOR, encrypted n'ekisumuluzo ky'ekisenge, posted nga obubaka bwa `kind:"board_op"`. Bakasitoma ba deserialise, basaba, bakola. Okubeerawo kwa cursor mu kiseera ekituufu nga oyita mu kika ky'obubaka obw'enjawulo `kind:"board_cursor"`. Okufulumya ebweru ku PNG / SVG / PDF ng'oyita mu kulaga kanvaasi ku ludda lwa kasitoma.
roadmap.h3_c: CRDTs (Shapiro et al. 2011) zafuuka ezisobola okufulumya ne Yjs (Kevin Jahns, 2017). Figma yamanyika nnyo okuzimba enkolagana yaabwe ku kizimbe ekiringa CRDT eky’ennono. Ekirowoozo ky’okuddamu okukozesa layeri yaffe ey’obubaka ensirifu okusinga okuzimba emikutu gya WebSocket egy’enjawulo kiva ku musingi: amakubo g’entambula matono, ebiwuka ebitono.
roadmap.h4_a: v0.5 — okusasula. Escrow eri ku lujegere (Solana + EVM) + fiat on/off ramp ng’oyita mu Stripe Connect.
roadmap.h4_b: Bot okugula route okuyita mu ndagaano ya on-chain escrow. Omuguzi akkirizza; 24 h okuyimirira; olwo ssente zifulumizibwa eri omutunzi nga ziggyiddwako 10 % platform fee. Enkaayana zigenda mu balamuzi b’omukitundu abaalondebwa nga bayita mu kussaako ssente. Fiat on-ramp: Akawunti za Stripe Connect buli muddukanya oba buli mutunzi wa bot; off-ramp: okukyusa obutereevu mu bbanka oba USDC okusasula. Obuwagizi bwa crypto: SOL, USDC, USDT ku byombi Solana ne Ethereum.
roadmap.h4_c: Endagaano za Escrow smart nkadde (OpenBazaar 2016) naye nga zikyali rough okwetoloola empenda mu nsonga za UX. Vortex esikira obuzibu naye akweka ebisinga obungi — abaguzi balaba bbaatuuni ya "gula" emanyiddwa. Ssente za 10 % eza platform zikwatagana n’enkuŋŋaana za App Store (wadde nga Apple etwala 30 %); okusala okwa wansi kukolebwa mu bugenderevu okusikiriza abatunzi.
roadmap.h5_a: v1.0 — okutebenkera. Okubala ebitabo by’ebyokwerinda, okuzimba eziddamu okukolebwa mu mikutu gyonna, SemVer efuuse bbugumu.
roadmap.h5_b: Okubala ebitabo by’ekibiina eky’okusatu kwategekebwa nga 1.0 tennabaawo freeze — kiyinzika okuba nga Trail of Bits oba NCC Group okusinziira ku quotes z’ebyobusuubuzi. Ebizimbe ebiddibwamu kitegeeza nti omuti gw’ensibuko gwe gumu gufulumya binaries ezifaanagana bit ku byuma byonna ebibiri ebizimba; kino kizuula okukyusakyusa mu nkola y’okugaba ebintu. SemVer frozen kitegeeza nti protocols za waya, schema y'okutereka, n'olukale SDK surface bafuna backward-compat guarantees mu 1.x. Bug bounty program etongozebwa ne $25k top tier okukola code okuva ewala ku node.
roadmap.h5_c: Omutendera gwa stabilise-audit-freeze gwe mutindo gwa Signal, Tor, I2P, ne WireGuard byonna bigobererwa. Ebizimbe ebiddamu okukolebwa byafuuka bya bulijjo oluvannyuma lwa pulojekiti ya Reproducible Builds (2014). Vortex ekozesa ekitabo ky’ebikozesebwa ekya Reproducible Builds. Bug bounties za mutindo ku pulojekiti yonna ekwata data y'omukozesa; $25k za mid-tier okusinziira ku mutindo gwa 2025.

v0.2 okutuusa (okutegekeddwa):

  desktop : Tauri 2 ku macOS / Windows / Linux (~ 5 MB) .

  ebibinja bya vidiyo : ≤ 32 abeetabye, VP9 L1/L2/L3 simulcast
