glossary.title: Enkuluze y’ebigambo
glossary.subtitle: Buli kigambo ekikozesebwa mu Vortex docs, ekiwandiikiddwa obulungi.
glossary.intro: Ekiwandiiko ekijuliziddwa mu nnyiriri. Buli kaadi y’ekigambo egaziwa n’efuuka ennyonyola enzijuvu, gye ekozesebwa, ebyafaayo byakyo, n’ensengekera oba ekyokulabirako bwe kiba nga kituufu.

aead.title: AEAD .
aead.subtitle: Ensirifu Enkakasiddwa ne Data Ekwatagana.
aead.intro: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) ye nkola ya cryptographic primitive egatta ebyama n’obutuufu mu kuyita okumu. Nga eweereddwa ekisumuluzo, nonce, plaintext, ne optional associated data (AAD), efulumya ciphertext + authentication tag nga okukyusakyusa kwonna oba plaintext, ciphertext, oba AAD kulemererwa okukakasa.
aead.h1_a: AEAD (Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data) ye nkola ya cryptographic primitive egatta ebyama n’obutuufu mu kuyita okumu. Nga eweereddwa ekisumuluzo, nonce, plaintext, ne optional associated data (AAD), efulumya ciphertext + authentication tag nga okukyusakyusa kwonna oba plaintext, ciphertext, oba AAD kulemererwa okukakasa.
aead.h1_b: Vortex's AEAD bulijjo eba AES-256-GCM. Ekifo kya AAD kitambuza ensonga oyo afuna alina okumanya okusobola okuggya ensirifu mu butuufu (room id, file id, offset). Okusiba AAD kulemesa okuddamu okuzannya cross-context — ekiwandiiko ekikusike okuva mu kisenge A tekiyinza kuggyibwamu nga ekisenge B.
aead.h1_c: AEAD nga erinnya ery’edda ligoberera Rogaway 2002. GCM (Galois/Counter Mode) yateekebwa ku mutindo gwa NIST mu SP 800-38D (2007). Yafuuka AEAD esookerwako mu TLS 1.3 (RFC 8446, 2018). Buli protocol ey’omulembe ey’obukuumi ekozesa AEAD.
aead.h1_f:
AEAD.Enc (k, n, pt, aad) = (ct, tag) // ct = len (pt) bytes, tag = 16 bytes
AEAD.Dec (k, n, ct, tag, aad) = pt oba ⊥

alembic.title: Alembic
alembic.subtitle: Ekintu eky'okusenguka database ekya SQLAlchemy.
alembic.intro: Alembic ye nkola y'okusenguka ey'ennono eya SQLAlchemy. Buli kusenguka ye fayiro ya Python erimu emirimu gya `upgrade()` ne `downgrade()` egitegeeza enkyukakyuka za schema nga SQL oba ORM emirimu.
alembic.h1_a: Alembic ye nkola y'okusenguka ey'ennono eya SQLAlchemy. Buli kusenguka ye fayiro ya Python erimu emirimu gya `upgrade()` ne `downgrade()` egitegeeza enkyukakyuka za schema nga SQL oba ORM emirimu.
alembic.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa Alembic n’ebyafaayo by’okuddamu okutunula mu layini (tewali matabi). `alembic upgrade head` eddukira ku buli Docker container etandika. `alembic downgrade -1` ezzaawo omutendera gumu okudda emabega. Dev mode ekozesa `create_all + ALTER TABLE fallback` kale okuddiŋŋana okw'omu kitundu tekyetaaga kusenguka ku buli rebase.
alembic.h1_c: Alembic yawandiikibwa Mike Bayer (omuwandiisi wa SQLAlchemy) mu 2011 ng'omusika wa `sqlalchemy-migrate`. Django’s built-in migrations (2014) yeewola enkola enkulu. Alembic yasigala mu maaso ku bikozesebwa — rollback, autogenerate, branching — wadde nga Vortex tekozesa matabi.
alembic.h1_f:
alembic/enkyusa/ .
  20240101_<okuddamu okutunula>_<slug>.py buli emu n'okulongoosa () / okukka ()

apns.title: APNs
apns.subtitle: Apple Empeereza y'okumanyisa okusika.
apns.intro: APNs ye mpeereza ya Apple ey’okumanyisa abantu ku iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Apps ziwandiisa device token era abagaba baweereza notification payloads ku APNs ekiziwanguza ku byuma.
apns.h1_a: APNs ye mpeereza ya Apple ey’okumanyisa abantu ku iOS, iPadOS, macOS, watchOS, tvOS. Apps ziwandiisa device token era abagaba baweereza notification payloads ku APNs ekiziwanguza ku byuma.
apns.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa APNs ezirina envulopu ezisiddwako akabonero: node esiba buli payload y'okumanyisa ku pubkey y'oyo afuna X25519; APNs zilaba blob etali ya bulambulukufu yokka. Notification Service Extension ya kasitoma wa iOS eggyamu mu nkola ey’enjawulo nga banner tennakola.
apns.h1_c: APNs zatongozebwa ne iOS 3.0 (2009). Obuwagizi bw’ebirimu ebisiddwako akabonero / ebikyukakyuka bwajja ne iOS 10 (2016). Token-based auth (.p8) yadda mu kifo kya certificate-based auth nga default mu 2016. Vortex ekozesa token auth ne tokens z'omugabi ez'eddakiika 60.
apns.h3_a: FCM, Web Push, okusika okussiddwako akabonero, Okugaziya Empeereza y'Okumanyisa

argon2id.title: Argon2id
argon2id.subtitle: Hash y’ekigambo ky’okuyita ekizibu eky’okujjukira (RFC 9106).
argon2id.intro: Argon2id ye nkola ya memory-hard, side-channel-resistant password hashing omulimu. Parameters: obunene bw’okujjukira (m), omuwendo gw’obudde (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), n’obuwanvu bwa hash. Enkyukakyuka ya 'id' etabula ebiyita ebitali bya data (Argon2i) n'ebiyita ebitali bya data (Argon2d).
argon2id.h1_a: Argon2id ye nkola ya memory-hard, side-channel-resistant password hashing omulimu. Parameters: obunene bw’okujjukira (m), omuwendo gw’obudde (iterations, t), parallelism (lanes, p), n’obuwanvu bwa hash. Enkyukakyuka ya 'id' etabula ebiyita ebitali bya data (Argon2i) n'ebiyita ebitali bya data (Argon2d).
argon2id.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa Argon2id nga m=64MiB, t=3, p=4, hashLen=32. Kino kitwala ~0.5 s ku iPhone X (ekyuma kyaffe ekisinga okuwanirirwa) ne roughly 5 ms ku ASIC ey’omulembe — 100× speedup tefaayo bw’ogeraageranya ne SHA-256-based hashes nga ASICs ziwangula obukadde n’obukadde.
argon2id.h1_c: Argon2 yawangula empaka za Password Hashing Competition eza 2015 ezaategekebwa Dmitry Khovratovich ne Alex Biryukov. Yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 9106 mu 2021. Ekozesebwa 1Password, Bitwarden, LastPass. Vortex's parameters ziva mu OWASP 2023 okuteesa.
argon2id.h1_f:
Argon2id (ekigambo ky'okuyita, omunnyo, m, t, p, hashLen) → hash
ekisookerwako: m = 64MiB, t = 3, p = 4, hashLen = 32
zigula ≈ 0.5s ku iPhone X; ~5ms ku ASIC (100× omulumbaganyi okusitula sipiidi)
argon2id.h3_a: okukozesa ebigambo by’okuyingira, AEAD, HKDF, omunnyo

blake3.title: BLAKE3 .
blake3.subtitle: Hash ya cryptographic ey’amangu.
blake3.intro: BLAKE3 ye nkola ya hash eya cryptographic evudde ku BLAKE2 ne BLAKE. Efulumya ebifulumizibwa eby’obuwanvu obw’okwegomba okuva mu kuyingizibwa okw’okwegomba; 10× mangu okusinga SHA-256 ku blobs ennene olw'okusiba emiti egy'omunda.
blake3.h1_a: BLAKE3 ye nkola ya hash eya cryptographic evudde ku BLAKE2 ne BLAKE. Efulumya ebifulumizibwa eby’obuwanvu obw’okwegomba okuva mu kuyingizibwa okw’okwegomba; 10× mangu okusinga SHA-256 ku blobs ennene olw'okusiba emiti egy'omunda.
blake3.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa BLAKE3 ku bulongoofu bwa fayiro: buli fayiro etekeddwa ku mukutu etambuza hash ya `plain_blake3` ey'ebirimu byayo ebikubiddwa basobole okukakasa oluvannyuma lw'okuwanula + okuggya. Ennyiriri DB mu byafaayo zituumiddwa `sha256` olw'okukwatagana kw'okusenguka naye nga zirimu ebifulumizibwa BLAKE3.
blake3.h1_c: BLAKE3 yafulumizibwa Jack O’Connor et al. mu 2020. Yava mu BLAKE, eyali SHA-3 finalist mu 2012. Enteekateeka y’okusiba emiti ereka BLAKE3 okugerageranya n’emisingi olw’ebiyingizibwa ebinene. SHA-256 ekyanguwa ku biyingizibwa ebitonotono; BLAKE3 efuga ku kintu kyonna > 4 KiB.
blake3.h1_f:
BLAKE3(bytes) = 32 bytes // ebifulumizibwa ebisookerwako
BLAKE3(bytes, len) = bytes za len (XOF) .
okuyita mu: ~3 GB/s ku Apple Silicon vs SHA-256 ~500 MB/s
blake3.h2_a: `vortex_chat` Rust okugaziya, iOS `VortexCrypto.Blake3Hasher`, Enkola ya Android `eky'okukozesa mu kukola emirimu egy'enjawulo.

bmp.title: BMP .
bmp.subtitle: Enkola ya Mailbox eya Muzibe.
bmp.intro: BMP ye layeri ya Vortex etamanyiddwa mannya ey’okutereka n’okugenda mu maaso. Abasindika bateeka blobs ezikubiddwa ensirifu ku node yonna esobozesa olugambo, nga zisumuluddwa hash ey’engeri emu eya pubkey y’oyo afuna. Blobs ride gossip okutuusa nga node y'oyo afuna esika.
bmp.h1_a: BMP ye layeri ya Vortex etamanyiddwa mannya ey’okutereka n’okugenda mu maaso. Abasindika bateeka blobs ezikubiddwa ensirifu ku node yonna esobozesa olugambo, nga zisumuluddwa hash ey’engeri emu eya pubkey y’oyo afuna. Blobs ride gossip okutuusa nga node y'oyo afuna esika.
bmp.h1_b: BMP egaba eby’ekyama bisatu ebyetongodde: okukweka omusindika (TLS + obutungulu obw’okwesalirawo), okukweka omuweereza (mailbox_id is opaque to middle nodes), content-hiding (blob is already E2E-encrypted). Max blob 1 MB, buli node cap 500 MB, omuwendo gw’okutereka 10/eddakiika/IP, TTL 7200 s.
bmp.h1_c: BMP yategekebwa okuva ku ntandikwa nga ttiimu ya Vortex. Twagizimba kubanga tewali mubaka mukulu yali mwetegefu kusasula ssente za yinginiya ez’okukweka metadata okuva ku nkomerero okutuuka ku nkomerero — zisiba ebirimu naye ne bafulumya graph y’embeera z’abantu. Ennyiriri zaffe okuva ku lunaku olusooka yali nti omubaka ow’obukuumi akulukuta ani-ayogera-na-ani alina obukuumi kitundu kyokka. BMP eggalawo ekitundu ekyo ng’efuula omusindika, omuweereza, n’ebirimu okwetongodde obutatangaala, waggulu w’akatimba k’olugambo ka Vortex yennyini okusinga ebikozesebwa ebisiddwako obuuma.
bmp.h3_a: olugambo, okuweereza obutungulu, omusindika assiddwako akabonero, Ekidiba

cbor.title: CBOR .
cbor.subtitle: Okukiikirira Ebintu Ebibiri mu Bufunze.
cbor.intro: CBOR (RFC 8949) ye nkola ya data ya binary ekoleddwa ku sayizi ya koodi entono n'okuwandiika enkodi ez'amangu. Superset ya JSON's data model, binary-encoded, strictly deterministic.
cbor.h1_a: CBOR (RFC 8949) ye nkola ya data ya binary ekoleddwa ku sayizi ya koodi entono n'okuwandiika enkodi ez'amangu. Superset ya JSON's data model, binary-encoded, strictly deterministic.
cbor.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa CBOR nga enkola ya payload munda mu AES-GCM envulopu. ~30 % entono okusinga JSON ku mboozi ezirimu unicode; strict parsing (tewali whitespace ambiguity) eziyiza enlumba za parser-enjawulo; schema-free kale okugattako ennimiro tekyetaagisa kuddamu kukungaanya .proto.
cbor.h1_c: CBOR yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 7049 mu 2013, n’etereezebwa okutuuka ku RFC 8949 mu 2020. Ekozesebwa Signal (internal framing okuva mu 2017), Matrix’s state-resolution layer, WebAuthn (ebintu ebikakasa). Yalondebwa Vortex mu v0.0.2 oluvannyuma lw’okugeraageranya ku JSON ne protobuf.
cbor.h1_f:
CBOR encoding: {ekika_ekinene (bits 3), ensonga (bits 5), [data]}
maapu: ekika=5 babiri
array: ekika=4 ebintu
ekiwandiiko: ekika=3 bytes
bytes: ekika=2 embisi
cbor.h2_a: Buli nvulopu y’obubaka, buli payload essiddwako akabonero, buli nvulopu ya federo.

controller.title: Omufuzi w’emirimu
controller.subtitle: Vortex's okukakasa + empeereza y'okuzuula.
controller.intro: Omufuzi ye nkola ya Python eyawukana (`vortex_controller`) ng'omulimu gwayo gwokka kwe kufulumya manifesito eriko omukono (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) ne URL z'okuyingiza. Bakasitoma ba pin ku controller's Ed25519 pubkey mu kiseera ky'okufulumya.
controller.h1_a: Omufuzi ye nkola ya Python eyawukana (`vortex_controller`) ng'omulimu gwayo gwokka kwe kufulumya manifesito eriko omukono (`INTEGRITY.sig.json`) ne URL z'okuyingiza. Bakasitoma ba pin ku controller's Ed25519 pubkey mu kiseera ky'okufulumya.
controller.h1_b: Eraga akatundu akatono aka API (~amakubo 12). Ekitundu ekifunda kigenderere — kye kigendererwa ky’okulumba eky’omuwendo ogusinga obunene oluvannyuma lwa bakasitoma pin. Endabirwamu zikola koodi y’emu nga zirina ekisumuluzo kye kimu eky’okufulumya; DNS/SNS/IPFS okufulumya enkalala z’endabirwamu.
controller.h1_c: Yatongozebwa mu v0.0.3 oluvannyuma lw'enkyusa ya monolith eyasooka okusiba okukakasa kwa node ku node yennyini (node ​​eyali ekoseddwa eyinza okulimba ku koodi yaayo). Okugabanya obukakafu mu nkola ey'enjawulo eyakoppa Debian's Release.gpg + Chrome's root store.
controller.h3_a: integrity manifest, okufulumya ekisumuluzo, endabirwamu, trusted_nodes

doubleRatchet.title: Ratchet ya mirundi ebiri
doubleRatchet.subtitle: Signal's per-DM enkola y'ekyama mu maaso.
doubleRatchet.intro: Double Ratchet egatta Ratchet ya Diffie-Hellman n’olujegere lw’ebisumuluzo ebikwatagana. Buli bubaka bugenda mu maaso n’olujegere lwabwo; periodic DH ratchets ziddamu okusumulula ekikolo. Etuusa ebyama eby'omu maaso (obubaka obwayita tebulina bulabe oluvannyuma lw'okukkaanya) n'obukuumi oluvannyuma lw'okukkaanya (obubaka obw'omu maaso tebulina bulabe oluvannyuma lw'okuddamu okukuba).
doubleRatchet.h1_a: Double Ratchet egatta Ratchet ya Diffie-Hellman n’olujegere lw’ebisumuluzo ebikwatagana. Buli bubaka bugenda mu maaso n’olujegere lwabwo; periodic DH ratchets ziddamu okusumulula ekikolo. Etuusa ebyama eby'omu maaso (obubaka obwayita tebulina bulabe oluvannyuma lw'okukkaanya) n'obukuumi oluvannyuma lw'okukkaanya (obubaka obw'omu maaso tebulina bulabe oluvannyuma lw'okuddamu okukuba).
doubleRatchet.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa Double Ratchet ku njegere z’obubaka obutereevu. Ebisenge by’ekibinja bikozesa enkola ennyangu ey’ekisumuluzo ky’omusindika ekisumuluddwa okuva ku kikolo ky’ekisenge. Obuwanvu bw'olujegere bwakoma ku bubaka 1000 nga tebunnawalirizibwa kuddamu kukola ratchet; skipped-key cache okutuuka ku bubaka 1000 obutali mu nkola; okusiba omutwe ku by default.
doubleRatchet.h1_c: Yakolebwa Trevor Perrin ne Moxie Marlinspike mu 2013; yassibwa mu nkola ya Signal 2014; eyatwalibwa WhatsApp (2016), Emboozi ez’ekyama ku Facebook, Emboozi ez’ekyama ku Skype. Public spec 2016. Okussa mu nkola kwa Vortex mwalo gwa butereevu.
doubleRatchet.h1_f:
olujegere lw'okusindika: CK_sindika → HKDF(CK_sindika, "omutendera") → CK_sindika'.
                    MK → HKDF(CK_okuweereza, "obubaka")
olujegere lw'okufuna: CK_recv → HKDF(CK_recv, "omutendera") → CK_recv'.
DH ratchet: RK, CK = HKDF(DH(eph yaffe, eph yaabwe), RK_eyasooka)
doubleRatchet.h3_a: ebyama mu maaso, obukuumi oluvannyuma lw’okukkaanya, X25519 .

ech.title: ECH .
ech.subtitle: Kasitoma Ensirifu Mbalamusizza (RFC 9460).
ech.intro: ECH ekweka SNI (Okulaga Erinnya lya Seva) ku TLS 1.3 ng’azinga ClientHello ey’omunda munda mu ClientHello ey’ebweru essiddwa wansi w’ekisumuluzo eky’olukale ekifulumiziddwa mu likoda ya DNS HTTPS.
ech.h1_a: ECH ekweka SNI (Okulaga Erinnya lya Seva) ku TLS 1.3 ng’azinga ClientHello ey’omunda munda mu ClientHello ey’ebweru essiddwa wansi w’ekisumuluzo eky’olukale ekifulumiziddwa mu likoda ya DNS HTTPS.
ech.h1_b: Vortex nodes zifulumya ECHConfigs mu biwandiiko byabwe DNS HTTPS. Bakasitoma abalina obuwagizi bwa ECH bakozesa erinnya ly'omukozi ery'ebweru (e.g. `vortex-public.cloudflare.com`) nga SNI erabika; abatunuulizi abataliiko kye bakola balaba erinnya eryo ery’ebweru erya bulijjo lyokka. DPI tasobola kumanya kasitoma wa Vortex okuva ku kasitoma omulala yenna Cloudflare.
ech.h1_c: ECH yayita mu bbago 5 IETF nga tannateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 9460 mu 2024. Enjawulo ezasooka: ESNI (2018-2019, esuuliddwa), ECH ebbago-00 okutuuka ku bbago-13 (2020-2024). Chrome yasobozesa ECH nga bwe kyali mu 2023; Firefox mu 2024. Vortex egiwagira okuva ku v0.0.9.
ech.h1_f:
ebweru SNI: "public.cloudflare.com" ← erabika eri abatunuulizi
munda SNI: "node.vortex.ekyokulabirako" ← ekikusike
ECHConfig: efulumiziddwa mu DNS HTTPS likoda y’ekitundu eky’ebweru
ech.h3_a: TLS 1.3, DoH, SNI, okutunula mu maaso g’ekitundu

ed25519.title: Ed25519
ed25519.subtitle: Omukono gwa EdDSA ku edwards25519 (RFC 8032).
ed25519.intro: Ed25519 ye nteekateeka y’omukono gwa elliptic-curve. Ebisumuluzo by’olukale ebya byte 32, emikono gya byte 64, emikono egy’okusalawo nga bwe busookerwako. Okukakasa okw’amangu (~200 μs ku CPU ey’omulembe), okukakasibwa mu kibinja.
ed25519.h1_a: Ed25519 ye nteekateeka y’omukono gwa elliptic-curve. Ebisumuluzo by’olukale ebya byte 32, emikono gya byte 64, emikono egy’okusalawo nga bwe busookerwako. Okukakasa okw’amangu (~200 μs ku CPU ey’omulembe), okukakasibwa mu kibinja.
ed25519.h1_b: Vortex assa omukono ku buli envulopu ya federo, buli integrity manifest, buli node attestation, ne buli bubaka bwa bot ne Ed25519. CryptoKit ya Apple ku iOS 17+ ekozesa enkyukakyuka ya RFC 8032bis eya randomized; Vortex akiriza oba — omukakasa yenna akwatagana n’amateeka akwata byombi.
ed25519.h1_c: Ed25519 yafulumizibwa Bernstein, Duif, Lange, Schwabe, Yang mu 2011. Yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 8032 mu 2017. Yakkirizibwa OpenSSH 6.5 (2014), TLS 1.3, Apple Keychain, signal-protocol. Okussa omukono ku deterministic kwalondebwa mu bulambulukufu okusinga ECDSA okwewala ECDSA RNG-reuse vulnerability class.
ed25519.h1_f:
Akabonero (d, m): r = SHA-512(d ∥ m) .
              R = r · G
              c = SHA-512(R ∥ A ∥ m) .
              S = r + c · a
              okudda (R, S) .
Kakasa: c = SHA-512 (R ∥ A ∥ m);  R + c·A ≟ S·G
ed25519.h3_a: X25519, ECDSA, omukono, okwekuuma mu maaso

fanout.title: Fan-out
fanout.subtitle: Okuweereza omukolo okuva ku nsonda emu eri abawandiise bangi.
fanout.intro: Fan-out ye nkola y’okuzimba nga pulodyusa omu afulumya omukolo ate abaguzi N ne bagufuna. Mu Vortex's WebSocket layer, obubaka bumu POST buleeta N socket sends — emu buli subscriber mu kisenge.
fanout.h1_a: Fan-out ye nkola y’okuzimba nga pulodyusa omu afulumya omukolo ate abaguzi N ne bagufuna. Mu Vortex's WebSocket layer, obubaka bumu POST buleeta N socket sends — emu buli subscriber mu kisenge.
fanout.h1_b: Eteekebwa mu nkola nga buli kisenge set ya WebSocket handles ezikuumibwa asyncio.Lock. Write efuna, ekoppa set, efulumya, olwo n'eddiŋŋana kkopi erindirira `ws.send_bytes(payload)` ne buli socket 1 s timeout. Abaguzi abagenda empola balina ennyiriri za fuleemu 256 nga fuleemu tezinnaba kugwa.
fanout.h1_c: Fan-out edda mu nkola z’okufulumya/okuwandiika mu myaka gya 1980 (POP, TIBCO). Dizayini ez’omulembe (Kafka, Redis pub/sub, NATS) zigerageranya omusono okutuuka ku bukadde n’obukadde bw’abawandiise. Vortex's per-room in-memory fan-out is minimal kubanga tekyetaaga cross-node replication mu mbeera ya single-node; Redis pub/sub ekola mu bibinja bya node eziwera.
fanout.h1_f:
okuweereza ku mpewo (ekisenge_id, payload):
  subs = fanout [ekisenge_id] # O (1) okunoonya dict
  for ws mu snapshot(subs): # koppa okuddiŋŋana mu ngeri ey'obukuumi
      linda ws.send_bytes (omugugu, obudde okuggwaako = 1s)
fanout.h2_a: `app/chats/fanout.py`, ekkubo erisinga okucamula buli bubaka, reaction, okuwandiika ekintu, akabonero k'okuyita.

fcm.title: FCM .
fcm.subtitle: Obubaka mu kire kya Firebase.
fcm.intro: FCM ye mpeereza ya Google ey'okumanyisa abantu okusika ku Android, iOS, web. Yakyusa Google Cloud Messaging enkadde (GCM) mu 2016. Ekkiriza OAuth2 service-account auth.
fcm.h1_a: FCM ye mpeereza ya Google ey'okumanyisa abantu okusika ku Android, iOS, web. Yakyusa Google Cloud Messaging enkadde (GCM) mu 2016. Ekkiriza OAuth2 service-account auth.
fcm.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa FCM mu mbeera ya `data` (si mbeera ya `kumanyisa`) kale FirebaseMessagingService ya app ekola nga etuuse era n'eggyamu omugugu gw'okusika-okusika nga tennasalawo oba kulaga banner. Okuzuukuka okw’okutuusa mu kasirise era kukozesa obubaka bwa data FCM.
fcm.h1_c: FCM yatongozebwa mu 2016 nga edda mu kifo kya GCM. Enkomerero ya legacy HTTP yaggyibwawo mu 2024; Vortex ekozesa enkomerero ya HTTP v1 ne OAuth2. Okukyusakyusa obubonero buli ssaawa kukolebwa mu ngeri ya otomatiki okuyita mu bundled service-account credentials.
fcm.h3_a: APNs, Web Push, okusika okussiddwako akabonero, OAuth2

federation.title: Ekibiina kya Federo
federation.subtitle: Okutuusa obubaka obw’okwesigagana wakati wa Vortex nodes ezeetongodde.
federation.intro: Federation ye nkolagana ey’okwesigagana wakati w’abaddukanya node babiri. Buli emu eyongera ku pubkey ya munne Ed25519 ku mmeeza yaayo eya `federations`. Abakozesa ku node A basobola okuweereza obubaka eri abakozesa ku node B nga bayisa envulopu nga bayita mu `POST /federation/deliver` eriko omukono.
federation.h1_a: Federation ye nkolagana ey’okwesigagana wakati w’abaddukanya node babiri. Buli emu eyongera ku pubkey ya munne Ed25519 ku mmeeza yaayo eya `federations`. Abakozesa ku node A basobola okuweereza obubaka eri abakozesa ku node B nga bayisa envulopu nga bayita mu `POST /federation/deliver` eriko omukono.
federation.h1_b: Opt-in buli omukozi: tewali "node yonna esobola okugatta" default. Okwongera ku peer kyetaagisa ekikolwa kya admin ekissiddwaako omukono gwa operator. Obubinja bw’ebyobulamu (AIMD ±1) buyimiriza federo eri bannaabwe abeeyisa obubi. Outbox retries okulemererwa okutuusa nga exponential backoff okutuuka ku nnaku 14.
federation.h1_c: Federation yali Matrix's killer feature (2014) ate nga tannabaawo XMPP/Jabber (1999). Dizayini ya Vortex eggya mu byombi: envulopu eziriko emikono (Matrix), ennanga z’obwesige ezitegeerekeka (nether — we’re stricter), obubonero bw’ebyobulamu (AIMD okuva ku TCP). Yayongeddeko mu v0.0.5.

fts5.title: FTS5 .
fts5.subtitle: SQLite's full-text-okunoonya emmeeza ya virtual.
fts5.intro: FTS5 ye SQLite ey'omulembe ogw'okutaano ogw'okunoonya ebiwandiiko ebijjuvu. Ekola emmeeza ey'omubiri (virtual table) etereka index eziriko obubonero (tokenised indexes) olw'okubuuza okw'amangu LIKE / MATCH.
fts5.h1_a: FTS5 ye SQLite ey'omulembe ogw'okutaano ogw'okunoonya ebiwandiiko ebijjuvu. Ekola emmeeza ey'omubiri (virtual table) etereka index eziriko obubonero (tokenised indexes) olw'okubuuza okw'amangu LIKE / MATCH.
fts5.h1_b: Vortex endabirwamu obubonero obw'ebiwandiiko ebya bulijjo (obusibiddwa kasitoma nga obutambi obutatangaavu) mu FTS5 emmeeza ey'omubiri kale okunoonya kukuba `O(log n)` mu kifo kya `O(n)` sikaani. Ku kisenge kya Android, FTS4 ekozesebwa ne triggers ezikuuma emmeeza ya virtual nga ekwatagana. Okuteekebwa mu nkola kwa Postgres kukozesa `tsvector` / `tsquery` ku kigendererwa kye kimu.
fts5.h1_c: FTS edda ku SQLite 3.7 (2010). FTS5 yasindikibwa mu SQLite 3.9 (2015). Emanyiddwa nnyo; buli app y’obubaka esooka mu kitundu ku iOS / Android egikozesa. Postgres ebadde ne `tsvector` okuva mu 8.3 (2008).
fts5.h2_a: `app/database.py` (Postgres tsvector), iOS `Okunoonya/impl/Etterekero ly'okunoonya Fts5`, Ekisenge kya Android `@Fts4`.

gossip.title: Gossip
gossip.subtitle: Okuwanyisiganya olukalala lwa bannaabwe buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera wakati wa Vortex nodes.
gossip.intro: Gossip ye nkola ekola bulungi ku bandwidth nga buli node buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera ewanyisiganya okumanya okufunze ne munne random. Ekiseera bwe kigenda kiyitawo buli node ekwatagana ku ndabika y’emu nga tewali dayirekita ya wakati.
gossip.h1_a: Gossip ye nkola ekola bulungi ku bandwidth nga buli node buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera ewanyisiganya okumanya okufunze ne munne random. Ekiseera bwe kigenda kiyitawo buli node ekwatagana ku ndabika y’emu nga tewali dayirekita ya wakati.
gossip.h1_b: Vortex nodes ziyomba buli luvannyuma lwa sikonda 60. Buli kuwaanyisiganya ye 256-bit Bloom filter efunza bannaabwe abamanyiddwa; oludda olulala luddamu nga bannaabwe babula mu ffilta nga kwogasse n’omusengejja gwalwo. Bandwidth eri O(new peers × 32 B), mu bujjuvu eri wansi wa 1 KiB buli round.
gossip.h1_c: Olugambo lwa Bloom-filter lwava ku lupapula lwa Cornell olwa bimodal multicast mu 1998. Apache Cassandra agikozesa ku bwammemba; Bitcoin ey’okutambuza emirimu; IPFS ku DHT okuddaabiriza. Okukwatagana kwa O(log N) kwe kugifuula ey’omugaso eri emikutu eminene.
gossip.h1_f:
okuwanyisiganya(A, B): .
  A → B: omusengejja_A = okuyingiza_byonna (banne_A, k = 5, m = 256)
  B → A: banne_abapya_ku_A = {p ∈ banne_B : p ∉ omusengejja_A}, omusengejja_B
  A aggyamu mu ngeri y’emu
ekkomo ku muwendo: okuwanyisiganya 1 buli munne buli s 30

gravitix.title: Gravitix .
gravitix.subtitle: Vortex's DSL olw'okuwandiika bots.
gravitix.intro: Gravitix lulimi olukwata ku domain olutegekeddwa okuwandiika Vortex bots. Ebikwata ebivugibwa ebibaddewo (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), embeera ezimbiddwamu, boilerplate entono. Ekunganyizibwa okutuuka ku bytecode era n'eddukanyizibwa mu muvvuunuzi ow'omusenyu.
gravitix.h1_a: Gravitix lulimi olukwata ku domain olutegekeddwa okuwandiika Vortex bots. Ebikwata ebivugibwa ebibaddewo (`on /start { emit "hi" }`), embeera ezimbiddwamu, boilerplate entono. Ekunganyizibwa okutuuka ku bytecode era n'eddukanyizibwa mu muvvuunuzi ow'omusenyu.
gravitix.h1_b: Eky’okuddako ku Python SDK. Gravitix bots tezisobola kuyingira mu nkola ya fayiro oba omukutu ogw'okwegomba — Vortex's API surface yokka. Omukung’aanya afulumya bytecode; ekiseera ky'okudduka Rust mu `Gravitix/` kivvuunula. Ebiwandiiko byonna mu ssuula ya Gravitix docs.
gravitix.h1_c: Yakolebwa mu kiseera kya v0.0.6 oluvannyuma lw’okulaba nti koodi ya bot ezisinga yali 80 % SDK boilerplate okwetoloola akatundu akatono ak’ensonga entuufu. A DSL ereka logic okwaka era sandboxes ziteeka mu kabi. Okufaananako mu mwoyo ne Hubot (2011) naye nga kulina sandboxing enkakali n’okugatta Vortex enzaaliranwa.
gravitix.h2_a: `Gravitix/` ekikolo kya repo, ekifo kya koodi ya bot mu `POST /api/bots`.

hkdf.title: HKDF .
hkdf.subtitle: Omulimu gw’okuggya ebisumuluzo ogwesigamiziddwa ku HMAC (RFC 5869).
hkdf.intro: HKDF ye mulimu gw’okuggya ekisumuluzo eky’emitendera ebiri: Extract kunyigiriza ekintu ekisumuluzo ekiyingizibwa mu kisumuluzo ekitali kya bulijjo (PRK); Expand egolola PRK mu output key material ey'obuwanvu bwonna, eyawuddwamu info labels.
hkdf.h1_a: HKDF ye mulimu gw’okuggya ekisumuluzo eky’emitendera ebiri: Extract kunyigiriza ekintu ekisumuluzo ekiyingizibwa mu kisumuluzo ekitali kya bulijjo (PRK); Expand egolola PRK mu output key material ey'obuwanvu bwonna, eyawuddwamu info labels.
hkdf.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa HKDF-SHA256 buli wamu: okwawula X25519 ebyama ebigabanyizibwa mu encryption + MAC + ebisumuluzo by'omutwe, okuggya ebisumuluzo bya fayiro buli kitundu, okuggya ebisumuluzo eby'okutereka okuva mu Argon2id output. Ennyiriri z'amawulire bulijjo zitwala entandikwa y'enkyusa (e.g. "v1:encryption") kale ensengeka y'ebisumuluzo yonna esobola okukyukakyuka nga ekuba v1 → v2.
hkdf.h1_c: Yafulumizibwa Hugo Krawczyk mu EUROCRYPT 2010; standardized nga RFC 5869 omwaka gwe gumu. Ekozesebwa TLS 1.3 ku nteekateeka yaayo, Signal ku Double Ratchet, WireGuard ku bisumuluzo by’olutuula.
hkdf.h1_f:
Ekiggiddwamu: PRK = HMAC-SHA256(omunnyo, IKM)
Gaziya: T (1) = HMAC-SHA256 (PRK, amawulire ∥ 0x01)
          T(i) = HMAC-SHA256(PRK, T(i-1) ∥ amawulire ∥ i) .
          OKM = T(1) ∥ T(2) ∥ ... esaliddwako okutuuka ku len
hkdf.h3_a: HMAC, X25519, AES-GCM, Ensigo ey’emirundi ebiri

hmac.title: HMAC .
hmac.subtitle: Koodi y'okukakasa obubaka eyesigamiziddwa ku hash (RFC 2104).
hmac.intro: HMAC ye nzimba efuula hash yonna eya cryptographic (SHA-256, SHA-512) okufuuka MAC. Ewa obugolokofu n'okukakasa nga eweereddwa ekyama ekigabanyizibwa.
hmac.h1_a: HMAC ye nzimba efuula hash yonna eya cryptographic (SHA-256, SHA-512) okufuuka MAC. Ewa obugolokofu n'okukakasa nga eweereddwa ekyama ekigabanyizibwa.
hmac.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa HMAC-SHA256 mu HKDF, ku mikono gya JWT (HS256), ku sender_pseudo derivation mu bisenge, ne ku coturn TURN credential signing. Okugeraageranya-obudde obutakyukakyuka kwetaagibwa ku ludda lw'okukakasa — `hmac.compare_digest` mu Python.
hmac.h1_c: HMAC yatongozebwa Bellare, Canetti, Krawczyk mu 1996. Yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 2104 (1997) ne FIPS 198 (2002). Yafuuka MAC esookerwako mu TLS, IPsec, SSH. Signal, Matrix, Discord, Slack byonna bikozesa HMAC-SHA256 ku JWT zaabwe ne session tokens.
hmac.h1_f:
HMAC (ekisumuluzo, obubaka) = H ( (ekisumuluzo ⊕ opad) ∥ H ( (ekisumuluzo ⊕ ipad) ∥ obubaka ) )
  awali opad = 0x5c eddiddwamu, ipad = 0x36 eddiddwamu, sayizi ya bulooka ekwatagana ne H
hmac.h2_a: Buli wamu mu crypto stack. Grep ku `hmac_sha256` oba `HKDF`.

ice.title: ICE .
ice.subtitle: Okuteekawo enkolagana ey’okukwatagana (RFC 8445).
ice.intro: ICE ye nkola ya WebRTC ey’okuzuula ekkubo ly’omukutu wakati wa bannaabwe babiri emabega wa NATs. Bannaabwe babala abesimbyewo (host, server-reflexive, relay), babawanyisiganya, era bagezaako babiri babiri okutuusa ng’omu atuuse ku buwanguzi.
ice.h1_a: ICE ye nkola ya WebRTC ey’okuzuula ekkubo ly’omukutu wakati wa bannaabwe babiri emabega wa NATs. Bannaabwe babala abesimbyewo (host, server-reflexive, relay), babawanyisiganya, era bagezaako babiri babiri okutuusa ng’omu atuuse ku buwanguzi.
ice.h1_b: Vortex's node brokers ICE okuwanyisiganya abesimbyewo nga bayita mu WebSocket signalling. coturn egaba STUN (okuzuula srflx) ne TURN (ku relay ng’amakubo ag’obutereevu galemererwa). Ebiwandiiko ebiwangaala HMAC biweebwa buli ssimu.
ice.h1_c: ICE yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 5245 (2010) era n’ezza obuggya nga RFC 8445 (2018). Emabega wa carrier-grade NAT, amakubo ag’obutereevu galemererwa ~15 % ku biseera — TURN relay tekyewalika. WebRTC yafuulibwa ICE eya bulijjo; buli kintu ekikubira essimu ku vidiyo kikikozesa.
ice.h1_f:
abesimbyewo:
  omutegesi : rtp://192.168.1.5:49152 (omu kitundu IP)
  srflx : rtp://203.0.113.5:49152 (STUN-ezuuliddwa okwogera mu lujjudde)
  relay : rtp://turn.vortex:49153 (TURN-ewereddwa relay)
okukebera babiri: STUN Okusaba Okusiba; pair esooka okutuuka ku buwanguzi = esunsuddwa
ice.h3_a: WebRTC, TURN, STUN, okukyuka, NAT okutambula

jwt.title: JWT .
jwt.subtitle: JSON Akabonero k’omukutu (RFC 7519).
jwt.intro: JWT ye nkola ya token entono erimu ebitundu bisatu ebiwandiikiddwa mu base64-url: omutwe, payload (claims), omukono. Ekozesebwa okukakasa olutuula olutaliiko mbeera.
jwt.h1_a: JWT ye nkola ya token entono erimu ebitundu bisatu ebiwandiikiddwa mu base64-url: omutwe, payload (claims), omukono. Ekozesebwa okukakasa olutuula olutaliiko mbeera.
jwt.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa HS256 (HMAC-SHA256) JWTs. Akabonero k'okuyingira katwala `{sub: user_id, jti: device_id, typ: okuyingira, exp}`, eddakiika 15 TTL. Akabonero akazza obuggya `ekika: okuzza obuggya`, 30 d TTL. Yassa omukono ku kyama kya byte 64 okuva mu `.env`. Tewali kwewozaako kwa makulu okusukka user_id.
jwt.h1_c: JWTs zaali za mutindo nga RFC 7519 (2015). OAuth 2.0 yali ebafuula abantu bangi okuva mu 2012. Emyaka kkumi egy’okunenya: okulumba alg-confusion, obutasazaamu. Vortex ekendeeza ku: HS256 yokka (tewali RS/ES kutabulwa), jti eriko ebisumuluzo by'ekyuma (ekyusibwa okuyita mu byuma_omukozesa).
jwt.h1_f:
HEADER.PAYLOAD.SIGNATURE.
omutwe = base64url ({alg: "HS256", ekika: "JWT"})
omugugu = base64url ({sub, jti, ekika, exp})
sig = base64url (HMAC-SHA256 (ekyama, omutwe + "." + omugugu))
jwt.h3_a: HMAC, OAuth 2.0, akabonero k'okuzza obuggya, akabonero k'okuyingira

kyber.title: Kyber-768
kyber.subtitle: Okusiba ebisumuluzo oluvannyuma lwa kwantumu (FIPS 203).
kyber.intro: Kyber-768 (mu butongole ML-KEM-768) ye nkola ya NIST etuukiridde ey’okusiba ebisumuluzo eby’oluvannyuma lwa kwantumu. Ebisumuluzo by’olukale ebya byte 1184, ebiwandiiko ebikusike ebya byte 1088, ebyama ebigabanyizibwa ebya byte 32. Obukuumi bukendeera okutuuka ku Module-LWE, kirowoozebwa nti quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_a: Kyber-768 (mu butongole ML-KEM-768) ye nkola ya NIST etuukiridde ey’okusiba ebisumuluzo eby’oluvannyuma lwa kwantumu. Ebisumuluzo by’olukale ebya byte 1184, ebiwandiiko ebikusike ebya byte 1088, ebyama ebigabanyizibwa ebya byte 32. Obukuumi bukendeera okutuuka ku Module-LWE, kirowoozebwa nti quantum-hard.
kyber.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa Kyber mu ngeri ey'okwesalirawo mu hybrid: `session_key = HKDF(x25519_out ∥ kyber_out, info="session-v1")`. Singa ekitundu kyonna kikwata, olutuula luba terulina bulabe. Opt-in mu v0.1, ku-by-default etegekeddwa ku v0.2. Ebisale: ~2 KB eby’okwongerako buli session okukwatagana mu ngalo; latency etali ya maanyi.
kyber.h1_c: Kyber yali omu ku ~70 ezaaweebwayo mu mpaka za NIST eza PQ (2016). Yalondebwa okuteekebwa ku mutindo mu July 2022; yamalirizibwa nga FIPS 203 mu August 2024. Chrome yasobozesa hybrid Kyber mu TLS 1.3 mu 2024. Signal yagigatta ku protocol yaabwe mu mwaka gwe gumu.
kyber.h1_f:
KeyGen (): (pk ∈ Zq ^ k, sk ∈ Zq ^ k) pk = 1184 B, sk = 2400 B
Encaps (pk): (ct ∈ Zq ^ k, ss ∈ {0,1}256) ct = 1088 B. Okuzimba omubiri (t ∈ Zq ^ k, ss ∈ {0,1}26) ct = 1088 B
Ebisengejja (sk, ct): ss ∈ {0,1}256
hybrid = HKDF (x25519_okufuluma ∥ kyber_okufuluma, "olutuula-v1")
kyber.h2_a: `app / obukuumi / oluvannyuma_quantum.py`, iOS `VortexCrypto.KyberKEM`, Android `crypto / pqc / KyberKEM`.
kyber.h3_a: X25519, HKDF, ekigumira quantum, ekigatta KEM .

mailbox.title: Ekibokisi ky’amabaluwa
mailbox.subtitle: Ekifo ky’okutereka ekiwandiikiddwako endagiriro y’oyo afuna mu BMP.
mailbox.intro: Ebbaluwa ebbaluwa ye abstraction ya BMP eri "ekifo obubaka bw'omuweereza aweereddwa we bulindirira". Emanyiddwa nga `mailbox_id` eya byte 32 eggiddwa mu pubkey y'oyo afuna ng'eyita mu HKDF.
mailbox.h1_a: Ebbaluwa ebbaluwa ye abstraction ya BMP eri "ekifo obubaka bw'omuweereza aweereddwa we bulindirira". Emanyiddwa nga `mailbox_id` eya byte 32 eggiddwa mu pubkey y'oyo afuna ng'eyita mu HKDF.
mailbox.h1_b: Omusindika (amanyi recipient_pubkey) n'oyo afuna (amanyi pubkey ye) bokka be basobola okubala mailbox_id eweereddwa. Ennyiriri ez’omu makkati zilaba ekimanyisa kya byte 32 ekitali kitangaavu kyokka. Buli mailbox erina TTL 7200 s ate storage cap 500 MB buli node.
mailbox.h1_c: Ekigambo kino kiva mu email eya classical. BMP yeewola olugero naye n'afuula mailbox recipient-derived okusinga server-provisioned — tewali "mailbox creation" step, tewali server emanyi ndagiriro ki eziriwo.
mailbox.h1_f:
mailbox_id = HKDF (omuweereza_ekisumuluzo ky'okufulumya, info = "bmp-v1", len = 32)
omusindika yekka (amanyi recipient_pk) ne recipient (amanyi pk ye) be basobola okubala
mailbox.h3_a: BMP, olugambo, HKDF, omusindika assiddwako akabonero

nonce.title: Nonce
nonce.subtitle: Ennamba ekozesebwa omulundi gumu — omuwendo ogukozesebwa omulundi gumu.
nonce.intro: Nonce gwe muwendo ogutalina kuddibwamu wansi w’ekisumuluzo ekiweereddwa. Mu Vortex buli AES-GCM operation ekozesa fresh 96-bit random nonce. Okuddamu okukozesa nonce n'ekisumuluzo kye kimu kisaanyaawo ebyama n'obutuufu — omulumbaganyi alina ebiwandiiko bibiri ebikusike wansi w'ekisumuluzo kye kimu (ekisumuluzo, nonce) asobola okuzzaawo XORs ez'ebiwandiiko ebitaliimu.
nonce.h1_a: Nonce gwe muwendo ogutalina kuddibwamu wansi w’ekisumuluzo ekiweereddwa. Mu Vortex buli AES-GCM operation ekozesa fresh 96-bit random nonce. Okuddamu okukozesa nonce n'ekisumuluzo kye kimu kisaanyaawo ebyama n'obutuufu — omulumbaganyi alina ebiwandiiko bibiri ebikusike wansi w'ekisumuluzo kye kimu (ekisumuluzo, nonce) asobola okuzzaawo XORs ez'ebiwandiiko ebitaliimu.
nonce.h1_b: Vortex ekola nonces ne OS CSPRNG (`ebyama.token_bytes`, `SecRandom`, `java.obukuumi.SecureRandom`). Birthday bound with 96 bits: ~2^32 messages before collision becomes plausible, okusinga nnyo ekisumuluzo kyonna eky'ekisenge kye kilaba mu bulamu bwakyo. Okulondoola okuzibiriza-okuddirira-nonce ku node nga belt-and-suspenders.
nonce.h1_c: Endowooza ya nonce ya dda mu nkola ya cryptography; ekigambo kyennyini kiva mu Lungereza olw'edda "for the once". GCM okuteesa kwa bit 96 kuva mu NIST SP 800-38D. Okumenya kwa Adobe 2013 kwamanyibwa okuzzaawo ebiwandiiko ebitegeerekeka okuva mu nonces eziddiŋŋanwa ku ludda lwa kasitoma RSA.
nonce.h1_f:
P(okutomeragana) ku 109 AES-GCM nonces = ~10−19
birthday bound: okutomeragana okusooka kusuubirwa around 248 nonces buli kisumuluzo
GCM obukuumi: 232 random nonces buli kisumuluzo nga bound tennakendeera
nonce.h2_a: Buli AES-GCM essimu. Counter alondoola mu ngeri ey'okwekuuma mu `app/security/crypto.py`.

ohttp.title: OHTTP .
ohttp.subtitle: Obutafaayo HTTP (RFC 9458).
ohttp.intro: OHTTP ye protocol ya relayed HTTP requests nga tewali ludda lumu lulaba byombi okusaba n'okuddamu. Kasitoma asindika ng’ayita mu relay eggyamu emitwe egy’okuzuula; relay egenda mu maaso okutuuka ku mulyango oguggya ensirifu n’okuddamu.
ohttp.h1_a: OHTTP ye protocol ya relayed HTTP requests nga tewali ludda lumu lulaba byombi okusaba n'okuddamu. Kasitoma asindika ng’ayita mu relay eggyamu emitwe egy’okuzuula; relay egenda mu maaso okutuuka ku mulyango oguggya ensirifu n’okuddamu.
ohttp.h1_b: Vortex ekozesa OHTTP nga Layer-5 stealth fallback. Nga ogattibwa wamu n’obuweereza bw’obutungulu ne BMP, OHTTP kiwa ekkubo erisembayo nga TLS ezibiddwa mu bujjuvu. Relay ye kibiina ekyawuddwamu obwesige (mu ngeri entuufu Cloudflare oba Apple's privacy-relay infrastructure).
ohttp.h1_c: OHTTP yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 9458 mu 2024, nga yawandiikibwa wamu ne Cloudflare, Apple, Mozilla. Apple's iCloud Private Relay (2021) ye OHTTP-okumpi n'okuteekebwa mu nkola nga bukyali. Vortex yayongeddeko OHTTP obuyambi bw'okudda emabega mu v0.0.9.
ohttp.h1_f:
kasitoma → relay: Encrypt_gateway_pub (okusaba) + amawulire agakwata ku nkola ey'ekifuulannenge
relay → gateway: mu maaso, eggyamu emitwe egy’okuzuula kasitoma
omulyango → okuddamu: okuggyamu, enkola, Encrypt_client_pub (okuddamu)
relay → kasitoma: okuddamu mu maaso

onion.title: Empeereza y'obutungulu
onion.subtitle: Tor obuweereza obukwese.
onion.intro: Empeereza y’obutungulu ye mpeereza ya TCP efunibwa okuyita mu nkola ya Tor ey’okusisinkana. Emanyiddwa n’endagiriro y’obutungulu (56-character base32 eya Ed25519 pubkey ku v3). Tewali IP ya lukale, tewali DNS, tewali registry ya wakati.
onion.h1_a: Empeereza y’obutungulu ye mpeereza ya TCP efunibwa okuyita mu nkola ya Tor ey’okusisinkana. Emanyiddwa n’endagiriro y’obutungulu (56-character base32 eya Ed25519 pubkey ku v3). Tewali IP ya lukale, tewali DNS, tewali registry ya wakati.
onion.h1_b: Buli Vortex node yebikkula nga `.obutungulu` nga kwotadde n'enkomerero yaayo eya bulijjo HTTPS. Bakasitoma abalina obuyambi bwa Tor bagwa mu butungulu ng’ebirala byonna biremye. Bandwidth ~10× egenda mpola naye etuukirirwa munda mu network ezikugirwa mu bujjuvu.
onion.h1_c: Empeereza y’obutungulu yava mu Tor 2004 (v1). Yaddamu okuzimbibwa nga v3 onion services mu 2017 nga erina ebisumuluzo bya Ed25519. Ekozesebwa SecureDrop, New York Times, Facebook, ProPublica, ebibiina byonna ebikulu ebimanyi crypto. Signal yayongeddeko okutuusa obutungulu-empeereza mu 2022.
onion.h1_f:
endagiriro = base32 (Ed25519_pubkey ∥ checksum ∥ enkyusa_byte) ∥ ".obutungulu".
          = ennukuta 56 ku butungulu bwa v3
onion.h3_a: Tor, Snowflake, BMP, entambula essiddwako enzigi

prekey.title: Ekisumuluzo ekisookerwako
prekey.subtitle: Ephemeral pubkey efulumiziddwa nga bukyali ku bootstrap ya DMs empya.
prekey.intro: Prekey ye X25519 keypair efulumizibwa ku node nga tebannaba kwetaaga kale abapya abakwatagana ne basobola okutandika emboozi ezikuumibwa awatali kudda n’okudda. Buli mukozesa ateeka ekibinja (ebisumuluzo 10 ebisookerwako nga bwe biba); server ebaweereza nga bwe baagala; client uploads ebisingawo nga wansi.
prekey.h1_a: Prekey ye X25519 keypair efulumizibwa ku node nga tebannaba kwetaaga kale abapya abakwatagana ne basobola okutandika emboozi ezikuumibwa awatali kudda n’okudda. Buli mukozesa ateeka ekibinja (ebisumuluzo 10 ebisookerwako nga bwe biba); server ebaweereza nga bwe baagala; client uploads ebisingawo nga wansi.
prekey.h1_b: Vortex's prekey bundle is signed by the device's long-term identity key kale omulumbaganyi tasobola kuwaanyisiganya prekeys ezijingirire ne bw'aba n'okuyingira ku ddaala lya node. DM empya bakozesa Diffie-Hellman eya round emu ku prekey empya nga Double Ratchet tennayingira.
prekey.h1_c: Ebisumuluzo ebisookerwako biva mu nteekateeka ya Signal eya 2013 protocol design (X3DH). Nga X3DH tennabaawo, encrypted bootstrap yali yeetaaga synchronous roundtrips — kibi ku asynchronous obubaka. Buli mubaka ow’omulembe ow’obukuumi akozesa bootstrap ey’omulembe gwa prekey.
prekey.h1_f:
ekibinja = { .
  endagamuntu_pk, .
  omukono_omukono_prekey_pk, .
  signed_prekey_sig = Ed25519-Sign (endagamuntu_priv, omukono_prekey_pk),
  ebisumuluzo_omulundi gumu: [pk_0, pk_1, ..., pk_9].
}
prekey.h3_a: X25519, Double Ratchet, X3DH, okuwanyisiganya ebisumuluzo

reality.title: Ebituufu
reality.subtitle: TLS-mu-TLS okwefuula entambula ey'okwekweka.
reality.intro: Reality ntambula ya nkukutu eyeefuula TLS okutuuka ku nsibuko ya tekinologiya omunene ddala (mu ngeri entuufu www.microsoft.com). Ebigendererwa by’okukwatagana mu ngalo eby’ebweru Microsoft; okukwatagana mu ngalo okw’omunda kuli Vortex. Active probes ezitunuuliddwa ebweru zifuna forwarded to the real origin kale probing tekulaga kintu kyonna.
reality.h1_a: Reality ntambula ya nkukutu eyeefuula TLS okutuuka ku nsibuko ya tekinologiya omunene ddala (mu ngeri entuufu www.microsoft.com). Ebigendererwa by’okukwatagana mu ngalo eby’ebweru Microsoft; okukwatagana mu ngalo okw’omunda kuli Vortex. Active probes ezitunuuliddwa ebweru zifuna forwarded to the real origin kale probing tekulaga kintu kyonna.
reality.h1_b: Vortex ewagira Reality nga Level-4 pluggable transport. Config eraga ekigendererwa kya masquerade, ID ennyimpi, n'ekisumuluzo eky'olukale Vortex X25519. Server ekakasa bakasitoma abayingira nga ekwatagana ne short-ID; probes ezitakwatagana zifuna eby’okuddamu eby’ensibuko entuufu.
reality.h1_c: Reality yafulumizibwa mu 2022 ng’okuddamu ku Great Firewall ya China okuzuula entambula ezaaliwo emabega ezisinziira ku TLS (V2Ray’s VMess, Trojan). Yatwalibwa XrayCore mu 2023. Vortex yayongera obuwagizi mu v0.0.9.
reality.h1_f:
okukwatagana mu ngalo okw’ebweru: TLS okutuuka ku Microsoft, SNI=www.microsoft.com
munda (bwe kiba nga auth ok): Vortex entambula ku mukutu gwa data
probe response: okuddamu kwa microsoft.com okwa nnamaddala kuweerezeddwa eri omulumbaganyi
                    ⇒ omutunuulizi alaba "yeah, it's microsoft.com" yokka.
reality.h3_a: okukweka, entambula eyinzika okusibirwa, Trojan, VMess

rbac.title: RBAC .
rbac.subtitle: Okufuga Okuyingira okwesigamiziddwa ku mirimu.
rbac.intro: RBAC ye nkola y’okufuga okuyingira ng’olukusa luweebwa emirimu era abakozesa ne baweebwa emirimu. Vortex ekozesa RBAC ez'emitendera esatu buli kisenge: nnannyini > admin > member.
rbac.h1_a: RBAC ye nkola y’okufuga okuyingira ng’olukusa luweebwa emirimu era abakozesa ne baweebwa emirimu. Vortex ekozesa RBAC ez'emitendera esatu buli kisenge: nnannyini > admin > member.
rbac.h1_b: Cascade: bannannyini balina buli admin power nga kwogasse n'obusobozi obw'enjawulo okusazaamu ekisenge oba okukyusa obwannannyini. Admins bayita, bakuba, basirisa, balongoosa ensengeka z'ekisenge. Bammemba baweereza obubaka, bakola, balongoosa obubaka bwabwe. Enkyukakyuka mu mirimu ziwandiikibwa ng’obubaka bw’enkola buli mmemba n’abulaba.
rbac.h1_c: RBAC nga model entongole etandikira ku lupapula lwa NIST olwa 1992 olwa Ferraiolo & Kuhn. Yafuuka mainstream mu enterprise IAM (AWS, Azure) mu myaka gya 2010. Room-level RBAC is standard mu chat products — IRC's ops/eddoboozi/omukozesa (1988), emirimu gya Discord (2015), admin/member/guest wa Slack.
rbac.h1_f:
emirimu: nnannyini ⊃ admin ⊃ mmemba
transfer: nnannyini ateeka new_owner_id → nnannyini mukadde akendeezeddwa ku admin
revoke: admin asobola okukendeeza ku mmemba; nnannyini asobola okukendeeza ku admin
rbac.h2_a: `room_members.role`, ekeberebwa mu buli kkubo ly'okuwandiika ng'eyita mu `app/chats/permissions.py`.

sfu.title: SFU .
sfu.subtitle: Ekitundu ky’Okuweereza Okulonda.
sfu.intro: SFU ye middlebox etabula emikutu mu kuyita mu bibinja. Buli eyeetabye mu mpaka zino assaako omugga gumu; SFU agiweereza abalala. Ekyusa topology ya full-mesh (buli peer encodes N-1 streams) nga scaling eri O(N2).
sfu.h1_a: SFU ye middlebox etabula emikutu mu kuyita mu bibinja. Buli eyeetabye mu mpaka zino assaako omugga gumu; SFU agiweereza abalala. Ekyusa topology ya full-mesh (buli peer encodes N-1 streams) nga scaling eri O(N2).
sfu.h1_b: Vortex's SFU eteekebwa mu nkola mu Rust olw'okukola. Simulcast-aware: buli muntu akubira essimu akwata enkodi z’ebiteeso bisatu mu kiseera kye kimu; the SFU alondawo omutuufu buli mulabi's reported downlink. Ebibinja eby’amaloboozi gokka okutuuka ku bantu 100 abeetabye mu mpaka zino; ebibinja bya vidiyo okutuuka ku 32 (v0.3 roadmap).
sfu.h1_c: SFU ebizimbe byava mu Videobridge ya Jitsi (2013). Nga SFU tennabaawo, okuyita kw’ekibinja WebRTC kwali kwa mutimba mu bujjuvu. Zoom, Google Sisinkana, Jitsi, Okuyita ekibinja kya siginiini byonna bikozesa SFU. Vortex ebibinja eby'amaloboozi byokka ebiweerezeddwa mu v0.0.8.
sfu.h1_f:
full mesh (N peers): buli emu esindika emikutu gya N-1 → O(N2) uplink
SFU (N peers): buli emu esindika 1 stream → O(N) uplink buli munne
simulcast: L1 (wansi) + L2 (wakati) + L3 (waggulu) enkodi ezikwatagana
SFU alonda layer buli mulabi okusinziira ku BWE-reported downlink
sfu.h3_a: WebRTC, okubunyisa omulundi gumu, ICE, TURN

snowflake.title: Ekiwujjo ky’omuzira
snowflake.subtitle: Tor volunteer-relay entambula esukka mu WebRTC.
snowflake.intro: Snowflake ye ntambula ya Tor Project eyitibwa pluggable nga browsers ez’obwannakyewa zikola nga WebRTC relays. Abakozesa bateekamu browser extension era browser yaabwe efuuka relay nga balina tab open.
snowflake.h1_a: Snowflake ye ntambula ya Tor Project eyitibwa pluggable nga browsers ez’obwannakyewa zikola nga WebRTC relays. Abakozesa bateekamu browser extension era browser yaabwe efuuka relay nga balina tab open.
snowflake.h1_b: Vortex ekkiriza Snowflake nga Layer-4 fallback nga TLS n’entambula ezisookerwako zizibiddwa. No infra required on our side — twetaaga Snowflake bridges zokka ezifulumiziddwa mu bifo ebimanyiddwa. Bannakyewa abaddukanya extension eno bawa cover.
snowflake.h1_c: Snowflake yatongozebwa mu 2020 nga Tor Project edda mu kifo kya obfs4 (eyali efuuse fingerprint-able). Entambula ya WebRTC nzibu okuzibira kubanga okukola ekyo kyandimenye amasimu mangi aga vidiyo agakkirizibwa. Vortex yayongedde obuwagizi mu v0.0.9.
snowflake.h1_f:
kasitoma → Omusuubuzi w'omuzira: "Nneetaaga proxy".
broker ekwatagana ne browser ya nnakyewa ekola extension
volunteer → Tor entry: egenda mu maaso entambula ya bakasitoma okusukka WebRTC .
enkizo: WebRTC entambula eri buli wamu; okuziyiza kimenya amasimu ga vidiyo
snowflake.h3_a: Tor, entambula essiddwako enzigi, WebRTC, obfs4

tls13.title: TLS 1.3
tls13.subtitle: Obukuumi bwa layeri y’entambula, enkyusa 1.3 (RFC 8446).
tls13.intro: TLS 1.3 ye nkyusa eriwo kati eya TLS protocol. Eggyawo primitives ezitali za bukuumi (RSA key exchange, CBC MACs, static ECDH), enyanguyiza okukwatagana mu ngalo okutuuka ku lugendo lumu okudda n’okudda, eragira okwekuuma mu maaso.
tls13.h1_a: TLS 1.3 ye nkyusa eriwo kati eya TLS protocol. Eggyawo primitives ezitali za bukuumi (RSA key exchange, CBC MACs, static ECDH), enyanguyiza okukwatagana mu ngalo okutuuka ku lugendo lumu okudda n’okudda, eragira okwekuuma mu maaso.
tls13.h1_b: Buli HTTPS + WSS + omukago gwa federo mu Vortex gukozesa TLS 1.3. Tukwatagana ne ClientHello eya Chrome 120 byte-for-byte kale DPI tesobola kutukuba fingerprint nga abatali ba browser. ECH (ensirifu SNI) elonda okuyingira ng'eyita mu nsengeka ey'ebweru-SNI.
tls13.h1_c: TLS 1.3 yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 8446 mu August 2018 oluvannyuma lw’emyaka 4 n’ebbago 28. Chrome, Firefox, Safari zaasindika obuwagizi mu 2018. Microsoft yabyongera ku Windows mu 2020. Mu 2022 we gwatuukira nga ye yali esinga obungi ku mikutu gya yintaneeti.
tls13.h1_f:
okukwatagana mu ngalo (1-RTT):
  Kasitoma → Seva: KasitomaHello (okugabana_ebisumuluzo, SNI?, ALPN, ...)
  Server → Kasitoma: ServerHello + EncryptedExtensions + Cert + Okukakasa okukakasa + Kiwedde
  Kasitoma → Seva: Emaliriziddwa + Data y'okukozesa
tls13.h2_a: Buli TLS okuyungibwa. Okukwatagana kw'engalo mu `app/transport/stealth_level1.py`.
tls13.h3_a: ECH, TLS engalo, JA4, okwekuuma mu maaso

totp.title: TOTP .
totp.subtitle: Ekigambo ky’Okuyita eky’Omulundi gumu (RFC 6238).
totp.intro: TOTP ye password ey’omulundi gumu eggiddwa mu kyama ekigabanyizibwa n’ekiseera ekiriwo. Ebipimo ebisookerwako: Omutendera gw’obudde ogwa sikonda 30, koodi ya digito 6, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_a: TOTP ye password ey’omulundi gumu eggiddwa mu kyama ekigabanyizibwa n’ekiseera ekiriwo. Ebipimo ebisookerwako: Omutendera gw’obudde ogwa sikonda 30, koodi ya digito 6, SHA-1 HMAC.
totp.h1_b: 2FA ya Vortex ekozesa TOTP n'ebisookerwako RFC. Abakozesa basika QR nga beewandiisa; code ekoleddwa okuva mu Authenticator app yaabwe ekwatagana ne code ya server esuubirwa. Rate-limited to 5 attempts buli ddakiika 5 buli mukozesa.
totp.h1_c: TOTP (RFC 6238, 2011) eya Mark Pei eyazimbibwa ku HOTP (RFC 4226, 2005). Nga ekyo tekinnatuuka, RSA SecurID yakozesanga enkola ey’obwannannyini. Google Omukakasa (2010) yamanyisa abantu TOTP; buli app ya 2FA kati egikozesa.
totp.h1_f:
TOTP(k, t) = HOTP(k, ⌊t / 30⌋) Omuntu w’abantu.
HOTP(k, c) = okusalako( HMAC-SHA1(k, c) ) mod 106
eddirisa: ±1 omutendera gugumiikiriza ku ssaawa skew

turn.title: TURN .
turn.subtitle: Okutambula nga tukozesa Relays okwetoloola NAT (RFC 8656).
turn.intro: TURN ye nkola ey’okutambuza UDP / TCP entambula okuyita mu seva ey’olukale ng’amakubo ag’obutereevu okuva ku bannaabwe galemererwa. Ekozesebwa nga ekkubo ly'okudda emabega nga ICE's host ne server-reflexive candidates tebakola.
turn.h1_a: TURN ye nkola ey’okutambuza UDP / TCP entambula okuyita mu seva ey’olukale ng’amakubo ag’obutereevu okuva ku bannaabwe galemererwa. Ekozesebwa nga ekkubo ly'okudda emabega nga ICE's host ne server-reflexive candidates tebakola.
turn.h1_b: Vortex esindika ekifaananyi kya coturn ne buli node. Ebiwandiiko ebikakasa biba bya kaseera katono (24 h), HMAC-signed, bifulumizibwa buli ssimu. Bwe NAT okutambula kulemererwa — mu ngeri entuufu emabega wa symmetric NAT oba strict firewall — emikutu gyonna egy’okuyita gikulukuta okuyita mu TURN.
turn.h1_c: TURN yasooka kuteekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 5766 (2010), n’etereezebwa okutuuka ku RFC 8656 (2020). Ekozesebwa buli WebRTC deployment ku ~15 % y'okuyita amakubo obutereevu we galemererwa. coturn ye nkola ey'okussa mu nkola ey'ensibuko enzigule ey'okujuliza.
turn.h1_f:
username = "{okuggwaako_unix}:{id_omukozesa}".
password = base64 (HMAC-SHA1 (ekyama_eky'omuweereza, erinnya ly'omukozesa))
TTL = essaawa 24
coturn ekakasa HMAC ku buli AUTH; agaana oluvannyuma lw’okuggwaako

vapid.title: VAPID .
vapid.subtitle: Okuzuula Seva y'Okusaba okw'Obwannakyewa (RFC 8292).
vapid.intro: VAPID ye bisumuluzo bibiri ebya Ed25519 seva y’enkola gy’ekozesa okwemanyisa abagaba Web Push. Emalawo ekibuuzo "ani akkirizibwa okusindika push" ku kuteeka mu nkola Web Push.
vapid.h1_a: VAPID ye bisumuluzo bibiri ebya Ed25519 seva y’enkola gy’ekozesa okwemanyisa abagaba Web Push. Emalawo ekibuuzo "ani akkirizibwa okusindika push" ku kuteeka mu nkola Web Push.
vapid.h1_b: Vortex's web client awandiika ku Web Push ng'akozesa ekisumuluzo kya node VAPID eky'olukale. Payloads zisibirwa n'ekisumuluzo eky'enjawulo ekya sealed-push (p256dh) buli subscription. Okuzimbulukuka: ekisumuluzo kya VAPID kiwangaala naye emigugu egy’omukono girina okuggwaako okumpi mu ngeri ya JWT.
vapid.h1_c: VAPID yateekebwa ku mutindo nga RFC 8292 mu 2017. Nga VAPID tennabaawo, Web Push yali yeetaaga oba FCM-brokered subscriptions oba enkola ey'enjawulo ey'okukakasa. VAPID kyanguyiza okuteeka mu nkola okwekyaza — tewali pulojekiti ya Firebase yeetaagibwa.
vapid.h2_a: `app/services/sealed_push.py::web_push`, efulumiziddwa okuyita mu controller `/v1/health` okuzuula obulwadde.
vapid.h3_a: Web Push, okusika okussiddwako akabonero, Ed25519, JWT

waf.title: WAF .
waf.subtitle: Firewall y’okukozesa Web.
waf.intro: WAF ye middleware eyeekenneenya HTTP okusaba n'okuziyiza enkola ezimanyiddwa-ez'obulabe (SQL empiso, okuyita mu kkubo, empiso ya template) nga tezinnatuuka ku koodi y'okukozesa.
waf.h1_a: WAF ye middleware eyeekenneenya HTTP okusaba n'okuziyiza enkola ezimanyiddwa-ez'obulabe (SQL empiso, okuyita mu kkubo, empiso ya template) nga tezinnatuuka ku koodi y'okukozesa.
waf.h1_b: Vortex's WAF ekola nga `app/obukuumi/middleware.py::WAFMiddleware`. ~50 regex ekebera ku URL, okubuuza, omubiri. Ebiziyiza `UNION SELECT`, `../`, `{{ config }}`, `$wa`, ebifaananyi ebimanyiddwa XSS. Era essa mu nkola ekkomo ku muwendo gw’ensi yonna (1000 req/s), ekkomo ku buli kkubo (okuyingira 10/min, register 5/min), ekkomo ku buli mukozesa.
waf.h1_c: WAFs zitandikira ku mod_security (2002). Cloudflare's WAF (2014) yafuula omusono guno ogw'ebyamaguzi. Buli nkola ya web ey’omulembe esindika ekibinja ky’okukebera ekisookerwako. Olukalala lwa Vortex olwa regex lwakunganyizibwa okuva mu OWASP Top 10 signatures.
waf.h1_f:
ku buli kusaba:
  ku pattern mu SQLI_PATTERNS: singa pattern.search (url + okubuuza + omubiri): gaana
  ku pattern mu TRAVERSAL: singa pattern.search(url): gaana
  ku pattern mu TEMPLATE: singa pattern.search(omubiri): gaana
rate-limit keyed nga (IP, ekkubo, user_id)
waf.h3_a: okussa ekkomo ku miwendo, ekiwandiiko ky’okubala ebitabo, OWASP, SQL empiso

x25519.title: X25519 .
x25519.subtitle: Enkulungo-enkulungo Diffie-Hellman ku kikonde25519 (RFC 7748).
x25519.intro: X25519 ye Diffie-Hellman eya elliptic-curve ku Curve25519 mu ngeri yaayo eya Montgomery. Ebisumuluzo eby’obwannannyini n’eby’olukale ebya byte 32, ebyama ebigabanyizibwa bya byte 32. Ekozesebwa okukkaanya ebikulu.
x25519.h1_a: X25519 ye Diffie-Hellman eya elliptic-curve ku Curve25519 mu ngeri yaayo eya Montgomery. Ebisumuluzo eby’obwannannyini n’eby’olukale ebya byte 32, ebyama ebigabanyizibwa bya byte 32. Ekozesebwa okukkaanya ebikulu.
x25519.h1_b: Buli ndagamuntu y’ekyuma ekitakyuka, buli kisumuluzo ky’olutuula eky’akaseera obuseera, buli kuwandiika okusindikiddwa mu Vortex kukozesa X25519. Okussa mu nkola Montgomery-ladder is constant-time era immune eri kiraasi y’okulumba ku side-channel okwatawaanya curves ezasooka.
x25519.h1_c: Curve25519 yafulumizibwa Bernstein (2005); omutindo nga RFC 7748 (2016) n’erinnya X25519 ku nkyukakyuka ya DH. Yatwalibwa nga Signal, WhatsApp, OpenSSH, WireGuard, Apple iMessage, Chrome (omugatte ogw’oluvannyuma lwa quantum). Esangibwa buli wamu mu nkola ey’omulembe ey’okuwandiika ebikusike.
x25519.h1_f:
ekisumuluzo eky’ekyama: a ∈ [0, 2255) (32 bytes little-endian, clamped)
ekisumuluzo eky’olukale: A = a · G (ekifo ekinyigirizibwa ekya byte 32) .
egabanyizibwa: s = a · B = b · A (bayiti 32, → okuyingiza HKDF)
omulimu: ~100 μs buli DH ku iPhone 11

websocketFanout.title: WebSocket fan-out ebintu eby’omunda
websocketFanout.subtitle: Engeri node emu gy’etuusa omukolo eri enkumi n’enkumi z’abawandiise.
websocketFanout.what: WebSocket fan-out ye Python-native set ya subscriber handles buli kisenge. Obubaka bwe buba POSTed, omusindika fan-out addiŋŋana set era n’ateeka ennyiriri mu fuleemu esengekeddwa ku nnyiriri z’okusindika buli muwandiisi.
websocketFanout.why: Fan-out yeewala omuwendo gwa N-copy ogw'okuweereza ku mpewo: okuggya ensirifu emu ku ludda lw'omusindika, fuleemu emu eya serialized, N send-queue pushes. Buli kusika kuba O(1); omuwendo gw'okukoppa gusindikibwa ku kernel mu kiseera kya `send()` nga kiyita mu zero-copy buffers nga OS eziwagira.
websocketFanout.where: Eteekeddwa mu nkola mu `app/chats/fanout.py`. Omutendera ogw'oku ntikko `FanoutRegistry` gukwata `dict [ekisenge_id, set [WebSocket]]`. Ebiwandiiko by'okuwandiisa bikuumibwa `asyncio.Lock`; ebisoma biba bifaananyi ebitaliiko kkufulu.
websocketFanout.how: Ku bubaka POST router eyita `linda fanout.broadcast(ekisenge_id, payload_bytes)`. Enkola ekoppa ekiteekeddwa wansi w'ekizibiti, n'efulumya, olwo n'eddiŋŋana kkopi erindirira `ws.send_bytes(payload)` n'ekiseera ekiggwaako ekya sikonda emu buli socket. Sockets eziwedde obudde ziwandiikibwako obubonero obubi era nga zirongooseddwa.
websocketFanout.when: Buli bubaka, reaction, read-receipt, typing indicator, call signal, n’okukyusakyusa ekisumuluzo ky’ekisenge bikulukuta okuyita mu fan-out eno y’emu. Sayizi ya fuleemu ekoma ku 64 KiB; payloads ennene zigaanibwa ne ziddizibwa eri oyo akubidde essimu nga ziyita mu HTTP.
websocketFanout.cfg1: `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE=256` — buli muntu awandiika obuziba bw'ennyiriri. Overflow esuula fuleemu esinga obukadde.
websocketFanout.cfg2: `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS=1000` — ensalosalo eya waggulu ku `sindika_bytes`. Okusukka kiraga nti socket embi.
websocketFanout.cfg3: `FANOUT_MAX_ROOM_SIZE=10000` — egaana fan-out ku bisenge ebinene okusinga kino. Ebisenge ebinene bikozesa channel mode ne pull pattern mu kifo ky’ekyo.
websocketFanout.fail1: Slow consumer — buli socket ennyiriri ejjula. Fuleemu ezisinga obukadde zagwa. Kasitoma akwata okuyita mu `since` ku reconnect.
websocketFanout.fail2: Socket enfu — `send_bytes` esitula `OmukagoGgale`. Dispatcher aggyawo ku set n'agenda mu maaso.
websocketFanout.fail3: Bursty producer — singa producer aba > 5× mangu okusinga aggregate consumer bandwidth, back-pressure kicks in via `alinda` okuyimiriza omusindika.
websocketFanout.fail4: Memory blow-up — ennyiriri ya buli muntu awandiika ekoma ku fuleemu 256; ku 64 KiB buli emu eyo eri 16 MiB max buli mukozesa empola. Omukozesa adduse ajja kuggyibwako omukutu gwa liveness check nga tannakuba ceiling eyo.
websocketFanout.mon1: Prometheus gauge `vortex_fanout_queue_depth{ekisenge,omukozesa}` — buli socket obuziba bw'ennyiriri.
websocketFanout.mon2: Counter `vortex_fanout_drops_total{reason}` — fuleemu ezisuuliddwa olw'ensonga (okujjula, ekiseera ekiwedde, kiggaddwa).
websocketFanout.tune1: Situla `FANOUT_QUEUE_SIZE` eri bakasitoma ku mikutu egy'empola naye nga ginywevu.
websocketFanout.tune2: Wansi `FANOUT_SEND_TIMEOUT_MS` mu bibinja eby'okukaayana okw'amaanyi nga sockets empola zifa enjala endala.
websocketFanout.tune3: Ebisenge ebinene byawulamu ebisenge ebitonotono oba bikyuse ku channel mode nga olina pull-based updates.
websocketFanout.edge1: Ebintu ebibaawo mu kukyusakyusa ekisenge (`type:"k"`) bisindikibwa n'ekiseera kya s 2 mu kifo kya s 1 kubanga bakasitoma balina okuddamu okuyingiza ebisumuluzo nga tebannakkiriza bubaka bulala.
websocketFanout.edge2: Ebibaddewo mu kuwandiika tebiddamu kugezesebwa — okufiirwa "omukozesa yayimiriza okuwandiika" tekirina bulabe.
websocketFanout.edge3: Okulongoosa mu kubeerawo kusengekebwa: enkyukakyuka z’okubeerawo kw’abakozesa eziwera mu ddirisa lye limu erya 250 ms zigatta mu fuleemu emu.
websocketFanout.mig1: v0.0 ekozesebwa buli kisenge `asyncio.Queue`s — ekyusiddwa mu v0.0.5 n'enkola ya kkufulu-okukoppa-okuddiŋŋana olw'obubaka obwa wansi CPU.
websocketFanout.mig2: Ebiseera eby'omu maaso: Redis bw'ebaawo, fan-out ejja kwagala pub/sub kale ebibinja by'ennyingo eziwera bikoppa ebibaddewo awatali mesh fan-out.
websocketFanout.ts1: High drop rate: kebera omukutu eri omukozesa agenda empola; obunene bw’ennyiriri z’okubuuka; okunoonyereza ku nneeyisa ya bakasitoma.
websocketFanout.ts2: Obudde obw’okusindika obw’amaanyi: kiyinzika okuba nga TLS okuddamu okuteesa kugenda mu maaso oba NAT ekiseera ky’okutambula ekiwedde; kebera ebiwandiiko bya kernel okulaba TCP okuddamu okutambuza.
websocketFanout.ts3: Memory creep: kebera `vortex_fanout_queue_depth` buli mukozesa; ssaako akabonero ku mukozesa yenna alina obuziba obutakyukakyuka > 200 nga kasitoma ayinza okuba nga agenda mpola oba ow'obulabe.
websocketFanout.faq1: Q: Kiki ekibaawo singa kasitoma asubwa frames mu kiseera ky’okukutuka? A: Eddamu okukwatagana ne `since=<last_seen_id>` era seva eddamu okuzannya okuva ku DB. Fan-out esinga kufuba mu kiseera ekituufu; okuwangaala kubeera mu DB.
websocketFanout.faq2: Q: Omukozesa omubi asobola okukendeeza ku fan-out? A: Bakendeeza ku nnyiriri zaabwe, ezijjuza, ezisuula fuleemu, n’okuzikutula. Tewali kuyingirira kwa cross-subscriber.
websocketFanout.faq3: Q: Nkola ntya okulongoosa mu kutuusa kw’omukozesa yennyini? A: `GET /api/admin/debug/fanout/{user_id}` esuula obuziba bwabwe obw'ennyiriri, akabonero k'ekiseera akasembayo okusindika, n'okugwa gye buvuddeko.

nonceManagement.title: Nonce okuddukanya emirimu
nonceManagement.subtitle: Engeri Vortex gy'ekuuma AES-GCM nonces ez'enjawulo mu byuma byonna, ebisenge, n'okuddamu okutandika.
nonceManagement.what: Buli nkola ya AES-GCM etwala nonce ya byte 12 nti MUST ebeere ya njawulo ku kisumuluzo ekiweereddwa. Okuddamu okukozesa nonce n’ekisumuluzo kye kimu kisaanyaawo byombi eby’ekyama n’obutuufu — omulumbaganyi alina ebiwandiiko bibiri ebikusike wansi w’ekimu (ekisumuluzo, nonce) asobola okuzzaawo ekiwandiiko ekitegeerekeka XOR.
nonceManagement.why: Vortex ekola ekisumuluzo ky’ekisenge kimu era n’ekikozesa enkumi n’enkumi z’obubaka. A compromised nonce across obubaka bubiri yandivuddemu plaintext. Nonces zonna n’olwekyo zikolebwa ne OS CSPRNG ku bits 96 — ekitundu ekikuumiddwa-obukuumi ku mazaalibwa kiri nga 2^32 obubaka buli kisumuluzo, okusinga nnyo ekisumuluzo kyonna ekimu kye kijja okusiba.
nonceManagement.where: Omulembe gwa nonce ku ludda lwa kasitoma gubeera mu `VortexCrypto` (iOS), `crypto/aead` module (Android), `app.security.crypto.aes_gcm_encrypt` (node). Node era ekola okukebera okw’okwekuuma okukoppa-obutabaawo.
nonceManagement.how: Omutendera ku mutendera: kasitoma akola bytes 12 ezitali za bulijjo, ayita mu AES-GCM encrypt, akola frame ku ciphertext nga `{ciphertext, nonce}` ne POSTs. Node ewandiika `(room_id, nonce)` mu kifo ekitereka LRU ekiri mu jjukira ekinene okutuuka ku biwandiiko 10^6. Ku POST, node ekebera cache — okukoppa ⇒ 400 `okukoppa_nonce`. Wansi w'enkozesa eya bulijjo kino tekikuba masasi (P(collision) ku bubaka 10^9 kiri ~10^-19).
nonceManagement.when: Ku buli kusindika. Receiver-side: tewali nonce check — AES-GCM's tag ekwata obulungi. Singa nonce somehow repeated, decrypt eyookubiri yandibadde ekyatuuka ku buwanguzi naye ebyama byandibadde mu kabi.
nonceManagement.cfg1: `NONCE_CACHE_SIZE=1000000` — omuwendo gwa nonces ezisembyeyo okulondoolebwa buli node.
nonceManagement.cfg2: `NONCE_CACHE_TTL_S=86400` — ebiyingiziddwa ebikadde bigobeddwa oluvannyuma lwa 24 h (ebisumuluzo ebisinga bikyukakyuka mu ssaawa mu ngeri yonna).
nonceManagement.fail1: RNG okulemererwa ku kasitoma — ekitali kya bulijjo nnyo ne OS-eweereddwa CSPRNG. Tetuddayo ku RNG ezitali za cryptographic.
nonceManagement.fail2: Cache miss ku node restart — ekkirizibwa kubanga cache ye defence-mu-buziba; clients never legitimately reuse nonces kale okusubwa teggulawo ddirisa lya kulumba.
nonceManagement.mon2: Gauge `vortex_nonce_cache_size` — yandibadde enywevu okwetoloola cache cap.
nonceManagement.tune1: Ebisenge ebinene: okwongera ku sayizi ya cache okubikka amadirisa amawanvu agakyukakyuka.
nonceManagement.tune2: Ebibinja by'ennyiriri eziwera: okugabana cache okuyita mu Redis nga eriwo.
nonceManagement.edge1: Kasitoma atali ku mutimbagano okuddamu okuyungibwa n'obubaka obuteekeddwa mu nnyiriri: buli bubaka obuteekeddwa mu nnyiriri butambuza nonce yaayo eya random. Tekyetaagisa kukwatagana.
nonceManagement.edge2: Okusindika ebyuma ebingi: ebyuma byombi bikola nonces ezeetongodde ezitali za bulijjo. P(okutomeragana) ku byuma 2 × obubaka 10 ^ 4 = obutafaayo.
nonceManagement.mig1: v0.0 mu bufunze yakozesa counter-based nonces seeded ne device id — deprecated oluvannyuma lw'olupapula okulaga cross-device okutomeragana wansi wa clock-skew. Random-96 kati lye kkubo lyokka ery’omukisa.
nonceManagement.ts1: Laba `duplicate_nonce` okugaana: kebera kasitoma oba buggy RNG; kebera ensibuko ya entropy y'ekyuma.
nonceManagement.ts2: Cache OOM: kebera obunene bwa cache okusinziira ku muwendo gw'okuwandiika mu kisenge; oba okulinnyisa sayizi oba wansi TTL.
nonceManagement.faq1: Q: Watya singa bakasitoma babiri balondawo nonce y’emu mu butanwa? A: Ku bits 96 ez’obutafaanagana, okutomeragana okusooka okusuubirwa mu bakozesa bonna kuli ku bubaka ~2^48 — obulamu bungi obw’okukozesa Vortex. Singa kyaliwo, node yandigaanyi eyookubiri.
nonceManagement.faq2: Q: Lwaki bits 96 so si 128? A: AES-GCM's standard obuwanvu bwa nonce. Bits 96 nazo zikekkereza bytes 4 buli bubaka.

keyRotation.title: Okukyusakyusa ebisumuluzo
keyRotation.subtitle: Ddi n’engeri ebisumuluzo by’ekisenge, ekyuma, n’okusumulula gye biyiringisibwa.
keyRotation.what: Buli kisumuluzo ekiwangaala mu Vortex kikyuka ku nteekateeka oba ku trigger. Ebisumuluzo by’ekisenge bikyukakyuka ku kukyuka kw’obwammemba oba buli luvannyuma lwa kiseera (buli wiiki). Ebisumuluzo by'ekyuma bikyukakyuka buli omukozesa gw'alonda. Ebisumuluzo by’okusumulula bikyukakyuka nga kiteeberezebwa nti waliwo okukkaanya.
keyRotation.why: Okuzimbulukuka kussa ekkomo ku radius y’okubwatuka kw’okukkaanya. Ekisumuluzo ky'ekisenge ekibbiddwa okuva eggulo kikomye okuggya obubaka bwa leero. Ekisumuluzo ky’okufulumya ekyabbibwa okuva mu 2024 kikoma okukakasa ebifulumizibwa mu 2026.
keyRotation.where: `app/keys/` erimu enzikiriziganya y'okukyusakyusa ku ludda lwa seva. Oludda lwa kasitoma: `ios/.../Ebisumuluzo/impl/RoomKeyProvider.swift`, `android/.../ebisumuluzo/impl/RoomKeyProvider.kt`.
keyRotation.how: Room rotation: admin yenna asobola okusitula; okukyusakyusa okwa bulijjo ku luwummula kuba kwa otomatiki. Rotator efuna ekikolo ekipya ekya byte 32, eddaamu envulopu ku bammemba abasigadde, eteeka `POST /api/rooms/{id}/rotate` ne envulopu empya. Node etereeza mu ngeri ya atomu `room_keys` era n'eweereza ku mpewo `{type:"k"}`.
keyRotation.when: Room: ku leave, ku admin trigger, buli luvannyuma lwa nnaku 7 automatically. Ekyuma: buli luvannyuma lwa nnaku 90 nga bwekiba (configurable). Okufulumya: ad-hoc ku kuteeberezebwa okukkaanya.
keyRotation.cfg3: `ROTATE_ON_LEAVE=true` — ggyako okubuuka okukyusakyusa ku luwummula (ekendeeza obukuumi ku CPU eya wansi).
keyRotation.fail1: Kasitoma tali ku mutimbagano mu kiseera ky'okukyusakyusa: akwata ku kuyungibwa okuddako. Node stores last 5 rotations kale reconnects bulijjo bafuna envulopu yaabwe.
keyRotation.fail2: Envelope minting race: ba admin babiri bakyukakyuka omulundi gumu. Node ekkiriza ekisooka n’ezzaayo 409 Conflict ku kyokubiri.
keyRotation.mon2: Histogram `vortex_rotation_duration_seconds` — essaawa ya bbugwe buli kuzimbulukuka.
keyRotation.tune1: Ebisenge by'olukale ku bammemba > 1000: kyusa ku Variant-B key publish. Okukyusakyusa mu luwummula kufuuka no-op; bammemba beesiga omukono gwa pubkey ogwateekebwako.
keyRotation.tune2: Ebisenge ebikwatagana n’obudde (e.g. emikutu gy’ensibuko y’amawulire): okukyusakyusa okumpi (buli lunaku oba buli ssaawa).
keyRotation.edge1: Ekisenge kya mmemba omu oluvannyuma lw’abalala bonna okugenda: okukyusakyusa tekyetaagisa naye nga kukyasindikibwa okusobola okukwatagana; lone member befunira envulopu empya.
keyRotation.edge2: Nnannyini ava: obwannannyini bukyusiddwa ne budda ku admin asinga okwegatta; envulopu ya nnannyini yo enkadde esaziddwamu.
keyRotation.mig1: v0.0 yakyusibwakyusibwa ku luwummula lwokka. v0.2 eyongerako okukyukakyuka okw'ekiseera okufugibwa `ROOM_KEY_ROTATION_DAYS`.
keyRotation.ts1: Bakasitoma basibidde mu kuggya ensirifu: kebera emmeeza y’envulopu; okukakasa nti omukolo gw’okukyusakyusa gwalagibwa ku mpewo.
keyRotation.ts2: Okulemererwa okukyusakyusa: ebiseera ebisinga omukutu ku mmemba agenda empola. Ddamu okugezaako okubala okuyingidde mu mutendera gw'okubala ebitabo.
keyRotation.faq1: Q: Okukyusakyusa kuddamu okusiba obubaka obukadde? A: Nedda.Ekiwandiiko ekikadde kisigala wansi w’ekisumuluzo ekikadde; bakasitoma bakuuma ebisumuluzo eby'edda mu cache yaabwe ey'omu kitundu okusobola okuggya ensirifu mu byafaayo.
keyRotation.faq2: Q: Watya singa omukozesa yeegatta n’avaawo mu bwangu emirundi 100? A: Buli kikolwa kikyukakyuka. Ku bisenge ebinene kino kya bbeeyi — tugerageranya-ekkomo ku mikolo gy’obwammemba ku 1/min buli mukozesa.

rateLimiting.title: Okussa ekkomo ku miwendo
rateLimiting.subtitle: Per- IP, buli-mukozesa, buli-kkubo token-bucket limits.
rateLimiting.what: Ekkomo ku miwendo kye kisinga okwekuuma ku kukozesa obubi mu bungi: okuyingira mu ngeri ey’obukambwe, amataba mu kwewandiisa, obubaka obutaliimu, okukoowa okuteeka fayiro.
rateLimiting.why: Awatali kkomo, omukozesa yenna akakasiddwa ayinza okufulumya disiki, okujjuza fan-out, oba brute-force a 4-digit 2FA. Limits za buseere (~10 ns buli check) era zifuula otherwise-trivial attacks mu za bbeeyi.
rateLimiting.where: `app/security/limits.py` ekwata ekikoma. `app/authentication/_helpers.py::_check_auth_rate` ye kizinga ekigonvu eky'amakubo ag'okukakasa.
rateLimiting.how: Token-bucket algorithm buli (obunene, ekisumuluzo). Bucket refills ku rate R, capacity C. Okusaba kutwala akabonero 1. Empty bucket ⇒ 429. Okutereka omulondozi: dict mu jjukira ku node emu; Redis nga `REDIS_URL=...`.
rateLimiting.when: Buli kusaba nga oyita mu WAF middleware. Skip list for static assets n'okukebera ebyobulamu.
rateLimiting.fail1: Omukozesa omutuufu emabega w’okugabana NAT (ofiisi, essomero) akuba buli-IP ekkomo — omukozesa-ayolekedde 429 n’obubaka obw’empisa.
rateLimiting.fail2: Memory blow-up ku huge burst — okukoppa ku 100k ebisumuluzo eby'enjawulo; LRU okugoba abantu.
rateLimiting.mon2: Histogram `vortex_rate_limit_check_duration_seconds` — erina okusigala wansi wa 100 μs.
rateLimiting.tune1: Emabega wa CDN eyambula IP entuufu: teeka `TRUSTED_PROXIES` kale tusoma `X-Forwarded-For`. Bwe kitaba ekyo ebidduka byonna bikuba ekkomo wansi w’okufuluma kwa CDN IP.
rateLimiting.tune2: Bots ez'obuzito obw'amaanyi: ziwa ekisumuluzo kya API nga kiriko `BOT_RATE_OVERRIDE=1000`.
rateLimiting.edge1: IPv6: tukoma ku buli /64 okusinga buli-endagiriro okubala ISP engabanya ennene.
rateLimiting.edge2: Tor exits: tukozesa ekkomo eritali ddene (`TOR_RATE_MULTIPLIER=5`) okwewala okubonereza abakozesa Tor ku kufuluma okugabana.
rateLimiting.mig1: v0.0 yakozesa `slowapi` ne decorator-per-route — ekyaliwo mu v0.0.5 ku middleware esengekeddwa.
rateLimiting.ts1: False-positive 429: kebera proxy config eyesigika, kebera shared-NAT setups, bump scope limit singa traffic entuufu eba ekukuba.
rateLimiting.ts2: Bypassed: okwekenneenya ebiwandiiko by’okuyingira ku batulugunya IP; yongera ku `BLACKLIST_IP=` env var ku bbulooka enzibu.
rateLimiting.faq1: Q: Ekkomo ligabanyizibwamu mu bitundutundu? A: Mu mbeera ya node emu, ensalo ziba za buli node. Nga olina Redis, ekkomo lya nsi yonna mu kibinja kyonna.
rateLimiting.faq2: Q: Nkola ntya ebisingawo ku lwange? A: Abakozesa abakakasibwa basobola okusaba omugabo ogw'oku ntikko nga bayita mu `/api/admin/quota`. Admins bakkiriza case ku musango.

emojiCatalog.title: Katalogu ya Emoji
emojiCatalog.subtitle: Dataset ya 1500-emoji egabanyizibwa mu bakasitoma bonna.
emojiCatalog.what: Vortex esindika emoji set yaayo okusinga okwesigama ku Unicode-version availability. Emojis 1500 ezitegekeddwa mu biti 9 (smileys, abantu, ebisolo, emmere, okutambula, emirimu, ebintu, obubonero, bendera). JSON y’emu ekozesebwa ku iOS (`Emoji/Eby’Obugagga/emoji.json`), Android (`android/app/src/src/main/assets/emoji.json`), ne kasitoma w’omukutu (`static/assets/emoji.json`).
emojiCatalog.why: Consistency: omukozesa asindika 🥹 ku iOS 17 alina okulaga nga 🥹 ku Android 9. Native system emoji diverge across OS versions by 1-3 years, kale tusindika eyaffe okukuuma mapping nga nnywevu.
emojiCatalog.where: `android / app / src / ebikulu / eby'obugagga / emoji.json`, `ios / Modules / Ensonda / Emoji / Ebikozesebwa / emoji.json`, `static / js / chat / emoji-picker.js`.
emojiCatalog.how: JSON ensengeka: `{ekika: [emoji_char, ...]}`. Bakasitoma batikka nga batandika, ne bafuuwa mu index y'okunoonya, ne balaga nga bayita mu LazyVGrid / LazyGrid / CSS grid.
emojiCatalog.when: Ku app start era buli omukozesa lw'aggulawo picker. MRU olukalala lunyweredde mu UserDefaults / SharedPreferences / localStorage.
emojiCatalog.cfg1: Recents cap: 30 ku iOS, 30 ku Android, 20 ku web.
emojiCatalog.cfg2: Ebika bitereezeddwa mu nsengeka — okuddamu okusengeka kumenya ensengeka y’omulonda.
emojiCatalog.fail1: OS y'omukozesa tesobola kulaga emoji: egwa okudda ku `?` glyph. Tulonda codepoints okuva mu Unicode ≤ 15.0 buli OS ey’omulembe gy’ewagira.
emojiCatalog.mon1: Tewali. Ku ludda lwa kasitoma lwokka.
emojiCatalog.tune1: Custom emoji packs: abakozesa basobola okuteeka sticker packs ezeeyisa mu ngeri y’emu naye nga zikola ebifaananyi bya raster.
emojiCatalog.edge1: Enjawulo mu langi y’olususu: katalogu yaffe etereka emojis za base zokka; enjawulo zikolebwa ku ludda lwa kasitoma nga ziyita mu nsengekera za ZWJ.
emojiCatalog.edge2: Emojis za bendera: obubonero obulaga ekitundu; iOS eraga bendera, enkyusa za Android ezimu ziraga ennukuta bbiri.
emojiCatalog.mig1: v0.0 yakozesa emoji.json okuva ku emoji-mart waggulu. v0.0.5 forked okusibira katalogu n'okusala ku 1500 olw'ensonga za bundle-size.
emojiCatalog.ts1: Emoji ezibula: okuddamu okuzimba eby’obugagga; kakasa nti JSON ntuufu; ebyuma ebimu bitereka enkyusa enkadde mu ngeri ey’obukambwe — clear app cache.
emojiCatalog.faq1: Q: Nsobola okwongerako emoji ez’enjawulo? A: Si kuyita mu katalogu. Kozesa obupapula bwa sitiika.

intro.p1: Architex lulimi olulangirira UI oluzimbibwa ku Vortex Mini Apps. Mu kifo ky’okuwandiika JavaScript ekikyusa DOM, onnyonnyola screen gy’oyagala era runtime ekuuma pixels nga zikwatagana ne state automatically.
intro.p2: Olulimi lutono: ebirangiriro bina (@screen, @theme, @import, @for), entandikwa emu ey’enkyukakyuka ezikola (~), n’olujegere olumu olw’omukozi olw’okukola sitayiro (::).
intro.p3: Bw’oba ​​wali owandiise HTML + CSS + JS, Architex ejja kuwulira ng’omanyidde ddala naye ng’erina 10× less boilerplate. Bw’oba ​​tolina, Architex nayo nnyanjula ya gentle mu reactive programming kubanga olulimi lutono nnyo osobola okulukwata byonna mu mutwe.
intro.p4: Buli kitundu ky’ekiwandiiko kino kizimba ku ebyo eby’emabega. Buuka mu wonna w’oyagala bw’oba ​​omanyi dda enkola endala ey’okulangirira UI; soma waggulu okutuuka wansi bw’oba ​​otandise buggya.
intro.li1: Ekirangirira — nnyonnyola enkula ya UI, so si mitendera gy’okugizimba
intro.li2: Reactive — omulimu gumu gutereeza buli label, kiraasi, oba node eyeesigama
intro.li3: Portable — .arx y’emu ekola ku web, iOS, ne Android hosts
intro.li4: Tiny — parser + renderer emmeeri wansi wa 30 KB gzipped
intro.ct1: Architex ekwata ku domain. Tekijja kudda mu kifo kya lulimi lwa kigendererwa kya bulijjo — naye olw’okusindika screen munda mu mboozi kisinga ku nkola yonna gye twapima.
intro.ct2: Buli construct mu lulimi ekola maapu ku runtime primitive emu. Tewali bulogo bw’otosobola kunnyonnyola.

syntax.p1: Buli pulogulaamu ya Architex ezimbiddwa okuva mu birango bina eby’omutendera ogw’oku ntikko: @screen, @theme, @import, @component, nga kwogasse n’omubiri gwa @for ogwa loopu. Buli emu etandikira mu nnyiriri 0; buli kimu ekiyingiziddwa wansi kya bulooka eyo.
syntax.p2: Enkyukakyuka ezikola ziwandiikibwa ~name — entandikwa ya tilde ziziteekako akabonero ng’obutoffaali obulondoolebwa. Soma ne ~name, ssaako ne =, bala ne :=.
syntax.p3: Ebitundu biba bimanyisa eby’obwereere ku layini yaabwe: text, button, image, col, row, n’ebirala. Ensonga yaabwe ey’ekifo ejja amangu ddala nga: text ~message, button "Save".
syntax.p4: Abakyusakyusa bakwata oluvannyuma lwa ::. Osobola okusiba enjegere nga bw’oyagala: :: pad(24) gap(16) center color(#4f8ef7) bold size(20).
syntax.p5: Ebikolwa bibeera oluvannyuma lwa =>. Ekikolwa kimu buli kasaale; olujegere lw’obusaale obungi: button "Buy" => ~busy = true => send(action: "buy") => ~busy = false.

variables.p1: Enkyukakyuka ekola (reactive variable) ekwata omuwendo era etegeeza buli muntu agisoma mu ngeri ey’otoma ng’owandiika omuwendo omupya. Langirira ne =, ddamu okugaba ne =, zza obuggya ne += / -= / *= / /=.
variables.p2: Enkyukakyuka ezibaliriddwa ziggya omuwendo gwazo okuva mu kigambo ekiddamu okwekenneenya buli lwe kiba nti ekiyingizibwa kyonna kikyuka. Langirira ne := mu kifo kya =. Tewali kuwandiika mu ngalo, tewali buzibu bwa muwendo mukadde.
variables.p3: Annotate ekika ne : Type oluvannyuma lw’erinnya. Ebika ebiwagirwa: number, string, boolean, array, object. Ebigambo ebinnyonnyola (annotations) biba bya kwesalirawo; ekika kiteeberezebwa okuva ku muwendo ogusooka.
variables.p4: Kozesa lowerCamelCase oba snake_case; Architex nayo tessa mu nkola. Amannya gakuume nga mampi: screen erimu amannya amawanvu amakumi ayonoona indentation.
variables.p5: Scope: enkyukakyuka ekola erangiriddwa munda mu @screen erabika mu mubiri gwa screen eyo gwokka. @theme obubonero bulabika mu nsi yonna.
variables.p6: Lifecycle: state ewangaala kasita screen eba esimbiddwa. Okutambulira wala kigisaanyaawo; okutambula emabega kiddamu okugitonda ku muwendo ogwasooka.
variables.p7: Okugumiikiriza: okuwangaala okusinga ku screen, kuba send(action: "save", data: ~state) era oleke bot host enywereze.

variables.li3: Ebikwata ku nnyiriri entono: ~count ne ~Count bya njawulo.
variables.li4: Ebigambo ebikulu (on, in, if) biterekeddwa ne bwe biba bimaze ~.

state.p1: Buli katoffaali akakola (reactive cell) kawangaala kasita @screen yaako ezing’amya eba esimbiddwa. Okuggulawo olutimbe kuddukanya ebirangiriro byakyo okuva waggulu okutuuka wansi; okugireka ng’oyita mu back() oba goto() kibasaanyaawo.
state.p2: Bw’oba ​​weetaaga state okuwona okutambulira, kiggye ku host: oba POST ku bot ne send() n’oddamu okuleeta ku open, oba okusigala mu kitundu ng’oyita mu store(key, value) okuyita.
state.p3: Okuddamu okuteekawo: ddamu okugabanya ku muwendo ogwasooka. Tewali kigambo kikulu reset kubanga okuddamu okugaba emirimu kikola dda; obudde bw'okudduka bwawukana era buddamu okulaga ebyo byokka ebyakyuka.
state.p4: Embeera evuddemu ebalwa okuyita mu :=. Architex erondoola ebisinziirwako mu ngeri ey'otoma, kale tobiwandiika mu ngalo. Okulondoola okwesigamizibwa kutuufu ku buli kintu, so si buli kintu.
state.p5: Arrays n’ebintu bigeraageranyizibwa nga bijuliziddwa. Okukaka okuddamu okulaga, ssaawo ensengekera empya / ekintu. Enkyukakyuka y’omukadde ebuusibwa amaaso — okusuubula okugenderere olw’amakulu g’okulongoosa agateeberezebwa.
state.cc1: ~list = [...~list, newItem] // okukaka okuddamu okulaga n'okujuliza ensengekera empya
state.li1: Obunene: obw’omu kitundu okutuuka ku @screen ezizingiramu.
state.li2: Obulamu: okuva ku @screen okuyingira okutuuka okufuluma.
state.li3: Concurrency: buli screen ya thread emu. Ebipya biba bikubiddwa mu microtask emu.

types.p1: Architex erina ebika bitaano ebisookerwako: number, string, boolean, null, n’ekigatta object / array. Ennaku ziyisibwa nga ennyiriri (ISO 8601) oba ennamba (unix ms).
types.p2: Ennamba zino za 64-bit doubles (IEEE 754). Okubala kwa namba enzijuvu okutuuka ku 2^53 kwe kutuufu.
types.p3: Ennyiriri ziri UTF-8; obuwanvu bubala ensonga za koodi, so si bytes. Okuyingiza (interpolation) kukozesa ebisiba ebizitowa (curly braces).
types.p4: Booleans ze true / false. Tewali kukyusa mu ngeri etegeerekeka okuva mu nnyiriri.
types.p5: Arrays ziragirwa, 0-indexed. Okutuuka ku ~arr[0]; obuwanvu nga buyita mu ~arr.length.
types.p6: Ebintu biba maapu za kisumuluzo→omuwendo ezitasengekeddwa. Okutuuka ku ~obj.name oba ~obj["name"].
types.p7: Okukaka: abakozi b’okubala bakaka ennyiriri okutuuka ku namba singa omuguwa gulabika nga gwa namba; bwe kitaba ekyo ensobi y'ekigambo ekusa mu kiseera ky'okudduka.
types.p8: Amazima: emiwendo egy’obulimba giri false, 0, "", null, n’ensengekera / ebintu ekyerere. Ebirala byonna biba bya mazima.

layout.p1: Architex erina ebibya bibiri ddala ebiyinza okukolebwa: col (ebyesimbye) ne row (eby’okwesimbye). Ebirala byonna kitundu kya makoola.
layout.p2: Indent abaana level emu mu buziba okusinga ekintu kyabwe. Tewali tag eggalawo — omusengejja akozesa indentation yokka.
layout.p3: Konteyina zikkiriza gap(px) ku kifo wakati w’abaana, pad(px) ku padding ey’omunda, center okutuuka wakati okuyita ku cross axis, grow okujjuza ekifo ekisigadde ku main axis.
layout.p4: Ebikyusakyusa mu kulaganya biri ku ddaala lya konteyina: center mu col wakati mu bbanga; mu row kibeera wakati mu vertikal. align(left) / align(right) / align(top) / align(bottom) biba bikyusiddwa mu bulambulukufu.
layout.p5: Sizing: by default buli kitundu kikendeera okutuukagana n'ebirimu. Kozesa w(px), h(px), grow, oba maxW(px) / maxH(px) etegeerekeka obulungi okusiba.

modifiers.p1: Ebikyusa bijja oluvannyuma lwa :: era bulijjo biba biyungibwa enjegere. Tewali kiragiro kya kulangirira kujjukira; enkaayana zigonjoola obuwanguzi bw’omuwandiisi obusembayo mu maka.
modifiers.p2: Amaka agalina ebanga: pad(n) (enjuyi zonna), pad(x, y) (okwesimbye, okwesimbye), pad(t, r, b, l) (CSS order), gap(n) (wakati w’abaana), margin(n) (ebweru ku bbali).
