control_flow.p1: Architex terina sitatimenti ya if ku ddaala erya waggulu mu nsengeka. Obukwakkulizo UI bulagibwa okuyita mu bikyusa hidden(~flag) / visible(~flag) oba okuyita mu bigambo eby’okusatu mu miwendo gy’ebitundu.
control_flow.p2: Ternary ekola wonna omuwendo we gukkirizibwa: ensonga y’ekitundu, ensonga y’omukyusa, omuwendo ogubaliriddwa.
control_flow.p3: Ku matabi agasukka mu abiri, ssaako ekisu eky’amatabi asatu. Architex esengejja okuva ku ddyo okudda ku kkono kale okukola ebisu kusoma mu butonde.
control_flow.p4: Ku switch-like logic ku kintu, kozesa computed lookup: ~labels := {home: "Home", settings: "Settings"}; text ~labels[~active].
control_flow.li1: Tewali if block — kozesa modifier oba ternary.
control_flow.li2: Tewali lujegere lwa else if — kozesa ebisu ebisatu.
control_flow.li3: Tewali kukwatagana kwa mutindo — kozesa emmeeza z'okunoonya mu kifo ky'ekyo.
control_flow.li4: Tewali kudda nga bukyali — amatabi ag’obukwakkulizo gwe muwendo, so si sitatimenti.

loops.p1: Ddamu bulooka ya UI buli elementi ne @for item in ~list. Indent omubiri; buli mwana akola omulundi gumu buli elementi.
loops.p2: Siba omuwendo ogwesigamiziddwa ku ziro n’engeri y’amannya abiri: @for item, idx in ~list.
loops.p3: Ekiseera ky'okudduka kirondoola endagamuntu nga elementi yennyini mu butonde. Prepending ku 10 000-row list costs O(1) DOM omulimu — renderer diffs by reference, so si ku kifo.
loops.p4: Ekisu @for mu ddembe. Loopu ez’omunda laba ebisiba loopu ez’ebweru.
loops.p5: Ensengeka y’okuddiŋŋana ye nsengeka y’ensengekera. Okudda emabega, ddiŋŋana okudda emabega okubaliriddwa: ~reversed := [...].reverse().

loops.li2: Omubiri gusobola okubaamu ekitundu kyonna, nga mw’otwalidde n’ekilala @for.
loops.li3: Okwongera / okuggyawo ku nkomerero kya bwereere; diffing kyesigamiziddwa ku ndagamuntu.
loops.li4: Enkalala njereere tezikola kintu kyonna — tewali kifo kya kifo kiterekeddwa.

theme.p1: Bbulooka ya @theme waggulu wa fayiro erangirira obubonero bwa dizayini nga enkyukakyuka ezikola. Omukyusa oba ekitundu kyonna kisobola okuzijuliza ne ~tokenName.
theme.p2: Tokens zifuuka enkyukakyuka za bulijjo ezikola. Okukyusakyusa mu mbeera y’ekizikiza mu kiseera ky’okudduka ye layini ssatu: olutindo ~isDark, leka omulamwa gutegeeze obubonero nga ternaries, era ekitundu kimu toggle kikyusa enkyukakyuka.
theme.p3: Emiramwa egy’ebisu: @screen esobola okukyusa obubonero obw’enjawulo mu bulooka ya @theme ey’omu kitundu. Tokens ezitategeerekese zisikira okuva mu scope ey'ebweru.
theme.cc9: // mode enzikiza nga oyita mu mulamwa oguddamu
theme.li1: Tokens are reactive — okukyusakyusa ekimu kitereeza buli mukozesa.
theme.li2: Tuuma obubonero mu makulu (~danger), so si mu bufunze (~red).
theme.li3: Yagala nnyo obubonero okusinga hex literals ku buli langi ekozesebwa emirundi egisukka mu ebiri.
theme.li4: Radii n’ebanga nabyo byesimbyewo ku mulamwa mulungi — obutakyukakyuka mu screen yonna kulongooka n’obubonero obugabanyizibwa.

imports.h4: Ebintu ebiyingizibwa mu ggwanga mu ngeri ey’enkulungo
imports.p1: @import "./path/to/file.arx" esika buli @component ne @screen okuva mu fayiro eyo mu sikopu eriwo kati. Amakubo gakwatagana ne fayiro eyingiza.
imports.p2: Ebiyingizibwa mu ggwanga tebikola bifo bya mannya. Amannya gatomeragana mu biyingizibwa mu ggwanga — obuwanguzi obusembayo okuyingizibwa. Kuuma amannya g’ebitundu nga ga njawulo.
imports.p3: Okuddamu okutunda ebweru: tewali kigambo kikulu re-export. Okufuula fayiro eya wansi okusikira ebitundu, yingiza eby'okungulu era olangirire screens zo ng'ozijuliza.
imports.p4: Ebiyingizibwa mu nkulungo bizuulibwa mu kiseera ky'okusengejja. Fayiro A eyingiza B eyingiza A ensobi n'ekkubo ly'enzirukanya.

define_comp.p1: Langirira ekitundu ekiyinza okuddamu okukozesebwa ne @component Name param1 param2 .... Munda mu mubiri, parameters ezituumiddwa amannya ziri mu scope nga plain identifiers (nga tezirina ~).
define_comp.p2: Parameters zisobola okuwandiikibwa n'ensengeka y'emu eya : Type. Params ezitawandiikiddwa zikkiriza omuwendo gwonna.
define_comp.p3: slot munda mu mubiri gw’ekitundu obubonero omubiri gw’oyo akubira we guyingira — lowooza React children oba Vue default slot.
define_comp.p4: Ebitundu birongoofu: bwe biweebwa paramita n’ebifo bye bimu, bikola UI y’emu. Embeera y’okuddamu ey’omunda ekkirizibwa naye mu ngeri entuufu ekulukuta okuva mu paramita.
define_comp.p5: Okutuuma amannya: PascalCase kya bulijjo, si kikakasibwa. Avatar, Card, UserRow.

define_comp.li3: Ebitundu bisobola okunnyonnyola enkyukakyuka zaabwe ezikola (reactive variables) ezipimiddwa ku buli kifaananyi.

reactivity.p1: Buli reactive read munda mu computed expression oba modifier argument ewandiisa okwesigamizibwa. Okwesigamira kwonna bwe kukyuka, ekigambo kiddamu okwekenneenya mu microtask eddako.
reactivity.p2: Writes are batched: assignments eziwera munda mu event handler emu zikuba ddala render pass emu ku nkomerero. Eno y’ensonga lwaki => ~a = 1 => ~b = 2 ya buseere ne bw’erina abasomi bangi.
reactivity.p3: Okwenkanankana kukakali (===). Okuwandiika omuwendo gwe gumu tekuddamu kuddukanya kintu kyonna. Okukaka okulongoosa n'ebika by'okujuliza, ssaawo ensengekera oba ekintu ekipya.
reactivity.p4: Enzirukanya mu kwesigama okubaliriddwa (~a := ~b + 1 ne ~b := ~a - 1) zizuulibwa mu kiseera ky’okulangirira era ne ziloopebwa ng’ensobi.
reactivity.p5: Async updates: a send() ezzaayo omuwendo etereeza cell gy'ogaba ekivaamu, nga etegeka render pass nga Promise egonjoddwa.
reactivity.cc3: ~info := "okubala: {~bala}, okukubisaamu emirundi ebiri: {~kubisaamu emirundi ebiri}"  // kisinziira ku byombi
reactivity.cc5: // tap emu ⇒ emu render pass okulongoosa info
reactivity.li1: Fine-grained: ebitundu byokka ebisoma cell ekyusiddwa re-render.
reactivity.li2: Batched: okuwandiika emirundi mingi mu microtask emu ⇒ render emu.
reactivity.li3: Deterministic: ebiyingizibwa bye bimu ⇒ ebifulumizibwa bye bimu, tewali byewuunyisa bya kulagira.
reactivity.li4: Type-safe: ensonga z'abakyusa zikeberebwa mu ngeri okusinziira ku mikono gyazo egyalangiriddwa.

strings.p1: Ennyiriri zijuliziddwa emirundi ebiri: "Hello". Ebijuliziddwa ebimu nabyo bikkirizibwa ku symmetry ne JS.
strings.p2: Okuyingiza (interpolation) kukozesa ebisiba ebikoonagana munda mu lunyiriri: "Hello, {~name}!". Okwolesebwa kwonna kukkirizibwa — obutoffaali, emiwendo egyabalirirwa, okuyita emirimu.
strings.p4: Ennyiriri nnyingi: menya ku layini empya munda mu bijuliziddwa. Ekiseera ky'okudduka kikuuma ekifo ekizungu ddala.
strings.p5: Templating: ku text block erimu interpolation eziwerako, olunyiriri olubaliriddwa lwa idiomatic. Kitereke mu kasenge era okijuliza okuva ku UI.
strings.li1: Ebigambo by’okuyingiza (interpolation expressions) biba bya kuddamu — buli kusoma kulondoola okwesigamizibwa.
strings.li2: Ebisiba ebitolose bikola nga ebisiba ebituufu.
strings.li3: Empty interpolation {} si ntuufu — ensobi z'omusengejja.
strings.li4: Okuyunga kukozesa + (okukaka emiguwa) ku nsonga ennyangu; interpolation esoma bulungi ku template empanvu.

errors.p1: Ensobi za parse zikuba mu kiseera ky'okutikka fayiro. Ekiseera ky'okudduka kitegeeza layini, ennyiriri, n'akabonero. Ebitera okuvaako: indent etakwatagana, = ebula, omukyusa atamanyiddwa, omuguwa ogutaggaddwa.
errors.p2: Ensobi mu kiseera ky’okudduka zikuba omuliro mu kiseera ky’okwekenneenya. Ebisinga biba bya kuddamu — ekigambo kijuliza obutoffaali obutalangiriddwa, oba obutakwatagana bw’ekika mu kubala. Ekiseera ky'okudduka kiwandiika, kiraga bbendera emmyufu ku kusooka, era kibuuka okulongoosa kwa fuleemu eyo.
errors.p3: Ensobi z'omukyusa (omukyusa atamanyiddwa, ekika ky'ensonga ekikyamu) zikwata omuliro mu kiseera ky'okusengejja. Architex ekakanyavu ku bakyusa abatamanyiddwa okukuuma okukwatagana mu maaso.

bestpractices.p1: Architex esasula obwangu. Buli screen ewulikika nga nzibu okusoma osanga erina emu esukkiridde okubeera nesting levels, emu esukkiridde inline ternaries, oba ekitundu kimu ekikola emirimu ebiri.
bestpractices.p2: Bw’oba ​​obuusabuusa, ggyamu. @component eya layini 5 nnyangu oku grok okusinga bbulooka ya layini 30 @screen.
bestpractices.p3: Osinga kwagala ba modifiers okusinga okuzinga. text :: pad(16) esinga okuzinga mu col :: pad(16).
bestpractices.p4: Leka runtime ekole omulimu. Manual hidden flags za buli kintu mu list zibeera za kwonoona — runtime ya diffs dda.
bestpractices.p5: Ebintu bituume amannya g’omusomi, so si mukung’aanya. ~isLoading > ~l.
bestpractices.li1: Wansi wa layini 200 buli screen — yawulwamu singa eba mpanvu
bestpractices.li2: Tegisukka mitendera gya kuzimba bisu 3 — refactor singa giba gya buziba
bestpractices.li3: Tewali kusukka 2 ternaries buli kigambo — kozesa computed
bestpractices.li4: Tewali screen esukka 1 buli fayiro — okuggyako nga eyungiddwa bulungi

forms.p1: Ebiyingizibwa bisiba mu ngeri bbiri ku katoffaali akakola: input ~email. Okuwandiika kulongoosa akasenge; okulongoosa akasenge kulongoosa ennimiro.
forms.p2: Okukakasa ye boolean ebaliriddwa: ~emailOk := ~email.matches("^[^@]+@[^@]+\.[^@]+$"). Kozesa ebikyusa hidden / visible ku biwandiiko ebiraga ensobi.
forms.p3: Submit ye ​​button eyabulijjo erimu ebikolwa ebisibiddwa enjegere. Block submission nga okukakasa kulemererwa okuyita mu disabled(!~formOk).
forms.p4: Okwolesebwa kw'ensobi: kola text oba label ne visible(!~fieldOk) okulaga nga si ntuufu yokka. Siiga color(~danger) okussa essira ku kulaba.
forms.p5: Debouncing: yongera :: debounce(300) okulwawo okukakasa okuyambibwako omukutu okutuusa ng'omukozesa akomye okuwandiika okumala 300 ms.
forms.p6: Ekifo: :: placeholder("...") kiraga akabonero ng’akasenge njereere. Hint ebula ku keystroke esooka.
forms.p7: Ebika by’ebiyingizibwa: plain input ye kiwandiiko; input.email, input.number, input.password, input.tel, input.date okutereeza kiiboodi ne masiki.

animations.p1: Architex ekola obulamu mu ngeri etegeerekeka nga omuwendo ogukola guvuga ekikyusa ennamba oba langi. Enkyukakyuka esookerwako eri 200 ms ease-out. Okukyusa ne :: animate(ms, curve).
animations.p2: Enkyukakyuka z’okuyingira / okufuluma: ennyiriri ezikoleddwa mu bukwakkulizo (hidden / visible) zikola obulamu mu n’okufuluma. Teekateeka ku mutindo ng’oyita mu :: animate.enter(...) ne :: animate.exit(...).
animations.p3: Ebikoona: ease-out (ekisookerwako), ease-in, ease-in-out, linear, spring. Spring etwala ensonga za stiffness ne damping ez’okwesalirawo.
animations.p4: Obubonero: :: draggable ne :: swipeable zigattako ebitegeera obubonero obutuukagana n’omukutu. Gatta ne reactive state okukola animation ku drag.
animations.p5: Entambula ekendedde: omugenyi assa ekitiibwa mu nteekateeka y'okutuuka ku mukozesa. Nga reduced-motion eri ku, animations zikendeera okutuuka wansi wa 100 ms era spring curves zifuuka linear.
animations.cc1: col :: animate (300, okwanguyirwa-okuyingira-okufuluma) bg (~ highlight ? ~ primary : ~ bg)
animations.cc2: button "Tikka" :: animate (150, ensulo) bg (~ busy ? ~ akabi : ~ primary)
animations.cc4: col :: animate.exit (200, okwanguyirwa mu) okukwekebwa (~ okulaga)
animations.li2: Spring curves ziwulira nga za butonde nnyo ku interactive drag.
animations.li3: Host ezikendeeza ku ntambula zifunza buli kimu mu ngeri ey’otoma.
animations.li4: Enkyukakyuka z'okufuluma zilwawo okusumulula okutuusa nga animation ewedde.

network.p1: send(action: "name", ...args) ye bridge eri ku bot host. Omugenyi afuna obubaka JSON RPC, akola, era n'azzaayo ekivaamu.
network.p2: Ekivaamu kiweebwa akatoffaali nga kiyita mu => ~result = it. it ye shorthand y'omuwendo ogudda.
network.p3: Okulemererwa kuvaayo nga ~result.error. Kebera nga tonnasoma ~result.data. Kozesa nested ternaries okutikka / obuwanguzi / embeera z'ensobi.
network.p4: Embeera z’okutikka ze boolean yo: kyusa akasimu ka ~loading nga tonnaba kuyita, kyusa emabega oluvannyuma. Laga ekitundu kya spinner ekiyingiziddwa ku ~loading.
network.p5: Embeera z’empaka: singa omukozesa akola send emirundi ebiri nga ekisooka tekinnagonjoolwa, ekyokubiri awandiika ku kasenge. Okuziyiza, gate ne disabled(~loading).

a11y.p1: Buli kitundu ekikwatagana kisobola okutwala akabonero k’okutuuka ku bantu nga kiyita mu :: a11y("label"). Abasomi ku screen balangirira label ku focus.
a11y.p2: Ensengeka y'okussa essira egoberera ensengeka y'ensibuko nga bwekiba. Override ne :: a11yOrder(n) ku layout ez'enjawulo.
a11y.p3: Dynamic Type: abakyusa ebiwandiiko bagerageranya n'obunene bw'empandiika y'okutuuka ku OS okutuuka ku 200 %% awatali kusala. Ekiseera ky'okudduka kiddamu okuteeka ebidomola ku nnyonyi.
a11y.p4: High-contrast mode: abakyusa abalina ennyuma ezitangaavu bafuna okujjuza okutali kwa maanyi; ensalosalo zikuba okuva ku 1 px okutuuka ku 2 px. Automatic — tewali koodi yeetaagibwa okusukka okussa ekitiibwa mu bubonero bw'omulamwa.
a11y.p5: Okwawukana kwa langi: Omulamwa gwa Vortex ogusookerwako gusisinkana WCAG AA (4.5:1) mu mbeera zombi ez’ekitangaala n’ekizikiza. Emiramwa egy’enjawulo girina okugezesa enjawulo n’ekintu kyonna ekiraga enjawulo ya langi nga tonnasindika.

performance.p1: Reactivity is fine-grained: ebitundu byokka ebisoma cell ekyusiddwa re-render. Tewali kintu kyonna ky'owandiika "ku bwereere" ekivaako okuddamu okulaga omuti mu bujjuvu.
performance.p2: Enkalala z’ebintu enkumi n’enkumi ziri bulungi. Ekiseera ky’okudduka kyawukana okusinziira ku ndagamuntu ya elementi, kale prepending ye O(1). runtime.p1: Ekiseera ky'okudduka ekya Architex ye nkola ya TypeScript efulumiziddwa nga architex. Kirina modulo nnya: lexer, parser, renderer, reactive.
runtime.p2: Lexer asoma source text era n'afulumya tokens. Ye kitundu kyokka ekifaayo ku whitespace — buli modulo eya wansi ekola ku tokens ne AST nodes.
runtime.p3: Omusengejja azimba AST. AST nodes ziwandiikibwa era zisobola okuteekebwa mu lunyiriri kale zisobola okusindikibwa okuyita mu nsalo z’enkola (ez’omugaso mu hot-reload ne remote preview).
runtime.p4: Omulaga atambula ku AST n'ensonga y'okulaga ewereddwa omugenyi (web DOM / SwiftUI bridge / Compose bridge) era n'afulumya okulaba enzaaliranwa.
runtime.p5: Abakyaza bassa mu nkola enkola enfunda: createNode, updateNode, removeNode, nga kwogasse n'okukozesa omukyusa. Okwongerako host empya kitwala layini nga 500 eza koodi ya glue.
runtime.li1: Lexer: amanyi ebifo ebyeru, indent ey’ebifo 2.
runtime.li3: Renderer: atambula AST, ababaka eri omugenyi.
runtime.li4: Reactive: okulondoola okwesigamizibwa okw'otoma + okulongoosa mu bibinja.

migration.p1: Architex egoberera semver. Patch tezimenya kintu kyonna. Abaana abatanneetuuka bongerako ebikozesebwa. Majors basobola okumenya ebintu nga balina eddirisa ly’okukendeeza ku nsimbi ery’emyezi 12.
migration.p2: Ebintu ebitaliiko mugaso bikyagenda mu maaso n’okukola okuyita mu lunyiriri lwonna olutonotono. Ekiseera ky'okudduka kiwandiika okulabula kw'okuggwaawo ku kukozesa okusooka; IDE eraga koodi etakozesebwa.
migration.p3: Forward compat: fayiro eziwandiikiddwa ku nkyusa entono eyasooka bulijjo zikola mu ngeri y'emu ku kiseera ky'okudduka oluvannyuma. Tetukyusakyusa makulu ga retro.
migration.p4: Enkyukakyuka ezimenya zirangirirwa mu kiwandiiko ky'enkyukakyuka n'ebiragiro ebikwata ku kusenguka. Ebikozesebwa mu kusenguka mu ngeri ey’obwengula bikwata ku nkyukakyuka ezisinga obungi ez’ebyuma.
migration.p5: LTS: buli nkyusa enkulu erina eddirisa ly’obuyambi ery’emyezi 24 eritereeza eby’okwerinda ebikulu, ne bwe biba bimaze okukolebwa emmeeri ennene eziddako.

faq.p1: Q: Nsobola okuwandiika app enzijuvu mu Architex? A: Architex ekoleddwa ku Mini Apps — screens ezibeera munda mu mboozi. Ku app enzaaliranwa enzijuvu oyagala SwiftUI / Compose / React.
faq.p2: Q: Kigeraageranyizibwa kitya ku Flutter? A: Flutter egazi nnyo naye erina runtime yaayo (Dart VM + Skia). Architex ntono era ekola ku host primitives. Bw’oba ​​weetaaga okusiba ku pulatifomu, Flutter; bw’oba ​​weetaaga okutuuka, Architex.
faq.p3: Q: Lwaki tewali bulooka ya if? A: Kubanga hidden / visible modifiers zibikka 95%% ku UI conditionals mu ngeri enyonjo ennyo. Ku bitundu 5%% ebirala, ebigambo ebisatu bikola.
faq.p4: Q: Architex ya nsibuko nzigule? A: Yee — laba GitHub repo. MIT-layisinsi y'okudduka, tewali miguwa gya patent.
faq.p5: Q: Nsobola okuyita native code? A: Okuyita mu bikolwa byokka ebizimbibwa oba bot send() ebibikkuddwa host. Direct native-bridge mu bugenderevu tewagirwa — yandimenye portability.
faq.p6: Q: Max screen complexity? A: Ekiseera ky’okudduka kikwata bulungi obutoffaali obukola 10 k n’ebintu eby’olukalala 100 k. Okusukka awo, menya mu screen eziwera.
faq.p7: Q: Nsobola okugumiikiriza embeera? A: Yee, okuyita mu store(key, value) (buli Mini-App local) oba send(action: "save") okutuuka ku bot (server-side).
faq.p8: Q: Kikola offline? A: Yee ku screens ezirongoofu-UI. Ekintu kyonna ekiyita send() kyetaaga omukutu.
faq.p9: Q: Nnyongera ntya ekitundu kya custom? A: Oba @component munda mu Architex, oba (bw'oba weetaaga native primitives) waayo ku Architex host package.
faq.p10: Q: Performance overhead vs enzaalwa ewandiikiddwa n’engalo? A: Mu bujjuvu 3-8 %% mpola okusinga SwiftUI / Compose ewandiikiddwa n’engalo. Omuntu-ekitategeerekeka ku screens ezabulijjo.
faq.li1: Max screen: ~10 k cells, ~100 k ebintu eby'olukalala.
faq.li2: Max file: 1 MB .arx ensibuko nga tebannaba kulabula.

gotchas.p1: Architex ekozesa ebifo 2 buli ddaala lya indent. Tabs zigaanibwa mu kiseera ky'okusengejja. IDE ezisinga zikyuka mu ngeri ya otomatiki; bw'olaba ensobi z'okuyingiza ezitasuubirwa, kebera oba waliwo ebifo ebyeru ebitabuddwa.
gotchas.p2: Okuggalawo mu bigambo ebibaliriddwa bisoma obutoffaali obukola mu kiseera ky’okwekenneenya, so si mu kiseera ky’okulangirira. ~a := ~b + 1 bulijjo ekozesa ~b eriwo kati, so si muwendo ku kulangirira.
gotchas.p3: Async send() egaba ku katoffaali nga Ekisuubizo kigonjoddwa, ekiyinza okuba nga tekiri mu nkola singa okusindika okungi kuba mu nnyonyi. Omukuumi nga alina bendera ya ~loading oba ennamba y’omutendera.
gotchas.p4: Ekika ky’okukaka: "5" + 1 yeetegereza okutuuka ku "51", so si 6. Kozesa Number("5") oba wandiika obugambo ku katoffaali nga : number.
gotchas.p5: Ebintu ebikola ebiteekeddwa mu buziba: okukyusa ekintu (~obj.x = 5) tekivaako kulongoosa ku basomi ba ~obj. Ddamu okugaba ekintu kyonna mu kifo ky'ekyo.
gotchas.p6: Ensengeka y'abakyusa mu maka: abakyusa langi bagonjoola last-writer-wins. Tosiba enjegere bbiri color(...) nga osuubira blend.
gotchas.p7: @for omubiri gulina okuyingizibwa mu buziba bwa level emu ddala. Omwana ku mitendera ebiri si nsobi ya parse wabula semantic mis-nest — runtime egitwala nga muganda wa @for.
gotchas.li2: Obutoffaali obukola mu biggalawo busoma omuwendo gwa kasasiro, so si kiseera kya kulangirira.
gotchas.li3: Async send() esobola okugonjoola out of order — omukuumi ne bendera.
gotchas.li4: Ddamu okugaba ebintu/ensengekera okusinga okukyusa ennimiro.
